sections.label: Invocation
sections.name: रहा एक दिन अवधि कर अति आरत पुर लोग

verses.sa:
केकीकण्ठाभनीलं सुरवरविलसद्विप्रपादाब्जचिह्नं ।
शोभाढ्यं पीतवस्त्रं सरसिजनयनं सर्वदा सुप्रसन्नम् ।
पाणौ नाराचचापं कपिनिकरयुतं बन्धुना सेव्यमानं ।
नौमीड्यं जानकीशं रघुवरमनिशं पुष्पकारूढरामम् ॥
verses.tr:
kekīkaṇṭhābhanīlaṃ suravaravilasadviprapādābjacihnaṃ
śobhāḍhyaṃ pītavastraṃ sarasijanayanaṃ sarvadā suprasannam
pāṇau nārācacāpaṃ kapinikarayutaṃ bandhunā sevyamānaṃ
naumīḍyaṃ jānakīśaṃ raghuvaramaniśaṃ puṣpakārūḍharāmam
verses.head: श्लोक

verses.sa:
कोसलेन्द्रपदकञ्जमञ्जुलौ कोमलावजमहेशवन्दितौ ।
जानकीकरसरोजलालितौ चिन्तकस्य मनभृङ्गसड्गिनौ ॥
verses.tr:
kosalendrapadakañjamañjulau komalāvajamaheśavanditau
jānakīkarasarojalālitau cintakasya manabhṛṅgasaḍginau

verses.sa:
कुन्दइन्दुदरगौरसुन्दरं अम्बिकापतिमभीष्टसिद्धिदम् ।
कारुणीककलकञ्जलोचनं नौमि शंकरमनंगमोचनम् ॥
verses.tr:
kundaindudaragaurasundaraṃ ambikāpatimabhīṣṭasiddhidam
kāruṇīkakalakañjalocanaṃ naumi śaṃkaramanaṃgamocanam

verses.sa:
रहा एक दिन अवधि कर अति आरत पुर लोग ।
जहँ तहँ सोचहिं नारि नर कृस तन राम बियोग ॥
verses.tr:
rahā ek din avadhi kar ati ārat pur log
jaham̐ taham̐ socahiṃ nāri nar kṛs tan rām biyog
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सगुन होहिं सुंदर सकल मन प्रसन्न सब केर ।
प्रभु आगवन जनाव जनु नगर रम्य चहुँ फेर ॥
verses.tr:
sagun hohiṃ suṃdar sakal man prasann sab ker
prabhu āgavan janāv janu nagar ramya cahum̐ pher

verses.sa:
कौसल्यादि मातु सब मन अनंद अस होइ ।
आयउ प्रभु श्री अनुज जुत कहन चहत अब कोइ ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyādi mātu sab man anaṃd as hoi
āyau prabhu śrī anuj jut kahan cahat ab koi

verses.sa:
भरत नयन भुज दच्छिन फरकत बारहिं बार ।
जानि सगुन मन हरष अति लागे करन बिचार ॥
verses.tr:
bharat nayan bhuj dacchin pharakat bārahiṃ bār
jāni sagun man haraṣ ati lāge karan bicār

trans: I apore without ceasing the glorious lord of Sita, the noblest of the sons of Ruyhu, even Rama as he appeared when mounted on the car Pushpaka, bright of hue as the neck of a peacock; marked with the print of the Brahman’s lotus foot, which declared him the greatest of the gods: all beautiful; yellow attired; lotus-eyed; ever gracious; with bow and arrows in hand; attended by a host of monkeys and served by his brother.
Beautiful are the lotus feet of the lord of Kosala, worshipped by Brahma and Siva, caressed by the tender hands of Janaki, ever clustered about by the beelike souls of the devout.

I worship Sankara, the annihilator of Love; beautiful with the brightness of the jasmine, the moon and the conch shell: the lord of Ambika: the granter of desired success, the compassionate lotus-eyed.

There remained only one day of the appointed term; the people of the city, men and women alike, sorely distrest in mind and wasted in body by sorrow for Rama’s absence, were everywhere despundent. Auspicious omens of every kind occurred; at once every heart was glad and the city itself brightened up all round, as if to announce the lord’s coming. Kausalya and the other royal dames were all as happy as if that minute expecting to be told ‘the Lord is here, and with him Sita and Lakshman.’ Bharat’s right eye and arm throbbed again and again. Recognizing this asa good sign, he was glad at heart and yet began to ponder deeply.

sections.label: Doha 1
sections.name: राम बिरह सागर महँ भरत मगन मन होत

verses.sa:
रहेउ एक दिन अवधि अधारा ।
समुझत मन दुख भयउ अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
raheu ek din avadhi adhārā
samujhat man dukh bhayau apārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कारन कवन नाथ नहिं आयउ ।
जानि कुटिल किधौं मोहि बिसरायउ ॥
verses.tr:
kāran kavan nāth nahiṃ āyau
jāni kuṭil kidhauṃ mohi bisarāyau

verses.sa:
अहह धन्य लछिमन बड़भागी ।
राम पदारबिंदु अनुरागी ॥
verses.tr:
ahah dhanya lachiman bar̤abhāgī
rām padārabiṃdu anurāgī

verses.sa:
कपटी कुटिल मोहि प्रभु चीन्हा ।
ताते नाथ संग नहिं लीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
kapaṭī kuṭil mohi prabhu cīnhā
tāte nāth saṃg nahiṃ līnhā

verses.sa:
जौं करनी समुझै प्रभु मोरी ।
नहिं निस्तार कलप सत कोरी ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ karanī samujhai prabhu morī
nahiṃ nistār kalap sat korī

verses.sa:
जन अवगुन प्रभु मान न काऊ ।
दीन बंधु अति मृदुल सुभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jan avagun prabhu mān na kāū
dīn baṃdhu ati mṛdul subhāū

verses.sa:
मोरि जियँ भरोस दृढ़ सोई ।
मिलिहहिं राम सगुन सुभ होई ॥
verses.tr:
mori jiyam̐ bharos dṛr̤h soī
milihahiṃ rām sagun subh hoī

verses.sa:
बीतें अवधि रहहि जौं प्राना ।
अधम कवन जग मोहि समाना ॥
verses.tr:
bīteṃ avadhi rahahi jauṃ prānā
adham kavan jag mohi samānā

verses.sa:
राम बिरह सागर महँ भरत मगन मन होत ।
बिप्र रूप धरि पवन सुत आइ गयउ जनु पोत ॥
verses.tr:
rām birah sāgar maham̐ bharat magan man hot
bipr rūp dhari pavan sut āi gayau janu pot
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
बैठि देखि कुसासन जटा मुकुट कृस गात ।
राम राम रघुपति जपत स्त्रवत नयन जलजात ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhi dekhi kusāsan jaṭā mukuṭ kṛs gāt
rām rām raghupati japat stravat nayan jalajāt

trans: ‘The one day that now only remains of the fixed time is my last chance; as I think thereon, my soul is full of anxiety. What is the reason that my lord has not returned? God saw my evil nature when he passed me over. Ah ] how blessed and truly fortunate is Lakshman in his devotion to Rama’s lotus feet. The lord knew me to be false and per-yerse, and therefore he did not take me with him. If the lord were to consider my actions, there would be no redemption for me ina handred million of ages. But the Lord never regards offences of his servants, being a very brother to the destitute and most tender-hearted. I am firmly persuaded of soul that Rama will come; the omens are so favourable. But if my life holds out after the term once expires, [ shall be a more despicable wretch than any in the world.”

While Bharat’s soul was thus sinking in the sea of Rama’s bereavement, the Son of the Wind, disguised io forin as a Brahman, came like a boat to his rescue. Seeing him seated on a mat of sacred grass, with matted hair for a crown, his body all wasted away, his lips muttering the names ‘Rama, Rama, Raghupati,’ and his eyes streaming with tears:

sections.label: Doha 2
sections.name: राम प्रान प्रिय नाथ तुम्ह सत्य बचन मम तात

verses.sa:
देखत हनूमान अति हरषेउ ।
पुलक गात लोचन जल बरषेउ ॥
verses.tr:
dekhat hanūmān ati haraṣeu
pulak gāt locan jal baraṣeu
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मन महँ बहुत भाँति सुख मानी ।
बोलेउ श्रवन सुधा सम बानी ॥
verses.tr:
man maham̐ bahut bhām̐ti sukh mānī
boleu śravan sudhā sam bānī

verses.sa:
जासु बिरहँ सोचहु दिन राती ।
रटहु निरंतर गुन गन पाँती ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu biraham̐ socahu din rātī
raṭahu niraṃtar gun gan pām̐tī

verses.sa:
रघुकुल तिलक सुजन सुखदाता ।
आयउ कुसल देव मुनि त्राता ॥
verses.tr:
raghukul tilak sujan sukhadātā
āyau kusal dev muni trātā

verses.sa:
रिपु रन जीति सुजस सुर गावत ।
सीता सहित अनुज प्रभु आवत ॥
verses.tr:
ripu ran jīti sujas sur gāvat
sītā sahit anuj prabhu āvat

verses.sa:
सुनत बचन बिसरे सब दूखा ।
तृषावंत जिमि पाइ पियूषा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bacan bisare sab dūkhā
tṛṣāvaṃt jimi pāi piyūṣā

verses.sa:
को तुम्ह तात कहाँ ते आए ।
मोहि परम प्रिय बचन सुनाए ॥
verses.tr:
ko tumh tāt kahām̐ te āe
mohi param priya bacan sunāe

verses.sa:
मारुत सुत मैं कपि हनुमाना ।
नामु मोर सुनु कृपानिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
mārut sut maiṃ kapi hanumānā
nāmu mor sunu kṛpānidhānā

verses.sa:
दीनबंधु रघुपति कर किंकर ।
सुनत भरत भेंटेउ उठि सादर ॥
verses.tr:
dīnabaṃdhu raghupati kar kiṃkar
sunat bharat bheṃṭeu uṭhi sādar

verses.sa:
मिलत प्रेम नहिं हृदयँ समाता ।
नयन स्त्रवत जल पुलकित गाता ॥
verses.tr:
milat prem nahiṃ hṛdayam̐ samātā
nayan stravat jal pulakit gātā

verses.sa:
कपि तव दरस सकल दुख बीते ।
मिले आजु मोहि राम पिरीते ॥
verses.tr:
kapi tav daras sakal dukh bīte
mile āju mohi rām pirīte

verses.sa:
बार बार बूझी कुसलाता ।
तो कहुँ देउँ काह सुनु भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār būjhī kusalātā
to kahum̐ deum̐ kāh sunu bhrātā

verses.sa:
एहि संदेस सरिस जग माहीं ।
करि बिचार देखेउँ कछु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi saṃdes saris jag māhīṃ
kari bicār dekheum̐ kachu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
नाहिन तात उरिन मैं तोही ।
अब प्रभु चरित सुनावहु मोही ॥
verses.tr:
nāhin tāt urin maiṃ tohī
ab prabhu carit sunāvahu mohī

verses.sa:
तब हनुमंत नाइ पद माथा ।
कहे सकल रघुपति गुन गाथा ॥
verses.tr:
tab hanumaṃt nāi pad māthā
kahe sakal raghupati gun gāthā

verses.sa:
कहु कपि कबहुँ कृपाल गोसाईं ।
सुमिरहिं मोहि दास की नाईं ॥
verses.tr:
kahu kapi kabahum̐ kṛpāl gosāīṃ
sumirahiṃ mohi dās kī nāīṃ

verses.sa:
निज दास ज्यों रघुबंसभूषन कबहुँ मम सुमिरन कर् यो ।
सुनि भरत बचन बिनीत अति कपि पुलकित तन चरनन्हि पर् यो ॥
verses.tr:
nij dās jyoṃ raghubaṃsabhūṣan kabahum̐ mam sumiran kar yo
suni bharat bacan binīt ati kapi pulakit tan carananhi par yo
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
रघुबीर निज मुख जासु गुन गन कहत अग जग नाथ जो ।
काहे न होइ बिनीत परम पुनीत सदगुन सिंधु सो ॥
verses.tr:
raghubīr nij mukh jāsu gun gan kahat ag jag nāth jo
kāhe na hoi binīt param punīt sadagun siṃdhu so

verses.sa:
राम प्रान प्रिय नाथ तुम्ह सत्य बचन मम तात ।
पुनि पुनि मिलत भरत सुनि हरष न हृदयँ समात ॥
verses.tr:
rām prān priya nāth tumh satya bacan mam tāt
puni puni milat bharat suni haraṣ na hṛdayam̐ samāt
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
भरत चरन सिरु नाइ तुरित गयउ कपि राम पहिं ।
कही कुसल सब जाइ हरषि चलेउ प्रभु जान चढ़ि ॥
verses.tr:
bharat caran siru nāi turit gayau kapi rām pahiṃ
kahī kusal sab jāi haraṣi caleu prabhu jān car̤hi

trans: At this sight Hanuman was overjoyed, every hair on his body stood erect and his eyes rained torrents; he felt at heart an indescribable satisfaction and addressed him in words that were as ambrosia to his ear: ‘He, for whose loss you sorrow night and day, the catalogae of whose virtues you are incessantly reciting, the glory of the line of Raghu, the benefactor of the pious, the deliverer of gods and saints, has arrived safely. After conquering the foe in the battle, with the gods to hymn his praises, the Lord is now on his way with Sita and his brother.” On hearing these words he forgot all his pain, like a man dying of thirst who finds a stream of nectar. “Who are you, Sir, and whence have you come, who have told me such glad tidings?” ‘Tam, the son of the Wind, a monkey, Hanuman by name, O fountain of mercy, a servant of the beneficent [Raghupati.” On hearing this, Bharat rose and respectfully advanced to meet him. The affection with which he embraced him was too great for heart to contain; his eyes streamed with tears and his body quivered all over. ‘OQ monkey, at the sight of you all my sorrows are gone, to-day I have embraced a friend of Rama's.” Again and again he asked of his welfare: “Hearken, brother; what is there I can give you? after taking thought, I find nothing in the whole world to match this news. Otherwise, I should be your debtor. Now tell me of
ny lord’s adventures.” Then Hanuman bowed his head at his feet and told him all Raghupati’s great doings. “Tell me, monkey, did the gracious god ever remember me as one of his servants?

Did the glory of the race of Raghu ever make mention of me his servant?” Onhearing Bharat’s modest speech, the monkey was in arapture and fell at his feet. How can he be otherwise than humble and holy and an ocean of virtue, whose praises Rama, the lord of all animate and inanimate creation, himself recites with his own mouth?
‘My lord, you are as dear to Rama as his own life; that is the truth, Sir.” Again and again he embraced Bharat, and his joy was more than his heart could contain.
After bowing his head at Bharat’s feet, the monkey returned in haste to Rama and told him that all was well. Then the Lord mounted his chariot and joyfully set forth.

sections.label: Doha 3
sections.name: हरषित गुर परिजन अनुज भूसुर बृंद समेत

verses.sa:
हरषि भरत कोसलपुर आए ।
समाचार सब गुरहि सुनाए ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi bharat kosalapur āe
samācār sab gurahi sunāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुनि मंदिर महँ बात जनाई ।
आवत नगर कुसल रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
puni maṃdir maham̐ bāt janāī
āvat nagar kusal raghurāī

verses.sa:
सुनत सकल जननीं उठि धाईं ।
कहि प्रभु कुसल भरत समुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
sunat sakal jananīṃ uṭhi dhāīṃ
kahi prabhu kusal bharat samujhāī

verses.sa:
समाचार पुरबासिन्ह पाए ।
नर अरु नारि हरषि सब धाए ॥
verses.tr:
samācār purabāsinh pāe
nar aru nāri haraṣi sab dhāe

verses.sa:
दधि दुर्बा रोचन फल फूला ।
नव तुलसी दल मंगल मूला ॥
verses.tr:
dadhi durbā rocan phal phūlā
nav tulasī dal maṃgal mūlā

verses.sa:
भरि भरि हेम थार भामिनी ।
गावत चलिं सिंधु सिंधुरगामिनी ॥
verses.tr:
bhari bhari hem thār bhāminī
gāvat caliṃ siṃdhu siṃdhuragāminī

verses.sa:
जे जैसेहिं तैसेहिं उटि धावहिं ।
बाल बृद्ध कहँ संग न लावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
je jaisehiṃ taisehiṃ uṭi dhāvahiṃ
bāl bṛddh kaham̐ saṃg na lāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
एक एकन्ह कहँ बूझहिं भाई ।
तुम्ह देखे दयाल रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
ek ekanh kaham̐ būjhahiṃ bhāī
tumh dekhe dayāl raghurāī

verses.sa:
अवधपुरी प्रभु आवत जानी ।
भई सकल सोभा कै खानी ॥
verses.tr:
avadhapurī prabhu āvat jānī
bhaī sakal sobhā kai khānī

verses.sa:
बहइ सुहावन त्रिबिध समीरा ।
भइ सरजू अति निर्मल नीरा ॥
verses.tr:
bahai suhāvan tribidh samīrā
bhai sarajū ati nirmal nīrā

verses.sa:
हरषित गुर परिजन अनुज भूसुर बृंद समेत ।
चले भरत मन प्रेम अति सन्मुख कृपानिकेत ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣit gur parijan anuj bhūsur bṛṃd samet
cale bharat man prem ati sanmukh kṛpāniket
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
बहुतक चढ़ी अटारिन्ह निरखहिं गगन बिमान ।
देखि मधुर सुर हरषित करहिं सुमंगल गान ॥
verses.tr:
bahutak car̤hī aṭārinh nirakhahiṃ gagan bimān
dekhi madhur sur haraṣit karahiṃ sumaṃgal gān

verses.sa:
राका ससि रघुपति पुर सिंधु देखि हरषान ।
बढ़यो कोलाहल करत जनु नारि तरंग समान ॥
verses.tr:
rākā sasi raghupati pur siṃdhu dekhi haraṣān
bar̤hayo kolāhal karat janu nāri taraṃg samān

trans: Bharat too returned in joy to Ayodhya and told his guru all the news, then published the fact in the palace, that Rama Ws approaching the city and was safe and sound. At these tidings ull the dowager queens started up in haste; but Bharat spoke and assured them of their lord’s welfare. When the citizens heard the news, men and women all ran out in their joy: the ladies formed in procession with stately gait, singing and bearing golden salvers laden with curds, dub grass, the sacred yellow pigment, fruits and flowers and fresh sprigs of the tulsi plant, all things of good omen. Each ran out just as she happened to be, without stopping to bring either children or old folk. Every one was usk-ing his neighbour, ‘Friend, have you seen” the gracions Rama?’ Directly it knew the Lord was coming, the whole city of Avadh became a quarry of delights. ‘The water of the Sarju flowed clear as clear could be; the air was deli-ciously soft, cool and fragrant. |
Bharat went forth to meet the All-merciful, full of joy

sections.label: Doha 4
sections.name: आवत देखि लोग सब कृपासिंधु भगवान

verses.sa:
इहाँ भानुकुल कमल दिवाकर ।
कपिन्ह देखावत नगर मनोहर ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ bhānukul kamal divākar
kapinh dekhāvat nagar manohar
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनु कपीस अंगद लंकेसा ।
पावन पुरी रुचिर यह देसा ॥
verses.tr:
sunu kapīs aṃgad laṃkesā
pāvan purī rucir yah desā

verses.sa:
जद्यपि सब बैकुंठ बखाना ।
बेद पुरान बिदित जगु जाना ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi sab baikuṃṭh bakhānā
bed purān bidit jagu jānā

verses.sa:
अवधपुरी सम प्रिय नहिं सोऊ ।
यह प्रसंग जानइ कोउ कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
avadhapurī sam priya nahiṃ soū
yah prasaṃg jānai kou koū

verses.sa:
जन्मभूमि मम पुरी सुहावनि ।
उत्तर दिसि बह सरजू पावनि ॥
verses.tr:
janmabhūmi mam purī suhāvani
uttar disi bah sarajū pāvani

verses.sa:
जा मज्जन ते बिनहिं प्रयासा ।
मम समीप नर पावहिं बासा ॥
verses.tr:
jā majjan te binahiṃ prayāsā
mam samīp nar pāvahiṃ bāsā

verses.sa:
अति प्रिय मोहि इहाँ के बासी ।
मम धामदा पुरी सुख रासी ॥
verses.tr:
ati priya mohi ihām̐ ke bāsī
mam dhāmadā purī sukh rāsī

verses.sa:
हरषे सब कपि सुनि प्रभु बानी ।
धन्य अवध जो राम बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣe sab kapi suni prabhu bānī
dhanya avadh jo rām bakhānī

verses.sa:
आवत देखि लोग सब कृपासिंधु भगवान ।
नगर निकट प्रभु प्रेरेउ उतरेउ भूमि बिमान ॥
verses.tr:
āvat dekhi log sab kṛpāsiṃdhu bhagavān
nagar nikaṭ prabhu prereu utareu bhūmi bimān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
उतरि कहेउ प्रभु पुष्पकहि तुम्ह कुबेर पहिं जाहु ।
प्रेरित राम चलेउ सो हरषु बिरहु अति ताहु ॥
verses.tr:
utari kaheu prabhu puṣpakahi tumh kuber pahiṃ jāhu
prerit rām caleu so haraṣu birahu ati tāhu

trans: and affection, accompanied by his guru, the citizens, hig younger brother anda throng of Brahmans. Many of the women mounted the upper stories of the houses to look for the chariot in the sky and, when they espied it, raised their sweet voices in auspicious songs of joy. As the waves of ocean rise and swell at the sight of the full moon, so poured forth the women of the city with a tumultuous noise at the sight of Rama. Chaupdi.

On the other hand, the Sun of the lotuses of the solar race was pointing out the beauties of the city to the monkeys; “Hearken, Sugriva, Angad and Vibhishan: this city is so holy and the country is so charming, that although all men speak of Vaikunth, which is indeed famous in the Vedas and Puranas and celebrated throughout the world, still it is not so dear to me as the city of Avadh: only here and there one can be found to comprehend this saying. Here is the delightful city my birth-place, and to the north the sacred Sarju, where every man that bathes obtains without further trouble a home near me. The dwellers here are very dear to me; the city makes them my fellow-citizens both here and hereafter and is altogether blessed.” The monkeys rejoiced to hear the Lord's words: what a glory for Avadh to be praised by Rama!

When the All-merciful Lord God saw all the people coming out to meet him, he urged on his chariot close up to the city and there alighted on the ground. Having dismounted, he directed Pushpaka to return to Kuver. On receiving Rama’s order it went its way, full of mingled joy and sorrow at parting.

sections.label: Doha 5
sections.name: पुनि प्रभु हरषि सत्रुहन भेंटे हृदयँ लगाइ

verses.sa:
आए भरत संग सब लोगा ।
कृस तन श्रीरघुबीर बियोगा ॥
verses.tr:
āe bharat saṃg sab logā
kṛs tan śrīraghubīr biyogā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बामदेव बसिष्ठ मुनिनायक ।
देखे प्रभु महि धरि धनु सायक ॥
verses.tr:
bāmadev basiṣṭh munināyak
dekhe prabhu mahi dhari dhanu sāyak

verses.sa:
धाइ धरे गुर चरन सरोरुह ।
अनुज सहित अति पुलक तनोरुह ॥
verses.tr:
dhāi dhare gur caran saroruh
anuj sahit ati pulak tanoruh

verses.sa:
भेंटि कुसल बूझी मुनिराया ।
हमरें कुसल तुम्हारिहिं दाया ॥
verses.tr:
bheṃṭi kusal būjhī munirāyā
hamareṃ kusal tumhārihiṃ dāyā

verses.sa:
सकल द्विजन्ह मिलि नायउ माथा ।
धर्म धुरंधर रघुकुलनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
sakal dvijanh mili nāyau māthā
dharm dhuraṃdhar raghukulanāthā

verses.sa:
गहे भरत पुनि प्रभु पद पंकज ।
नमत जिन्हहि सुर मुनि संकर अज ॥
verses.tr:
gahe bharat puni prabhu pad paṃkaj
namat jinhahi sur muni saṃkar aj

verses.sa:
परे भूमि नहिं उठत उठाए ।
बर करि कृपासिंधु उर लाए ॥
verses.tr:
pare bhūmi nahiṃ uṭhat uṭhāe
bar kari kṛpāsiṃdhu ur lāe

verses.sa:
स्यामल गात रोम भए ठाढ़े ।
नव राजीव नयन जल बाढ़े ॥
verses.tr:
syāmal gāt rom bhae ṭhār̤he
nav rājīv nayan jal bār̤he

verses.sa:
राजीव लोचन स्त्रवत जल तन ललित पुलकावलि बनी ।
अति प्रेम हृदयँ लगाइ अनुजहि मिले प्रभु त्रिभुअन धनी ॥
verses.tr:
rājīv locan stravat jal tan lalit pulakāvali banī
ati prem hṛdayam̐ lagāi anujahi mile prabhu tribhuan dhanī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
प्रभु मिलत अनुजहि सोह मो पहिं जाति नहिं उपमा कही ।
जनु प्रेम अरु सिंगार तनु धरि मिले बर सुषमा लही ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu milat anujahi soh mo pahiṃ jāti nahiṃ upamā kahī
janu prem aru siṃgār tanu dhari mile bar suṣamā lahī

verses.sa:
बूझत कृपानिधि कुसल भरतहि बचन बेगि न आवई ।
सुनु सिवा सो सुख बचन मन ते भिन्न जान जो पावई ॥
verses.tr:
būjhat kṛpānidhi kusal bharatahi bacan begi na āvaī
sunu sivā so sukh bacan man te bhinn jān jo pāvaī

verses.sa:
अब कुसल कौसलनाथ आरत जानि जन दरसन दियो ।
बूड़त बिरह बारीस कृपानिधान मोहि कर गहि लियो ॥
verses.tr:
ab kusal kausalanāth ārat jāni jan darasan diyo
būr̤at birah bārīs kṛpānidhān mohi kar gahi liyo

verses.sa:
पुनि प्रभु हरषि सत्रुहन भेंटे हृदयँ लगाइ ।
लछिमन भरत मिले तब परम प्रेम दोउ भाइ ॥
verses.tr:
puni prabhu haraṣi satruhan bheṃṭe hṛdayam̐ lagāi
lachiman bharat mile tab param prem dou bhāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: With Bharat came the whole population, all emaciated in body by their mourning for Rama. When the Lord saw Vamadeva and Vasishtha, greatest of sages, he dropt his bow and arrows on the ground and ran to clasp his guru’s lotus feet, both he and his younger brother, with every hair on their body erect. The great sage embraced them and asked of their welfare. ‘By your favour all is well with us.” Then the champion of the faith, the king of the Raghu race, made obeisance to all the Brahmans. Next Bharat embraced the Lord's lotus feet, ever worship by Sankara Brahma and all the gods and sages. He fell to the ground and refused to rise, till the All-merciful by force took and pressed him to his bosom, every hair standing erect on his dark-hued body, and his lotus eyes all streaming with tears.: Chhand 2.

His lotus eyes streamed with tears and his beauteous body quivered with emotion, as he lovingly clasped his brother to his heart, even he, the Lord the sovereign of the three spheres. There is no similitude by which I can express the beauty of the meeting between the Lord and his brother; it was as though Love and Desire in bodily form had met together ia a rapturous embrace. When the All mercifal asked of his welfare, it was with difficulty that Bharat found words to reply. Hearken, Uma; such joy can only be felt, it is beyond speech or inteliigeuce. “Now is all well with me, O Lord of Kosala; seeing your servant’s distress, you have revealed yourself to him and have taken me by the hand, O All-merciful, when I was sinking in the deep waters of bereavement.”

As when a thief going gaily along the road, with stolen property still about him, is suddenly seized at the waistbelt by the man he has robbed, so felt Sugriva and Vibhishan at the sight of the meeting between Rama and Bharat. Then the Lord smilingly embraced Satrughna and took him to his bosom, while Bharat embraced Lakshman, his heart overflowing with love.

sections.label: Doha 6
sections.name: भेटेउ तनय सुमित्राँ राम चरन रति जानि

verses.sa:
भरतानुज लछिमन पुनि भेंटे ।
दुसह बिरह संभव दुख मेटे ॥
verses.tr:
bharatānuj lachiman puni bheṃṭe
dusah birah saṃbhav dukh meṭe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सीता चरन भरत सिरु नावा ।
अनुज समेत परम सुख पावा ॥
verses.tr:
sītā caran bharat siru nāvā
anuj samet param sukh pāvā

verses.sa:
प्रभु बिलोकि हरषे पुरबासी ।
जनित बियोग बिपति सब नासी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu biloki haraṣe purabāsī
janit biyog bipati sab nāsī

verses.sa:
प्रेमातुर सब लोग निहारी ।
कौतुक कीन्ह कृपाल खरारी ॥
verses.tr:
premātur sab log nihārī
kautuk kīnh kṛpāl kharārī

verses.sa:
अमित रूप प्रगटे तेहि काला ।
जथाजोग मिले सबहि कृपाला ॥
verses.tr:
amit rūp pragaṭe tehi kālā
jathājog mile sabahi kṛpālā

verses.sa:
कृपादृष्टि रघुबीर बिलोकी ।
किए सकल नर नारि बिसोकी ॥
verses.tr:
kṛpādṛṣṭi raghubīr bilokī
kie sakal nar nāri bisokī

verses.sa:
छन महिं सबहि मिले भगवाना ।
उमा मरम यह काहुँ न जाना ॥
verses.tr:
chan mahiṃ sabahi mile bhagavānā
umā maram yah kāhum̐ na jānā

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सबहि सुखी करि रामा ।
आगें चले सील गुन धामा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sabahi sukhī kari rāmā
āgeṃ cale sīl gun dhāmā

verses.sa:
कौसल्यादि मातु सब धाई ।
निरखि बच्छ जनु धेनु लवाई ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyādi mātu sab dhāī
nirakhi bacch janu dhenu lavāī

verses.sa:
जनु धेनु बालक बच्छ तजि गृहँ चरन बन परबस गईं ।
दिन अंत पुर रुख स्त्रवत थन हुंकार करि धावत भई ॥
verses.tr:
janu dhenu bālak bacch taji gṛham̐ caran ban parabas gaīṃ
din aṃt pur rukh stravat than huṃkār kari dhāvat bhaī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
अति प्रेम सब मातु भेटीं बचन मृदु बहुबिधि कहे ।
गइ बिषम बियोग भव तिन्ह हरष सुख अगनित लहे ॥
verses.tr:
ati prem sab mātu bheṭīṃ bacan mṛdu bahubidhi kahe
gai biṣam biyog bhav tinh haraṣ sukh aganit lahe

verses.sa:
भेटेउ तनय सुमित्राँ राम चरन रति जानि ।
रामहि मिलत कैकेई हृदयँ बहुत सकुचानि ॥
verses.tr:
bheṭeu tanaya sumitrām̐ rām caran rati jāni
rāmahi milat kaikeī hṛdayam̐ bahut sakucāni
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
लछिमन सब मातन्ह मिलि हरषे आसिष पाइ ।
कैकेइ कहँ पुनि पुनि मिले मन कर छोभु न जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman sab mātanh mili haraṣe āsiṣ pāi
kaikei kaham̐ puni puni mile man kar chobhu na jāi

trans: After that Satrughna and Lakshman embraced, remembering no more the intolerable sorrow of separation. Finally Bharat bowed his head at Sita’s feet, both he and his younger brother, with an intensity of delight. The citizens were so glad at the sight of the Lord, that all the sorrow caused by his absence was at once forgotten. Seeing all the people so agitated by affection, the gracious Kharari practised an illusion and appearing at one and the same time in multiplied form, was thus in his benignity enabled to salute every one with due ceremony. The look of compassion, with which Raghubir regarded them, made every man and woman supremely happy. In a single moment the God embraced them all; this, Uma, is a mystery that none can comprehend. When Rama the perfection of amiability and every virtue, had on this manner made them all happy, he went on his way. Kausalya and the other royal dames ran out to meet him, like a cow that has lately calved at the sight of its little one. Chhand 3.

Like a cow that has been driven hy force to graze in the woods, leaving its little one at home, when it draws near to the village at the close of the day, hurries on lowing and with dripping teats, so did all the matrons haste to embrace the Lord with the utmost affection, lavi-hing upon him every term of endearment. The cruel pangs of parting had past away and were replaced by unutterable happiness and delight.

Sumitra embraced her son. remembering his devotion to Rama's feet; Kaikeyi too embraced Kama, but with a heart sadly ill at ease. Lakshman embraced the royal dames one and all and with joy received their blessing; but though he embraced Kaikeyi again and again, her anguish of soul still continued.

sections.label: Doha 7
sections.name: लछिमन अरु सीता सहित प्रभुहि बिलोकति मातु

verses.sa:
सासुन्ह सबनि मिली बैदेही ।
चरनन्हि लागि हरषु अति तेही ॥
verses.tr:
sāsunh sabani milī baidehī
carananhi lāgi haraṣu ati tehī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देहिं असीस बूझि कुसलाता ।
होइ अचल तुम्हार अहिवाता ॥
verses.tr:
dehiṃ asīs būjhi kusalātā
hoi acal tumhār ahivātā

verses.sa:
सब रघुपति मुख कमल बिलोकहिं ।
मंगल जानि नयन जल रोकहिं ॥
verses.tr:
sab raghupati mukh kamal bilokahiṃ
maṃgal jāni nayan jal rokahiṃ

verses.sa:
कनक थार आरति उतारहिं ।
बार बार प्रभु गात निहारहिं ॥
verses.tr:
kanak thār ārati utārahiṃ
bār bār prabhu gāt nihārahiṃ

verses.sa:
नाना भाँति निछावरि करहीं ।
परमानंद हरष उर भरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bhām̐ti nichāvari karahīṃ
paramānaṃd haraṣ ur bharahīṃ

verses.sa:
कौसल्या पुनि पुनि रघुबीरहि ।
चितवति कृपासिंधु रनधीरहि ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyā puni puni raghubīrahi
citavati kṛpāsiṃdhu ranadhīrahi

verses.sa:
हृदयँ बिचारति बारहिं बारा ।
कवन भाँति लंकापति मारा ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ bicārati bārahiṃ bārā
kavan bhām̐ti laṃkāpati mārā

verses.sa:
अति सुकुमार जुगल मेरे बारे ।
निसिचर सुभट महाबल भारे ॥
verses.tr:
ati sukumār jugal mere bāre
nisicar subhaṭ mahābal bhāre

verses.sa:
लछिमन अरु सीता सहित प्रभुहि बिलोकति मातु ।
परमानंद मगन मन पुनि पुनि पुलकित गातु ॥
verses.tr:
lachiman aru sītā sahit prabhuhi bilokati mātu
paramānaṃd magan man puni puni pulakit gātu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Sita saluted each of her mothers in-law and rejoiced greatly to kiss their feet. They asked of her welfare and invoked upon her the blessing: ‘May your happy wedded life last for ever.” A}! gazed on Raghupati’s lotus face and out of regard for the auspiciousness of the day checked the tears that rose in their eyes. They waved above his head their golden salvers and sacrificial lamps and again and again contemplated his divine person. They scatter all round about him every kind of offering,.their heart full of supreme felicity. Time after time Kausalya fixed her gaze on Rama, so pitiful and so valiant, and kept pondering within herself: “How can he have killed the king of Lanka? My two boys are so daintily delicate, is it possible they can have slain the demon’s doughtiest champions?”
As she looked upon the Lord and upon Lakshman and Sita, her maternal heart was overwhelmed with felicity and her every limb quivered with emotion.

sections.label: Doha 8
sections.name: कौसल्या के चरनन्हि पुनि तिन्ह नायउ माथ

verses.sa:
लंकापति कपीस नल नीला ।
जामवंत अंगद सुभसीला ॥
verses.tr:
laṃkāpati kapīs nal nīlā
jāmavaṃt aṃgad subhasīlā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हनुमदादि सब बानर बीरा ।
धरे मनोहर मनुज सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
hanumadādi sab bānar bīrā
dhare manohar manuj sarīrā

verses.sa:
भरत सनेह सील ब्रत नेमा ।
सादर सब बरनहिं अति प्रेमा ॥
verses.tr:
bharat saneh sīl brat nemā
sādar sab baranahiṃ ati premā

verses.sa:
देखि नगरबासिन्ह कै रीती ।
सकल सराहहि प्रभु पद प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi nagarabāsinh kai rītī
sakal sarāhahi prabhu pad prītī

verses.sa:
पुनि रघुपति सब सखा बोलाए ।
मुनि पद लागहु सकल सिखाए ॥
verses.tr:
puni raghupati sab sakhā bolāe
muni pad lāgahu sakal sikhāe

verses.sa:
गुर बसिष्ट कुलपूज्य हमारे ।
इन्ह की कृपाँ दनुज रन मारे ॥
verses.tr:
gur basiṣṭ kulapūjya hamāre
inh kī kṛpām̐ danuj ran māre

verses.sa:
ए सब सखा सुनहु मुनि मेरे ।
भए समर सागर कहँ बेरे ॥
verses.tr:
e sab sakhā sunahu muni mere
bhae samar sāgar kaham̐ bere

verses.sa:
मम हित लागि जन्म इन्ह हारे ।
भरतहु ते मोहि अधिक पिआरे ॥
verses.tr:
mam hit lāgi janm inh hāre
bharatahu te mohi adhik piāre

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु बचन मगन सब भए ।
निमिष निमिष उपजत सुख नए ॥
verses.tr:
suni prabhu bacan magan sab bhae
nimiṣ nimiṣ upajat sukh nae

verses.sa: कौसल्या के चरनन्हि पुनि तिन्ह नायउ माथ ॥
verses.tr: kausalyā ke carananhi puni tinh nāyau māth
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: आसिष दीन्हे हरषि तुम्ह प्रिय मम जिमि रघुनाथ ॥
verses.tr: āsiṣ dīnhe haraṣi tumh priya mam jimi raghunāth

verses.sa:
सुमन बृष्टि नभ संकुल भवन चले सुखकंद ।
चढ़ी अटारिन्ह देखहिं नगर नारि नर बृंद ॥
verses.tr:
suman bṛṣṭi nabh saṃkul bhavan cale sukhakaṃd
car̤hī aṭārinh dekhahiṃ nagar nāri nar bṛṃd

trans: Vibhishan, Sugriva, Nala and Nila, Jambavan and the generous Angad, with Hunumen and all the other monkey chiefs assumed beautiful human forms. With most reverent devotion, every one told the tale of Bharat’s loving disposition, his penance and vow. When they saw the citizens’ mode of life, they extolled them also for their attachment to their Lord’s feet Then Rama summoned all his comrades and bade them kiss the feet of the saint. ‘' The guru Vasishtha is highly to be reverenced by all my race; it is by his favour that we slew the demons inthe battle. But hearken, holy Sir, all these my comrades were the raft that bore me safely out of the waves of the battle. For my sake they lost their lives and they are more dear to me even than Bharat.” On hearing the Lord’s words, all were greatly overcome. Every moment gave birth to some new raptare.
Then they bowed the head at Kausalya’s feet, who rejoiced to give them her blessing, saying “You are as dear to me as Rama.” The heaven was obscured with the

sections.label: Doha 9
sections.name: नारि कुमुदिनीं अवध सर रघुपति बिरह दिनेस

verses.sa:
कंचन कलस बिचित्र सँवारे ।
सबहिं धरे सजि निज निज द्वारे ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃcan kalas bicitr sam̐vāre
sabahiṃ dhare saji nij nij dvāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बंदनवार पताका केतू ।
सबन्हि बनाए मंगल हेतू ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdanavār patākā ketū
sabanhi banāe maṃgal hetū

verses.sa:
बीथीं सकल सुगंध सिंचाई ।
गजमनि रचि बहु चौक पुराई ॥
verses.tr:
bīthīṃ sakal sugaṃdh siṃcāī
gajamani raci bahu cauk purāī

verses.sa:
नाना भाँति सुमंगल साजे ।
हरषि नगर निसान बहु बाजे ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bhām̐ti sumaṃgal sāje
haraṣi nagar nisān bahu bāje

verses.sa:
जहँ तहँ नारि निछावर करहीं ।
देहिं असीस हरष उर भरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ nāri nichāvar karahīṃ
dehiṃ asīs haraṣ ur bharahīṃ

verses.sa:
कंचन थार आरती नाना ।
जुबती सजें करहिं सुभ गाना ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃcan thār āratī nānā
jubatī sajeṃ karahiṃ subh gānā

verses.sa:
करहिं आरती आरतिहर कें ।
रघुकुल कमल बिपिन दिनकर कें ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ āratī āratihar keṃ
raghukul kamal bipin dinakar keṃ

verses.sa:
पुर सोभा संपति कल्याना ।
निगम सेष सारदा बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
pur sobhā saṃpati kalyānā
nigam seṣ sāradā bakhānā

verses.sa:
तेउ यह चरित देखि ठगि रहहीं ।
उमा तासु गुन नर किमि कहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
teu yah carit dekhi ṭhagi rahahīṃ
umā tāsu gun nar kimi kahahīṃ

verses.sa:
नारि कुमुदिनीं अवध सर रघुपति बिरह दिनेस ।
अस्त भएँ बिगसत भईं निरखि राम राकेस ॥
verses.tr:
nāri kumudinīṃ avadh sar raghupati birah dines
ast bhaem̐ bigasat bhaīṃ nirakhi rām rākes
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
होहिं सगुन सुभ बिबिध बिधि बाजहिं गगन निसान ।
पुर नर नारि सनाथ करि भवन चले भगवान ॥
verses.tr:
hohiṃ sagun subh bibidh bidhi bājahiṃ gagan nisān
pur nar nāri sanāth kari bhavan cale bhagavān

trans: _ showers of flowers as the Root of joy took his way to the palace, while all the fairest ladies in the city mounted the tops of the houses to see him.

They made ready all kinds of golden bowls, which they took and set every one at her own door. They busied themselves with wreaths of flowers, flags and banners. all to makea plad show. The roads were all watered with perfumes, and innumerable mystic squares were drawn and filled in with the finest pearls. Every kind of festive preparation was taken in hand; the city was en fete and all sorts of music were heard. in different places women scattered their offerings on his path, invoking blessings upon him with their hearts full of joy. Girls wave over his head their golden salvers and sacrificial lamps, singing sweetly the while, salvers for him the salve of every ill, the Sun of the lotus growth of Raghu’s line. The beauty, the wealth, the magnificence of the city would be a theme for the Vedas, or Seshnag, or Serade; but the spectacle was too much even for them; how then can any man, Uma, be able to describe its glory?

Rama’s absence, like the heat of the sun, had withered the lily-like fair in the Avadh lake; at sunset they blossomed again, at the sight of the moon-god Rama. Every conceivable auspicious omen occurred and music resounded in the sky, as the Lord God moved to the palace, a father restored to his people.

sections.label: Doha 10
sections.name: तब मुनि कहेउ सुमंत्र सन सुनत चलेउ हरषाइ

verses.sa:
प्रभु जानी कैकेई लजानी ।
प्रथम तासु गृह गए भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu jānī kaikeī lajānī
pratham tāsu gṛh gae bhavānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ताहि प्रबोधि बहुत सुख दीन्हा ।
पुनि निज भवन गवन हरि कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
tāhi prabodhi bahut sukh dīnhā
puni nij bhavan gavan hari kīnhā

verses.sa:
कृपासिंधु जब मंदिर गए ।
पुर नर नारि सुखी सब भए ॥
verses.tr:
kṛpāsiṃdhu jab maṃdir gae
pur nar nāri sukhī sab bhae

verses.sa:
गुर बसिष्ट द्विज लिए बुलाई ।
आजु सुघरी सुदिन समुदाई ॥
verses.tr:
gur basiṣṭ dvij lie bulāī
āju sugharī sudin samudāī

verses.sa:
सब द्विज देहु हरषि अनुसासन ।
रामचंद्र बैठहिं सिंघासन ॥
verses.tr:
sab dvij dehu haraṣi anusāsan
rāmacaṃdr baiṭhahiṃ siṃghāsan

verses.sa:
मुनि बसिष्ट के बचन सुहाए ।
सुनत सकल बिप्रन्ह अति भाए ॥
verses.tr:
muni basiṣṭ ke bacan suhāe
sunat sakal bipranh ati bhāe

verses.sa:
कहहिं बचन मृदु बिप्र अनेका ।
जग अभिराम राम अभिषेका ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ bacan mṛdu bipr anekā
jag abhirām rām abhiṣekā

verses.sa:
अब मुनिबर बिलंब नहिं कीजे ।
महाराज कहँ तिलक करीजै ॥
verses.tr:
ab munibar bilaṃb nahiṃ kīje
mahārāj kaham̐ tilak karījai

verses.sa:
तब मुनि कहेउ सुमंत्र सन सुनत चलेउ हरषाइ ।
रथ अनेक बहु बाजि गज तुरत सँवारे जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
tab muni kaheu sumaṃtr san sunat caleu haraṣāi
rath anek bahu bāji gaj turat sam̐vāre jāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
जहँ तहँ धावन पठइ पुनि मंगल द्रब्य मगाइ ।
हरष समेत बसिष्ट पद पुनि सिरु नायउ आइ ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ dhāvan paṭhai puni maṃgal drabya magāi
haraṣ samet basiṣṭ pad puni siru nāyau āi

trans: The lord knew Kaikeyi was ashamed and went to her house first, Bhav4ni. After comforting her and putting her thoroughly at ease, Hari went on to his own apartments, The All-merciful entered the palace, and every man and woman in the city was happy once more. The guru Vasishtha then called the Brahmans. ‘The day and the hour are now most auspicious: give the glad order, all ye Brahmans, that Ramohandra to-day take his seat upon the throne.” On hearing Vasishtha’s gracious address, the BrAhmans were all highly pleased. and the multitude of them made seemly response, ‘Rama's inauguration is the desire of the whole world. Now, best of saints, make no delay, but sign the king with the sign of sovereigaty.”

The saint thereupon ordered Sumanta, who no sooner heard than he went with joy and quickly got ready a multitude of chariots, elephants and horses. Then he despatched messengers in every direction to borrow stores of all good things, and lastly came himself with joy and bowed his head at Vasishtha’s feet.

sections.label: Doha 11
sections.name: सासुन्ह सादर जानकिहि मज्जन तुरत कराइ

verses.sa:
अवधपुरी अति रुचिर बनाई ।
देवन्ह सुमन बृष्टि झरि लाई ॥
verses.tr:
avadhapurī ati rucir banāī
devanh suman bṛṣṭi jhari lāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम कहा सेवकन्ह बुलाई ।
प्रथम सखन्ह अन्हवावहु जाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām kahā sevakanh bulāī
pratham sakhanh anhavāvahu jāī

verses.sa:
सुनत बचन जहँ तहँ जन धाए ।
सुग्रीवादि तुरत अन्हवाए ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bacan jaham̐ taham̐ jan dhāe
sugrīvādi turat anhavāe

verses.sa:
पुनि करुनानिधि भरतु हँकारे ।
निज कर राम जटा निरुआरे ॥
verses.tr:
puni karunānidhi bharatu ham̐kāre
nij kar rām jaṭā niruāre

verses.sa:
अन्हवाए प्रभु तीनिउ भाई ।
भगत बछल कृपाल रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
anhavāe prabhu tīniu bhāī
bhagat bachal kṛpāl raghurāī

verses.sa:
भरत भाग्य प्रभु कोमलताई ।
सेष कोटि सत सकहिं न गाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bhāgya prabhu komalatāī
seṣ koṭi sat sakahiṃ na gāī

verses.sa:
पुनि निज जटा राम बिबराए ।
गुर अनुसासन मागि नहाए ॥
verses.tr:
puni nij jaṭā rām bibarāe
gur anusāsan māgi nahāe

verses.sa:
करि मज्जन प्रभु भूषन साजे ।
अंग अनंग देखि सत लाजे ॥
verses.tr:
kari majjan prabhu bhūṣan sāje
aṃg anaṃg dekhi sat lāje

verses.sa:
सासुन्ह सादर जानकिहि मज्जन तुरत कराइ ।
दिब्य बसन बर भूषन अँग अँग सजे बनाइ ॥
verses.tr:
sāsunh sādar jānakihi majjan turat karāi
dibya basan bar bhūṣan am̐g am̐g saje banāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
राम बाम दिसि सोभति रमा रूप गुन खानि ।
देखि मातु सब हरषीं जन्म सुफल निज जानि ॥
verses.tr:
rām bām disi sobhati ramā rūp gun khāni
dekhi mātu sab haraṣīṃ janm suphal nij jāni

verses.sa:
सुनु खगेस तेहि अवसर ब्रह्मा सिव मुनि बृंद ।
चढ़ि बिमान आए सब सुर देखन सुखकंद ॥
verses.tr:
sunu khages tehi avasar brahmā siv muni bṛṃd
car̤hi bimān āe sab sur dekhan sukhakaṃd

trans: When the city of Avadh had been decorated, the gods rained down a contiouous shower of flowers. Rama called and directed his servants, “Go first and assist my comrades at their bath.” On receiving this order, his people ran in every direction and quickly bathed Sugriva and the rest. Next the All-merciful R4ma summoned Bharat and with his own hands untied his knotted coil of hair; the Lord then proceeded to bathe all his three brothers, even he the gracious Raghu-rai, the cherisher of all pious souls. The blessedness of Bharat, the meekness of the Lord, not a hundred myriads of Sesh-ndegs would be able to declare. Finally Rama unloosed his own matted hair and. after receiving the guru’s permission, himself bathed. After his bath the Lord put on his ornaments; the beauty of his every limb outshining a myriad Loves. Dohd 12.

Forthwith JAnaki was attended in the bath with all reverence by her mothers-in-law, who attired her in heavenly apparel with rich jewels for every part of her body. As she shone forth on Rama's left side, the Goddess Lakshmi herself, full of beauty and goodness, the royal dames were all overjoyed at the sight and thought their life had been well worth living. Hearken, Garar; upon this occasion Brabme, Siva and all the gods and saints mounted their chariots and came to have a sight of the Blessed one.

sections.label: Doha 12
sections.name: वह सोभा समाज सुख कहत न बनइ खगेस

verses.sa:
प्रभु बिलोकि मुनि मन अनुरागा ।
तुरत दिब्य सिंघासन मागा ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu biloki muni man anurāgā
turat dibya siṃghāsan māgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रबि सम तेज सो बरनि न जाई ।
बैठे राम द्विजन्ह सिरु नाई ॥
verses.tr:
rabi sam tej so barani na jāī
baiṭhe rām dvijanh siru nāī

verses.sa:
जनकसुता समेत रघुराई ।
पेखि प्रहरषे मुनि समुदाई ॥
verses.tr:
janakasutā samet raghurāī
pekhi praharaṣe muni samudāī

verses.sa:
बेद मंत्र तब द्विजन्ह उचारे ।
नभ सुर मुनि जय जयति पुकारे ॥
verses.tr:
bed maṃtr tab dvijanh ucāre
nabh sur muni jaya jayati pukāre

verses.sa:
प्रथम तिलक बसिष्ट मुनि कीन्हा ।
पुनि सब बिप्रन्ह आयसु दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
pratham tilak basiṣṭ muni kīnhā
puni sab bipranh āyasu dīnhā

verses.sa:
सुत बिलोकि हरषीं महतारी ।
बार बार आरती उतारी ॥
verses.tr:
sut biloki haraṣīṃ mahatārī
bār bār āratī utārī

verses.sa:
बिप्रन्ह दान बिबिध बिधि दीन्हे ।
जाचक सकल अजाचक कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
bipranh dān bibidh bidhi dīnhe
jācak sakal ajācak kīnhe

verses.sa:
सिंघासन पर त्रिभुअन साई ।
देखि सुरन्ह दुंदुभीं बजाईं ॥
verses.tr:
siṃghāsan par tribhuan sāī
dekhi suranh duṃdubhīṃ bajāīṃ

verses.sa:
नभ दुंदुभीं बाजहिं बिपुल गंधर्ब किंनर गावहीं ।
नाचहिं अपछरा बृंद परमानंद सुर मुनि पावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nabh duṃdubhīṃ bājahiṃ bipul gaṃdharb kiṃnar gāvahīṃ
nācahiṃ apacharā bṛṃd paramānaṃd sur muni pāvahīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
भरतादि अनुज बिभीषनांगद हनुमदादि समेत ते ।
गहें छत्र चामर ब्यजन धनु असि चर्म सक्ति बिराजते ॥
verses.tr:
bharatādi anuj bibhīṣanāṃgad hanumadādi samet te
gaheṃ chatr cāmar byajan dhanu asi carm sakti birājate

verses.sa:
श्री सहित दिनकर बंस बूषन काम बहु छबि सोहई ।
नव अंबुधर बर गात अंबर पीत सुर मन मोहई ॥
verses.tr:
śrī sahit dinakar baṃs būṣan kām bahu chabi sohaī
nav aṃbudhar bar gāt aṃbar pīt sur man mohaī

verses.sa:
मुकुटांगदादि बिचित्र भूषन अंग अंगन्हि प्रति सजे ।
अंभोज नयन बिसाल उर भुज धन्य नर निरखंति जे ॥
verses.tr:
mukuṭāṃgadādi bicitr bhūṣan aṃg aṃganhi prati saje
aṃbhoj nayan bisāl ur bhuj dhanya nar nirakhaṃti je

verses.sa:
वह सोभा समाज सुख कहत न बनइ खगेस ।
बरनहिं सारद सेष श्रुति सो रस जान महेस ॥
verses.tr:
vah sobhā samāj sukh kahat na banai khages
baranahiṃ sārad seṣ śruti so ras jān mahes
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
भिन्न भिन्न अस्तुति करि गए सुर निज निज धाम ।
बंदी बेष बेद तब आए जहँ श्रीराम ॥
verses.tr:
bhinn bhinn astuti kari gae sur nij nij dhām
baṃdī beṣ bed tab āe jaham̐ śrīrām

verses.sa:
प्रभु सर्बग्य कीन्ह अति आदर कृपानिधान ।
लखेउ न काहूँ मरम कछु लगे करन गुन गान ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu sarbagya kīnh ati ādar kṛpānidhān
lakheu na kāhūm̐ maram kachu lage karan gun gān

trans: _ The soul of the sage was enraptured as he gazed upon the Lord. He sent at once for « gorgeous throne. Then Raemn took his seat, after bowing his head to the Brahmans, his glory effulgent as the sun, defying description. As they looked upon Rama and Sita, the whole saintly throng was overjoyed. Then the Brahmans repeated their Vedic incantations; while in the heaven above the gods and saints shouted ‘Victory.’ The sage Vasishtha first himself made the tilak and then ordered the other Brahmans to do the same. His mother rejoiced as she looked upon her son and again and again waved the sacrificial lamp above his head. All kinds of presents were made to the Brahmans and not a beggar remained with a want unsatisfied. At the sight of the lord of the three spheres seated on his throne, the gods beat their kettle-drums.

Drums sounded in the sky, the hosts of Gandharvas and Kinnars sang and all nymphs of heaven danced before the enraptured assembly of gods and saints. Bharat and his other brothers, with Vibhishan and Angad and Hanuman and the rest, were there to be seen, some with umbrellas and chaurise and fans, and some with bows, swords, shields and spears. With Sita by his side, the glory of the Solar race outshone the beauty of unnumbered Loves; the soul of the gods was fascinated by his exquisite cloud-dark form in its yellow apparel, his diadem and bracelets and all the other ornaments that bedecked his limbs, his lotus eyes and stalwart chest and arms, a_ blessed vision indeed for man to behold.

The magnificence of the sight and the delight of the assembly are past all telling, Garur; Sarasvati, Sesh-neg and the Veda may tell itia part, but only Mahadeva has learnt all the sweetness of it. After they had all severally hymned his praises, the gods departed each to his own sphere. Then came the Vedas, in the disguise of bards, into the presence of the divine R^ma. The omniscient and compassionate Lord received them with all honour, nor did any one penetrate the mystery as they thus recited his panegyric:

sections.label: Doha 13
sections.name: सब के देखत बेदन्ह बिनती कीन्हि उदार

verses.sa:
जय सगुन निर्गुन रूप रूप अनूप भूप सिरोमने ।
दसकंधरादि प्रचंड निसिचर प्रबल खल भुज बल हने ॥
verses.tr:
jaya sagun nirgun rūp rūp anūp bhūp siromane
dasakaṃdharādi pracaṃḍ nisicar prabal khal bhuj bal hane
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
अवतार नर संसार भार बिभंजि दारुन दुख दहे ।
जय प्रनतपाल दयाल प्रभु संजुक्त सक्ति नमामहे ॥
verses.tr:
avatār nar saṃsār bhār bibhaṃji dārun dukh dahe
jaya pranatapāl dayāl prabhu saṃjukt sakti namāmahe

verses.sa:
तव बिषम माया बस सुरासुर नाग नर अग जग हरे ।
भव पंथ भ्रमत अमित दिवस निसि काल कर्म गुननि भरे ॥
verses.tr:
tav biṣam māyā bas surāsur nāg nar ag jag hare
bhav paṃth bhramat amit divas nisi kāl karm gunani bhare

verses.sa:
जे नाथ करि करुना बिलोके त्रिबिधि दुख ते निर्बहे ।
भव खेद छेदन दच्छ हम कहुँ रच्छ राम नमामहे ॥
verses.tr:
je nāth kari karunā biloke tribidhi dukh te nirbahe
bhav khed chedan dacch ham kahum̐ racch rām namāmahe

verses.sa:
जे ग्यान मान बिमत्त तव भव हरनि भक्ति न आदरी ।
ते पाइ सुर दुर्लभ पदादपि परत हम देखत हरी ॥
verses.tr:
je gyān mān bimatt tav bhav harani bhakti na ādarī
te pāi sur durlabh padādapi parat ham dekhat harī

verses.sa:
बिस्वास करि सब आस परिहरि दास तव जे होइ रहे ।
जपि नाम तव बिनु श्रम तरहिं भव नाथ सो समरामहे ॥
verses.tr:
bisvās kari sab ās parihari dās tav je hoi rahe
japi nām tav binu śram tarahiṃ bhav nāth so samarāmahe

verses.sa:
जे चरन सिव अज पूज्य रज सुभ परसि मुनिपतिनी तरी ।
नख निर्गता मुनि बंदिता त्रेलोक पावनि सुरसरी ॥
verses.tr:
je caran siv aj pūjya raj subh parasi munipatinī tarī
nakh nirgatā muni baṃditā trelok pāvani surasarī

verses.sa:
ध्वज कुलिस अंकुस कंज जुत बन फिरत कंटक किन लहे ।
पद कंज द्वंद मुकुंद राम रमेस नित्य भजामहे ॥
verses.tr:
dhvaj kulis aṃkus kaṃj jut ban phirat kaṃṭak kin lahe
pad kaṃj dvaṃd mukuṃd rām rames nitya bhajāmahe

verses.sa:
अब्यक्तमूलमनादि तरु त्वच चारि निगमागम भने ।
षट कंध साखा पंच बीस अनेक पर्न सुमन घने ॥
verses.tr:
abyaktamūlamanādi taru tvac cāri nigamāgam bhane
ṣaṭ kaṃdh sākhā paṃc bīs anek parn suman ghane

verses.sa:
फल जुगल बिधि कटु मधुर बेलि अकेलि जेहि आश्रित रहे ।
पल्लवत फूलत नवल नित संसार बिटप नमामहे ॥
verses.tr:
phal jugal bidhi kaṭu madhur beli akeli jehi āśrit rahe
pallavat phūlat naval nit saṃsār biṭap namāmahe

verses.sa:
जे ब्रह्म अजमद्वैतमनुभवगम्य मनपर ध्यावहीं ।
ते कहहुँ जानहुँ नाथ हम तव सगुन जस नित गावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
je brahm ajamadvaitamanubhavagamya manapar dhyāvahīṃ
te kahahum̐ jānahum̐ nāth ham tav sagun jas nit gāvahīṃ

verses.sa:
करुनायतन प्रभु सदगुनाकर देव यह बर मागहीं ।
मन बचन कर्म बिकार तजि तव चरन हम अनुरागहीं ॥
verses.tr:
karunāyatan prabhu sadagunākar dev yah bar māgahīṃ
man bacan karm bikār taji tav caran ham anurāgahīṃ

verses.sa:
सब के देखत बेदन्ह बिनती कीन्हि उदार ।
अंतर्धान भए पुनि गए ब्रह्म आगार ॥
verses.tr:
sab ke dekhat bedanh binatī kīnhi udār
aṃtardhān bhae puni gae brahm āgār
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
बैनतेय सुनु संभु तब आए जहँ रघुबीर ।
बिनय करत गदगद गिरा पूरित पुलक सरीर ॥
verses.tr:
bainateya sunu saṃbhu tab āe jaham̐ raghubīr
binaya karat gadagad girā pūrit pulak sarīr

trans: ‘Hail, visible manifestation of the invisible, incomparable in thy beauty, jewel of kings; who by the might of thy arm hast slain Ravan and the other terrible demons, monsters of iniquity; who, incarnate as a man, hast loosed the burdens of the world and put an end to its grievous affliction; hail, protector of the suppliant, lord ef compassion, thee we worship, and with thee thy spouse. QO Hari, gods and demons, Nagas!, men, and all creation, animate and inanimate, have been overcome by thy marvellous delusive power, wearily wandering night and day in the paths of life full, of the mysteries of fate and necessity. If there be any, O lord, whom thou regardest with compassion, they at once are freed from all their troubles; so prompt to cut short the weariness of existence; have mercy upon us,

a Rama, we implore thee. They, O Hari, who intoxicated with the pride of learning, despise that faith in thee which rvercomes the world, may attain to a rank which even the gods might fail to secure, and yet I have seen them fall ‘from it again. They who confidently abandon every other hope and continue thy disciples, by repeating thy name cross the ocean of life without any difficulty; this is the lord whom we invoke. QO Mukunda, Rama, spouse of Lakshmi, we ever adore thy lotus feet, object of the worship of Siva and Brahma; by touching the dust of which the sage’s wife obtained salvation; from beneath the nails of which flows the Ganges, reverenced by the saints, sanctifier of the three spheres; feet that bear the marks of the flag, the thunderbolt, the elephant-goad and the lotus, sorely pierced by the thorns daring thy wanderings in the forest. We adore the uncreated tree whose root is the Primordial germ; whose bark is fourfold as the Vedas and Puranas declare; whose boughs are six in number and branchlets twenty-five; with innumerable leaves and abundant flowers; whose fruits are of two kinds, bitter and sweet; with a single creeper ever clinging to it; Full of buds and blossoms and fruit, the everlasting tree of creation. Let them preach in their wisdom, who contemplate thee as the Supreme Spirit, the Uncreate, the inseparable from the universe, recognizable only by inference and beyond the understanding; bat we, O lord, will ever hymn the glories of thy incarnation. O merciful lord god. mine of every perfection, this is the boon we ask, that in thought, word and deed, and without any variableness we may maintain a devotion for thy feet.”

When, in the sight of all, the Vedas had uttered this glorious prayer, they became invisible and returned to their home with Brahma. Hearken, Garur; then came Sambhu to Raghubir and with a choking voice and every hair on his body erect he thus made supplication: Peper

sections.label: Doha 14
sections.name: बार बार बर मागउँ हरषि देहु श्रीरंग

verses.sa: जय राम रमारमनं समनं। भव ताप भयाकुल पाहि जनं ॥
verses.tr: jaya rām ramāramanaṃ samanaṃ bhav tāp bhayākul pāhi janaṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: अवधेस सुरेस रमेस बिभो। सरनागत मागत पाहि प्रभो ॥
verses.tr: avadhes sures rames bibho saranāgat māgat pāhi prabho

verses.sa: दससीस बिनासन बीस भुजा। कृत दूरि महा महि भूरि रुजा ॥
verses.tr: dasasīs bināsan bīs bhujā kṛt dūri mahā mahi bhūri rujā

verses.sa: रजनीचर बृंद पतंग रहे। सर पावक तेज प्रचंड दहे ॥
verses.tr: rajanīcar bṛṃd pataṃg rahe sar pāvak tej pracaṃḍ dahe

verses.sa: महि मंडल मंडन चारुतरं। धृत सायक चाप निषंग बरं ॥
verses.tr: mahi maṃḍal maṃḍan cārutaraṃ dhṛt sāyak cāp niṣaṃg baraṃ

verses.sa: मद मोह महा ममता रजनी। तम पुंज दिवाकर तेज अनी ॥
verses.tr: mad moh mahā mamatā rajanī tam puṃj divākar tej anī

verses.sa: मनजात किरात निपात किए। मृग लोग कुभोग सरेन हिए ॥
verses.tr: manajāt kirāt nipāt kie mṛg log kubhog saren hie

verses.sa: हति नाथ अनाथनि पाहि हरे। बिषया बन पावँर भूलि परे ॥
verses.tr: hati nāth anāthani pāhi hare biṣayā ban pāvam̐r bhūli pare

verses.sa: बहु रोग बियोगन्हि लोग हए। भवदंघ्रि निरादर के फल ए ॥
verses.tr: bahu rog biyoganhi log hae bhavadaṃghri nirādar ke phal e

verses.sa: भव सिंधु अगाध परे नर ते। पद पंकज प्रेम न जे करते ॥
verses.tr: bhav siṃdhu agādh pare nar te pad paṃkaj prem na je karate

verses.sa: अति दीन मलीन दुखी नितहीं। जिन्ह के पद पंकज प्रीति नहीं ॥
verses.tr: ati dīn malīn dukhī nitahīṃ jinh ke pad paṃkaj prīti nahīṃ

verses.sa: अवलंब भवंत कथा जिन्ह के।। प्रिय संत अनंत सदा तिन्ह कें ॥
verses.tr: avalaṃb bhavaṃt kathā jinh ke priya saṃt anaṃt sadā tinh keṃ

verses.sa: नहिं राग न लोभ न मान मदा।।तिन्ह कें सम बैभव वा बिपदा ॥
verses.tr: nahiṃ rāg na lobh na mān madā tinh keṃ sam baibhav vā bipadā

verses.sa: एहि ते तव सेवक होत मुदा। मुनि त्यागत जोग भरोस सदा ॥
verses.tr: ehi te tav sevak hot mudā muni tyāgat jog bharos sadā

verses.sa: करि प्रेम निरंतर नेम लिएँ। पद पंकज सेवत सुद्ध हिएँ ॥
verses.tr: kari prem niraṃtar nem liem̐ pad paṃkaj sevat suddh hiem̐

verses.sa: सम मानि निरादर आदरही। सब संत सुखी बिचरंति मही ॥
verses.tr: sam māni nirādar ādarahī sab saṃt sukhī bicaraṃti mahī

verses.sa: मुनि मानस पंकज भृंग भजे। रघुबीर महा रनधीर अजे ॥
verses.tr: muni mānas paṃkaj bhṛṃg bhaje raghubīr mahā ranadhīr aje

verses.sa: तव नाम जपामि नमामि हरी। भव रोग महागद मान अरी ॥
verses.tr: tav nām japāmi namāmi harī bhav rog mahāgad mān arī

verses.sa: गुन सील कृपा परमायतनं। प्रनमामि निरंतर श्रीरमनं ॥
verses.tr: gun sīl kṛpā paramāyatanaṃ pranamāmi niraṃtar śrīramanaṃ

verses.sa: रघुनंद निकंदय द्वंद्वघनं। महिपाल बिलोकय दीन जनं ॥
verses.tr: raghunaṃd nikaṃdaya dvaṃdvaghanaṃ mahipāl bilokaya dīn janaṃ

verses.sa:
बार बार बर मागउँ हरषि देहु श्रीरंग ।
पद सरोज अनपायनी भगति सदा सतसंग ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār bar māgaum̐ haraṣi dehu śrīraṃg
pad saroj anapāyanī bhagati sadā satasaṃg
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
बरनि उमापति राम गुन हरषि गए कैलास ।
तब प्रभु कपिन्ह दिवाए सब बिधि सुखप्रद बास ॥
verses.tr:
barani umāpati rām gun haraṣi gae kailās
tab prabhu kapinh divāe sab bidhi sukhaprad bās

trans: “Hail to thee, Rama, the spouse of Lakshmi, the pacifier; have mercy on thy servant, harassed with the terrors and troubles of existence. Glorious lord, sovereign of Avadh, sovereign of heaven, Lakshmi’s sovereign, have mercy on the suppliant, who has fled to thee for refuge. Destroyer of the ten-headed and twenty-armed, remover of earth’s sore burden, consumer of the moth-like demon host in the fierce flame of thy fiery arrows; most beauteous ornament of the terrestrial sphere; noblest of all that handle bow, arrows and quiver; radiant as the sun to disperse the thick darkness of the night of pride, ignorance und ego ism; thou hast vanquished the God of Love, who like a huntsman had smitten all men to the heart with the arrows of evil desire as though they were herd of deer; now, O lord Hari, have mercy on us destitute wretches, who have gone astray in the wilderness of sensuality. The many diseases and bereavemente, with which the people are stricken, are the fruit of this disregard for thy holy feet. The bottomless ocean of existence overwhelms all who cherish no love for thy lotus feet. Poor indeed and vile and wretched for ever are they who have no affection for thy lotus feet. They who take delight in making mention of thy name, have the saints as their constant friends for ever, are eternally exempt from passion, greed and arrogance, and regard prosperity and adversity as both alike. Thus it is that thy servants are so happy; the saint abandons for ever all confidence in mortification and making simply a vow of perpetual love serves thy lotus feet with a pure heart. QO Raghu-bir, mighty and invincible hero, indwelling as a bee in the lotus-like soul of the saints, thy name, O Hari, I repeat in prayer and adore, destroyer of vanity and pride, which are the diseases of life. Humbly I adore without ceasing the spouse of Lakshmi, the supreme abode of goodness, generosity and compassion. O
sun of Raghu, extirpate every animosity; O king of earth, regard thy humble servant.
each line.in the quatrain consists o

Again and again [ beg of thee a boon—be gracious and grant it O Sriranga! —an unwavering faith in thy lotus feet and constant communion with saints.” After thus hymning Rama’s praises, Siva returned with joy to Kailas. The Lord then assigned the monkeys most delightful residences,

sections.label: Doha 15
sections.name: ब्रह्मानंद मगन कपि सब कें प्रभु पद प्रीति

verses.sa:
सुनु खगपति यह कथा पावनी ।
त्रिबिध ताप भव भय दावनी ॥
verses.tr:
sunu khagapati yah kathā pāvanī
tribidh tāp bhav bhaya dāvanī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
महाराज कर सुभ अभिषेका ।
सुनत लहहिं नर बिरति बिबेका ॥
verses.tr:
mahārāj kar subh abhiṣekā
sunat lahahiṃ nar birati bibekā

verses.sa:
जे सकाम नर सुनहिं जे गावहिं ।
सुख संपति नाना बिधि पावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
je sakām nar sunahiṃ je gāvahiṃ
sukh saṃpati nānā bidhi pāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
सुर दुर्लभ सुख करि जग माहीं ।
अंतकाल रघुपति पुर जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sur durlabh sukh kari jag māhīṃ
aṃtakāl raghupati pur jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनहिं बिमुक्त बिरत अरु बिषई ।
लहहिं भगति गति संपति नई ॥
verses.tr:
sunahiṃ bimukt birat aru biṣaī
lahahiṃ bhagati gati saṃpati naī

verses.sa:
खगपति राम कथा मैं बरनी ।
स्वमति बिलास त्रास दुख हरनी ॥
verses.tr:
khagapati rām kathā maiṃ baranī
svamati bilās trās dukh haranī

verses.sa:
बिरति बिबेक भगति दृढ़ करनी ।
मोह नदी कहँ सुंदर तरनी ॥
verses.tr:
birati bibek bhagati dṛr̤h karanī
moh nadī kaham̐ suṃdar taranī

verses.sa:
नित नव मंगल कौसलपुरी ।
हरषित रहहिं लोग सब कुरी ॥
verses.tr:
nit nav maṃgal kausalapurī
haraṣit rahahiṃ log sab kurī

verses.sa:
नित नइ प्रीति राम पद पंकज ।
सबकें जिन्हहि नमत सिव मुनि अज ॥
verses.tr:
nit nai prīti rām pad paṃkaj
sabakeṃ jinhahi namat siv muni aj

verses.sa:
मंगन बहु प्रकार पहिराए ।
द्विजन्ह दान नाना बिधि पाए ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgan bahu prakār pahirāe
dvijanh dān nānā bidhi pāe

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मानंद मगन कपि सब कें प्रभु पद प्रीति ।
जात न जाने दिवस तिन्ह गए मास षट बीति ॥
verses.tr:
brahmānaṃd magan kapi sab keṃ prabhu pad prīti
jāt na jāne divas tinh gae mās ṣaṭ bīti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearken, Garuy; this sacred legend annihilates all the distresses and sins of the world. Any one who hears this narrative of the royal installation obtains self-control and discretion. They who lovingly sing it or hear it sung, obtain every kind of happiness and prosperity; after enjoying in this world « bliss, to which the gods can scarce attain, they are admitted after death into Rama’s own presence. The finally emancipated, the detached from the world and the worldly, who hear it, obtain respectively faith, absorption into the divinity and ever-increasing prosperity. O Garur, this history of Rama that I have repeated is the delight of a good understanding: a remedy for anxiety and sorrow; a confirmation of detachment, discretion and faith; a splendid raft on which to cross the river of delusion. In the city of Kosala was ever some new delight; the people were all happy, from the highest to the lowest. All felt an evergrowing affection for Rama’s lotus feet, the adored of Brahma, Siva and the saints. The poor had clothes given them in abundance and the Brahmans were presented with offerings of every description.
The monkeys were drowned in a joy like that of heaven; all were devoted to the Lord’s feet: day and night passed unnoticed till now six months had been spent.

sections.label: Doha 16
sections.name: अब गृह जाहु सखा सब भजेहु मोहि दृढ़ नेम

verses.sa:
बिसरे गृह सपनेहुँ सुधि नाहीं ।
जिमि परद्रोह संत मन माही ॥
verses.tr:
bisare gṛh sapanehum̐ sudhi nāhīṃ
jimi paradroh saṃt man māhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तब रघुपति सब सखा बोलाए ।
आइ सबन्हि सादर सिरु नाए ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghupati sab sakhā bolāe
āi sabanhi sādar siru nāe

verses.sa:
परम प्रीति समीप बैठारे ।
भगत सुखद मृदु बचन उचारे ॥
verses.tr:
param prīti samīp baiṭhāre
bhagat sukhad mṛdu bacan ucāre

verses.sa:
तुम्ह अति कीन्ह मोरि सेवकाई ।
मुख पर केहि बिधि करौं बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
tumh ati kīnh mori sevakāī
mukh par kehi bidhi karauṃ bar̤āī

verses.sa:
ताते मोहि तुम्ह अति प्रिय लागे ।
मम हित लागि भवन सुख त्यागे ॥
verses.tr:
tāte mohi tumh ati priya lāge
mam hit lāgi bhavan sukh tyāge

verses.sa:
अनुज राज संपति बैदेही ।
देह गेह परिवार सनेही ॥
verses.tr:
anuj rāj saṃpati baidehī
deh geh parivār sanehī

verses.sa:
सब मम प्रिय नहिं तुम्हहि समाना ।
मृषा न कहउँ मोर यह बाना ॥
verses.tr:
sab mam priya nahiṃ tumhahi samānā
mṛṣā na kahaum̐ mor yah bānā

verses.sa:
सब के प्रिय सेवक यह नीती ।
मोरें अधिक दास पर प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
sab ke priya sevak yah nītī
moreṃ adhik dās par prītī

verses.sa:
अब गृह जाहु सखा सब भजेहु मोहि दृढ़ नेम ।
सदा सर्बगत सर्बहित जानि करेहु अति प्रेम ॥
verses.tr:
ab gṛh jāhu sakhā sab bhajehu mohi dṛr̤h nem
sadā sarbagat sarbahit jāni karehu ati prem
verses.head: दोहा

trans: They had forgotten their homes so absolutely as never even to dream of them, like as the idea of injuring another never enters the soul of a saint. At last Raghupati summoned all his comrades before him. They came and made reverent obeisance. He seated them by his side with the greatest kindness and thus addressed them in gracious terms, which might well gladden their pious souls: “You have done me excellant service; but how can I praise you to your face? I hold you all) most dear for having left the comforts of your home solely on my account. My younger brother, my crown; my fortune, my wife, my life, my home and loving kinsmen are none uf them so dear in my sight as you are. I tell you no falsehood; these are my real sentiments. It is the ordinary rule for a man to cherish his own adherents, but I have a special affection for my servants.
Now, my comrades, return to your homes; there worship me with steadfast faith and maintain your fervent devotion, knowing me to be the eternal and omnipresent benefactor of the universe.”

sections.label: Doha 17
sections.name: जामवंत नीलादि सब पहिराए रघुनाथ

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु बचन मगन सब भए ।
को हम कहाँ बिसरि तन गए ॥
verses.tr:
suni prabhu bacan magan sab bhae
ko ham kahām̐ bisari tan gae
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एकटक रहे जोरि कर आगे ।
सकहिं न कछु कहि अति अनुरागे ॥
verses.tr:
ekaṭak rahe jori kar āge
sakahiṃ na kachu kahi ati anurāge

verses.sa:
परम प्रेम तिन्ह कर प्रभु देखा ।
कहा बिबिध बिधि ग्यान बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
param prem tinh kar prabhu dekhā
kahā bibidh bidhi gyān biseṣā

verses.sa:
प्रभु सन्मुख कछु कहन न पारहिं ।
पुनि पुनि चरन सरोज निहारहिं ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu sanmukh kachu kahan na pārahiṃ
puni puni caran saroj nihārahiṃ

verses.sa:
तब प्रभु भूषन बसन मगाए ।
नाना रंग अनूप सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
tab prabhu bhūṣan basan magāe
nānā raṃg anūp suhāe

verses.sa:
सुग्रीवहि प्रथमहिं पहिराए ।
बसन भरत निज हाथ बनाए ॥
verses.tr:
sugrīvahi prathamahiṃ pahirāe
basan bharat nij hāth banāe

verses.sa:
प्रभु प्रेरित लछिमन पहिराए ।
लंकापति रघुपति मन भाए ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu prerit lachiman pahirāe
laṃkāpati raghupati man bhāe

verses.sa:
अंगद बैठ रहा नहिं डोला ।
प्रीति देखि प्रभु ताहि न बोला ॥
verses.tr:
aṃgad baiṭh rahā nahiṃ ḍolā
prīti dekhi prabhu tāhi na bolā

verses.sa:
जामवंत नीलादि सब पहिराए रघुनाथ ।
हियँ धरि राम रूप सब चले नाइ पद माथ ॥
verses.tr:
jāmavaṃt nīlādi sab pahirāe raghunāth
hiyam̐ dhari rām rūp sab cale nāi pad māth
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
तब अंगद उठि नाइ सिरु सजल नयन कर जोरि ।
अति बिनीत बोलेउ बचन मनहुँ प्रेम रस बोरि ॥
verses.tr:
tab aṃgad uṭhi nāi siru sajal nayan kar jori
ati binīt boleu bacan manahum̐ prem ras bori

trans: When they heard the Lord’s words, all were so overcome that they forgot who they were, or where they were, or where they had come from. With clasped hands and fixed gaze they stood before him, unable to speak from excess of devotion. The Lord perceived the intensity of their love and said all he could to teach them resignation. In his presence they could not answer a word, but still turned their eyes to his lotus feet. Then the Lord called for jewels and robes of honour, of many colours, incomparably beautiful, and first Bharat with his own hands made ready a dress, with which he invested Sugriva. By the Lord’s command Lakshman next invested the king of Lanka, to Rama’s great contentment. But Angad remained seated ae did not stir. Seeing his love, the Lord did not speak to

But proceeded with the investiture of Jambavan and Nila and the rest, who with Rama's image impressed upon their heart after bowing their head at his feet withdrew. Then Angad arose and made obeisance and with weeping eyes and clasped hands uttered his humble petition, im-pregnate as it were with the very essence of devotion.

sections.label: Doha 18
sections.name: अंगद बचन बिनीत सुनि रघुपति करुना सींव

verses.sa:
सुनु सर्बग्य कृपा सुख सिंधो ।
दीन दयाकर आरत बंधो ॥
verses.tr:
sunu sarbagya kṛpā sukh siṃdho
dīn dayākar ārat baṃdho
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मरती बेर नाथ मोहि बाली ।
गयउ तुम्हारेहि कोंछें घाली ॥
verses.tr:
maratī ber nāth mohi bālī
gayau tumhārehi koṃcheṃ ghālī

verses.sa:
असरन सरन बिरदु संभारी ।
मोहि जनि तजहु भगत हितकारी ॥
verses.tr:
asaran saran biradu saṃbhārī
mohi jani tajahu bhagat hitakārī

verses.sa:
मोरें तुम्ह प्रभु गुर पितु माता ।
जाउँ कहाँ तजि पद जलजाता ॥
verses.tr:
moreṃ tumh prabhu gur pitu mātā
jāum̐ kahām̐ taji pad jalajātā

verses.sa:
तुम्हहि बिचारि कहहु नरनाहा ।
प्रभु तजि भवन काज मम काहा ॥
verses.tr:
tumhahi bicāri kahahu naranāhā
prabhu taji bhavan kāj mam kāhā

verses.sa:
बालक ग्यान बुद्धि बल हीना ।
राखहु सरन नाथ जन दीना ॥
verses.tr:
bālak gyān buddhi bal hīnā
rākhahu saran nāth jan dīnā

verses.sa:
नीचि टहल गृह कै सब करिहउँ ।
पद पंकज बिलोकि भव तरिहउँ ॥
verses.tr:
nīci ṭahal gṛh kai sab karihaum̐
pad paṃkaj biloki bhav tarihaum̐

verses.sa:
अस कहि चरन परेउ प्रभु पाही ।
अब जनि नाथ कहहु गृह जाही ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi caran pareu prabhu pāhī
ab jani nāth kahahu gṛh jāhī

verses.sa:
अंगद बचन बिनीत सुनि रघुपति करुना सींव ।
प्रभु उठाइ उर लायउ सजल नयन राजीव ॥
verses.tr:
aṃgad bacan binīt suni raghupati karunā sīṃv
prabhu uṭhāi ur lāyau sajal nayan rājīv
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
निज उर माल बसन मनि बालितनय पहिराइ ।
बिदा कीन्हि भगवान तब बहु प्रकार समुझाइ ॥
verses.tr:
nij ur māl basan mani bālitanaya pahirāi
bidā kīnhi bhagavān tab bahu prakār samujhāi

trans: = Hearken, all-wise, all-merciful and all-blessed, com-miserator of the destitute, succour of the distressed; Bali, my lord, in his last moments placed me in your charge, To be the helper of the helpless is the character you support; benefactor of the faithful, do not abandon me. You, Sire, are my spiritual guide, my father and my mother; where can I go, I leave your lotus feet # Consider yourself and tell me, O king of men; apart from my lord, what is my home to me? Extend to me your protection, a mere child as I am without knowledge, wisdom, or strength, and regard me as one of the humblest of your servants. Let me perform the most menial office in your palace, if only I may see your lotus feet and thus traverse the ocean of existence.” So saying, he fell at the Lord's feet, ““O Sire, do again
tell me to go home.” Dohe 19.

On hearing Angad's piteous prayer, the all-merciful lord Rama raised him from the ground and clasped him to his bosom, his lotus eyes streaming with tears. He clothed the son of Bali in his own robe and jewels and the chain from his own neck, and then the Lord dismissed him with many words of exhortation.

sections.label: Doha 19
sections.name: कहेहु दंडवत प्रभु सैं तुम्हहि कहउँ कर जोरि

verses.sa:
भरत अनुज सौमित्र समेता ।
पठवन चले भगत कृत चेता ॥
verses.tr:
bharat anuj saumitr sametā
paṭhavan cale bhagat kṛt cetā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अंगद हृदयँ प्रेम नहिं थोरा ।
फिरि फिरि चितव राम कीं ओरा ॥
verses.tr:
aṃgad hṛdayam̐ prem nahiṃ thorā
phiri phiri citav rām kīṃ orā

verses.sa:
बार बार कर दंड प्रनामा ।
मन अस रहन कहहिं मोहि रामा ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār kar daṃḍ pranāmā
man as rahan kahahiṃ mohi rāmā

verses.sa:
राम बिलोकनि बोलनि चलनी ।
सुमिरि सुमिरि सोचत हँसि मिलनी ॥
verses.tr:
rām bilokani bolani calanī
sumiri sumiri socat ham̐si milanī

verses.sa:
प्रभु रुख देखि बिनय बहु भाषी ।
चलेउ हृदयँ पद पंकज राखी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu rukh dekhi binaya bahu bhāṣī
caleu hṛdayam̐ pad paṃkaj rākhī

verses.sa:
अति आदर सब कपि पहुँचाए ।
भाइन्ह सहित भरत पुनि आए ॥
verses.tr:
ati ādar sab kapi pahum̐cāe
bhāinh sahit bharat puni āe

verses.sa:
तब सुग्रीव चरन गहि नाना ।
भाँति बिनय कीन्हे हनुमाना ॥
verses.tr:
tab sugrīv caran gahi nānā
bhām̐ti binaya kīnhe hanumānā

verses.sa:
दिन दस करि रघुपति पद सेवा ।
पुनि तव चरन देखिहउँ देवा ॥
verses.tr:
din das kari raghupati pad sevā
puni tav caran dekhihaum̐ devā

verses.sa:
पुन्य पुंज तुम्ह पवनकुमारा ।
सेवहु जाइ कृपा आगारा ॥
verses.tr:
punya puṃj tumh pavanakumārā
sevahu jāi kṛpā āgārā

verses.sa:
अस कहि कपि सब चले तुरंता ।
अंगद कहइ सुनहु हनुमंता ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi kapi sab cale turaṃtā
aṃgad kahai sunahu hanumaṃtā

verses.sa:
कहेहु दंडवत प्रभु सैं तुम्हहि कहउँ कर जोरि ।
बार बार रघुनायकहि सुरति कराएहु मोरि ॥
verses.tr:
kahehu daṃḍavat prabhu saiṃ tumhahi kahaum̐ kar jori
bār bār raghunāyakahi surati karāehu mori
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
अस कहि चलेउ बालिसुत फिरि आयउ हनुमंत ।
तासु प्रीति प्रभु सन कहि मगन भए भगवंत।।!9(ख) ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi caleu bālisut phiri āyau hanumaṃt
tāsu prīti prabhu san kahi magan bhae bhagavaṃt !9(kha)

verses.sa:
कुलिसहु चाहि कठोर अति कोमल कुसुमहु चाहि ।
चित्त खगेस राम कर समुझि परइ कहु काहि ॥
verses.tr:
kulisahu cāhi kaṭhor ati komal kusumahu cāhi
citt khages rām kar samujhi parai kahu kāhi

trans: Bharat with his brother Satrughna and Lakshman Proceeded to escort him, being greatly moved by his devotion. But Angad’s heart was so overflowing with love that he turned again and again for one more look at Rama. Time after time he prostrated himself upon the ground, crying, ‘Thus would I stay, if Rama would only let me.’ Treasuring up in his mind Rama’s look and voice and gait, his smile too and his embrace, with a last glance at his face and many words of fervent prayer, he went forth, cherishing his lotus feet in his heart. After escorting all the «monkeys with the utmost respect, Bharat and his brother returned. Then Hanuman clasped Sugriva by the feet and earnestly besought him: “Let me spend ten day more in Rama's service and then I will return to your feet, my master.” ‘son of the Wind, great is your piety; go, serve the All-merciful.”’ So saying, the other monkeys went their way, but Angad cried: “Hearken, Hanuman:
With clasped hands I beg of you to present my service

sections.label: Doha 20
sections.name: बरनाश्रम निज निज धरम बनिरत बेद पथ लोग

verses.sa:
पुनि कृपाल लियो बोलि निषादा ।
दीन्हे भूषन बसन प्रसादा ॥
verses.tr:
puni kṛpāl liyo boli niṣādā
dīnhe bhūṣan basan prasādā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जाहु भवन मम सुमिरन करेहू ।
मन क्रम बचन धर्म अनुसरेहू ॥
verses.tr:
jāhu bhavan mam sumiran karehū
man kram bacan dharm anusarehū

verses.sa:
तुम्ह मम सखा भरत सम भ्राता ।
सदा रहेहु पुर आवत जाता ॥
verses.tr:
tumh mam sakhā bharat sam bhrātā
sadā rahehu pur āvat jātā

verses.sa:
बचन सुनत उपजा सुख भारी ।
परेउ चरन भरि लोचन बारी ॥
verses.tr:
bacan sunat upajā sukh bhārī
pareu caran bhari locan bārī

verses.sa:
चरन नलिन उर धरि गृह आवा ।
प्रभु सुभाउ परिजनन्हि सुनावा ॥
verses.tr:
caran nalin ur dhari gṛh āvā
prabhu subhāu parijananhi sunāvā

verses.sa:
रघुपति चरित देखि पुरबासी ।
पुनि पुनि कहहिं धन्य सुखरासी ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati carit dekhi purabāsī
puni puni kahahiṃ dhanya sukharāsī

verses.sa:
राम राज बैंठें त्रेलोका ।
हरषित भए गए सब सोका ॥
verses.tr:
rām rāj baiṃṭheṃ trelokā
haraṣit bhae gae sab sokā

verses.sa:
बयरु न कर काहू सन कोई ।
राम प्रताप बिषमता खोई ॥
verses.tr:
bayaru na kar kāhū san koī
rām pratāp biṣamatā khoī

verses.sa:
बरनाश्रम निज निज धरम बनिरत बेद पथ लोग ।
चलहिं सदा पावहिं सुखहि नहिं भय सोक न रोग ॥
verses.tr:
baranāśram nij nij dharam banirat bed path log
calahiṃ sadā pāvahiṃ sukhahi nahiṃ bhaya sok na rog
verses.head: दोहा

trans: to the Lord and frequently remind him of me.” So saying, the son of Bali started on his way, while Hanuman
566 ae THE SEQUEL
returnd and told the Lord of his devotion: the great god was overjoyed. Now hard as adamant, now soft as the petal of a flower, such, Garur, is Rama’s heart; who can comprehend it?

Next the All-merciful summoned the Nishad and graciously presented him with jewels and raiment. “Return to your home, but ever remember me, and in heart, word and deed observe all the ordinances of religion. You, my companion, are as much my brother as Bharat; you must always be backwards and forwards here.” On hearing these words he was greatly delighted and fell at his feet, his eyes full of tears. With the image of his lotus feet impressed upon his heart, he returned home and declared the Lord’s generosity to all his kinsfolk. The citizens, on beholding Rama's actions, shouted again their vivas to his blessed name. Under RAma's sway the three spheres were full of joy, all sorrow was at an end, no one had a grudge against another, every variance was extinguished under Rama's auspices.
Devoted to religion, the people walked in the path of the Vedas, each according to his own caste and stage of life, and enjoyed perfect happiness, unvexed by fear, or sorrow, or disease.

sections.label: Doha 21
sections.name: राम राज नभगेस सुनु सचराचर जग माहिं

verses.sa:
दैहिक दैविक भौतिक तापा ।
राम राज नहिं काहुहि ब्यापा ॥
verses.tr:
daihik daivik bhautik tāpā
rām rāj nahiṃ kāhuhi byāpā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सब नर करहिं परस्पर प्रीती ।
चलहिं स्वधर्म निरत श्रुति नीती ॥
verses.tr:
sab nar karahiṃ paraspar prītī
calahiṃ svadharm nirat śruti nītī

verses.sa:
चारिउ चरन धर्म जग माहीं ।
पूरि रहा सपनेहुँ अघ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
cāriu caran dharm jag māhīṃ
pūri rahā sapanehum̐ agh nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
राम भगति रत नर अरु नारी ।
सकल परम गति के अधिकारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagati rat nar aru nārī
sakal param gati ke adhikārī

verses.sa:
अल्पमृत्यु नहिं कवनिउ पीरा ।
सब सुंदर सब बिरुज सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
alpamṛtyu nahiṃ kavaniu pīrā
sab suṃdar sab biruj sarīrā

verses.sa:
नहिं दरिद्र कोउ दुखी न दीना ।
नहिं कोउ अबुध न लच्छन हीना ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ daridr kou dukhī na dīnā
nahiṃ kou abudh na lacchan hīnā

verses.sa:
सब निर्दंभ धर्मरत पुनी ।
नर अरु नारि चतुर सब गुनी ॥
verses.tr:
sab nirdaṃbh dharmarat punī
nar aru nāri catur sab gunī

verses.sa:
सब गुनग्य पंडित सब ग्यानी ।
सब कृतग्य नहिं कपट सयानी ॥
verses.tr:
sab gunagya paṃḍit sab gyānī
sab kṛtagya nahiṃ kapaṭ sayānī

verses.sa: राम राज नभगेस सुनु सचराचर जग माहिं ॥
verses.tr: rām rāj nabhages sunu sacarācar jag māhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: काल कर्म सुभाव गुन कृत दुख काहुहि नाहिं ॥
verses.tr: kāl karm subhāv gun kṛt dukh kāhuhi nāhiṃ

trans: In the whole of Rd,ma's dominions there was no one who suffered from trouble of any kind, whether of the body or from the visitation of heaven or the attacks of enemies. Every one was in charity with his neighbour and contented with the state of life to which he had been born, conformably to the teaching of Scripture and sound morality. The four pillars of religion were established throughout the world; on one even dreamt of sin. Men and women alike were devoted to Rama’s worship and enjoyed all the blessedness of highest heaven. There was no premature death and no sickness even, but every one was comely and sound of body. inh reader wits What would be cioiliaaly ledeuctent sites of Wee ola are four in number: Ist, that of the Brahmacbari, or student; 2nd, that of

No one was in poverty, in sorrow, or distress; no one ignorant or unlucky. All were unaffectedly good and pious, clever and intelligent. Every one appreciated the merits of his neighbour and was himself learned and wise; every one was grateful for kindnesses and guilelessly prudent.

Hearken, Garur; daring Rama’s reign there was not a creature in the world, animate or inanimate, that suffered from any of the ills that ordinarily result from time or past conduct or personal temperament;and character.

sections.label: Doha 22
sections.name: दंड जतिन्ह कर भेद जहँ नर्तक नृत्य समाज

verses.sa:
भूमि सप्त सागर मेखला ।
एक भूप रघुपति कोसला ॥
verses.tr:
bhūmi sapt sāgar mekhalā
ek bhūp raghupati kosalā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भुअन अनेक रोम प्रति जासू ।
यह प्रभुता कछु बहुत न तासू ॥
verses.tr:
bhuan anek rom prati jāsū
yah prabhutā kachu bahut na tāsū

verses.sa:
सो महिमा समुझत प्रभु केरी ।
यह बरनत हीनता घनेरी ॥
verses.tr:
so mahimā samujhat prabhu kerī
yah baranat hīnatā ghanerī

verses.sa:
सोउ महिमा खगेस जिन्ह जानी ।
फिरी एहिं चरित तिन्हहुँ रति मानी ॥
verses.tr:
sou mahimā khages jinh jānī
phirī ehiṃ carit tinhahum̐ rati mānī

verses.sa:
सोउ जाने कर फल यह लीला ।
कहहिं महा मुनिबर दमसीला ॥
verses.tr:
sou jāne kar phal yah līlā
kahahiṃ mahā munibar damasīlā

verses.sa:
राम राज कर सुख संपदा ।
बरनि न सकइ फनीस सारदा ॥
verses.tr:
rām rāj kar sukh saṃpadā
barani na sakai phanīs sāradā

verses.sa:
सब उदार सब पर उपकारी ।
बिप्र चरन सेवक नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
sab udār sab par upakārī
bipr caran sevak nar nārī

verses.sa:
एकनारि ब्रत रत सब झारी ।
ते मन बच क्रम पति हितकारी ॥
verses.tr:
ekanāri brat rat sab jhārī
te man bac kram pati hitakārī

verses.sa:
दंड जतिन्ह कर भेद जहँ नर्तक नृत्य समाज ।
जीतहु मनहि सुनिअ अस रामचंद्र कें राज ॥
verses.tr:
daṃḍ jatinh kar bhed jaham̐ nartak nṛtya samāj
jītahu manahi sunia as rāmacaṃdr keṃ rāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The world encircled by its seven seas had only one king, Rama, the lord of Kosala. This was oo great matter for him, every hair on whose body is one of the countless spheres of creation. To a man who rightly understands the greatness of the Lord this description will seem highly disparaging. But those who understand his divine majesty, Garur, are the very persons who take a delight in these actions of his. They are the special rewards of such knowledge; so declare the greatest of sages and ascetics.!

Not even Sesh-nag or Sarada could describe the happiness and prosperity of Rama's reign. Every one was generous and kindly disposed to his neighbour and submissive to the Brahmans. Every husband was faithful to his single wife and every wife was devoted to her hasband.
A rod was never seen, save io the hand of a Religious;. the words ‘to beat’ had no meaning except to mark the

sections.label: Doha 23
sections.name: बिधु महि पूर मयूखन्हि रबि तप जेतनेहि काज

verses.sa:
फूलहिं फरहिं सदा तरु कानन ।
रहहि एक सँग गज पंचानन ॥
verses.tr:
phūlahiṃ pharahiṃ sadā taru kānan
rahahi ek sam̐g gaj paṃcānan
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
खग मृग सहज बयरु बिसराई ।
सबन्हि परस्पर प्रीति बढ़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
khag mṛg sahaj bayaru bisarāī
sabanhi paraspar prīti bar̤hāī

verses.sa:
कूजहिं खग मृग नाना बृंदा ।
अभय चरहिं बन करहिं अनंदा ॥
verses.tr:
kūjahiṃ khag mṛg nānā bṛṃdā
abhaya carahiṃ ban karahiṃ anaṃdā

verses.sa:
सीतल सुरभि पवन बह मंदा ।
गूंजत अलि लै चलि मकरंदा ॥
verses.tr:
sītal surabhi pavan bah maṃdā
gūṃjat ali lai cali makaraṃdā

verses.sa:
लता बिटप मागें मधु चवहीं ।
मनभावतो धेनु पय स्त्रवहीं ॥
verses.tr:
latā biṭap māgeṃ madhu cavahīṃ
manabhāvato dhenu paya stravahīṃ

verses.sa:
ससि संपन्न सदा रह धरनी ।
त्रेताँ भइ कृतजुग कै करनी ॥
verses.tr:
sasi saṃpann sadā rah dharanī
tretām̐ bhai kṛtajug kai karanī

verses.sa:
प्रगटीं गिरिन्ह बिबिध मनि खानी ।
जगदातमा भूप जग जानी ॥
verses.tr:
pragaṭīṃ girinh bibidh mani khānī
jagadātamā bhūp jag jānī

verses.sa:
सरिता सकल बहहिं बर बारी ।
सीतल अमल स्वाद सुखकारी ॥
verses.tr:
saritā sakal bahahiṃ bar bārī
sītal amal svād sukhakārī

verses.sa:
सागर निज मरजादाँ रहहीं ।
डारहिं रत्न तटन्हि नर लहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sāgar nij marajādām̐ rahahīṃ
ḍārahiṃ ratn taṭanhi nar lahahīṃ

verses.sa:
सरसिज संकुल सकल तड़ागा ।
अति प्रसन्न दस दिसा बिभागा ॥
verses.tr:
sarasij saṃkul sakal tar̤āgā
ati prasann das disā bibhāgā

verses.sa:
बिधु महि पूर मयूखन्हि रबि तप जेतनेहि काज ।
मागें बारिद देहिं जल रामचंद्र के राज ॥
verses.tr:
bidhu mahi pūr mayūkhanhi rabi tap jetanehi kāj
māgeṃ bārid dehiṃ jal rāmacaṃdr ke rāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: time for a dancer on the stage; and the only victory known was self-conquest, throughout all Kamohandra’s realm. Chaupdt.

The trees of the forest were ever full of flowers and fruit; the elephant and the lion dwelt peaceably together. Birds and deer forgot their instinctive animosities and lived in the greatest harmony with one another. The cooing of the birds and the many herds of deer fearlessly roaming the woods made a charming scene. The air was cool, fragrant and exquisitely soft; bees laden with honey made a pleasant humming. very creeper and tree yielded its sweetness on being asked and the cows in sheer lightness of heart dropt their milk on the road. The earth was ever clothed with crops and every feature of the Golden Age was repeated in the Age of Silver. Mines of jewels of every description were disclosed in the mountains and the world acknowledged its king to be in truth the Universal Spirit. Every river flowed with an abundance of water, cool, pure and pleasant to the taste. The sea remained within its bounds, casting forth pearls on its shore for men to gather. The ponds were all thick with lotuses and every quarter and section of the world was supremely happy. Dohd 24.
