The earth was suffused with the radiance of the moon, the heat of the sun was greater than circumstances required, and the clouds dropt rain whenever asked, in the days when Rama was king.

sections.label: Doha 24
sections.name: जासु कृपा कटाच्छु सुर चाहत चितव न सोइ

verses.sa:
कोटिन्ह बाजिमेध प्रभु कीन्हे ।
दान अनेक द्विजन्ह कहँ दीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
koṭinh bājimedh prabhu kīnhe
dān anek dvijanh kaham̐ dīnhe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
श्रुति पथ पालक धर्म धुरंधर ।
गुनातीत अरु भोग पुरंदर ॥
verses.tr:
śruti path pālak dharm dhuraṃdhar
gunātīt aru bhog puraṃdar

verses.sa:
पति अनुकूल सदा रह सीता ।
सोभा खानि सुसील बिनीता ॥
verses.tr:
pati anukūl sadā rah sītā
sobhā khāni susīl binītā

verses.sa:
जानति कृपासिंधु प्रभुताई ।
सेवति चरन कमल मन लाई ॥
verses.tr:
jānati kṛpāsiṃdhu prabhutāī
sevati caran kamal man lāī

verses.sa:
जद्यपि गृहँ सेवक सेवकिनी ।
बिपुल सदा सेवा बिधि गुनी ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi gṛham̐ sevak sevakinī
bipul sadā sevā bidhi gunī

verses.sa:
निज कर गृह परिचरजा करई ।
रामचंद्र आयसु अनुसरई ॥
verses.tr:
nij kar gṛh paricarajā karaī
rāmacaṃdr āyasu anusaraī

verses.sa:
जेहि बिधि कृपासिंधु सुख मानइ ।
सोइ कर श्री सेवा बिधि जानइ ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bidhi kṛpāsiṃdhu sukh mānai
soi kar śrī sevā bidhi jānai

verses.sa:
कौसल्यादि सासु गृह माहीं ।
सेवइ सबन्हि मान मद नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyādi sāsu gṛh māhīṃ
sevai sabanhi mān mad nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
उमा रमा ब्रह्मादि बंदिता ।
जगदंबा संततमनिंदिता ॥
verses.tr:
umā ramā brahmādi baṃditā
jagadaṃbā saṃtatamaniṃditā

verses.sa:
जासु कृपा कटाच्छु सुर चाहत चितव न सोइ ।
राम पदारबिंद रति करति सुभावहि खोइ ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu kṛpā kaṭācchu sur cāhat citav na soi
rām padārabiṃd rati karati subhāvahi khoi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Lord celebrated millions of horse-sacritices and conferred innumerable gifts up» the Brahmans, approving himself the defender of scriptural usage, the champion of religion, perfect in every virtue and the sworn foe of all sensuality. Sita wasever obediant to her lord, incomparable in her beauty, her virtue and her meekness, sensible of the majesty of the All-merciful and devotedly attached to his lotus feet. Though there were many man-servants and maidservants in the palace, all well-skilled in their work, she discharged every domestic duty with her own hands, waiting on Rama’s orders. Any service that might give pleasure to the All-merciful she herself studied to perform. Without the slightest pride or conceit she attended on Kausalya and the other queen dowagers io the palace. O Uma, Lakshmi, the object of the adoration of Brahma and all the divinities, the mother of the universe, the ever blameless.
The slightest glance of favour from whose eye is coveted by the gods, practised this devotion to’ Rama’s lotus feet, for such was her nature.

sections.label: Doha 25
sections.name: ग्यान गिरा गोतीत अज माया मन गुन पार

verses.sa:
सेवहिं सानकूल सब भाई ।
राम चरन रति अति अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
sevahiṃ sānakūl sab bhāī
rām caran rati ati adhikāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रभु मुख कमल बिलोकत रहहीं ।
कबहुँ कृपाल हमहि कछु कहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu mukh kamal bilokat rahahīṃ
kabahum̐ kṛpāl hamahi kachu kahahīṃ

verses.sa:
राम करहिं भ्रातन्ह पर प्रीती ।
नाना भाँति सिखावहिं नीती ॥
verses.tr:
rām karahiṃ bhrātanh par prītī
nānā bhām̐ti sikhāvahiṃ nītī

verses.sa:
हरषित रहहिं नगर के लोगा ।
करहिं सकल सुर दुर्लभ भोगा ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣit rahahiṃ nagar ke logā
karahiṃ sakal sur durlabh bhogā

verses.sa:
अहनिसि बिधिहि मनावत रहहीं ।
श्रीरघुबीर चरन रति चहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ahanisi bidhihi manāvat rahahīṃ
śrīraghubīr caran rati cahahīṃ

verses.sa:
दुइ सुत सुन्दर सीताँ जाए ।
लव कुस बेद पुरानन्ह गाए ॥
verses.tr:
dui sut sundar sītām̐ jāe
lav kus bed purānanh gāe

verses.sa:
दोउ बिजई बिनई गुन मंदिर ।
हरि प्रतिबिंब मनहुँ अति सुंदर ॥
verses.tr:
dou bijaī binaī gun maṃdir
hari pratibiṃb manahum̐ ati suṃdar

verses.sa:
दुइ दुइ सुत सब भ्रातन्ह केरे ।
भए रूप गुन सील घनेरे ॥
verses.tr:
dui dui sut sab bhrātanh kere
bhae rūp gun sīl ghanere

verses.sa:
ग्यान गिरा गोतीत अज माया मन गुन पार ।
सोइ सच्चिदानंद घन कर नर चरित उदार ॥
verses.tr:
gyān girā gotīt aj māyā man gun pār
soi saccidānaṃd ghan kar nar carit udār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Though she waited diligently on all the brothers, her

devotion to Rama was most. conspicuous. She never ceased to watch his lotus face on the chance that he might be pleased to speak to her, Rama on his part was most affectionate to his brothers and instructed them on all points of morality. The citizens lived happy, each enjoying a felicity to which the gods might scarce attain. Day and night they made their prayer to God fora fervent devotion to ltema’s holy feet. Two comely sons were born to Sita, Lava and Kusa; so the Vedas and Purdnas have declared; both glorious in battle, modest and accomplished and so beautiful that they seemed the very image of Hari. The other brothers also had each two sons, pre-eminent in beauty, virtue and all good qualities. Doha 26.

The Supreme Spirit that transcends all intelligence, speech and perception; that is from everlasting; unaffected by material phenomena, or the workings of mind or the properties of things, even he it was who thus exhibited the actions of exalted humanity.

sections.label: Doha 26
sections.name: अवधपुरी बासिन्ह कर सुख संपदा समाज

verses.sa:
प्रातकाल सरऊ करि मज्जन ।
बैठहिं सभाँ संग द्विज सज्जन ॥
verses.tr:
prātakāl saraū kari majjan
baiṭhahiṃ sabhām̐ saṃg dvij sajjan
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बेद पुरान बसिष्ट बखानहिं ।
सुनहिं राम जद्यपि सब जानहिं ॥
verses.tr:
bed purān basiṣṭ bakhānahiṃ
sunahiṃ rām jadyapi sab jānahiṃ

verses.sa:
अनुजन्ह संजुत भोजन करहीं ।
देखि सकल जननीं सुख भरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
anujanh saṃjut bhojan karahīṃ
dekhi sakal jananīṃ sukh bharahīṃ

verses.sa:
भरत सत्रुहन दोनउ भाई ।
सहित पवनसुत उपबन जाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat satruhan donau bhāī
sahit pavanasut upaban jāī

verses.sa:
बूझहिं बैठि राम गुन गाहा ।
कह हनुमान सुमति अवगाहा ॥
verses.tr:
būjhahiṃ baiṭhi rām gun gāhā
kah hanumān sumati avagāhā

verses.sa:
सुनत बिमल गुन अति सुख पावहिं ।
बहुरि बहुरि करि बिनय कहावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bimal gun ati sukh pāvahiṃ
bahuri bahuri kari binaya kahāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
सब कें गृह गृह होहिं पुराना ।
रामचरित पावन बिधि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
sab keṃ gṛh gṛh hohiṃ purānā
rāmacarit pāvan bidhi nānā

verses.sa:
नर अरु नारि राम गुन गानहिं ।
करहिं दिवस निसि जात न जानहिं ॥
verses.tr:
nar aru nāri rām gun gānahiṃ
karahiṃ divas nisi jāt na jānahiṃ

verses.sa:
अवधपुरी बासिन्ह कर सुख संपदा समाज ।
सहस सेष नहिं कहि सकहिं जहँ नृप राम बिराज ॥
verses.tr:
avadhapurī bāsinh kar sukh saṃpadā samāj
sahas seṣ nahiṃ kahi sakahiṃ jaham̐ nṛp rām birāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In the early morning after bathing io the Sarju he sat in his court, in the midst of Brahmans and sages, while Vasishtha recited the Vedas and Puranas; Rama listening attentively, though he knew them all of himself. He took his meals with his brothers: the royal matrons looking on with the utmost satisfaction. Then Bharat and Satrughna, the two brothers, would take Hanuman to some grove, where they would sit down and ask him all about Rama’s doings, and he would reply out of the depth of his wisdom, It was such a delight to them to hear the glorious narrative that they would beg him to repeat it again and again. In every single house the sacred legend was told of Rama’s marvellously holy deeds. Men and women alike joined in hymning his praises, and day and night passed unheeded.
Not a thousand Sesh-nags could tell all the happiness and prosperity of the city of Avadh, when Rama reigned as King.

sections.label: Doha 27
sections.name: चारु चित्रसाला गृह गृह प्रति लिखे बनाइ

verses.sa:
नारदादि सनकादि मुनीसा ।
दरसन लागि कोसलाधीसा ॥
verses.tr:
nāradādi sanakādi munīsā
darasan lāgi kosalādhīsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दिन प्रति सकल अजोध्या आवहिं ।
देखि नगरु बिरागु बिसरावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
din prati sakal ajodhyā āvahiṃ
dekhi nagaru birāgu bisarāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
जातरूप मनि रचित अटारीं ।
नाना रंग रुचिर गच ढारीं ॥
verses.tr:
jātarūp mani racit aṭārīṃ
nānā raṃg rucir gac ḍhārīṃ

verses.sa:
पुर चहुँ पास कोट अति सुंदर ।
रचे कँगूरा रंग रंग बर ॥
verses.tr:
pur cahum̐ pās koṭ ati suṃdar
race kam̐gūrā raṃg raṃg bar

verses.sa:
नव ग्रह निकर अनीक बनाई ।
जनु घेरी अमरावति आई ॥
verses.tr:
nav grah nikar anīk banāī
janu gherī amarāvati āī

verses.sa:
महि बहु रंग रचित गच काँचा ।
जो बिलोकि मुनिबर मन नाचा ॥
verses.tr:
mahi bahu raṃg racit gac kām̐cā
jo biloki munibar man nācā

verses.sa:
धवल धाम ऊपर नभ चुंबत ।
कलस मनहुँ रबि ससि दुति निंदत ॥
verses.tr:
dhaval dhām ūpar nabh cuṃbat
kalas manahum̐ rabi sasi duti niṃdat

verses.sa:
बहु मनि रचित झरोखा भ्राजहिं ।
गृह गृह प्रति मनि दीप बिराजहिं ॥
verses.tr:
bahu mani racit jharokhā bhrājahiṃ
gṛh gṛh prati mani dīp birājahiṃ

verses.sa:
मनि दीप राजहिं भवन भ्राजहिं देहरीं बिद्रुम रची ।
मनि खंभ भीति बिरंचि बिरची कनक मनि मरकत खची ॥
verses.tr:
mani dīp rājahiṃ bhavan bhrājahiṃ deharīṃ bidrum racī
mani khaṃbh bhīti biraṃci biracī kanak mani marakat khacī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
सुंदर मनोहर मंदिरायत अजिर रुचिर फटिक रचे ।
प्रति द्वार द्वार कपाट पुरट बनाइ बहु बज्रन्हि खचे ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar manohar maṃdirāyat ajir rucir phaṭik race
prati dvār dvār kapāṭ puraṭ banāi bahu bajranhi khace

verses.sa:
चारु चित्रसाला गृह गृह प्रति लिखे बनाइ ।
राम चरित जे निरख मुनि ते मन लेहिं चोराइ ॥
verses.tr:
cāru citrasālā gṛh gṛh prati likhe banāi
rām carit je nirakh muni te man lehiṃ corāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Narad and Sanat-Kumira and all the great sages came
every day to Ayodhya to.have a sight of the king of Kosala.

The appearance of the city made them forget all their asceticism. The balconies encrusted with gold and jewels, the splendid pavements laid in diverse colours, the magnificent forts on every side of the city with their brightly painted battlements, as though the nine planets had been mustered in array to beleaguer Indra’s capital, Amaravati; the floors so beautifully inlaid with coloured crystal that the soul of any saint would be distracted at the sight; the glistening palaces reaching to the sky with pinnacles that put to shame the brightness of sun and moon; the lattices gleaming with jewels and the jewelled lamps that shone in every room.

Beneath the light of jewelled lamps the houses were resplendent with their thresholds of coral and pillars of precious stone and golden walls, such as the Creator himself might have fashioned, all inlaid with emeralds and gems. The stately palace-courts were lovely with inworked crystal, and every gate was fitted with folding doors of gold embossed with diamonds,
In every house was a beautiful and well-furnished picture gallery, where Rama’s achievements were so set forth that the soul of a saint would be ravished at the sight.

sections.label: Doha 28
sections.name: उत्तर दिसि सरजू बह निर्मल जल गंभीर

verses.sa:
सुमन बाटिका सबहिं लगाई ।
बिबिध भाँति करि जतन बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
suman bāṭikā sabahiṃ lagāī
bibidh bhām̐ti kari jatan banāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लता ललित बहु जाति सुहाई ।
फूलहिं सदा बंसत कि नाई ॥
verses.tr:
latā lalit bahu jāti suhāī
phūlahiṃ sadā baṃsat ki nāī

verses.sa:
गुंजत मधुकर मुखर मनोहर ।
मारुत त्रिबिध सदा बह सुंदर ॥
verses.tr:
guṃjat madhukar mukhar manohar
mārut tribidh sadā bah suṃdar

verses.sa:
नाना खग बालकन्हि जिआए ।
बोलत मधुर उड़ात सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
nānā khag bālakanhi jiāe
bolat madhur ur̤āt suhāe

verses.sa:
मोर हंस सारस पारावत ।
भवननि पर सोभा अति पावत ॥
verses.tr:
mor haṃs sāras pārāvat
bhavanani par sobhā ati pāvat

verses.sa:
जहँ तहँ देखहिं निज परिछाहीं ।
बहु बिधि कूजहिं नृत्य कराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ dekhahiṃ nij parichāhīṃ
bahu bidhi kūjahiṃ nṛtya karāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुक सारिका पढ़ावहिं बालक ।
कहहु राम रघुपति जनपालक ॥
verses.tr:
suk sārikā par̤hāvahiṃ bālak
kahahu rām raghupati janapālak

verses.sa:
राज दुआर सकल बिधि चारू ।
बीथीं चौहट रूचिर बजारू ॥
verses.tr:
rāj duār sakal bidhi cārū
bīthīṃ cauhaṭ rūcir bajārū

verses.sa:
बाजार रुचिर न बनइ बरनत बस्तु बिनु गथ पाइए ।
जहँ भूप रमानिवास तहँ की संपदा किमि गाइए ॥
verses.tr:
bājār rucir na banai baranat bastu binu gath pāie
jaham̐ bhūp ramānivās taham̐ kī saṃpadā kimi gāie
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
बैठे बजाज सराफ बनिक अनेक मनहुँ कुबेर ते ।
सब सुखी सब सच्चरित सुंदर नारि नर सिसु जरठ जे ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhe bajāj sarāph banik anek manahum̐ kuber te
sab sukhī sab saccarit suṃdar nāri nar sisu jaraṭh je

verses.sa:
उत्तर दिसि सरजू बह निर्मल जल गंभीर ।
बाँधे घाट मनोहर स्वल्प पंक नहिं तीर ॥
verses.tr:
uttar disi sarajū bah nirmal jal gaṃbhīr
bām̐dhe ghāṭ manohar svalp paṃk nahiṃ tīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Every one had a flower garden trimmed with the greatest care, adorned with every kind of choice creeper, and blossoming with perpetual spring. There was ever a pleasant sound of the buzzing of bees, and the air was delightfully cool, soft and fragrant. Birds of all kinds, the children’s pets, sweet of note and graceful in flight, peacocks, swans, herons and pigeons, made a charming show on the tops of the houses, cooing and dancing in high glee at the sight of their own shadow. Other children were teaching parrots and mainas to speak and repeat the name of Rama, Raghupati, Saviour. The palace gates were most magni-
ficent, and the roads, squares and bazars all elegantly laid out.

The elegance of the bazars’ was beyond all description, and things could be had without price. How is it possible to sing the riches of the city where the spouse of Lakshmi reigned as king The cloth-merchants, money-changers and grain-dealers sat at their shops like so many Kuvers. Every one was happy, every one well-conducted and come- ay, men and women, young and old, all alike.
To the north flowed the deep and pellucid stream of the Sarju, with a line @of handsome ghats and no muddy bank any where,

sections.label: Doha 29
sections.name: रमानाथ जहँ राजा सो पुर बरनि कि जाइ

verses.sa:
दूरि फराक रुचिर सो घाटा ।
जहँ जल पिअहिं बाजि गज ठाटा ॥
verses.tr:
dūri pharāk rucir so ghāṭā
jaham̐ jal piahiṃ bāji gaj ṭhāṭā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पनिघट परम मनोहर नाना ।
तहाँ न पुरुष करहिं अस्नाना ॥
verses.tr:
panighaṭ param manohar nānā
tahām̐ na puruṣ karahiṃ asnānā

verses.sa:
राजघाट सब बिधि सुंदर बर ।
मज्जहिं तहाँ बरन चारिउ नर ॥
verses.tr:
rājaghāṭ sab bidhi suṃdar bar
majjahiṃ tahām̐ baran cāriu nar

verses.sa:
तीर तीर देवन्ह के मंदिर ।
चहुँ दिसि तिन्ह के उपबन सुंदर ॥
verses.tr:
tīr tīr devanh ke maṃdir
cahum̐ disi tinh ke upaban suṃdar

verses.sa:
कहुँ कहुँ सरिता तीर उदासी ।
बसहिं ग्यान रत मुनि संन्यासी ॥
verses.tr:
kahum̐ kahum̐ saritā tīr udāsī
basahiṃ gyān rat muni saṃnyāsī

verses.sa:
तीर तीर तुलसिका सुहाई ।
बृंद बृंद बहु मुनिन्ह लगाई ॥
verses.tr:
tīr tīr tulasikā suhāī
bṛṃd bṛṃd bahu muninh lagāī

verses.sa:
पुर सोभा कछु बरनि न जाई ।
बाहेर नगर परम रुचिराई ॥
verses.tr:
pur sobhā kachu barani na jāī
bāher nagar param rucirāī

verses.sa:
देखत पुरी अखिल अघ भागा ।
बन उपबन बापिका तड़ागा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhat purī akhil agh bhāgā
ban upaban bāpikā tar̤āgā

verses.sa:
बापीं तड़ाग अनूप कूप मनोहरायत सोहहीं ।
सोपान सुंदर नीर निर्मल देखि सुर मुनि मोहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bāpīṃ tar̤āg anūp kūp manoharāyat sohahīṃ
sopān suṃdar nīr nirmal dekhi sur muni mohahīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
बहु रंग कंज अनेक खग कूजहिं मधुप गुंजारहीं ।
आराम रम्य पिकादि खग रव जनु पथिक हंकारहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bahu raṃg kaṃj anek khag kūjahiṃ madhup guṃjārahīṃ
ārām ramya pikādi khag rav janu pathik haṃkārahīṃ

verses.sa:
रमानाथ जहँ राजा सो पुर बरनि कि जाइ ।
अनिमादिक सुख संपदा रहीं अवध सब छाइ ॥
verses.tr:
ramānāth jaham̐ rājā so pur barani ki jāi
animādik sukh saṃpadā rahīṃ avadh sab chāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: At some distance was a fine spacious ghet, where all the horses and elephants went to drink. There were also elaborate yhat» for the citizens’ drinking water, where no one was allowed to bathe. The most beautiful of all was the king’s ghat, which was frequented by men of all four castes. All along the banks were temples to the gods sar-rounded by pleasant groves. Here and there on the river bank hermits, sages and anchorites dwelt and meditated; and many bushes of the fragrant ¢tulsi were there, planted by different holy men. The beauty of the city surpassed all description; its outskirts also were most picturesque. Every sin was effaced by a sight of it, with its woods and groves, its lakes and ponds.

Its matchless lakes and ponds and large and beautiful wells were so charming, with their elegant flights of steps and limpid water, that gods and saints were fascinated by the sight. The many-coloured lotuses, the cooing of the numerous birds and the buzzing of the bees made the spot a delightful one, where the parrots by the clamour seemed to be inviting travellers to halt.
How is it possible to describe the city, of which [Lakshmi's lord was king? Anima& and the other fairies had diffused through the whole of Avadh every happiness and prosperity.

sections.label: Doha 30
sections.name: एहि बिधि नगर नारि नर करहिं राम गुन गान

verses.sa:
जहँ तहँ नर रघुपति गुन गावहिं ।
बैठि परसपर इहइ सिखावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ nar raghupati gun gāvahiṃ
baiṭhi parasapar ihai sikhāvahiṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भजहु प्रनत प्रतिपालक रामहि ।
सोभा सील रूप गुन धामहि ॥
verses.tr:
bhajahu pranat pratipālak rāmahi
sobhā sīl rūp gun dhāmahi

verses.sa:
जलज बिलोचन स्यामल गातहि ।
पलक नयन इव सेवक त्रातहि ॥
verses.tr:
jalaj bilocan syāmal gātahi
palak nayan iv sevak trātahi

verses.sa:
धृत सर रुचिर चाप तूनीरहि ।
संत कंज बन रबि रनधीरहि ॥
verses.tr:
dhṛt sar rucir cāp tūnīrahi
saṃt kaṃj ban rabi ranadhīrahi

verses.sa:
काल कराल ब्याल खगराजहि ।
नमत राम अकाम ममता जहि ॥
verses.tr:
kāl karāl byāl khagarājahi
namat rām akām mamatā jahi

verses.sa:
लोभ मोह मृगजूथ किरातहि ।
मनसिज करि हरि जन सुखदातहि ॥
verses.tr:
lobh moh mṛgajūth kirātahi
manasij kari hari jan sukhadātahi

verses.sa:
संसय सोक निबिड़ तम भानुहि ।
दनुज गहन घन दहन कृसानुहि ॥
verses.tr:
saṃsaya sok nibir̤ tam bhānuhi
danuj gahan ghan dahan kṛsānuhi

verses.sa:
जनकसुता समेत रघुबीरहि ।
कस न भजहु भंजन भव भीरहि ॥
verses.tr:
janakasutā samet raghubīrahi
kas na bhajahu bhaṃjan bhav bhīrahi

verses.sa:
बहु बासना मसक हिम रासिहि ।
सदा एकरस अज अबिनासिहि ॥
verses.tr:
bahu bāsanā masak him rāsihi
sadā ekaras aj abināsihi

verses.sa:
मुनि रंजन भंजन महि भारहि ।
तुलसिदास के प्रभुहि उदारहि ॥
verses.tr:
muni raṃjan bhaṃjan mahi bhārahi
tulasidās ke prabhuhi udārahi

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि नगर नारि नर करहिं राम गुन गान ।
सानुकूल सब पर रहहिं संतत कृपानिधान ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi nagar nāri nar karahiṃ rām gun gān
sānukūl sab par rahahiṃ saṃtat kṛpānidhān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Everywhere men were singing Rama’s praises and as they sat thus exhorted one another: ‘Worship Rama, the defender of the suppliant; the home of beauty and goodness, of comeliness and virtue; the lotus-eyed and dark-complexioned; who protects his servants as the eyelid does the eye equipt with lovely bow and arrows and quiver; the champion of the battle; a very sun to rejoice the lotus-like company of the saints; a Garur to consume the terrible serpent Death; whose loving kindness is over all who unselfishly worship Rama; a huntsman to scatter the deer-like herd of ignorance and greed; alion to quell the wild elephant, Love; the giver of happiness to his people; a sun to scatter the thick darkness of doubt and sorrow;a fire to consume the dense forest of demons; who can refuse to worship Raghubir and Sita, seeing that he is the breaker of earth’s burdens; the frost that kills the insect swarm of manifold desires; the ever uniform; the uncreated and imperishable; the delight of the saints; the breaker of earth’s burdens; Tulsi Daes’s own gracious Lord?”
In such wise the city sang Rama's praises, while on his

sections.label: Doha 31
sections.name: यह प्रताप रबि जाकें उर जब करइ प्रकास

verses.sa:
जब ते राम प्रताप खगेसा ।
उदित भयउ अति प्रबल दिनेसा ॥
verses.tr:
jab te rām pratāp khagesā
udit bhayau ati prabal dinesā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पूरि प्रकास रहेउ तिहुँ लोका ।
बहुतेन्ह सुख बहुतन मन सोका ॥
verses.tr:
pūri prakās raheu tihum̐ lokā
bahutenh sukh bahutan man sokā

verses.sa:
जिन्हहि सोक ते कहउँ बखानी ।
प्रथम अबिद्या निसा नसानी ॥
verses.tr:
jinhahi sok te kahaum̐ bakhānī
pratham abidyā nisā nasānī

verses.sa:
अघ उलूक जहँ तहाँ लुकाने ।
काम क्रोध कैरव सकुचाने ॥
verses.tr:
agh ulūk jaham̐ tahām̐ lukāne
kām krodh kairav sakucāne

verses.sa:
बिबिध कर्म गुन काल सुभाऊ ।
ए चकोर सुख लहहिं न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh karm gun kāl subhāū
e cakor sukh lahahiṃ na kāū

verses.sa:
मत्सर मान मोह मद चोरा ।
इन्ह कर हुनर न कवनिहुँ ओरा ॥
verses.tr:
matsar mān moh mad corā
inh kar hunar na kavanihum̐ orā

verses.sa:
धरम तड़ाग ग्यान बिग्याना ।
ए पंकज बिकसे बिधि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
dharam tar̤āg gyān bigyānā
e paṃkaj bikase bidhi nānā

verses.sa:
सुख संतोष बिराग बिबेका ।
बिगत सोक ए कोक अनेका ॥
verses.tr:
sukh saṃtoṣ birāg bibekā
bigat sok e kok anekā

verses.sa:
यह प्रताप रबि जाकें उर जब करइ प्रकास ।
पछिले बाढ़हिं प्रथम जे कहे ते पावहिं नास ॥
verses.tr:
yah pratāp rabi jākeṃ ur jab karai prakās
pachile bār̤hahiṃ pratham je kahe te pāvahiṃ nās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: part the All-merciful was ever to them most gracious. Chaupdi.

From the time, Garur, of the uprising of the glorious sun of Rama’s power the three spheres were all suffused with light: many were happy, but many also were sad. First to enumerate the sorrowful: to begin with, the night of Ignorance was at an end; owl-like Sin slunk away out and of sight; Lust and Anger, like gamblers, were ashamed to show themselves; Formalism, Phenomenal Existence, Time and Nature, were as ill at ease as the chakor; Envy, Pride, Infatuation and Conceit were like thieves, with nowhere a chance to display their skill. But the. ponds of Piety blossomed with the lotuses of Knowledge and Understanding; while Happiness, Contentment, Self-control and
Discretion were like so many chakwas and chakwis when their sorrow is over.
When this glorious sun illumines any man’s heart, the Just-named qualities grow and increase, the first mentioned die away.

sections.label: Doha 32
sections.name: देखि राम मुनि आवत हरषि दंडवत कीन्ह

verses.sa:
भ्रातन्ह सहित रामु एक बारा ।
संग परम प्रिय पवनकुमारा ॥
verses.tr:
bhrātanh sahit rāmu ek bārā
saṃg param priya pavanakumārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुंदर उपबन देखन गए ।
सब तरु कुसुमित पल्लव नए ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar upaban dekhan gae
sab taru kusumit pallav nae

verses.sa:
जानि समय सनकादिक आए ।
तेज पुंज गुन सील सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
jāni samaya sanakādik āe
tej puṃj gun sīl suhāe

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मानंद सदा लयलीना ।
देखत बालक बहुकालीना ॥
verses.tr:
brahmānaṃd sadā layalīnā
dekhat bālak bahukālīnā

verses.sa:
रूप धरें जनु चारिउ बेदा ।
समदरसी मुनि बिगत बिभेदा ॥
verses.tr:
rūp dhareṃ janu cāriu bedā
samadarasī muni bigat bibhedā

verses.sa:
आसा बसन ब्यसन यह तिन्हहीं ।
रघुपति चरित होइ तहँ सुनहीं ॥
verses.tr:
āsā basan byasan yah tinhahīṃ
raghupati carit hoi taham̐ sunahīṃ

verses.sa:
तहाँ रहे सनकादि भवानी ।
जहँ घटसंभव मुनिबर ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
tahām̐ rahe sanakādi bhavānī
jaham̐ ghaṭasaṃbhav munibar gyānī

verses.sa:
राम कथा मुनिबर बहु बरनी ।
ग्यान जोनि पावक जिमि अरनी ॥
verses.tr:
rām kathā munibar bahu baranī
gyān joni pāvak jimi aranī

verses.sa:
देखि राम मुनि आवत हरषि दंडवत कीन्ह ।
स्वागत पूँछि पीत पट प्रभु बैठन कहँ दीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rām muni āvat haraṣi daṃḍavat kīnh
svāgat pūm̐chi pīt paṭ prabhu baiṭhan kaham̐ dīnh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: One day Rama with his brothers and his special favourite Hanuman went to visit a beautiful grove, where every tree was bright with flowers and fresh leaves. “Sanat- Kumara and the others noted their opportunity and came also; a glorious band of pre-eminent virtue and goodness, ever absorbed in the rapture of transcendental felicity, and still youthful to look at despite their immemorial years. One in appearance and without any distirctive mark, as it might be the four Vedas in bodily form, the saints had but this one hope, desire and ambition, to hear the recital of Rama’s actions. The stopt, Bhavani, at the same place as the learned sage Agastya, who repeated to them the whole of Rama’s history, the source of true wisdom, as friction is of fire.
When RAma saw the sages approaching, he rejoiced and prostrated himself before them; then after giving them welcome, the lord of the yellow robe made them sit down.

sections.label: Doha 33
sections.name: संत संग अपबर्ग कर कामी भव कर पंथ

verses.sa:
कीन्ह दंडवत तीनिउँ भाई ।
सहित पवनसुत सुख अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh daṃḍavat tīnium̐ bhāī
sahit pavanasut sukh adhikāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मुनि रघुपति छबि अतुल बिलोकी ।
भए मगन मन सके न रोकी ॥
verses.tr:
muni raghupati chabi atul bilokī
bhae magan man sake na rokī

verses.sa:
स्यामल गात सरोरुह लोचन ।
सुंदरता मंदिर भव मोचन ॥
verses.tr:
syāmal gāt saroruh locan
suṃdaratā maṃdir bhav mocan

verses.sa:
एकटक रहे निमेष न लावहिं ।
प्रभु कर जोरें सीस नवावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
ekaṭak rahe nimeṣ na lāvahiṃ
prabhu kar joreṃ sīs navāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
तिन्ह कै दसा देखि रघुबीरा ।
स्त्रवत नयन जल पुलक सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
tinh kai dasā dekhi raghubīrā
stravat nayan jal pulak sarīrā

verses.sa:
कर गहि प्रभु मुनिबर बैठारे ।
परम मनोहर बचन उचारे ॥
verses.tr:
kar gahi prabhu munibar baiṭhāre
param manohar bacan ucāre

verses.sa:
आजु धन्य मैं सुनहु मुनीसा ।
तुम्हरें दरस जाहिं अघ खीसा ॥
verses.tr:
āju dhanya maiṃ sunahu munīsā
tumhareṃ daras jāhiṃ agh khīsā

verses.sa:
बड़े भाग पाइब सतसंगा ।
बिनहिं प्रयास होहिं भव भंगा ॥
verses.tr:
bar̤e bhāg pāib satasaṃgā
binahiṃ prayās hohiṃ bhav bhaṃgā

verses.sa:
संत संग अपबर्ग कर कामी भव कर पंथ ।
कहहि संत कबि कोबिद श्रुति पुरान सदग्रंथ ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt saṃg apabarg kar kāmī bhav kar paṃth
kahahi saṃt kabi kobid śruti purān sadagraṃth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: His three brothers made their obeisance also and were greatly delighted, as also Hanuman. The saints, as they gazed on Rama's incomparable beauty, were beside themselves with rapture. With clasped hands they bowed the head before him and could not close their eyes for a moment, so intensely were they fixed on the shrine of beauty, the conqueror of the world, with bis lotus-eyes and dark -hued frame. When Raghubir perceived their condition, his eyes streamed with tears and his body quivered with emotion. He took them by the hand and made them sit down and addressed them in these most gracious words: ‘Hearken, reverend Sirs; to-day I am indeed blessed; at the Sight of you sin ig annihilated. The fellowship of the saints is
5T THE SEQUEL
the greatest of blessings; it at once effects a severance from the world. Dohd 34.

To consorts with the saints leads to final beatitude, but with the sensual to endless tranemigrations: so say the saints themselves, the greatest of the poets, the Vedas, the Purdnas and all the Scriptures.”

sections.label: Doha 34
sections.name: परमानंद कृपायतन मन परिपूरन काम

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु बचन हरषि मुनि चारी ।
पुलकित तन अस्तुति अनुसारी ॥
verses.tr:
suni prabhu bacan haraṣi muni cārī
pulakit tan astuti anusārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जय भगवंत अनंत अनामय ।
अनघ अनेक एक करुनामय ॥
verses.tr:
jaya bhagavaṃt anaṃt anāmaya
anagh anek ek karunāmaya

verses.sa:
जय निर्गुन जय जय गुन सागर ।
सुख मंदिर सुंदर अति नागर ॥
verses.tr:
jaya nirgun jaya jaya gun sāgar
sukh maṃdir suṃdar ati nāgar

verses.sa:
जय इंदिरा रमन जय भूधर ।
अनुपम अज अनादि सोभाकर ॥
verses.tr:
jaya iṃdirā raman jaya bhūdhar
anupam aj anādi sobhākar

verses.sa:
ग्यान निधान अमान मानप्रद ।
पावन सुजस पुरान बेद बद ॥
verses.tr:
gyān nidhān amān mānaprad
pāvan sujas purān bed bad

verses.sa:
तग्य कृतग्य अग्यता भंजन ।
नाम अनेक अनाम निरंजन ॥
verses.tr:
tagya kṛtagya agyatā bhaṃjan
nām anek anām niraṃjan

verses.sa:
सर्ब सर्बगत सर्ब उरालय ।
बससि सदा हम कहुँ परिपालय ॥
verses.tr:
sarb sarbagat sarb urālaya
basasi sadā ham kahum̐ paripālaya

verses.sa:
द्वंद बिपति भव फंद बिभंजय ।
ह्रदि बसि राम काम मद गंजय ॥
verses.tr:
dvaṃd bipati bhav phaṃd bibhaṃjaya
hradi basi rām kām mad gaṃjaya

verses.sa:
परमानंद कृपायतन मन परिपूरन काम ।
प्रेम भगति अनपायनी देहु हमहि श्रीराम ॥
verses.tr:
paramānaṃd kṛpāyatan man paripūran kām
prem bhagati anapāyanī dehu hamahi śrīrām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The four sages were rejoiced to hear the lord’s words and with quivering body they raised this hymn of praise: “Glory to the Lord God, the everlasting, the unchangeable, the sinless, the multiform, the One, the All-merciful. Glory to the unembodied; glory, glory to the universal embodiment, the palace of bliss, the beautiful in his comeliness. Glory to the spouse of Lakshmi; glory to the supporter cf the earth, peerless in his splendour; the uncreated, of whom there is no beginning: the fountain of wisdom; the immeasurable; the bestower of honour; whose holy fame is the theme of the Vedas and Puranas; the all-wise, the all-generous; the destroyer of ignorance; the many-named, the nameless; the emotionless; the universe itself, the universal spirit;the indweller of every heart. Abide with us and protect ns for ever, O Rama; dwell in our heart, tearing asunder the bonds of the world and its miserable conten-tions and destroying our sensuality and conceit.
O holy Rama, all-blessed and all-merciful, fulfiller of every desire of the soul, bestow on us the boon of constant love and devotion.

sections.label: Doha 35
sections.name: बार बार अस्तुति करि प्रेम सहित सिरु नाइ

verses.sa:
देहु भगति रघुपति अति पावनि ।
त्रिबिध ताप भव दाप नसावनि ॥
verses.tr:
dehu bhagati raghupati ati pāvani
tribidh tāp bhav dāp nasāvani
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रनत काम सुरधेनु कलपतरु ।
होइ प्रसन्न दीजै प्रभु यह बरु ॥
verses.tr:
pranat kām suradhenu kalapataru
hoi prasann dījai prabhu yah baru

verses.sa:
भव बारिधि कुंभज रघुनायक ।
सेवत सुलभ सकल सुख दायक ॥
verses.tr:
bhav bāridhi kuṃbhaj raghunāyak
sevat sulabh sakal sukh dāyak

verses.sa:
मन संभव दारुन दुख दारय ।
दीनबंधु समता बिस्तारय ॥
verses.tr:
man saṃbhav dārun dukh dāraya
dīnabaṃdhu samatā bistāraya

verses.sa:
आस त्रास इरिषादि निवारक ।
बिनय बिबेक बिरति बिस्तारक ॥
verses.tr:
ās trās iriṣādi nivārak
binaya bibek birati bistārak

verses.sa:
भूप मौलि मन मंडन धरनी ।
देहि भगति संसृति सरि तरनी ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp mauli man maṃḍan dharanī
dehi bhagati saṃsṛti sari taranī

verses.sa:
मुनि मन मानस हंस निरंतर ।
चरन कमल बंदित अज संकर ॥
verses.tr:
muni man mānas haṃs niraṃtar
caran kamal baṃdit aj saṃkar

verses.sa:
रघुकुल केतु सेतु श्रुति रच्छक ।
काल करम सुभाउ गुन भच्छक ॥
verses.tr:
raghukul ketu setu śruti racchak
kāl karam subhāu gun bhacchak

verses.sa:
तारन तरन हरन सब दूषन ।
तुलसिदास प्रभु त्रिभुवन भूषन ॥
verses.tr:
tāran taran haran sab dūṣan
tulasidās prabhu tribhuvan bhūṣan

verses.sa:
बार बार अस्तुति करि प्रेम सहित सिरु नाइ ।
ब्रह्म भवन सनकादि गे अति अभीष्ट बर पाइ ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār astuti kari prem sahit siru nāi
brahm bhavan sanakādi ge ati abhīṣṭ bar pāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Grant us, O Raghupati, that purifying faith which annihilates every distress and worldly conceit. Be propitious and grant us this boon, O our Lord, a very cow of heaven, or tree of paradise to satisfy the desires of the suppliant. O Raghu -nayak, the Agastya of the ocean of mundane existence, the bestower of blessings which only your servants find it easy to acquire; destroyer of the destroying tortures of love; friend of the friendless: diffuser of equanimity; preventer of hope and fear, of envy and all evil passions; bestower of meekness, discretion and detachment; jewel of earthly kings; glory of the world; grant us devotion to thee, the only raft on which to cross the Floods of existence; immortal swan io the Manas lake of saintly souls; whose lotus feet are adored by Brahma and Siva; standard of the line of Raghu; bridge for the recovery of the Scriptures; annihilator of time, destiny, nature and phenomenal existence 3, ark of salvation; healer of every sorrow; glory of the three spheres; Tulsi Das’s own lord.”
Having again and again hymned his praises and lovingly bowed the head, ‘Sanat-Kamera and his companions returned to Brahma’s sphere, after obtaining the boon they had so vehemently coveted.

sections.label: Doha 36
sections.name: नाथ न मोहि संदेह कछु सपनेहुँ सोक न मोह

verses.sa:
सनकादिक बिधि लोक सिधाए ।
भ्रातन्ह राम चरन सिरु नाए ॥
verses.tr:
sanakādik bidhi lok sidhāe
bhrātanh rām caran siru nāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पूछत प्रभुहि सकल सकुचाहीं ।
चितवहिं सब मारुतसुत पाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
pūchat prabhuhi sakal sakucāhīṃ
citavahiṃ sab mārutasut pāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि चहहिं प्रभु मुख कै बानी ।
जो सुनि होइ सकल भ्रम हानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni cahahiṃ prabhu mukh kai bānī
jo suni hoi sakal bhram hānī

verses.sa:
अंतरजामी प्रभु सभ जाना ।
बूझत कहहु काह हनुमाना ॥
verses.tr:
aṃtarajāmī prabhu sabh jānā
būjhat kahahu kāh hanumānā

verses.sa:
जोरि पानि कह तब हनुमंता ।
सुनहु दीनदयाल भगवंता ॥
verses.tr:
jori pāni kah tab hanumaṃtā
sunahu dīnadayāl bhagavaṃtā

verses.sa:
नाथ भरत कछु पूँछन चहहीं ।
प्रस्न करत मन सकुचत अहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nāth bharat kachu pūm̐chan cahahīṃ
prasn karat man sakucat ahahīṃ

verses.sa:
तुम्ह जानहु कपि मोर सुभाऊ ।
भरतहि मोहि कछु अंतर काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tumh jānahu kapi mor subhāū
bharatahi mohi kachu aṃtar kāū

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु बचन भरत गहे चरना ।
सुनहु नाथ प्रनतारति हरना ॥
verses.tr:
suni prabhu bacan bharat gahe caranā
sunahu nāth pranatārati haranā

verses.sa:
नाथ न मोहि संदेह कछु सपनेहुँ सोक न मोह ।
केवल कृपा तुम्हारिहि कृपानंद संदोह ॥
verses.tr:
nāth na mohi saṃdeh kachu sapanehum̐ sok na moh
keval kṛpā tumhārihi kṛpānaṃd saṃdoh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When Sanat-Komira and his companions had gone their way to Brahma’s sphere, the three brothers bowed their head at Rama’s feet, but being too diffident themselves to put the question tothe Lord, they looked to Hanuman, wishing to hear from the Lord’s own mouth an explanation which would terminate all their doubts. The reader of the heart understood this perfectly and said, ‘What is it you wish to know, Hanuman?” Then replied Hanuman with clasped hands: ‘Hearken, all-merciful Lord God; Bharat, Sire, wishes to ask something, but is too diffident to speak out.” *‘ Monkey, you know my feelings; there are no secrets between me and Bharat.” On hearing the Lord’s words Bharat clasped his feet: * Hearken, my lord, reliever of all the anxieties of the sappliant;
I have no doubts whatever, Sire; not a shadow of dis-quietade or distrust; and this all of your mercy, O All-merciful and All-blessed.

sections.label: Doha 37
sections.name: ताते सुर सीसन्ह चढ़त जग बल्लभ श्रीखंड

verses.sa:
करउँ कृपानिधि एक ढिठाई ।
मैं सेवक तुम्ह जन सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
karaum̐ kṛpānidhi ek ḍhiṭhāī
maiṃ sevak tumh jan sukhadāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
संतन्ह कै महिमा रघुराई ।
बहु बिधि बेद पुरानन्ह गाई ॥
verses.tr:
saṃtanh kai mahimā raghurāī
bahu bidhi bed purānanh gāī

verses.sa:
श्रीमुख तुम्ह पुनि कीन्हि बड़ाई ।
तिन्ह पर प्रभुहि प्रीति अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
śrīmukh tumh puni kīnhi bar̤āī
tinh par prabhuhi prīti adhikāī

verses.sa:
सुना चहउँ प्रभु तिन्ह कर लच्छन ।
कृपासिंधु गुन ग्यान बिचच्छन ॥
verses.tr:
sunā cahaum̐ prabhu tinh kar lacchan
kṛpāsiṃdhu gun gyān bicacchan

verses.sa:
संत असंत भेद बिलगाई ।
प्रनतपाल मोहि कहहु बुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt asaṃt bhed bilagāī
pranatapāl mohi kahahu bujhāī

verses.sa:
संतन्ह के लच्छन सुनु भ्राता ।
अगनित श्रुति पुरान बिख्याता ॥
verses.tr:
saṃtanh ke lacchan sunu bhrātā
aganit śruti purān bikhyātā

verses.sa:
संत असंतन्हि कै असि करनी ।
जिमि कुठार चंदन आचरनी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt asaṃtanhi kai asi karanī
jimi kuṭhār caṃdan ācaranī

verses.sa:
काटइ परसु मलय सुनु भाई ।
निज गुन देइ सुगंध बसाई ॥
verses.tr:
kāṭai parasu malaya sunu bhāī
nij gun dei sugaṃdh basāī

verses.sa:
ताते सुर सीसन्ह चढ़त जग बल्लभ श्रीखंड ।
अनल दाहि पीटत घनहिं परसु बदन यह दंड ॥
verses.tr:
tāte sur sīsanh car̤hat jag ballabh śrīkhaṃḍ
anal dāhi pīṭat ghanahiṃ parasu badan yah daṃḍ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bat if I may presume oa your loving-kindness—for I am your servant and you the benefactor of your faithful people — the Vedas and Pur^nas, O Raghurdi, have sung in various ways the greatness of the saints; you too have exalted them by your own holy mouth, declaring that the Lord has a special affection for them. I would fain hear, Sire, their distinctive marks, O gracious discerner of character and understanding. Instruct me, protector of the suppliant, in the notes that distinguish the good from the wicked.” “Hearken brother; the notes of the good as told in the Vedas and Puranas are innumerable. The conduct of the good to the wicked is like that of the sundal-tree to the axe, for—see, brother—the fragrant wood imparts its perfume to the very iron that fells it.
For this reason sandal-wood is the desire of the world and has the honour of being put on the head of gods; while the axe, for its punishment, has its edge heated in the fire and is well hammered.

sections.label: Doha 38
sections.name: निंदा अस्तुति उभय सम ममता मम पद कंज

verses.sa:
बिषय अलंपट सील गुनाकर ।
पर दुख दुख सुख सुख देखे पर ॥
verses.tr:
biṣaya alaṃpaṭ sīl gunākar
par dukh dukh sukh sukh dekhe par
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सम अभूतरिपु बिमद बिरागी ।
लोभामरष हरष भय त्यागी ॥
verses.tr:
sam abhūtaripu bimad birāgī
lobhāmaraṣ haraṣ bhaya tyāgī

verses.sa:
कोमलचित दीनन्ह पर दाया ।
मन बच क्रम मम भगति अमाया ॥
verses.tr:
komalacit dīnanh par dāyā
man bac kram mam bhagati amāyā

verses.sa:
सबहि मानप्रद आपु अमानी ।
भरत प्रान सम मम ते प्रानी ॥
verses.tr:
sabahi mānaprad āpu amānī
bharat prān sam mam te prānī

verses.sa:
बिगत काम मम नाम परायन ।
सांति बिरति बिनती मुदितायन ॥
verses.tr:
bigat kām mam nām parāyan
sāṃti birati binatī muditāyan

verses.sa:
सीतलता सरलता मयत्री ।
द्विज पद प्रीति धर्म जनयत्री ॥
verses.tr:
sītalatā saralatā mayatrī
dvij pad prīti dharm janayatrī

verses.sa:
ए सब लच्छन बसहिं जासु उर ।
जानेहु तात संत संतत फुर ॥
verses.tr:
e sab lacchan basahiṃ jāsu ur
jānehu tāt saṃt saṃtat phur

verses.sa:
सम दम नियम नीति नहिं डोलहिं ।
परुष बचन कबहूँ नहिं बोलहिं ॥
verses.tr:
sam dam niyam nīti nahiṃ ḍolahiṃ
paruṣ bacan kabahūm̐ nahiṃ bolahiṃ

verses.sa:
निंदा अस्तुति उभय सम ममता मम पद कंज ।
ते सज्जन मम प्रानप्रिय गुन मंदिर सुख पुंज ॥
verses.tr:
niṃdā astuti ubhaya sam mamatā mam pad kaṃj
te sajjan mam prānapriya gun maṃdir sukh puṃj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Without attachment to sensual objects; store-houses of virtue and generosity; sorrowing in the sorrow of others and finding joy in their joy; equable, devoid of animosity; sober, passionless: conquerors of greed and impatience, joy and fear; tender of heart, compassionate to the poor; with a guileless devotion to me in thought, word and deed; giving honour to all, but claiming none for themselves; such, Bharat, are dear to moas my own life; unselfish, devoted to my name; happy abodes of tranquillity, continence and humility; models of contentment, simplicity, benevolence, piety and devotion tothe Brahmans. Verily, brothers, any’ heart in which these qualities abide is ever the heart of a saint. They are never disturbed in their quietude, their self-control, their religious observances or their moral principles; they never utter a harsh word;

They regard praise and blame as both alike, ia their ex-clusivo devotion to my lotus feet; such are the treasurers vf virtue, the compendiums of bliss, who are the good, and whom I love as my own soul.

sections.label: Doha 39
sections.name: पर द्रोही पर दार रत पर धन पर अपबाद

verses.sa:
सनहु असंतन्ह केर सुभाऊ ।
भूलेहुँ संगति करिअ न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sanahu asaṃtanh ker subhāū
bhūlehum̐ saṃgati karia na kāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तिन्ह कर संग सदा दुखदाई ।
जिमि कलपहि घालइ हरहाई ॥
verses.tr:
tinh kar saṃg sadā dukhadāī
jimi kalapahi ghālai harahāī

verses.sa:
खलन्ह हृदयँ अति ताप बिसेषी ।
जरहिं सदा पर संपति देखी ॥
verses.tr:
khalanh hṛdayam̐ ati tāp biseṣī
jarahiṃ sadā par saṃpati dekhī

verses.sa:
जहँ कहुँ निंदा सुनहिं पराई ।
हरषहिं मनहुँ परी निधि पाई ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ kahum̐ niṃdā sunahiṃ parāī
haraṣahiṃ manahum̐ parī nidhi pāī

verses.sa:
काम क्रोध मद लोभ परायन ।
निर्दय कपटी कुटिल मलायन ॥
verses.tr:
kām krodh mad lobh parāyan
nirdaya kapaṭī kuṭil malāyan

verses.sa:
बयरु अकारन सब काहू सों ।
जो कर हित अनहित ताहू सों ॥
verses.tr:
bayaru akāran sab kāhū soṃ
jo kar hit anahit tāhū soṃ

verses.sa:
झूठइ लेना झूठइ देना ।
झूठइ भोजन झूठ चबेना ॥
verses.tr:
jhūṭhai lenā jhūṭhai denā
jhūṭhai bhojan jhūṭh cabenā

verses.sa:
बोलहिं मधुर बचन जिमि मोरा ।
खाइ महा अति हृदय कठोरा ॥
verses.tr:
bolahiṃ madhur bacan jimi morā
khāi mahā ati hṛdaya kaṭhorā

verses.sa:
पर द्रोही पर दार रत पर धन पर अपबाद ।
ते नर पाँवर पापमय देह धरें मनुजाद ॥
verses.tr:
par drohī par dār rat par dhan par apabād
te nar pām̐var pāpamaya deh dhareṃ manujād
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hear now the characteristics of the bad, with whom one should carefully avoid any dealings. Their company always leads te trouble, as when an ill-conditioned cow gets a gentle companion beaten like itself. The heart of the wicked is a

Consuming fire, which is ever rekindled at the sight of another’s prosperity: but whenever they hear a neighbour abused, they are as glad as if they had picked upa treasure on the road. Devoted to sensuality, choleric, arrogant and greedy; censorious, treacherous, perverse and impure; cherishing causeless animosities against every one: disliking anything that others like; false in taking, false in giving, false in great matters and false in small; speaking plausible words, but ruthless of heart, like the peacock that devours the biggest snake. Dold 40.
Injurious to their neighbour, covetous of his wife and wealth and gloating over his misfortunes; men thus vile and abominable are ruthless incarnate fiends.

sections.label: Doha 40
sections.name: ऐसे अधम मनुज खल कृतजुग त्रेता नाहिं

verses.sa:
लोभइ ओढ़न लोभइ डासन ।
सिस्त्रोदर पर जमपुर त्रास न ॥
verses.tr:
lobhai or̤han lobhai ḍāsan
sistrodar par jamapur trās na
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
काहू की जौं सुनहिं बड़ाई ।
स्वास लेहिं जनु जूड़ी आई ॥
verses.tr:
kāhū kī jauṃ sunahiṃ bar̤āī
svās lehiṃ janu jūr̤ī āī

verses.sa:
जब काहू कै देखहिं बिपती ।
सुखी भए मानहुँ जग नृपती ॥
verses.tr:
jab kāhū kai dekhahiṃ bipatī
sukhī bhae mānahum̐ jag nṛpatī

verses.sa:
स्वारथ रत परिवार बिरोधी ।
लंपट काम लोभ अति क्रोधी ॥
verses.tr:
svārath rat parivār birodhī
laṃpaṭ kām lobh ati krodhī

verses.sa:
मातु पिता गुर बिप्र न मानहिं ।
आपु गए अरु घालहिं आनहिं ॥
verses.tr:
mātu pitā gur bipr na mānahiṃ
āpu gae aru ghālahiṃ ānahiṃ

verses.sa:
करहिं मोह बस द्रोह परावा ।
संत संग हरि कथा न भावा ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ moh bas droh parāvā
saṃt saṃg hari kathā na bhāvā

verses.sa:
अवगुन सिंधु मंदमति कामी ।
बेद बिदूषक परधन स्वामी ॥
verses.tr:
avagun siṃdhu maṃdamati kāmī
bed bidūṣak paradhan svāmī

verses.sa:
बिप्र द्रोह पर द्रोह बिसेषा ।
दंभ कपट जियँ धरें सुबेषा ॥
verses.tr:
bipr droh par droh biseṣā
daṃbh kapaṭ jiyam̐ dhareṃ subeṣā

verses.sa:
ऐसे अधम मनुज खल कृतजुग त्रेता नाहिं ।
द्वापर कछुक बृंद बहु होइहहिं कलिजुग माहिं ॥
verses.tr:
aise adham manuj khal kṛtajug tretā nāhiṃ
dvāpar kachuk bṛṃd bahu hoihahiṃ kalijug māhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Coveting dress, coveting bed; addicted to lust and gluttony; with no fear of the realm of Yama before their eyes; vatching their breath, as though they had got the ague when they hear of any one’s advancement; but as glad as though they had been made kings of the world, when they see their neighbour in distress; devoted to their own selfish interests, quarrelsome to their kinsfolk, dissolute, avaricious and choleric; disobedient to father and mother, to guru and Brahman: dragging down others into the same ruin with themselves; infatuated workers of other's ill; taking no pleasure in the company of the good or in discourse about Hari: oceans of immorality, dull of understanding, lascivi-cus, revilers of the Vedas, masterful with other men’s goods, special torment of the Brahmans and the gods, with deceit and treachery in their heart, though outwardly fair seeming.
No such vile wretches of man existed in the first and second age, and only afew in the third, but in the fourth there are swarms of them.

sections.label: Doha 41
sections.name: सुनहु तात माया कृत गुन अरु दोष अनेक

verses.sa:
पर हित सरिस धर्म नहिं भाई ।
पर पीड़ा सम नहिं अधमाई ॥
verses.tr:
par hit saris dharm nahiṃ bhāī
par pīr̤ā sam nahiṃ adhamāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
निर्नय सकल पुरान बेद कर ।
कहेउँ तात जानहिं कोबिद नर ॥
verses.tr:
nirnaya sakal purān bed kar
kaheum̐ tāt jānahiṃ kobid nar

verses.sa:
नर सरीर धरि जे पर पीरा ।
करहिं ते सहहिं महा भव भीरा ॥
verses.tr:
nar sarīr dhari je par pīrā
karahiṃ te sahahiṃ mahā bhav bhīrā

verses.sa:
करहिं मोह बस नर अघ नाना ।
स्वारथ रत परलोक नसाना ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ moh bas nar agh nānā
svārath rat paralok nasānā

verses.sa:
कालरूप तिन्ह कहँ मैं भ्राता ।
सुभ अरु असुभ कर्म फल दाता ॥
verses.tr:
kālarūp tinh kaham̐ maiṃ bhrātā
subh aru asubh karm phal dātā

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि जे परम सयाने ।
भजहिं मोहि संसृत दुख जाने ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri je param sayāne
bhajahiṃ mohi saṃsṛt dukh jāne

verses.sa:
त्यागहिं कर्म सुभासुभ दायक ।
भजहिं मोहि सुर नर मुनि नायक ॥
verses.tr:
tyāgahiṃ karm subhāsubh dāyak
bhajahiṃ mohi sur nar muni nāyak

verses.sa:
संत असंतन्ह के गुन भाषे ।
ते न परहिं भव जिन्ह लखि राखे ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt asaṃtanh ke gun bhāṣe
te na parahiṃ bhav jinh lakhi rākhe

verses.sa:
सुनहु तात माया कृत गुन अरु दोष अनेक ।
गुन यह उभय न देखिअहिं देखिअ सो अबिबेक ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu tāt māyā kṛt gun aru doṣ anek
gun yah ubhaya na dekhiahiṃ dekhia so abibek
verses.head: दोहा

trans: O my brother, there is no religion like charity and no meanness like malevolence. What I now declare to you is the sum of the Vedas and Purdnas and the verdict of the philosophers. Men who in the body cause suffering to others undergo an enormous series of transmigrations. Men are go infatuated that in their devotion to their own selfish interests they commit many sins and ruin their prospects for the next world, [ reveal myself to them, brother, as their destiny and assign them the reward of their deeds, whether good or evil. The truly wise consider the matter thus and worship me, regarding the world only as a burden; they discard action with its result, good or bad, and devoutly adore me, the king of gods and men and saints, Thus have I declared the characteristics of the good and the bad; they who remember them will not be submerged in the flood of existence.
Hearken, brothor; the multitudinous forms of merit and demerit are all the products of Maya: greatest merit is to notice neither: to notice them is an imperfection of knowledge.”

sections.label: Doha 42
sections.name: जीवनमुक्त ब्रह्मपर चरित सुनहिं तजि ध्यान

verses.sa:
श्रीमुख बचन सुनत सब भाई ।
हरषे प्रेम न हृदयँ समाई ॥
verses.tr:
śrīmukh bacan sunat sab bhāī
haraṣe prem na hṛdayam̐ samāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करहिं बिनय अति बारहिं बारा ।
हनूमान हियँ हरष अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ binaya ati bārahiṃ bārā
hanūmān hiyam̐ haraṣ apārā

verses.sa:
पुनि रघुपति निज मंदिर गए ।
एहि बिधि चरित करत नित नए ॥
verses.tr:
puni raghupati nij maṃdir gae
ehi bidhi carit karat nit nae

verses.sa:
बार बार नारद मुनि आवहिं ।
चरित पुनीत राम के गावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār nārad muni āvahiṃ
carit punīt rām ke gāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
नित नव चरन देखि मुनि जाहीं ।
ब्रह्मलोक सब कथा कहाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nit nav caran dekhi muni jāhīṃ
brahmalok sab kathā kahāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि बिरंचि अतिसय सुख मानहिं ।
पुनि पुनि तात करहु गुन गानहिं ॥
verses.tr:
suni biraṃci atisaya sukh mānahiṃ
puni puni tāt karahu gun gānahiṃ

verses.sa:
सनकादिक नारदहि सराहहिं ।
जद्यपि ब्रह्म निरत मुनि आहहिं ॥
verses.tr:
sanakādik nāradahi sarāhahiṃ
jadyapi brahm nirat muni āhahiṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि गुन गान समाधि बिसारी ।
सादर सुनहिं परम अधिकारी ॥
verses.tr:
suni gun gān samādhi bisārī
sādar sunahiṃ param adhikārī

verses.sa:
जीवनमुक्त ब्रह्मपर चरित सुनहिं तजि ध्यान ।
जे हरि कथाँ न करहिं रति तिन्ह के हिय पाषान ॥
verses.tr:
jīvanamukt brahmapar carit sunahiṃ taji dhyān
je hari kathām̐ na karahiṃ rati tinh ke hiya pāṣān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing this utterance of the divine mouth, the brothers rejoiced and their heart overflowed with love. Again and again they paid him profound homage, while a boundless delight filled the soul] of Hanuman also. Rama then withdrew to the private palace; but every day there © was some new incident of the same character. The sage Narad came time after time and hymned Rama's holy acts, every day finding something new to record. He then went to Brahma's realm and there recited the whole story. The Creator on hearing it was so highly pleased that he urged him to repeat it again and again. Sanat-Kumdara and the others marvelled at Narad; and the saints, though absorbed in the contemplation of the Supreme Spirit, forgot their abstraction on hearing his hymn of praise. The highest powers listened reverently.

Though exempted from mundane existence and intent on the contemplation of the Supreme, they interrupted their meditations in order to hear his lay. Truly theirs must be a heart of stone who take no delight in Rama's history.

sections.label: Doha 43
sections.name: सो परत्र दुख पावइ सिर धुनि धुनि पछिताइ

verses.sa:
एक बार रघुनाथ बोलाए ।
गुर द्विज पुरबासी सब आए ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār raghunāth bolāe
gur dvij purabāsī sab āe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बैठे गुर मुनि अरु द्विज सज्जन ।
बोले बचन भगत भव भंजन ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhe gur muni aru dvij sajjan
bole bacan bhagat bhav bhaṃjan

verses.sa:
सनहु सकल पुरजन मम बानी ।
कहउँ न कछु ममता उर आनी ॥
verses.tr:
sanahu sakal purajan mam bānī
kahaum̐ na kachu mamatā ur ānī

verses.sa:
नहिं अनीति नहिं कछु प्रभुताई ।
सुनहु करहु जो तुम्हहि सोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ anīti nahiṃ kachu prabhutāī
sunahu karahu jo tumhahi sohāī

verses.sa:
सोइ सेवक प्रियतम मम सोई ।
मम अनुसासन मानै जोई ॥
verses.tr:
soi sevak priyatam mam soī
mam anusāsan mānai joī

verses.sa:
जौं अनीति कछु भाषौं भाई ।
तौं मोहि बरजहु भय बिसराई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ anīti kachu bhāṣauṃ bhāī
tauṃ mohi barajahu bhaya bisarāī

verses.sa:
बड़ें भाग मानुष तनु पावा ।
सुर दुर्लभ सब ग्रंथिन्ह गावा ॥
verses.tr:
bar̤eṃ bhāg mānuṣ tanu pāvā
sur durlabh sab graṃthinh gāvā

verses.sa:
साधन धाम मोच्छ कर द्वारा ।
पाइ न जेहिं परलोक सँवारा ॥
verses.tr:
sādhan dhām mocch kar dvārā
pāi na jehiṃ paralok sam̐vārā

verses.sa:
सो परत्र दुख पावइ सिर धुनि धुनि पछिताइ ।
कालहि कर्महि ईस्वरहि मिथ्या दोष लगाइ ॥
verses.tr:
so paratr dukh pāvai sir dhuni dhuni pachitāi
kālahi karmahi īsvarahi mithyā doṣ lagāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: One day by Rama’s invitation all the gurus and Brab-
mans and people of the city came together, and when the priests and nobles had taken their seat in the assembly, the

Comforter of the pious made them this speech: “Hearken to my words, all ye people of the city: I speak without any selfish motive at heart, neither wronging another nor aggrandizing myself; listen and act as may seem good to you. He is my servant and he my best beloved, who accepts my commands. IfI say anything that is wrong, brother, do not be afraid to correct me. All the Scriptures declare that it is great good fortune and a great difficulty surmounted to be born with the body of a man, which is a store-house of opportunities, a gate of deliverance; and those who have received it and still attain not to heaven.
They, 1 say, reap torment in the next world and beat their head in despair, wrongly attributing the blame to time, fate and God.

sections.label: Doha 44
sections.name: जो न तरै भव सागर नर समाज अस पाइ

verses.sa:
एहि तन कर फल बिषय न भाई ।
स्वर्गउ स्वल्प अंत दुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
ehi tan kar phal biṣaya na bhāī
svargau svalp aṃt dukhadāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नर तनु पाइ बिषयँ मन देहीं ।
पलटि सुधा ते सठ बिष लेहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nar tanu pāi biṣayam̐ man dehīṃ
palaṭi sudhā te saṭh biṣ lehīṃ

verses.sa:
ताहि कबहुँ भल कहइ न कोई ।
गुंजा ग्रहइ परस मनि खोई ॥
verses.tr:
tāhi kabahum̐ bhal kahai na koī
guṃjā grahai paras mani khoī

verses.sa:
आकर चारि लच्छ चौरासी ।
जोनि भ्रमत यह जिव अबिनासी ॥
verses.tr:
ākar cāri lacch caurāsī
joni bhramat yah jiv abināsī

verses.sa:
फिरत सदा माया कर प्रेरा ।
काल कर्म सुभाव गुन घेरा ॥
verses.tr:
phirat sadā māyā kar prerā
kāl karm subhāv gun gherā

verses.sa:
कबहुँक करि करुना नर देही ।
देत ईस बिनु हेतु सनेही ॥
verses.tr:
kabahum̐k kari karunā nar dehī
det īs binu hetu sanehī

verses.sa:
नर तनु भव बारिधि कहुँ बेरो ।
सन्मुख मरुत अनुग्रह मेरो ॥
verses.tr:
nar tanu bhav bāridhi kahum̐ bero
sanmukh marut anugrah mero

verses.sa:
करनधार सदगुर दृढ़ नावा ।
दुर्लभ साज सुलभ करि पावा ॥
verses.tr:
karanadhār sadagur dṛr̤h nāvā
durlabh sāj sulabh kari pāvā

verses.sa:
जो न तरै भव सागर नर समाज अस पाइ ।
सो कृत निंदक मंदमति आत्माहन गति जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
jo na tarai bhav sāgar nar samāj as pāi
so kṛt niṃdak maṃdamati ātmāhan gati jāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: But materialism, brother, is not the proper object of the human body; it is happiness for a very brief period, but ends in misery. The possessor of a human body who gives himself up to materialism is like a fool who chooses poison in preference to ambrosia. He is one of whom none can speak well; he throws away the philosopher’s stone to pick up @ pepper-corn, Such a creature drifts for ever among the four modes of birth and the eighty-four lakhs of living species, perpetually changing at the will of May and encompassed by Time, Fate, Nature and Phenomena. At some time or another God of his mercy, and without any reason for the favour, gives him a human body, 4 raft on which he may cross the ocean of existence, with my grace asa fair wind to speed him on his course: with pious teachers at the helm he easily procures all the equipment of a stout ship, which would else be beyond him.
If thus equipt be fails to cross the sea, he ix an ungrate-

sections.label: Doha 45
sections.name: औरउ एक गुपुत मत सबहि कहउँ कर जोरि

verses.sa:
जौं परलोक इहाँ सुख चहहू ।
सुनि मम बचन ह्रृदयँ दृढ़ गहहू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ paralok ihām̐ sukh cahahū
suni mam bacan hrṛdayam̐ dṛr̤h gahahū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुलभ सुखद मारग यह भाई ।
भगति मोरि पुरान श्रुति गाई ॥
verses.tr:
sulabh sukhad mārag yah bhāī
bhagati mori purān śruti gāī

verses.sa:
ग्यान अगम प्रत्यूह अनेका ।
साधन कठिन न मन कहुँ टेका ॥
verses.tr:
gyān agam pratyūh anekā
sādhan kaṭhin na man kahum̐ ṭekā

verses.sa:
करत कष्ट बहु पावइ कोऊ ।
भक्ति हीन मोहि प्रिय नहिं सोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
karat kaṣṭ bahu pāvai koū
bhakti hīn mohi priya nahiṃ soū

verses.sa:
भक्ति सुतंत्र सकल सुख खानी ।
बिनु सतसंग न पावहिं प्रानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhakti sutaṃtr sakal sukh khānī
binu satasaṃg na pāvahiṃ prānī

verses.sa:
पुन्य पुंज बिनु मिलहिं न संता ।
सतसंगति संसृति कर अंता ॥
verses.tr:
punya puṃj binu milahiṃ na saṃtā
satasaṃgati saṃsṛti kar aṃtā

verses.sa:
पुन्य एक जग महुँ नहिं दूजा ।
मन क्रम बचन बिप्र पद पूजा ॥
verses.tr:
punya ek jag mahum̐ nahiṃ dūjā
man kram bacan bipr pad pūjā

verses.sa:
सानुकूल तेहि पर मुनि देवा ।
जो तजि कपटु करइ द्विज सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
sānukūl tehi par muni devā
jo taji kapaṭu karai dvij sevā

verses.sa:
औरउ एक गुपुत मत सबहि कहउँ कर जोरि ।
संकर भजन बिना नर भगति न पावइ मोरि ॥
verses.tr:
aurau ek guput mat sabahi kahaum̐ kar jori
saṃkar bhajan binā nar bhagati na pāvai mori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ful wretch, bent on his own destruction. Chaupdi.

Whoso desires happiness in this world and the next will hearken to my words and imprint them deeply in his heart. It is an easy anda pleasant road, brother, that of my service, at the Vedas and Puranas declare. Knowledge is difficult and beset with impediments; its appliances are cumbrous and it has no grasp on the soul. Though a man endures endless tortures, without faith he is no friend of mine. Faith is all-powerful and a mine of every blessing; but men cannot attain to it except by the fellowship of the saints. The saints are not won except by meritorious deeds; their fellowship isthe end of mundane existence. Now there is no other meritorious deed in the whole wor'd but this one, to worship Brahmans in thought, word and deed. Seers and gods are all in his favour who eschews guile and devotes himself to the Brahmans.
One other mysterious dogma I with clasped hands impress upon you all; without prayer to Siva no one can attain to the faith that I require.

sections.label: Doha 46
sections.name: मम गुन ग्राम नाम रत गत ममता मद मोह

verses.sa:
कहहु भगति पथ कवन प्रयासा ।
जोग न मख जप तप उपवासा ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu bhagati path kavan prayāsā
jog na makh jap tap upavāsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सरल सुभाव न मन कुटिलाई ।
जथा लाभ संतोष सदाई ॥
verses.tr:
saral subhāv na man kuṭilāī
jathā lābh saṃtoṣ sadāī

verses.sa:
मोर दास कहाइ नर आसा ।
करइ तौ कहहु कहा बिस्वासा ॥
verses.tr:
mor dās kahāi nar āsā
karai tau kahahu kahā bisvāsā

verses.sa:
बहुत कहउँ का कथा बढ़ाई ।
एहि आचरन बस्य मैं भाई ॥
verses.tr:
bahut kahaum̐ kā kathā bar̤hāī
ehi ācaran basya maiṃ bhāī

verses.sa:
बैर न बिग्रह आस न त्रासा ।
सुखमय ताहि सदा सब आसा ॥
verses.tr:
bair na bigrah ās na trāsā
sukhamaya tāhi sadā sab āsā

verses.sa:
अनारंभ अनिकेत अमानी ।
अनघ अरोष दच्छ बिग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
anāraṃbh aniket amānī
anagh aroṣ dacch bigyānī

verses.sa:
प्रीति सदा सज्जन संसर्गा ।
तृन सम बिषय स्वर्ग अपबर्गा ॥
verses.tr:
prīti sadā sajjan saṃsargā
tṛn sam biṣaya svarg apabargā

verses.sa:
भगति पच्छ हठ नहिं सठताई ।
दुष्ट तर्क सब दूरि बहाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati pacch haṭh nahiṃ saṭhatāī
duṣṭ tark sab dūri bahāī

verses.sa:
मम गुन ग्राम नाम रत गत ममता मद मोह ।
ता कर सुख सोइ जानइ परानंद संदोह ॥
verses.tr:
mam gun grām nām rat gat mamatā mad moh
tā kar sukh soi jānai parānaṃd saṃdoh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Tell me what are the difficulties in the way of faith; neither abstract meditation is necessary, nor sacrifice, prayer, penance nor fasting; only simplicity of character, a mind void of frowardaoess and absolute content whatever may befall. If one who is called a worshipper of mine trust in man, tell me where is his trust in me? But why protract my discourse to sucha length? these are the practices, brother, by which Iam won: avoidance of enmity and rancour, of hope and fear; a constant atmosphere of perfect repose; passionless homeless; without pride and without sin; placid, provident and wise; ever devoted to the Fellowship of the saints; lightly esteaming every object of sense and even heaven and final deliverance from the body; persistent in faith, innocent of wickedness, a stranger to impious scepticism.
Devoted to my name, which is the sum of all my perfections; devoid of selfishness, conceit and vain imagination; such a man’s happiness, be assured, is the very sum of transcendental felicity.”

sections.label: Doha 47
sections.name: -उमा अवधबासी नर नारि कृतारथ रूप

verses.sa:
सुनत सुधासम बचन राम के ।
गहे सबनि पद कृपाधाम के ॥
verses.tr:
sunat sudhāsam bacan rām ke
gahe sabani pad kṛpādhām ke
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जननि जनक गुर बंधु हमारे ।
कृपा निधान प्रान ते प्यारे ॥
verses.tr:
janani janak gur baṃdhu hamāre
kṛpā nidhān prān te pyāre

verses.sa:
तनु धनु धाम राम हितकारी ।
सब बिधि तुम्ह प्रनतारति हारी ॥
verses.tr:
tanu dhanu dhām rām hitakārī
sab bidhi tumh pranatārati hārī

verses.sa:
असि सिख तुम्ह बिनु देइ न कोऊ ।
मातु पिता स्वारथ रत ओऊ ॥
verses.tr:
asi sikh tumh binu dei na koū
mātu pitā svārath rat oū

verses.sa:
हेतु रहित जग जुग उपकारी ।
तुम्ह तुम्हार सेवक असुरारी ॥
verses.tr:
hetu rahit jag jug upakārī
tumh tumhār sevak asurārī

verses.sa:
स्वारथ मीत सकल जग माहीं ।
सपनेहुँ प्रभु परमारथ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
svārath mīt sakal jag māhīṃ
sapanehum̐ prabhu paramārath nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सबके बचन प्रेम रस साने ।
सुनि रघुनाथ हृदयँ हरषाने ॥
verses.tr:
sabake bacan prem ras sāne
suni raghunāth hṛdayam̐ haraṣāne

verses.sa:
निज निज गृह गए आयसु पाई ।
बरनत प्रभु बतकही सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
nij nij gṛh gae āyasu pāī
baranat prabhu batakahī suhāī

verses.sa:
-उमा अवधबासी नर नारि कृतारथ रूप ।
ब्रह्म सच्चिदानंद घन रघुनायक जहँ भूप ॥
verses.tr:
-umā avadhabāsī nar nāri kṛtārath rūp
brahm saccidānaṃd ghan raghunāyak jaham̐ bhūp
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing the gracious Rama's ambrosial speech, they all embraced his feet: ‘Fountain of mercy, you are our father, our mother, or spiritual guide and our brethren, and are dearer than our life. You,O Rama, have blessed us in body, substance and house, and have removed all the sorrows of your suppliants. No one but you could teach us this lesson; for even father and mother are self-interested. The only two disinterested friends in the world are you yourself and your servants, O conqueror of the demons. Every friend in the world has his own object in view: no one, Sire, ever dreams of the highest object.” When Raghunath heard them all speak in such terms of devotion he was rejoiced at heart; and they on receiving his permission returned to their several homes, making the Lord the glorious theme of all their talk.
O Uma, every man and woman among the inhabitants of Avadh was the picture of satisfaction; the supreme felicity of heaven suffused the whole city when Rama was king.

sections.label: Doha 48
sections.name: -तब मैं हृदयँ बिचारा जोग जग्य ब्रत दान

verses.sa:
एक बार बसिष्ट मुनि आए ।
जहाँ राम सुखधाम सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār basiṣṭ muni āe
jahām̐ rām sukhadhām suhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अति आदर रघुनायक कीन्हा ।
पद पखारि पादोदक लीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
ati ādar raghunāyak kīnhā
pad pakhāri pādodak līnhā

verses.sa:
राम सुनहु मुनि कह कर जोरी ।
कृपासिंधु बिनती कछु मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
rām sunahu muni kah kar jorī
kṛpāsiṃdhu binatī kachu morī

verses.sa:
देखि देखि आचरन तुम्हारा ।
होत मोह मम हृदयँ अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi dekhi ācaran tumhārā
hot moh mam hṛdayam̐ apārā

verses.sa:
महिमा अमित बेद नहिं जाना ।
मैं केहि भाँति कहउँ भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
mahimā amit bed nahiṃ jānā
maiṃ kehi bhām̐ti kahaum̐ bhagavānā

verses.sa:
उपरोहित्य कर्म अति मंदा ।
बेद पुरान सुमृति कर निंदा ॥
verses.tr:
uparohitya karm ati maṃdā
bed purān sumṛti kar niṃdā

verses.sa:
जब न लेउँ मैं तब बिधि मोही ।
कहा लाभ आगें सुत तोही ॥
verses.tr:
jab na leum̐ maiṃ tab bidhi mohī
kahā lābh āgeṃ sut tohī

verses.sa:
परमातमा ब्रह्म नर रूपा ।
होइहि रघुकुल भूषन भूपा ॥
verses.tr:
paramātamā brahm nar rūpā
hoihi raghukul bhūṣan bhūpā

verses.sa:
-तब मैं हृदयँ बिचारा जोग जग्य ब्रत दान ।
जा कहुँ करिअ सो पैहउँ धर्म न एहि सम आन ॥
verses.tr:
-tab maiṃ hṛdayam̐ bicārā jog jagya brat dān
jā kahum̐ karia so paihaum̐ dharm na ehi sam ān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: One day saint Vasishtha came to visit the blessed and glorious Rama. The prince of the house of Raghu received him with the most profound respect and washed his feet and drank of the water. “Hearken, Rama,” cried the sage, ‘clasping his hands, “Ocean of mercy, I have a request to make. After seeing your deeds, a boundless bewilderment possesses my soul. Your immeasurable greatness is beyond the comprehension of the Vedas, how then can I tell it The business of a family-priest is very contemptible; the Vedas and Pur^nas and all the Scripture make small account of it. At first I refused it, but the Creator said to me, ‘You will be a gainer hereafter, my son. Brahma, the Supreme Spirit, will be born in human form as a king, the glory of the race of Raghu.’
Then I thought to myself, I shall thus attain to him who is the object of all contemplation, penance, charity and sacrifice; what better course can I pursue?

sections.label: Doha 49
sections.name: नाथ एक बर मागउँ राम कृपा करि देहु

verses.sa:
जप तप नियम जोग निज धर्मा ।
श्रुति संभव नाना सुभ कर्मा ॥
verses.tr:
jap tap niyam jog nij dharmā
śruti saṃbhav nānā subh karmā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ग्यान दया दम तीरथ मज्जन ।
जहँ लगि धर्म कहत श्रुति सज्जन ॥
verses.tr:
gyān dayā dam tīrath majjan
jaham̐ lagi dharm kahat śruti sajjan

verses.sa:
आगम निगम पुरान अनेका ।
पढ़े सुने कर फल प्रभु एका ॥
verses.tr:
āgam nigam purān anekā
par̤he sune kar phal prabhu ekā

verses.sa:
तब पद पंकज प्रीति निरंतर ।
सब साधन कर यह फल सुंदर ॥
verses.tr:
tab pad paṃkaj prīti niraṃtar
sab sādhan kar yah phal suṃdar

verses.sa:
छूटइ मल कि मलहि के धोएँ ।
घृत कि पाव कोइ बारि बिलोएँ ॥
verses.tr:
chūṭai mal ki malahi ke dhoem̐
ghṛt ki pāv koi bāri biloem̐

verses.sa:
प्रेम भगति जल बिनु रघुराई ।
अभिअंतर मल कबहुँ न जाई ॥
verses.tr:
prem bhagati jal binu raghurāī
abhiaṃtar mal kabahum̐ na jāī

verses.sa:
सोइ सर्बग्य तग्य सोइ पंडित ।
सोइ गुन गृह बिग्यान अखंडित ॥
verses.tr:
soi sarbagya tagya soi paṃḍit
soi gun gṛh bigyān akhaṃḍit

verses.sa:
दच्छ सकल लच्छन जुत सोई ।
जाकें पद सरोज रति होई ॥
verses.tr:
dacch sakal lacchan jut soī
jākeṃ pad saroj rati hoī

verses.sa:
नाथ एक बर मागउँ राम कृपा करि देहु ।
जन्म जन्म प्रभु पद कमल कबहुँ घटै जनि नेहु ॥
verses.tr:
nāth ek bar māgaum̐ rām kṛpā kari dehu
janm janm prabhu pad kamal kabahum̐ ghaṭai jani nehu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Prayer, penance, pious observances, and doing one’s duty in life are different good actions based on the Scriptures. But knowledge, mercy, self-control, bathing at holy places and all the religious practices inculcated by revelation, as also the study of the Vedas and sacred traditions and numerous Purdnas are only means to a glorious end, viz., 8 constant devotion to your lotus feet. Can dirt be removed by cleansing with dirt?is ghi to be obtained by churning water? Except, O Raghurdi, by the water of faith and love, the interior stain can never be effaced. He is all-wise, he the philosopher, the scholar, the thoroughly accomplished, the irrefutable doctor, the truly judicious and the possessor of every auspicious attribute, who is devoted to your lotus feet.
My lord, I would as one boon; grant it, O Rama, in your clemency: in all my future births may my love for my lord’s lotusfeet never diminish.”:

sections.label: Doha 50
sections.name: तेहिं अवसर मुनि नारद आए करतल बीन

verses.sa:
अस कहि मुनि बसिष्ट गृह आए ।
कृपासिंधु के मन अति भाए ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi muni basiṣṭ gṛh āe
kṛpāsiṃdhu ke man ati bhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हनूमान भरतादिक भ्राता ।
संग लिए सेवक सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
hanūmān bharatādik bhrātā
saṃg lie sevak sukhadātā

verses.sa:
पुनि कृपाल पुर बाहेर गए ।
गज रथ तुरग मगावत भए ॥
verses.tr:
puni kṛpāl pur bāher gae
gaj rath turag magāvat bhae

verses.sa:
देखि कृपा करि सकल सराहे ।
दिए उचित जिन्ह जिन्ह तेइ चाहे ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi kṛpā kari sakal sarāhe
die ucit jinh jinh tei cāhe

verses.sa:
हरन सकल श्रम प्रभु श्रम पाई ।
गए जहाँ सीतल अवँराई ॥
verses.tr:
haran sakal śram prabhu śram pāī
gae jahām̐ sītal avam̐rāī

verses.sa:
भरत दीन्ह निज बसन डसाई ।
बैठे प्रभु सेवहिं सब भाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat dīnh nij basan ḍasāī
baiṭhe prabhu sevahiṃ sab bhāī

verses.sa:
मारुतसुत तब मारूत करई ।
पुलक बपुष लोचन जल भरई ॥
verses.tr:
mārutasut tab mārūt karaī
pulak bapuṣ locan jal bharaī

verses.sa:
हनूमान सम नहिं बड़भागी ।
नहिं कोउ राम चरन अनुरागी ॥
verses.tr:
hanūmān sam nahiṃ bar̤abhāgī
nahiṃ kou rām caran anurāgī

verses.sa:
गिरिजा जासु प्रीति सेवकाई ।
बार बार प्रभु निज मुख गाई ॥
verses.tr:
girijā jāsu prīti sevakāī
bār bār prabhu nij mukh gāī

verses.sa:
तेहिं अवसर मुनि नारद आए करतल बीन ।
गावन लगे राम कल कीरति सदा नबीन ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ avasar muni nārad āe karatal bīn
gāvan lage rām kal kīrati sadā nabīn
verses.head: दोहा

trans: So saying, Saint Vasishtha returned home and the Allmerciful was greatly pleased at heart. Then, being ever gracious to his servants, he took with him Hanuman and Bharat and his other brothers and in his benignity went outside the city, where he ordered up the elephants, chariots and horses. After inspecting them he was pleased to praise them all and then distributed them, giving each person the one that he wished. The Lord, the remover of all weariness, was himself a weary and repaired toa ooo] mango grove, where Bharat spread his own raiment on the ground, and there the Lord took his seat, with all his brothers in attendance, while the Son of the Wind fanned him. At this his body quivered with emotion and his eyes filled with tears. Thereis no one so blessed as Hanuman, nor any so devoted to Rama's feet, whose love and devotion, O Uma, have again and again been told by the Lord with his own mouth.
At that time came the Saint Narad, with his lute in his hand, and began to hymn Rama's glorious renown, that pregnant theme.

sections.label: Doha 51
sections.name: प्रेम सहित मुनि नारद बरनि राम गुन ग्राम

verses.sa:
मामवलोकय पंकज लोचन ।
कृपा बिलोकनि सोच बिमोचन ॥
verses.tr:
māmavalokaya paṃkaj locan
kṛpā bilokani soc bimocan
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नील तामरस स्याम काम अरि ।
हृदय कंज मकरंद मधुप हरि ॥
verses.tr:
nīl tāmaras syām kām ari
hṛdaya kaṃj makaraṃd madhup hari

verses.sa:
जातुधान बरूथ बल भंजन ।
मुनि सज्जन रंजन अघ गंजन ॥
verses.tr:
jātudhān barūth bal bhaṃjan
muni sajjan raṃjan agh gaṃjan

verses.sa:
भूसुर ससि नव बृंद बलाहक ।
असरन सरन दीन जन गाहक ॥
verses.tr:
bhūsur sasi nav bṛṃd balāhak
asaran saran dīn jan gāhak

verses.sa:
भुज बल बिपुल भार महि खंडित ।
खर दूषन बिराध बध पंडित ॥
verses.tr:
bhuj bal bipul bhār mahi khaṃḍit
khar dūṣan birādh badh paṃḍit

verses.sa:
रावनारि सुखरूप भूपबर ।
जय दसरथ कुल कुमुद सुधाकर ॥
verses.tr:
rāvanāri sukharūp bhūpabar
jaya dasarath kul kumud sudhākar

verses.sa:
सुजस पुरान बिदित निगमागम ।
गावत सुर मुनि संत समागम ॥
verses.tr:
sujas purān bidit nigamāgam
gāvat sur muni saṃt samāgam

verses.sa:
कारुनीक ब्यलीक मद खंडन ।
सब बिधि कुसल कोसला मंडन ॥
verses.tr:
kārunīk byalīk mad khaṃḍan
sab bidhi kusal kosalā maṃḍan

verses.sa:
कलि मल मथन नाम ममताहन ।
तुलसीदास प्रभु पाहि प्रनत जन ॥
verses.tr:
kali mal mathan nām mamatāhan
tulasīdās prabhu pāhi pranat jan

verses.sa:
प्रेम सहित मुनि नारद बरनि राम गुन ग्राम ।
सोभासिंधु हृदयँ धरि गए जहाँ बिधि धाम ॥
verses.tr:
prem sahit muni nārad barani rām gun grām
sobhāsiṃdhu hṛdayam̐ dhari gae jahām̐ bidhi dhām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Look upon me, O lotus-eyed, merciful of aspect, liberator from delusion; dark of hue as the blue lotus; conqueror of love; bee of the perfumed Lotus of the soul; Hari, breaker of the might of the demon host; delight of the saints and the pious; exterminator of sin; beneficent to Brahmans as a rain-cloud to the new crops; help of the helpless; befriender of the humble; by the might of whose arm earth’s grievous burden has been broken; ingenious destroyer of Khara and Dutshan and Viradh; Ravan's antagonist; incarnation of beauty; noblest of kings. Glory to the moon of the lotus house of Dasarath, whose glory is renowned in the Puranas, the Vedas and all the Scriptures, and sung by gods and patriarchs and all the company of the saints. © merciful lord, destroyer of falsehood and pride, infinitely glorious, glory of Kosala, whose name corrects all the impurities of this sinful age and puts un end to the delusions of self, have mercy upon your humble adorer, even me Tulsi Das.”
When the venerable Narad had completed his loving recital of Rama’s praises, he clasped the Ocean of beauty to his heart and withdrew to the realm of Brahma.

sections.label: Doha 52
sections.name: तुम्हरी कृपाँ कृपायतन अब कृतकृत्य न मोह

verses.sa:
गिरिजा सुनहु बिसद यह कथा ।
मैं सब कही मोरि मति जथा ॥
verses.tr:
girijā sunahu bisad yah kathā
maiṃ sab kahī mori mati jathā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम चरित सत कोटि अपारा ।
श्रुति सारदा न बरनै पारा ॥
verses.tr:
rām carit sat koṭi apārā
śruti sāradā na baranai pārā

verses.sa:
राम अनंत अनंत गुनानी ।
जन्म कर्म अनंत नामानी ॥
verses.tr:
rām anaṃt anaṃt gunānī
janm karm anaṃt nāmānī

verses.sa:
जल सीकर महि रज गनि जाहीं ।
रघुपति चरित न बरनि सिराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jal sīkar mahi raj gani jāhīṃ
raghupati carit na barani sirāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बिमल कथा हरि पद दायनी ।
भगति होइ सुनि अनपायनी ॥
verses.tr:
bimal kathā hari pad dāyanī
bhagati hoi suni anapāyanī

verses.sa:
उमा कहिउँ सब कथा सुहाई ।
जो भुसुंडि खगपतिहि सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
umā kahium̐ sab kathā suhāī
jo bhusuṃḍi khagapatihi sunāī

verses.sa:
कछुक राम गुन कहेउँ बखानी ।
अब का कहौं सो कहहु भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
kachuk rām gun kaheum̐ bakhānī
ab kā kahauṃ so kahahu bhavānī

verses.sa:
सुनि सुभ कथा उमा हरषानी ।
बोली अति बिनीत मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni subh kathā umā haraṣānī
bolī ati binīt mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
धन्य धन्य मैं धन्य पुरारी ।
सुनेउँ राम गुन भव भय हारी ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya dhanya maiṃ dhanya purārī
suneum̐ rām gun bhav bhaya hārī

verses.sa:
तुम्हरी कृपाँ कृपायतन अब कृतकृत्य न मोह ।
जानेउँ राम प्रताप प्रभु चिदानंद संदोह ॥
verses.tr:
tumharī kṛpām̐ kṛpāyatan ab kṛtakṛtya na moh
jāneum̐ rām pratāp prabhu cidānaṃd saṃdoh
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
नाथ तवानन ससि स्रवत कथा सुधा रघुबीर ।
श्रवन पुटन्हि मन पान करि नहिं अघात मतिधीर ॥
verses.tr:
nāth tavānan sasi sravat kathā sudhā raghubīr
śravan puṭanhi man pān kari nahiṃ aghāt matidhīr

trans: Hearken, Uma, to his glorious legend, the whole of which I have now told to the best of my ability. But Rama’s acts are hundreds of millions in number and beyond all reckoning; not even the Vedas or Serada could recount them all. Rdemais infiniteand his virtues are infinite; infinite are his incarnations, his actions and his names. You may count the drops in a shower of rain or the dust on the earth, but Rama’s doings defy enumeration. This holy story ensures translation to Hari’s own sphere; whoever hears it acquires an imperishable devotion. ‘The whole of the delectable history, which Bhusundi repeated to the king of the birds, has now, Uma, been told you. I have mentioned only a fraction of Rama's virtues; tell me, Bhavani, what I am to tell you next.” Uma rejoiced to have heard the glorious narrative and in modest and gentle accents thus replied: “Blessed, yea thrice blessed am I, Pureri, to have heard the virtues of Rama, that put an end to all the terrors of life.

By your clemency, © most clement, I have attained my desire and am no longer in doubt: I know the glory of Rama, that he is the Lord, the sum of all knowledge and joy. Your mouth, Sire, flows like the moon with the nectar of Rama’s praises; my soul drinks them in through the

sections.label: Doha 53
sections.name: बिरति ग्यान बिग्यान दृढ़ राम चरन अति नेह

verses.sa:
राम चरित जे सुनत अघाहीं ।
रस बिसेष जाना तिन्ह नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām carit je sunat aghāhīṃ
ras biseṣ jānā tinh nāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जीवनमुक्त महामुनि जेऊ ।
हरि गुन सुनहीं निरंतर तेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jīvanamukt mahāmuni jeū
hari gun sunahīṃ niraṃtar teū

verses.sa:
भव सागर चह पार जो पावा ।
राम कथा ता कहँ दृढ़ नावा ॥
verses.tr:
bhav sāgar cah pār jo pāvā
rām kathā tā kaham̐ dṛr̤h nāvā

verses.sa:
बिषइन्ह कहँ पुनि हरि गुन ग्रामा ।
श्रवन सुखद अरु मन अभिरामा ॥
verses.tr:
biṣainh kaham̐ puni hari gun grāmā
śravan sukhad aru man abhirāmā

verses.sa:
श्रवनवंत अस को जग माहीं ।
जाहि न रघुपति चरित सोहाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
śravanavaṃt as ko jag māhīṃ
jāhi na raghupati carit sohāhīṃ

verses.sa:
ते जड़ जीव निजात्मक घाती ।
जिन्हहि न रघुपति कथा सोहाती ॥
verses.tr:
te jar̤ jīv nijātmak ghātī
jinhahi na raghupati kathā sohātī

verses.sa:
हरिचरित्र मानस तुम्ह गावा ।
सुनि मैं नाथ अमिति सुख पावा ॥
verses.tr:
haricaritr mānas tumh gāvā
suni maiṃ nāth amiti sukh pāvā

verses.sa:
तुम्ह जो कही यह कथा सुहाई ।
कागभसुंडि गरुड़ प्रति गाई ॥
verses.tr:
tumh jo kahī yah kathā suhāī
kāgabhasuṃḍi garur̤ prati gāī

verses.sa:
बिरति ग्यान बिग्यान दृढ़ राम चरन अति नेह ।
बायस तन रघुपति भगति मोहि परम संदेह ॥
verses.tr:
birati gyān bigyān dṛr̤h rām caran ati neh
bāyas tan raghupati bhagati mohi param saṃdeh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: pitchers of my ears, but refuses to be satisfied, O resolute of purpose. Chaupat.

They whocan be satiated with hearing Rama's deeds do not relish their peculiar savour. The great sages, who have been liberated from mundane existence, listen for ever to Rama’s virtues. Whoever desires to traverse the ocean of life finds in Rama’s history a sure ship. Even the worldly accept the praises of Hari as pleasant to the ear and grateful to the soul; for is there any one in the world with ears to hear who takes no pleasure in Rama's history: they must be dull of soul indeed and self-destroyers, to whom Rama’s history gives no pleasure. While you have been reciting your Rama lay, I have listened, my lord, with boundless delight. But this delectable story that you have repeated was declared by Kaka-bhusundi to Garur.
Now I marvel greatly how any one in the form of a crow could be a votary of Rama's, and possess such self-control and knowledge and wisdom and such staunch devotion to his feet.

sections.label: Doha 54
sections.name: राम परायन ग्यान रत गुनागार मति धीर

verses.sa:
नर सहस्त्र महँ सुनहु पुरारी ।
कोउ एक होइ धर्म ब्रतधारी ॥
verses.tr:
nar sahastr maham̐ sunahu purārī
kou ek hoi dharm bratadhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
धर्मसील कोटिक महँ कोई ।
बिषय बिमुख बिराग रत होई ॥
verses.tr:
dharmasīl koṭik maham̐ koī
biṣaya bimukh birāg rat hoī

verses.sa:
कोटि बिरक्त मध्य श्रुति कहई ।
सम्यक ग्यान सकृत कोउ लहई ॥
verses.tr:
koṭi birakt madhya śruti kahaī
samyak gyān sakṛt kou lahaī

verses.sa:
ग्यानवंत कोटिक महँ कोऊ ।
जीवनमुक्त सकृत जग सोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
gyānavaṃt koṭik maham̐ koū
jīvanamukt sakṛt jag soū

verses.sa:
तिन्ह सहस्त्र महुँ सब सुख खानी ।
दुर्लभ ब्रह्मलीन बिग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
tinh sahastr mahum̐ sab sukh khānī
durlabh brahmalīn bigyānī

verses.sa:
धर्मसील बिरक्त अरु ग्यानी ।
जीवनमुक्त ब्रह्मपर प्रानी ॥
verses.tr:
dharmasīl birakt aru gyānī
jīvanamukt brahmapar prānī

verses.sa:
सब ते सो दुर्लभ सुरराया ।
राम भगति रत गत मद माया ॥
verses.tr:
sab te so durlabh surarāyā
rām bhagati rat gat mad māyā

verses.sa:
सो हरिभगति काग किमि पाई ।
बिस्वनाथ मोहि कहहु बुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
so haribhagati kāg kimi pāī
bisvanāth mohi kahahu bujhāī

verses.sa:
राम परायन ग्यान रत गुनागार मति धीर ।
नाथ कहहु केहि कारन पायउ काक सरीर ॥
verses.tr:
rām parāyan gyān rat gunāgār mati dhīr
nāth kahahu kehi kāran pāyau kāk sarīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearken, Porari; among a thousand men there may be one who is steadfast in the practices of his religion; among a million religious people there may be one who loathes sensuality and delights in asceticism; among a million asoe= tics—so the Scriptures declare—there may be one who attains to perfect knowledge; among a million of the truly wise, one may be liberated from mundane existence; among a thousand of these it is difficult to find the perfect bliss of philosophic absorption into the Supreme Spirit. But beyond the religious, the ascetic, the wise, the exempt from transmigration and the absorbed in the divinity, beyond all these persons, O king of the gods, there is one yet more.

Difficult to find, a devoted believer in: Rama, superior to all vanity and illusion of the senses. Tell me, lord of the universe, how # crow could attain to such faith. Tell me, Sire, if he were devoted to Rama, enamoured of wisdom, full of all good qualities and resolute of purpose, what was the reason that he had the body of a crow?

sections.label: Doha 55
sections.name: ऐसिअ प्रस्न बिहंगपति कीन्ह काग सन जाइ

verses.sa:
यह प्रभु चरित पवित्र सुहावा ।
कहहु कृपाल काग कहँ पावा ॥
verses.tr:
yah prabhu carit pavitr suhāvā
kahahu kṛpāl kāg kaham̐ pāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तुम्ह केहि भाँति सुना मदनारी ।
कहहु मोहि अति कौतुक भारी ॥
verses.tr:
tumh kehi bhām̐ti sunā madanārī
kahahu mohi ati kautuk bhārī

verses.sa:
गरुड़ महाग्यानी गुन रासी ।
हरि सेवक अति निकट निवासी ॥
verses.tr:
garur̤ mahāgyānī gun rāsī
hari sevak ati nikaṭ nivāsī

verses.sa:
तेहिं केहि हेतु काग सन जाई ।
सुनी कथा मुनि निकर बिहाई ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ kehi hetu kāg san jāī
sunī kathā muni nikar bihāī

verses.sa:
कहहु कवन बिधि भा संबादा ।
दोउ हरिभगत काग उरगादा ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu kavan bidhi bhā saṃbādā
dou haribhagat kāg uragādā

verses.sa:
गौरि गिरा सुनि सरल सुहाई ।
बोले सिव सादर सुख पाई ॥
verses.tr:
gauri girā suni saral suhāī
bole siv sādar sukh pāī

verses.sa:
धन्य सती पावन मति तोरी ।
रघुपति चरन प्रीति नहिं थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya satī pāvan mati torī
raghupati caran prīti nahiṃ thorī

verses.sa:
सुनहु परम पुनीत इतिहासा ।
जो सुनि सकल लोक भ्रम नासा ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu param punīt itihāsā
jo suni sakal lok bhram nāsā

verses.sa:
उपजइ राम चरन बिस्वासा ।
भव निधि तर नर बिनहिं प्रयासा ॥
verses.tr:
upajai rām caran bisvāsā
bhav nidhi tar nar binahiṃ prayāsā

verses.sa:
ऐसिअ प्रस्न बिहंगपति कीन्ह काग सन जाइ ।
सो सब सादर कहिहउँ सुनहु उमा मन लाइ ॥
verses.tr:
aisia prasn bihaṃgapati kīnh kāg san jāi
so sab sādar kahihaum̐ sunahu umā man lāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Be pleased to inform me where the crow learnt this holy and delectable history of the lord’s doings. Tell me also, O conqueror of Love, the strange mystery of how you heard it. Garur again is very wise and accomplished and one of Hari’s most intimate disciples, what was his reason for leaving a company of saints and going toa crow to hear this story?
