Describe to me the nature of the interview ‘between these two servants of Hari, the crow and the serpent-eater.”” On hearing Gauri’s artless and charming speech Siva was glad and made reverent reply: “A blessing, Sati on your sanctifying scheme! great indeed is your devotion to Rama's feet. Hearken then to the all-holy story, the hearing of which puts an end to every sorrow and delusion;for from it there springs up an implicit faith in Rama’s feet and without any difficulty man crosses the abyss of existence.
This was the very question which the king of the birds, went and put to the crow, as I will reverently explain to you in full, hearken, Uma, with all attention.

sections.label: Doha 56
sections.name: -सीतल अमल मधुर जल जलज बिपुल बहुरंग

verses.sa:
मैं जिमि कथा सुनी भव मोचनि ।
सो प्रसंग सुनु सुमुखि सुलोचनि ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ jimi kathā sunī bhav mocani
so prasaṃg sunu sumukhi sulocani
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रथम दच्छ गृह तव अवतारा ।
सती नाम तब रहा तुम्हारा ॥
verses.tr:
pratham dacch gṛh tav avatārā
satī nām tab rahā tumhārā

verses.sa:
दच्छ जग्य तब भा अपमाना ।
तुम्ह अति क्रोध तजे तब प्राना ॥
verses.tr:
dacch jagya tab bhā apamānā
tumh ati krodh taje tab prānā

verses.sa:
मम अनुचरन्ह कीन्ह मख भंगा ।
जानहु तुम्ह सो सकल प्रसंगा ॥
verses.tr:
mam anucaranh kīnh makh bhaṃgā
jānahu tumh so sakal prasaṃgā

verses.sa:
तब अति सोच भयउ मन मोरें ।
दुखी भयउँ बियोग प्रिय तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
tab ati soc bhayau man moreṃ
dukhī bhayaum̐ biyog priya toreṃ

verses.sa:
सुंदर बन गिरि सरित तड़ागा ।
कौतुक देखत फिरउँ बेरागा ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar ban giri sarit tar̤āgā
kautuk dekhat phiraum̐ berāgā

verses.sa:
गिरि सुमेर उत्तर दिसि दूरी ।
नील सैल एक सुन्दर भूरी ॥
verses.tr:
giri sumer uttar disi dūrī
nīl sail ek sundar bhūrī

verses.sa:
तासु कनकमय सिखर सुहाए ।
चारि चारु मोरे मन भाए ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu kanakamaya sikhar suhāe
cāri cāru more man bhāe

verses.sa:
तिन्ह पर एक एक बिटप बिसाला ।
बट पीपर पाकरी रसाला ॥
verses.tr:
tinh par ek ek biṭap bisālā
baṭ pīpar pākarī rasālā

verses.sa:
सैलोपरि सर सुंदर सोहा ।
मनि सोपान देखि मन मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
sailopari sar suṃdar sohā
mani sopān dekhi man mohā

verses.sa:
-सीतल अमल मधुर जल जलज बिपुल बहुरंग ।
कूजत कल रव हंस गन गुंजत मजुंल भृंग ॥
verses.tr:
-sītal amal madhur jal jalaj bipul bahuraṃg
kūjat kal rav haṃs gan guṃjat majuṃl bhṛṃg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Beautiful and bright-eyed deliver from the world, listen to the account of how and I heard the story. You first took birth in the house of Daksha and the name you then bore was Sati. At Daksha’s sacrifice you were slighted and in the violence of your indignation yielded up your life, My servants then broke up to the sacrifice; but all this is a story that you know already. Afterwards I was sorely troubled at heart, sorrowing for the loss of you, my beloved, and wandered among the beautiful woods, and hills and rivers and lakes, admiring the scene, but a sworn ascetic. Far away to the north among the heights of Sumera is a huge and magnificent purple peak with four glittering pinnacles of gold, so lovely that my soul was enraptured. On each stood one enormous tree, a banyan, a pipal, a pakar and a mango, and on the top of the mountain was a glorious lake, with jewelled steps which it was a delight to behold:
Its water cool, pure and sweet;its lotuses abundant and of many colours; while flocks of swans murmured their melodious notes and the bees made a delicious buzzing. Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 57
sections.name: तब कछु काल मराल तनु धरि तहँ कीन्ह निवास

verses.sa:
तेहिं गिरि रुचिर बसइ खग सोई ।
तासु नास कल्पांत न होई ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ giri rucir basai khag soī
tāsu nās kalpāṃt na hoī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
माया कृत गुन दोष अनेका ।
मोह मनोज आदि अबिबेका ॥
verses.tr:
māyā kṛt gun doṣ anekā
moh manoj ādi abibekā

verses.sa:
रहे ब्यापि समस्त जग माहीं ।
तेहि गिरि निकट कबहुँ नहिं जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rahe byāpi samast jag māhīṃ
tehi giri nikaṭ kabahum̐ nahiṃ jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
तहँ बसि हरिहि भजइ जिमि कागा ।
सो सुनु उमा सहित अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ basi harihi bhajai jimi kāgā
so sunu umā sahit anurāgā

verses.sa:
पीपर तरु तर ध्यान सो धरई ।
जाप जग्य पाकरि तर करई ॥
verses.tr:
pīpar taru tar dhyān so dharaī
jāp jagya pākari tar karaī

verses.sa:
आँब छाहँ कर मानस पूजा ।
तजि हरि भजनु काजु नहिं दूजा ॥
verses.tr:
ām̐b chāham̐ kar mānas pūjā
taji hari bhajanu kāju nahiṃ dūjā

verses.sa:
बर तर कह हरि कथा प्रसंगा ।
आवहिं सुनहिं अनेक बिहंगा ॥
verses.tr:
bar tar kah hari kathā prasaṃgā
āvahiṃ sunahiṃ anek bihaṃgā

verses.sa:
राम चरित बिचीत्र बिधि नाना ।
प्रेम सहित कर सादर गाना ॥
verses.tr:
rām carit bicītr bidhi nānā
prem sahit kar sādar gānā

verses.sa:
सुनहिं सकल मति बिमल मराला ।
बसहिं निरंतर जे तेहिं ताला ॥
verses.tr:
sunahiṃ sakal mati bimal marālā
basahiṃ niraṃtar je tehiṃ tālā

verses.sa:
जब मैं जाइ सो कौतुक देखा ।
उर उपजा आनंद बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
jab maiṃ jāi so kautuk dekhā
ur upajā ānaṃd biseṣā

verses.sa:
तब कछु काल मराल तनु धरि तहँ कीन्ह निवास ।
सादर सुनि रघुपति गुन पुनि आयउँ कैलास ॥
verses.tr:
tab kachu kāl marāl tanu dhari taham̐ kīnh nivās
sādar suni raghupati gun puni āyaum̐ kailās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On this fair height dwelt a crow, outliving even the end of the world. All the virtuesand vices that are produced of Maya, together with Delusion, Love and the other errors of judgment, which permeate the whole world, never came near this mountain. Hearken, Uma, with tender affection, while I tell how the crow passed his life here in the worship of Hari. Under the pipal tree he practised meditation; under the pdekar, prayer and sacrifice; in the shade of the mango he mentally performed the temple ritual, having no other occupation whatever save the worship of Hari; and under the banyan he recited the story of Rama’s adventures, which countless birds flocked to hear. With loving reverence he sung the varying cycle of Rama’s deeds, in the hearing of all the pure-souled swans that ever dwell in that lake. When I arrived there and saw the sight, an intense joy sprang up in my heart.
Assuming for a time the form ofa swan, I took up my abode there and after reverently listening to Rama’s praises again returned to Kailas.

sections.label: Doha 58
sections.name: -भव बंधन ते छूटहिं नर जपि जा कर नाम

verses.sa:
गिरिजा कहेउँ सो सब इतिहासा ।
मैं जेहि समय गयउँ खग पासा ॥
verses.tr:
girijā kaheum̐ so sab itihāsā
maiṃ jehi samaya gayaum̐ khag pāsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अब सो कथा सुनहु जेही हेतू ।
गयउ काग पहिं खग कुल केतू ॥
verses.tr:
ab so kathā sunahu jehī hetū
gayau kāg pahiṃ khag kul ketū

verses.sa:
जब रघुनाथ कीन्हि रन क्रीड़ा ।
समुझत चरित होति मोहि ब्रीड़ा ॥
verses.tr:
jab raghunāth kīnhi ran krīr̤ā
samujhat carit hoti mohi brīr̤ā

verses.sa:
इंद्रजीत कर आपु बँधायो ।
तब नारद मुनि गरुड़ पठायो ॥
verses.tr:
iṃdrajīt kar āpu bam̐dhāyo
tab nārad muni garur̤ paṭhāyo

verses.sa:
बंधन काटि गयो उरगादा ।
उपजा हृदयँ प्रचंड बिषादा ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdhan kāṭi gayo uragādā
upajā hṛdayam̐ pracaṃḍ biṣādā

verses.sa:
प्रभु बंधन समुझत बहु भाँती ।
करत बिचार उरग आराती ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu baṃdhan samujhat bahu bhām̐tī
karat bicār urag ārātī

verses.sa:
ब्यापक ब्रह्म बिरज बागीसा ।
माया मोह पार परमीसा ॥
verses.tr:
byāpak brahm biraj bāgīsā
māyā moh pār paramīsā

verses.sa:
सो अवतार सुनेउँ जग माहीं ।
देखेउँ सो प्रभाव कछु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
so avatār suneum̐ jag māhīṃ
dekheum̐ so prabhāv kachu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
-भव बंधन ते छूटहिं नर जपि जा कर नाम ।
खर्च निसाचर बाँधेउ नागपास सोइ राम ॥
verses.tr:
-bhav baṃdhan te chūṭahiṃ nar japi jā kar nām
kharc nisācar bām̐dheu nāgapās soi rām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I have thus told you, Girija, the full account of the circumstances under which | visited the crow. Hearken now to the explanation of the reason for Garur’s going to see him. When Raghunath exhibited the battle phantasm, though I understood his action, I was ashamed that he should allow himself to be bound by Meghnad. N^rad the sage then despatched Garur, who cut his bonds and came back, the serpent-eater, but a grievous dejection possessed his soul, as he thought over the Lord’s bonds and pondered the matter to himself: “The omnipresent and passionless Supreme Spirit, the lord of speech, who is absolute master over the vanities of illusion, has I hear taken birth in the world; but I see no signs of his majesty..
Can this be Rama, by the repetition of whose name men escape from the bonds of existence, if a wretched demon can bind him in snakey coils?”

sections.label: Doha 59
sections.name: अस कहि चले देवरिषि करत राम गुन गान

verses.sa:
नाना भाँति मनहि समुझावा ।
प्रगट न ग्यान हृदयँ भ्रम छावा ॥
verses.tr:
nānā bhām̐ti manahi samujhāvā
pragaṭ na gyān hṛdayam̐ bhram chāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
खेद खिन्न मन तर्क बढ़ाई ।
भयउ मोहबस तुम्हरिहिं नाई ॥
verses.tr:
khed khinn man tark bar̤hāī
bhayau mohabas tumharihiṃ nāī

verses.sa:
ब्याकुल गयउ देवरिषि पाहीं ।
कहेसि जो संसय निज मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
byākul gayau devariṣi pāhīṃ
kahesi jo saṃsaya nij man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि नारदहि लागि अति दाया ।
सुनु खग प्रबल राम कै माया ॥
verses.tr:
suni nāradahi lāgi ati dāyā
sunu khag prabal rām kai māyā

verses.sa:
जो ग्यानिन्ह कर चित अपहरई ।
बरिआई बिमोह मन करई ॥
verses.tr:
jo gyāninh kar cit apaharaī
bariāī bimoh man karaī

verses.sa:
जेहिं बहु बार नचावा मोही ।
सोइ ब्यापी बिहंगपति तोही ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ bahu bār nacāvā mohī
soi byāpī bihaṃgapati tohī

verses.sa:
महामोह उपजा उर तोरें ।
मिटिहि न बेगि कहें खग मोरें ॥
verses.tr:
mahāmoh upajā ur toreṃ
miṭihi na begi kaheṃ khag moreṃ

verses.sa:
चतुरानन पहिं जाहु खगेसा ।
सोइ करेहु जेहि होइ निदेसा ॥
verses.tr:
caturānan pahiṃ jāhu khagesā
soi karehu jehi hoi nidesā

verses.sa:
अस कहि चले देवरिषि करत राम गुन गान ।
हरि माया बल बरनत पुनि पुनि परम सुजान ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi cale devariṣi karat rām gun gān
hari māyā bal baranat puni puni param sujān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: _ Though he did all he could to re-assure himself, his understanding was not enlightened; error overshadowed his soul. Distracted by doubt and full of mental question-ings, he became as subject to delusion as you yourself were. In his perplexity he went to the Rishi of the gods and told him the difficulty that he had in his mind. On hearing his tale, Narad was moved with a great compassion: ‘Hearken, O bird; Rama’s delusive power is very strong. When he robs the wise of their sense, he makes their infatuation superlative. The same spectre that has often disturbed me has now, O king of the birds, affected you. The mighty error that has taken root in your soul will not be readily removed by any words of mine. You must go to Brahma, and do whatever he enjoins you.”
So saying the teacher of the gods went his way chanting Rama's praises, again and again in his infinite wisdom insisting on the might of Rama’s delusive power.

sections.label: Doha 60
sections.name: परमातुर बिहंगपति आयउ तब मो पास

verses.sa:
तब खगपति बिरंचि पहिं गयऊ ।
निज संदेह सुनावत भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tab khagapati biraṃci pahiṃ gayaū
nij saṃdeh sunāvat bhayaū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि बिरंचि रामहि सिरु नावा ।
समुझि प्रताप प्रेम अति छावा ॥
verses.tr:
suni biraṃci rāmahi siru nāvā
samujhi pratāp prem ati chāvā

verses.sa:
मन महुँ करइ बिचार बिधाता ।
माया बस कबि कोबिद ग्याता ॥
verses.tr:
man mahum̐ karai bicār bidhātā
māyā bas kabi kobid gyātā

verses.sa:
हरि माया कर अमिति प्रभावा ।
बिपुल बार जेहिं मोहि नचावा ॥
verses.tr:
hari māyā kar amiti prabhāvā
bipul bār jehiṃ mohi nacāvā

verses.sa:
अग जगमय जग मम उपराजा ।
नहिं आचरज मोह खगराजा ॥
verses.tr:
ag jagamaya jag mam uparājā
nahiṃ ācaraj moh khagarājā

verses.sa:
तब बोले बिधि गिरा सुहाई ।
जान महेस राम प्रभुताई ॥
verses.tr:
tab bole bidhi girā suhāī
jān mahes rām prabhutāī

verses.sa:
बैनतेय संकर पहिं जाहू ।
तात अनत पूछहु जनि काहू ॥
verses.tr:
bainateya saṃkar pahiṃ jāhū
tāt anat pūchahu jani kāhū

verses.sa:
तहँ होइहि तव संसय हानी ।
चलेउ बिहंग सुनत बिधि बानी ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ hoihi tav saṃsaya hānī
caleu bihaṃg sunat bidhi bānī

verses.sa:
परमातुर बिहंगपति आयउ तब मो पास ।
जात रहेउँ कुबेर गृह रहिहु उमा कैलास ॥
verses.tr:
paramātur bihaṃgapati āyau tab mo pās
jāt raheum̐ kuber gṛh rahihu umā kailās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The king of the birds then went to the Creator and told him his difficulty. On hearing his story, Brahma bowed the head to Rama and, as he thought on his majesty, his heart was filled with love, and he thus mused within himself: “Poets and the wisest of philosophers are subjects to delusion, The might of Hari’s deceptive power is unbounded; many a time has it made me its puppet, though all things animate and inanimate are of my creation, no wonder then that it has beguiled the king ot the birds.” Then said Brahma in: gracious accents: ‘Siva understands Rama's power, Goto him, O son of Vinata, and ask no questions of any other. There you will find the solution of your doubts.” On hearing Brahma's advice, the bird went his way.
Then came the king of the birds in the utmost distress tome, At that time, Uma, I was on my way to the palace of Kuver, and had left you at Kuilas.

sections.label: Doha 61
sections.name: बिनु सतसंग न हरि कथा तेहि बिनु मोह न भाग

verses.sa:
तेहिं मम पद सादर सिरु नावा ।
पुनि आपन संदेह सुनावा ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ mam pad sādar siru nāvā
puni āpan saṃdeh sunāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि ता करि बिनती मृदु बानी ।
परेम सहित मैं कहेउँ भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni tā kari binatī mṛdu bānī
parem sahit maiṃ kaheum̐ bhavānī

verses.sa:
मिलेहु गरुड़ मारग महँ मोही ।
कवन भाँति समुझावौं तोही ॥
verses.tr:
milehu garur̤ mārag maham̐ mohī
kavan bhām̐ti samujhāvauṃ tohī

verses.sa:
तबहि होइ सब संसय भंगा ।
जब बहु काल करिअ सतसंगा ॥
verses.tr:
tabahi hoi sab saṃsaya bhaṃgā
jab bahu kāl karia satasaṃgā

verses.sa:
सुनिअ तहाँ हरि कथा सुहाई ।
नाना भाँति मुनिन्ह जो गाई ॥
verses.tr:
sunia tahām̐ hari kathā suhāī
nānā bhām̐ti muninh jo gāī

verses.sa:
जेहि महुँ आदि मध्य अवसाना ।
प्रभु प्रतिपाद्य राम भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
jehi mahum̐ ādi madhya avasānā
prabhu pratipādya rām bhagavānā

verses.sa:
नित हरि कथा होत जहँ भाई ।
पठवउँ तहाँ सुनहि तुम्ह जाई ॥
verses.tr:
nit hari kathā hot jaham̐ bhāī
paṭhavaum̐ tahām̐ sunahi tumh jāī

verses.sa:
जाइहि सुनत सकल संदेहा ।
राम चरन होइहि अति नेहा ॥
verses.tr:
jāihi sunat sakal saṃdehā
rām caran hoihi ati nehā

verses.sa:
बिनु सतसंग न हरि कथा तेहि बिनु मोह न भाग ।
मोह गएँ बिनु राम पद होइ न दृढ़ अनुराग ॥
verses.tr:
binu satasaṃg na hari kathā tehi binu moh na bhāg
moh gaem̐ binu rām pad hoi na dṛr̤h anurāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: He revorently bowed his head at my feet and then told

me his difficulty. On hearing his humble petition, I lovingly responded, Bhavani: ‘“ You have met me, Garur, on the road; bow can I instruct you Your doubts will not be settled till you have been for a long time in the company of © the saints. There you must listen to the delightful story of RAma, as sung in diverse manners by the seers, in which the beginning, middle, and end is the adorable lord, the great God Rama. 1 will send you, brother to a place where the story of Rama is told without ceasing; go there and listen. As you hear it, all your doubts will vanish; you will have a vehement affection for Rama’s feet.
Except in the company of saints there is no talk about Rama;: without that there is no overcoming delusion; till delusion is dispersed, there is no firm affection for Rama’s feet.

sections.label: Doha 62
sections.name: ग्यानि भगत सिरोमनि त्रिभुवनपति कर जान

verses.sa:
मिलहिं न रघुपति बिनु अनुरागा ।
किएँ जोग तप ग्यान बिरागा ॥
verses.tr:
milahiṃ na raghupati binu anurāgā
kiem̐ jog tap gyān birāgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
उत्तर दिसि सुंदर गिरि नीला ।
तहँ रह काकभुसुंडि सुसीला ॥
verses.tr:
uttar disi suṃdar giri nīlā
taham̐ rah kākabhusuṃḍi susīlā

verses.sa:
राम भगति पथ परम प्रबीना ।
ग्यानी गुन गृह बहु कालीना ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagati path param prabīnā
gyānī gun gṛh bahu kālīnā

verses.sa:
राम कथा सो कहइ निरंतर ।
सादर सुनहिं बिबिध बिहंगबर ॥
verses.tr:
rām kathā so kahai niraṃtar
sādar sunahiṃ bibidh bihaṃgabar

verses.sa:
जाइ सुनहु तहँ हरि गुन भूरी ।
होइहि मोह जनित दुख दूरी ॥
verses.tr:
jāi sunahu taham̐ hari gun bhūrī
hoihi moh janit dukh dūrī

verses.sa:
मैं जब तेहि सब कहा बुझाई ।
चलेउ हरषि मम पद सिरु नाई ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ jab tehi sab kahā bujhāī
caleu haraṣi mam pad siru nāī

verses.sa:
ताते उमा न मैं समुझावा ।
रघुपति कृपाँ मरमु मैं पावा ॥
verses.tr:
tāte umā na maiṃ samujhāvā
raghupati kṛpām̐ maramu maiṃ pāvā

verses.sa:
होइहि कीन्ह कबहुँ अभिमाना ।
सो खौवै चह कृपानिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
hoihi kīnh kabahum̐ abhimānā
so khauvai cah kṛpānidhānā

verses.sa:
कछु तेहि ते पुनि मैं नहिं राखा ।
समुझइ खग खगही कै भाषा ॥
verses.tr:
kachu tehi te puni maiṃ nahiṃ rākhā
samujhai khag khagahī kai bhāṣā

verses.sa:
प्रभु माया बलवंत भवानी ।
जाहि न मोह कवन अस ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu māyā balavaṃt bhavānī
jāhi na moh kavan as gyānī

verses.sa:
ग्यानि भगत सिरोमनि त्रिभुवनपति कर जान ।
ताहि मोह माया नर पावँर करहिं गुमान ॥
verses.tr:
gyāni bhagat siromani tribhuvanapati kar jān
tāhi moh māyā nar pāvam̐r karahiṃ gumān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सिव बिरंचि कहुँ मोहइ को है बपुरा आन ।
अस जियँ जानि भजहिं मुनि माया पति भगवान ॥
verses.tr:
siv biraṃci kahum̐ mohai ko hai bapurā ān
as jiyam̐ jāni bhajahiṃ muni māyā pati bhagavān

trans: Without affection there is no finding Rama, though you have recourse to meditation, prayer, sacrifice, and asceticism. In the region of the north is a beautiful purple mountain. where lives the amiable Kaka-bhusundi, supremely skilled in the method of Rama’s worship, wise and Full of all good qualities and very aged. He unceasingly recites Rama's history and all the noblest to the birds reverently listen, Go there and hear all Rama’s excellences; your distress born of delusion will then be removed." After I had given him full instructions, he bowed his head at my feet and set out with joy. Idid not myself instruct him, Uma, for 1 understood the mystery of Rama’s grace. Perhaps he had shown pride on some occasion and the Allmerciful wished that he should cure himself of this defect. There wasulso another reason why I did not detain him; being a bird he understood bird language. The Lord's
delusive power, Bhavani, is great; who is so wise as not to be fascinated by it?

Even the vehicle of the lord of the three spheres, the very crown of philosophers and saints, was overcome by its deceptive influence; wretched man may well have his doubts. It fascinates Siva and Brahma; why speak of other poor creatures? The saints know this at heart, when they worship the great God, Maya’s master.

sections.label: Doha 63
sections.name: नाथ कृतारथ भयउँ मैं तव दरसन खगराज

verses.sa:
गयउ गरुड़ जहँ बसइ भुसुंडा ।
मति अकुंठ हरि भगति अखंडा ॥
verses.tr:
gayau garur̤ jaham̐ basai bhusuṃḍā
mati akuṃṭh hari bhagati akhaṃḍā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखि सैल प्रसन्न मन भयऊ ।
माया मोह सोच सब गयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi sail prasann man bhayaū
māyā moh soc sab gayaū

verses.sa:
करि तड़ाग मज्जन जलपाना ।
बट तर गयउ हृदयँ हरषाना ॥
verses.tr:
kari tar̤āg majjan jalapānā
baṭ tar gayau hṛdayam̐ haraṣānā

verses.sa:
बृद्ध बृद्ध बिहंग तहँ आए ।
सुनै राम के चरित सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
bṛddh bṛddh bihaṃg taham̐ āe
sunai rām ke carit suhāe

verses.sa:
कथा अरंभ करै सोइ चाहा ।
तेही समय गयउ खगनाहा ॥
verses.tr:
kathā araṃbh karai soi cāhā
tehī samaya gayau khaganāhā

verses.sa:
आवत देखि सकल खगराजा ।
हरषेउ बायस सहित समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
āvat dekhi sakal khagarājā
haraṣeu bāyas sahit samājā

verses.sa:
अति आदर खगपति कर कीन्हा ।
स्वागत पूछि सुआसन दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
ati ādar khagapati kar kīnhā
svāgat pūchi suāsan dīnhā

verses.sa:
करि पूजा समेत अनुरागा ।
मधुर बचन तब बोलेउ कागा ॥
verses.tr:
kari pūjā samet anurāgā
madhur bacan tab boleu kāgā

verses.sa:
नाथ कृतारथ भयउँ मैं तव दरसन खगराज ।
आयसु देहु सो करौं अब प्रभु आयहु केहि काज ॥
verses.tr:
nāth kṛtārath bhayaum̐ maiṃ tav darasan khagarāj
āyasu dehu so karauṃ ab prabhu āyahu kehi kāj
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सदा कृतारथ रूप तुम्ह कह मृदु बचन खगेस ।
जेहि कै अस्तुति सादर निज मुख कीन्हि महेस ॥
verses.tr:
sadā kṛtārath rūp tumh kah mṛdu bacan khages
jehi kai astuti sādar nij mukh kīnhi mahes

trans: _ Garey went to Bhusundi’s abode, that sturdy-hearted und indefatigable votary of Hari’s. At the sight of the rock. his heart rejoiced; the trouble caused him by Maya's wiles all passed away. After bathing in the lake and drinking of the water, he went under the banyan tree with exalting soul. There assembled flocks upon flocks of birds to hear of Rama's glorious doings. He wasjast on the point of beginning to recite, when the king of the birds arrived. All were glad to see him approach, the crow no less than the rest of the assembly. They received him with the utmost politeness and asked of his welfare and conducted him to aseat. Then the crow, after doing him loving homage, addressed him in these winning words:

‘Now am I content, O king of the birds, in that I have see you; whatever you may order me, I am ready to do: what is the object of your visit, my lord?” ‘You have ever been the image of content,’ replied Garur in gracious phrase, “seeing that Siva with his own mouth is ever reverently singing your praises.

sections.label: Doha 64
sections.name: बालचरित कहिं बिबिध बिधि मन महँ परम उछाह

verses.sa:
सुनहु तात जेहि कारन आयउँ ।
सो सब भयउ दरस तव पायउँ ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu tāt jehi kāran āyaum̐
so sab bhayau daras tav pāyaum̐
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखि परम पावन तव आश्रम ।
गयउ मोह संसय नाना भ्रम ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi param pāvan tav āśram
gayau moh saṃsaya nānā bhram

verses.sa:
अब श्रीराम कथा अति पावनि ।
सदा सुखद दुख पुंज नसावनि ॥
verses.tr:
ab śrīrām kathā ati pāvani
sadā sukhad dukh puṃj nasāvani

verses.sa:
सादर तात सुनावहु मोही ।
बार बार बिनवउँ प्रभु तोही ॥
verses.tr:
sādar tāt sunāvahu mohī
bār bār binavaum̐ prabhu tohī

verses.sa:
सुनत गरुड़ कै गिरा बिनीता ।
सरल सुप्रेम सुखद सुपुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
sunat garur̤ kai girā binītā
saral suprem sukhad supunītā

verses.sa:
भयउ तासु मन परम उछाहा ।
लाग कहै रघुपति गुन गाहा ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau tāsu man param uchāhā
lāg kahai raghupati gun gāhā

verses.sa:
प्रथमहिं अति अनुराग भवानी ।
रामचरित सर कहेसि बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
prathamahiṃ ati anurāg bhavānī
rāmacarit sar kahesi bakhānī

verses.sa:
पुनि नारद कर मोह अपारा ।
कहेसि बहुरि रावन अवतारा ॥
verses.tr:
puni nārad kar moh apārā
kahesi bahuri rāvan avatārā

verses.sa:
प्रभु अवतार कथा पुनि गाई ।
तब सिसु चरित कहेसि मन लाई ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu avatār kathā puni gāī
tab sisu carit kahesi man lāī

verses.sa:
बालचरित कहिं बिबिध बिधि मन महँ परम उछाह ।
रिषि आगवन कहेसि पुनि श्री रघुबीर बिबाह ॥
verses.tr:
bālacarit kahiṃ bibidh bidhi man maham̐ param uchāh
riṣi āgavan kahesi puni śrī raghubīr bibāh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearken father; the object for which | came was attained as soon as I saw you. Directly I beheld your most holy hermitage, my delusion was at an end with all my distracting doubts. Now, father, repeat to me with all solemnity the most sanctifying story of Rama, which is ever delightful and a remedy for every ill: this, my lord, is what I urgently beg of you.” On hearing Garur’s prayer, so humble sincere and affectionate, so graceful and pious, a supreme joy was diffused over his soul and he began the recital of Raghupati's glory. First, Bhavani, he expounded with fervent devotion the motive of Rama's acts. Then he told of Narad’s extraordinary delusion and of Ravan’s incarnation. After this he sang the story of the Lord’s birth and then carefully recounted his doings as a child.
After telling all the details of his childish performances with the utmost rapture of soul, he next told of the Rishi’s coming and of Raghu-bir's” marriage.

sections.label: Doha 65
sections.name: कहि बिराध बध जेहि बिधि देह तजी सरभंग

verses.sa:
बहुरि राम अभिषेक प्रसंगा ।
पुनि नृप बचन राज रस भंगा ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri rām abhiṣek prasaṃgā
puni nṛp bacan rāj ras bhaṃgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुरबासिन्ह कर बिरह बिषादा ।
कहेसि राम लछिमन संबादा ॥
verses.tr:
purabāsinh kar birah biṣādā
kahesi rām lachiman saṃbādā

verses.sa:
बिपिन गवन केवट अनुरागा ।
सुरसरि उतरि निवास प्रयागा ॥
verses.tr:
bipin gavan kevaṭ anurāgā
surasari utari nivās prayāgā

verses.sa:
बालमीक प्रभु मिलन बखाना ।
चित्रकूट जिमि बसे भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
bālamīk prabhu milan bakhānā
citrakūṭ jimi base bhagavānā

verses.sa:
सचिवागवन नगर नृप मरना ।
भरतागवन प्रेम बहु बरना ॥
verses.tr:
sacivāgavan nagar nṛp maranā
bharatāgavan prem bahu baranā

verses.sa:
करि नृप क्रिया संग पुरबासी ।
भरत गए जहँ प्रभु सुख रासी ॥
verses.tr:
kari nṛp kriyā saṃg purabāsī
bharat gae jaham̐ prabhu sukh rāsī

verses.sa:
पुनि रघुपति बहु बिधि समुझाए ।
लै पादुका अवधपुर आए ॥
verses.tr:
puni raghupati bahu bidhi samujhāe
lai pādukā avadhapur āe

verses.sa:
भरत रहनि सुरपति सुत करनी ।
प्रभु अरु अत्रि भेंट पुनि बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
bharat rahani surapati sut karanī
prabhu aru atri bheṃṭ puni baranī

verses.sa: कहि बिराध बध जेहि बिधि देह तजी सरभंग ॥
verses.tr: kahi birādh badh jehi bidhi deh tajī sarabhaṃg
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: बरनि सुतीछन प्रीति पुनि प्रभु अगस्ति सतसंग ॥
verses.tr: barani sutīchan prīti puni prabhu agasti satasaṃg

trans: Then came the narrative of Rama’s coronation, of the king’s vow and abdication of royal state, the sorrow of the citizens at parting, the colloquy between Rama and Lakshman, the journey to the forest, the devotion of the boatman, the passage of the Ganges and the stay at Prayag: He described also the Lord’s meeting with Valmiki and how the god dwelt at Chitra-kut, the coming of the Minister, the death of the king in the city, the arrival of Bharat and the greatness of his affection, how after performing the king’s obsequies both Bharat himself and the citizens had gone to join the [Lord blessed for ever, and how after he had said all be could to console them Bharat took his sandal back with him to Avadh Next he related Bharat’s mode of life, the action of the son of Indra and the Lord's interview with Atri
Then he told of Viraddh’s death, of bow Sarabhanga dropped his body, of Satikshna’s devotion and the Lord's pious intercourse with Agastya.

sections.label: Doha 66
sections.name: प्रभु नारद संबाद कहि मारुति मिलन प्रसंग

verses.sa:
कहि दंडक बन पावनताई ।
गीध मइत्री पुनि तेहिं गाई ॥
verses.tr:
kahi daṃḍak ban pāvanatāī
gīdh maitrī puni tehiṃ gāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुनि प्रभु पंचवटीं कृत बासा ।
भंजी सकल मुनिन्ह की त्रासा ॥
verses.tr:
puni prabhu paṃcavaṭīṃ kṛt bāsā
bhaṃjī sakal muninh kī trāsā

verses.sa:
पुनि लछिमन उपदेस अनूपा ।
सूपनखा जिमि कीन्हि कुरूपा ॥
verses.tr:
puni lachiman upades anūpā
sūpanakhā jimi kīnhi kurūpā

verses.sa:
खर दूषन बध बहुरि बखाना ।
जिमि सब मरमु दसानन जाना ॥
verses.tr:
khar dūṣan badh bahuri bakhānā
jimi sab maramu dasānan jānā

verses.sa:
दसकंधर मारीच बतकहीं ।
जेहि बिधि भई सो सब तेहिं कही ॥
verses.tr:
dasakaṃdhar mārīc batakahīṃ
jehi bidhi bhaī so sab tehiṃ kahī

verses.sa:
पुनि माया सीता कर हरना ।
श्रीरघुबीर बिरह कछु बरना ॥
verses.tr:
puni māyā sītā kar haranā
śrīraghubīr birah kachu baranā

verses.sa:
पुनि प्रभु गीध क्रिया जिमि कीन्ही ।
बधि कबंध सबरिहि गति दीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
puni prabhu gīdh kriyā jimi kīnhī
badhi kabaṃdh sabarihi gati dīnhī

verses.sa:
बहुरि बिरह बरनत रघुबीरा ।
जेहि बिधि गए सरोबर तीरा ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri birah baranat raghubīrā
jehi bidhi gae sarobar tīrā

verses.sa:
प्रभु नारद संबाद कहि मारुति मिलन प्रसंग ।
पुनि सुग्रीव मिताई बालि प्रान कर भंग।।66((क) ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu nārad saṃbād kahi māruti milan prasaṃg
puni sugrīv mitāī bāli prān kar bhaṃg 66((ka)
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
कपिहि तिलक करि प्रभु कृत सैल प्रबरषन बास ।
बरनन बर्षा सरद अरु राम रोष कपि त्रास ॥
verses.tr:
kapihi tilak kari prabhu kṛt sail prabaraṣan bās
baranan barṣā sarad aru rām roṣ kapi trās

trans: He told him also ot the purification of the Dandaka forest, of the friendliness of the vulture, of the Lord’s stay in the woods of Panchavati, and how he putan end to the fears of all the saints. Then came the incomparable exhortation to Lakshman and the story of Surpa-nakha’s mutila-tion. After this he narrated to him the death of Khara and Dashan, and how Ravan penetrated the mystery and all the particulars of his talk with Mericha. Then he described the rape of the fictitious Sita and gave an idea of Rama’s bereavement. After this he told how the Lord performed the vulture's funeral rites and slew Kabandh and gave salvation to Sabari. He told of Raghubir’s mourning and how he went to the shore of the luke.

Of his interview with Narad, his meeting with Hann-man, his alliance with Sugriva and his taking Bali’s life; of his making the monkey king and taking up his abode on the rock during the rains. He described also the rains and the autumn and Rama’s indignation and the monkey’s alarm.

sections.label: Doha 67
sections.name: सेतु बाँधि कपि सेन जिमि उतरी सागर पार

verses.sa:
जेहि बिधि कपिपति कीस पठाए ।
सीता खोज सकल दिसि धाए ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bidhi kapipati kīs paṭhāe
sītā khoj sakal disi dhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिबर प्रबेस कीन्ह जेहि भाँती ।
कपिन्ह बहोरि मिला संपाती ॥
verses.tr:
bibar prabes kīnh jehi bhām̐tī
kapinh bahori milā saṃpātī

verses.sa:
सुनि सब कथा समीरकुमारा ।
नाघत भयउ पयोधि अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
suni sab kathā samīrakumārā
nāghat bhayau payodhi apārā

verses.sa:
लंकाँ कपि प्रबेस जिमि कीन्हा ।
पुनि सीतहि धीरजु जिमि दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
laṃkām̐ kapi prabes jimi kīnhā
puni sītahi dhīraju jimi dīnhā

verses.sa:
बन उजारि रावनहि प्रबोधी ।
पुर दहि नाघेउ बहुरि पयोधी ॥
verses.tr:
ban ujāri rāvanahi prabodhī
pur dahi nāgheu bahuri payodhī

verses.sa:
आए कपि सब जहँ रघुराई ।
बैदेही कि कुसल सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
āe kapi sab jaham̐ raghurāī
baidehī ki kusal sunāī

verses.sa:
सेन समेति जथा रघुबीरा ।
उतरे जाइ बारिनिधि तीरा ॥
verses.tr:
sen sameti jathā raghubīrā
utare jāi bārinidhi tīrā

verses.sa:
मिला बिभीषन जेहि बिधि आई ।
सागर निग्रह कथा सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
milā bibhīṣan jehi bidhi āī
sāgar nigrah kathā sunāī

verses.sa:
सेतु बाँधि कपि सेन जिमि उतरी सागर पार ।
गयउ बसीठी बीरबर जेहि बिधि बालिकुमार ॥
verses.tr:
setu bām̐dhi kapi sen jimi utarī sāgar pār
gayau basīṭhī bīrabar jehi bidhi bālikumār
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
निसिचर कीस लराई बरनिसि बिबिध प्रकार ।
कुंभकरन घननाद कर बल पौरुष संघार ॥
verses.tr:
nisicar kīs larāī baranisi bibidh prakār
kuṃbhakaran ghananād kar bal pauruṣ saṃghār

trans: How-the monkey king sent out monkeys, who ran in every direction in search for Sita; how they entered the cave and found Sampati; how Hanuman, when he had heard all the circumstances, jumped over the mighty ocean; how he made his way into Lanka and bade Sita be of good cheer; how he laid waste the garden, and lectured Ravan and set fire to the city and leaped over the sea again. How the monkeys all rejoined Rama and told him of Sita’s welfare; how Raghubir with his army went and encamped on the sea-shore; how Vibhishan came to meet him, and how the sea was put in check;

How the bridge was built and the monkey host crossed over to the opposite side, and how the valiant son of Bali went as an envoy. He described the various battles between the demons and the monkeys, the might and valour of Kumbha-karn and Meghnded and their destruction;

sections.label: Doha 68
sections.name: गयउ मोर संदेह सुनेउँ सकल रघुपति चरित

verses.sa:
निसिचर निकर मरन बिधि नाना ।
रघुपति रावन समर बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
nisicar nikar maran bidhi nānā
raghupati rāvan samar bakhānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रावन बध मंदोदरि सोका ।
राज बिभीषण देव असोका ॥
verses.tr:
rāvan badh maṃdodari sokā
rāj bibhīṣaṇ dev asokā

verses.sa:
सीता रघुपति मिलन बहोरी ।
सुरन्ह कीन्ह अस्तुति कर जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
sītā raghupati milan bahorī
suranh kīnh astuti kar jorī

verses.sa:
पुनि पुष्पक चढ़ि कपिन्ह समेता ।
अवध चले प्रभु कृपा निकेता ॥
verses.tr:
puni puṣpak car̤hi kapinh sametā
avadh cale prabhu kṛpā niketā

verses.sa:
जेहि बिधि राम नगर निज आए ।
बायस बिसद चरित सब गाए ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bidhi rām nagar nij āe
bāyas bisad carit sab gāe

verses.sa:
कहेसि बहोरि राम अभिषैका ।
पुर बरनत नृपनीति अनेका ॥
verses.tr:
kahesi bahori rām abhiṣaikā
pur baranat nṛpanīti anekā

verses.sa:
कथा समस्त भुसुंड बखानी ।
जो मैं तुम्ह सन कही भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
kathā samast bhusuṃḍ bakhānī
jo maiṃ tumh san kahī bhavānī

verses.sa:
सुनि सब राम कथा खगनाहा ।
कहत बचन मन परम उछाहा ॥
verses.tr:
suni sab rām kathā khaganāhā
kahat bacan man param uchāhā

verses.sa:
गयउ मोर संदेह सुनेउँ सकल रघुपति चरित ।
भयउ राम पद नेह तव प्रसाद बायस तिलक ॥
verses.tr:
gayau mor saṃdeh suneum̐ sakal raghupati carit
bhayau rām pad neh tav prasād bāyas tilak
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
मोहि भयउ अति मोह प्रभु बंधन रन महुँ निरखि ।
चिदानंद संदोह राम बिकल कारन कवन ॥
verses.tr:
mohi bhayau ati moh prabhu baṃdhan ran mahum̐ nirakhi
cidānaṃd saṃdoh rām bikal kāran kavan

trans: The different deaths of all the demons, the fight between Rama and Ravan the death of Ravan, the mourning of Mandodari, the eothronement of Vibhishan and the satisfaction of the gods; the meeting also of Rama and Sita and how the gods with clasped hands hymned their praises; how the all-merciful Lord with the monkeys mounted the car Pushpaka and set out for Avadh; and how Rama arrived at his own city; all these glorious doings were sung by the crow. Then he told of Rama’s coronation and described the city and all its kingly polity. The entire history did Bhusundi tell, as I have told it to you, Bhavani. When the king of the birds had heard it all, his soul was in raptures and he cried;
i Sorathd h.

‘“‘ My doubts are gone, now that] have heard Rama's full history. By your favour, O best of crows, I feel a devotion to Rama’s feet. A mighty bewilderment possessed me when I saw the Lord bound in the battle: if Rama be the sum of all knowledge and bliss, what can embarrass him?
Seeing all his ways so entirely consistent with humanity,

sections.label: Doha 69
sections.name: सुनि बिहंगपति बानी सहित बिनय अनुराग

verses.sa:
देखि चरित अति नर अनुसारी ।
भयउ हृदयँ मम संसय भारी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi carit ati nar anusārī
bhayau hṛdayam̐ mam saṃsaya bhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोइ भ्रम अब हित करि मैं माना ।
कीन्ह अनुग्रह कृपानिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
soi bhram ab hit kari maiṃ mānā
kīnh anugrah kṛpānidhānā

verses.sa:
जो अति आतप ब्याकुल होई ।
तरु छाया सुख जानइ सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jo ati ātap byākul hoī
taru chāyā sukh jānai soī

verses.sa:
जौं नहिं होत मोह अति मोही ।
मिलतेउँ तात कवन बिधि तोही ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ nahiṃ hot moh ati mohī
milateum̐ tāt kavan bidhi tohī

verses.sa:
सुनतेउँ किमि हरि कथा सुहाई ।
अति बिचित्र बहु बिधि तुम्ह गाई ॥
verses.tr:
sunateum̐ kimi hari kathā suhāī
ati bicitr bahu bidhi tumh gāī

verses.sa:
निगमागम पुरान मत एहा ।
कहहिं सिद्ध मुनि नहिं संदेहा ॥
verses.tr:
nigamāgam purān mat ehā
kahahiṃ siddh muni nahiṃ saṃdehā

verses.sa:
संत बिसुद्ध मिलहिं परि तेही ।
चितवहिं राम कृपा करि जेही ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt bisuddh milahiṃ pari tehī
citavahiṃ rām kṛpā kari jehī

verses.sa:
राम कृपाँ तव दरसन भयऊ ।
तव प्रसाद सब संसय गयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
rām kṛpām̐ tav darasan bhayaū
tav prasād sab saṃsaya gayaū

verses.sa:
सुनि बिहंगपति बानी सहित बिनय अनुराग ।
पुलक गात लोचन सजल मन हरषेउ अति काग ॥
verses.tr:
suni bihaṃgapati bānī sahit binaya anurāg
pulak gāt locan sajal man haraṣeu ati kāg
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
श्रोता सुमति सुसील सुचि कथा रसिक हरि दास ।
पाइ उमा अति गोप्यमपि सज्जन करहिं प्रकास ॥
verses.tr:
śrotā sumati susīl suci kathā rasik hari dās
pāi umā ati gopyamapi sajjan karahiṃ prakās

trans: a very grievous doubts arose in my soul. But now I under- stand that my error wasa favour which the All-merciful was pleased to bestow upon me. To appreciate the blessing of a shady tree, one must first have suffered from the sun. If this delusion had not befallen me, how should I have met you, father, and how should I have heard the delightful story of Rama which you have told me so Fully in all its details? ‘his ie the doctrine of the Puranas and all the Scriptures, the unbesitating assertion of all the seers and sages, that the company of good and holy men can only be attained by one on whom Rama has looked with an eye of favour. By Raima's favour I have had sight ef you, snd by your grace all my doubts are gone.”

On hearing Garur's modest and affectionate speech, the crow was greatly rejoiced at heart; every hair on his body stood erect and his eyes streamed with tears. O Uma, when a good man finds and intelligent and well-disposed listener, who is pious and fond of religious reading and a worshipper of Hari, he reveals to him hidden mysteries.

sections.label: Doha 70
sections.name: ग्यानी तापस सूर कबि कोबिद गुन आगार

verses.sa:
बोलेउ काकभसुंड बहोरी ।
नभग नाथ पर प्रीति न थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
boleu kākabhasuṃḍ bahorī
nabhag nāth par prīti na thorī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सब बिधि नाथ पूज्य तुम्ह मेरे ।
कृपापात्र रघुनायक केरे ॥
verses.tr:
sab bidhi nāth pūjya tumh mere
kṛpāpātr raghunāyak kere

verses.sa:
तुम्हहि न संसय मोह न माया ।
मो पर नाथ कीन्ह तुम्ह दाया ॥
verses.tr:
tumhahi na saṃsaya moh na māyā
mo par nāth kīnh tumh dāyā

verses.sa:
पठइ मोह मिस खगपति तोही ।
रघुपति दीन्हि बड़ाई मोही ॥
verses.tr:
paṭhai moh mis khagapati tohī
raghupati dīnhi bar̤āī mohī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह निज मोह कही खग साईं ।
सो नहिं कछु आचरज गोसाईं ॥
verses.tr:
tumh nij moh kahī khag sāīṃ
so nahiṃ kachu ācaraj gosāīṃ

verses.sa:
नारद भव बिरंचि सनकादी ।
जे मुनिनायक आतमबादी ॥
verses.tr:
nārad bhav biraṃci sanakādī
je munināyak ātamabādī

verses.sa:
मोह न अंध कीन्ह केहि केही ।
को जग काम नचाव न जेही ॥
verses.tr:
moh na aṃdh kīnh kehi kehī
ko jag kām nacāv na jehī

verses.sa:
तृस्नाँ केहि न कीन्ह बौराहा ।
केहि कर हृदय क्रोध नहिं दाहा ॥
verses.tr:
tṛsnām̐ kehi na kīnh baurāhā
kehi kar hṛdaya krodh nahiṃ dāhā

verses.sa:
ग्यानी तापस सूर कबि कोबिद गुन आगार ।
केहि कै लौभ बिडंबना कीन्हि न एहिं संसार ॥
verses.tr:
gyānī tāpas sūr kabi kobid gun āgār
kehi kai laubh biḍaṃbanā kīnhi na ehiṃ saṃsār
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
श्री मद बक्र न कीन्ह केहि प्रभुता बधिर न काहि ।
मृगलोचनि के नैन सर को अस लाग न जाहि ॥
verses.tr:
śrī mad bakr na kīnh kehi prabhutā badhir na kāhi
mṛgalocani ke nain sar ko as lāg na jāhi

trans: Then answered Keka-bhusundi, who had no slight affection for the king of the birds: “My lord, you are in every way entitled to my respect, as a vessel of Hari's grace. You had no doubts, infatuation, or delusion; it was only a pretext, Sire, for doing me a kindness. By sending you. Garur, asa victim of delusion, Raghupati has conferred an honour upon me. Yet there is nothing wonderful, Sir, in that delusion of yours of which you tell me; for Narad, Siva, Brahma, Sanat: IXumara and his brethren, with all the great saints who discourse of the soul, is there one of them whom delusion has not blinded, or whom Love has not
made a puppet of, whom Desire has not maddened, or whose heart choler has not inflamed?

Is there any philosopher, ascetic, or hero in the world, or any learned and accomplished bard, whom Greed has not buguiled; whom the pride of wealth has not rendered wanton; whom power has not made deaf; or whom the glance of beauty has not smitten us an arrow?

sections.label: Doha 71
sections.name: ब्यापि रहेउ संसार महुँ माया कटक प्रचंड

verses.sa:
गुन कृत सन्यपात नहिं केही ।
कोउ न मान मद तजेउ निबेही ॥
verses.tr:
gun kṛt sanyapāt nahiṃ kehī
kou na mān mad tajeu nibehī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जोबन ज्वर केहि नहिं बलकावा ।
ममता केहि कर जस न नसावा ॥
verses.tr:
joban jvar kehi nahiṃ balakāvā
mamatā kehi kar jas na nasāvā

verses.sa:
मच्छर काहि कलंक न लावा ।
काहि न सोक समीर डोलावा ॥
verses.tr:
macchar kāhi kalaṃk na lāvā
kāhi na sok samīr ḍolāvā

verses.sa:
चिंता साँपिनि को नहिं खाया ।
को जग जाहि न ब्यापी माया ॥
verses.tr:
ciṃtā sām̐pini ko nahiṃ khāyā
ko jag jāhi na byāpī māyā

verses.sa:
कीट मनोरथ दारु सरीरा ।
जेहि न लाग घुन को अस धीरा ॥
verses.tr:
kīṭ manorath dāru sarīrā
jehi na lāg ghun ko as dhīrā

verses.sa:
सुत बित लोक ईषना तीनी ।
केहि के मति इन्ह कृत न मलीनी ॥
verses.tr:
sut bit lok īṣanā tīnī
kehi ke mati inh kṛt na malīnī

verses.sa:
यह सब माया कर परिवारा ।
प्रबल अमिति को बरनै पारा ॥
verses.tr:
yah sab māyā kar parivārā
prabal amiti ko baranai pārā

verses.sa:
सिव चतुरानन जाहि डेराहीं ।
अपर जीव केहि लेखे माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
siv caturānan jāhi ḍerāhīṃ
apar jīv kehi lekhe māhīṃ

verses.sa: ब्यापि रहेउ संसार महुँ माया कटक प्रचंड ॥
verses.tr: byāpi raheu saṃsār mahum̐ māyā kaṭak pracaṃḍ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: सेनापति कामादि भट दंभ कपट पाषंड ॥
verses.tr: senāpati kāmādi bhaṭ daṃbh kapaṭ pāṣaṃḍ

verses.sa:
सो दासी रघुबीर कै समुझें मिथ्या सोपि ।
छूट न राम कृपा बिनु नाथ कहउँ पद रोपि ॥
verses.tr:
so dāsī raghubīr kai samujheṃ mithyā sopi
chūṭ na rām kṛpā binu nāth kahaum̐ pad ropi

trans: Is there any whom success has not paralyzed; who has effectually discarded vanity and pride; whom the fever of youth has not overcome; whose glory has not been ruined hy self-conceit; whom envy has not besmirched; whom the blast of sorrow has not shiken; whom the serpent of care has not ‘bitten; or whom delusion has not affected Is there any so well seasoned of frame that he has not been attacked by desire, as a blank by the weevil The desire of family, of wealth and of renown isa threefold temptation; whose soul has it not sullied These all are Maya's suite; who can describe in ‘full her illimitable might? Since Siva and Brahma stand in awe of her, why speak of other creatures?

Maya's formidable army is spread over the whole world; Love and the other Passions are her generals; Fraud, Deceit and Heresy her champions. Being the servant of Raghu-bir, though known to be a delusion, she can only be dispersed by his favour; this, my lord, I assert with the utmost confideace.

sections.label: Doha 72
sections.name: भगत हेतु भगवान प्रभु राम धरेउ तनु भूप

verses.sa:
जो माया सब जगहि नचावा ।
जासु चरित लखि काहुँ न पावा ॥
verses.tr:
jo māyā sab jagahi nacāvā
jāsu carit lakhi kāhum̐ na pāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोइ प्रभु भ्रू बिलास खगराजा ।
नाच नटी इव सहित समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
soi prabhu bhrū bilās khagarājā
nāc naṭī iv sahit samājā

verses.sa:
सोइ सच्चिदानंद घन रामा ।
अज बिग्यान रूपो बल धामा ॥
verses.tr:
soi saccidānaṃd ghan rāmā
aj bigyān rūpo bal dhāmā

verses.sa:
ब्यापक ब्याप्य अखंड अनंता ।
अखिल अमोघसक्ति भगवंता ॥
verses.tr:
byāpak byāpya akhaṃḍ anaṃtā
akhil amoghasakti bhagavaṃtā

verses.sa:
अगुन अदभ्र गिरा गोतीता ।
सबदरसी अनवद्य अजीता ॥
verses.tr:
agun adabhr girā gotītā
sabadarasī anavadya ajītā

verses.sa:
निर्मम निराकार निरमोहा ।
नित्य निरंजन सुख संदोहा ॥
verses.tr:
nirmam nirākār niramohā
nitya niraṃjan sukh saṃdohā

verses.sa:
प्रकृति पार प्रभु सब उर बासी ।
ब्रह्म निरीह बिरज अबिनासी ॥
verses.tr:
prakṛti pār prabhu sab ur bāsī
brahm nirīh biraj abināsī

verses.sa:
इहाँ मोह कर कारन नाहीं ।
रबि सन्मुख तम कबहुँ कि जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ moh kar kāran nāhīṃ
rabi sanmukh tam kabahum̐ ki jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
भगत हेतु भगवान प्रभु राम धरेउ तनु भूप ।
किए चरित पावन परम प्राकृत नर अनुरूप ॥
verses.tr:
bhagat hetu bhagavān prabhu rām dhareu tanu bhūp
kie carit pāvan param prākṛt nar anurūp
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
जथा अनेक बेष धरि नृत्य करइ नट कोइ ।
सोइ सोइ भाव देखावइ आपुन होइ न सोइ ॥
verses.tr:
jathā anek beṣ dhari nṛtya karai naṭ koi
soi soi bhāv dekhāvai āpun hoi na soi

trans: This Mays, that seta the whole world adancing and whose actions ao one can understand, is herself set dancing with all her troupe, like an actress on the stage, U king of the birds, by the play of the Lord's eye brows. for Rama is the totality of existence, knowledge and bliss!, the uncreated the all-wise the home of beauty and streagth; the permeator and the permeated; the indivisible, the eternal;

the insoluble, the unerring; the primal energy, the Godhead; of whom no qualities can be predicated and no deceit; beyond the range of speech or perception; all seeing, irreproachable, unconquered; without personal interests, without form, without illusion: deathless, passionless, blessed for ever; transcending nature: the Lord that indwelleth in every heart; the Supreme Spirit, effortless, passionless, imperishable; in him delusion finds no sphere; does darkness ever attack the sun?

For the sake of his faithful people, the very God, our lord Rama, has become incarnate as a king and for our supreme sanctification has lived as it were the life of any ordinary man. Asan actor in the course of his performance assumes a variety of dresses and exhibits different characters, but himself remains the same;

sections.label: Doha 73
sections.name: काम क्रोध मद लोभ रत गृहासक्त दुखरूप

verses.sa:
असि रघुपति लीला उरगारी ।
दनुज बिमोहनि जन सुखकारी ॥
verses.tr:
asi raghupati līlā uragārī
danuj bimohani jan sukhakārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जे मति मलिन बिषयबस कामी ।
प्रभु मोह धरहिं इमि स्वामी ॥
verses.tr:
je mati malin biṣayabas kāmī
prabhu moh dharahiṃ imi svāmī

verses.sa:
नयन दोष जा कहँ जब होई ।
पीत बरन ससि कहुँ कह सोई ॥
verses.tr:
nayan doṣ jā kaham̐ jab hoī
pīt baran sasi kahum̐ kah soī

verses.sa:
जब जेहि दिसि भ्रम होइ खगेसा ।
सो कह पच्छिम उयउ दिनेसा ॥
verses.tr:
jab jehi disi bhram hoi khagesā
so kah pacchim uyau dinesā

verses.sa:
नौकारूढ़ चलत जग देखा ।
अचल मोह बस आपुहि लेखा ॥
verses.tr:
naukārūr̤h calat jag dekhā
acal moh bas āpuhi lekhā

verses.sa:
बालक भ्रमहिं न भ्रमहिं गृहादीं ।
कहहिं परस्पर मिथ्याबादी ॥
verses.tr:
bālak bhramahiṃ na bhramahiṃ gṛhādīṃ
kahahiṃ paraspar mithyābādī

verses.sa:
हरि बिषइक अस मोह बिहंगा ।
सपनेहुँ नहिं अग्यान प्रसंगा ॥
verses.tr:
hari biṣaik as moh bihaṃgā
sapanehum̐ nahiṃ agyān prasaṃgā

verses.sa:
मायाबस मतिमंद अभागी ।
हृदयँ जमनिका बहुबिधि लागी ॥
verses.tr:
māyābas matimaṃd abhāgī
hṛdayam̐ jamanikā bahubidhi lāgī

verses.sa:
ते सठ हठ बस संसय करहीं ।
निज अग्यान राम पर धरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
te saṭh haṭh bas saṃsaya karahīṃ
nij agyān rām par dharahīṃ

verses.sa:
काम क्रोध मद लोभ रत गृहासक्त दुखरूप ।
ते किमि जानहिं रघुपतिहि मूढ़ परे तम कूप ॥
verses.tr:
kām krodh mad lobh rat gṛhāsakt dukharūp
te kimi jānahiṃ raghupatihi mūr̤h pare tam kūp
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
निर्गुन रूप सुलभ अति सगुन जान नहिं कोइ ।
सुगम अगम नाना चरित सुनि मुनि मन भ्रम होइ ॥
verses.tr:
nirgun rūp sulabh ati sagun jān nahiṃ koi
sugam agam nānā carit suni muni man bhram hoi

trans: Such, Garur, is Rama’s divertissement, a bewilderment to the demons, but a delight to the faithful. Sensual libertines in their dulness of soul) impute the delusion to the Lord, like as when, Sir, a man whose eyesight is in fault says that the moon is of a yellow colour; or when mistaken as to the points of the compass, affirms that the sun has risen in the west; or as one on boardship, who deludes himself with the idea that he is standing still and that the land is moving. When children in play turn round and round, the house, or whatever else it may be, does not turn round, it is only their idle fashion of talking. In this way only, O Garur, can error be ascribed to Hari; never even in adream is he really subject to delusion. The wretched dullards, who succumb to Maya4, have a thick veil over their soul, and these are the obstinate fools who raise doubts and
lay their own ignorance on Rama.

How o1n these clowns understand Raghu-pati, addicted as they are to lust, choler, pride and greed, absorbed in domestic affairs, pictures of misery, at the bottom of a well of darkness? The unembodied phase of the Godhead is easy to understand, but who can comprehend its incarna-

sections.label: Doha 74
sections.name: जदपि प्रथम दुख पावइ रोवइ बाल अधीर

verses.sa:
सुनु खगेस रघुपति प्रभुताई ।
कहउँ जथामति कथा सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
sunu khages raghupati prabhutāī
kahaum̐ jathāmati kathā suhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जेहि बिधि मोह भयउ प्रभु मोही ।
सोउ सब कथा सुनावउँ तोही ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bidhi moh bhayau prabhu mohī
sou sab kathā sunāvaum̐ tohī

verses.sa:
राम कृपा भाजन तुम्ह ताता ।
हरि गुन प्रीति मोहि सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
rām kṛpā bhājan tumh tātā
hari gun prīti mohi sukhadātā

verses.sa:
ताते नहिं कछु तुम्हहिं दुरावउँ ।
परम रहस्य मनोहर गावउँ ॥
verses.tr:
tāte nahiṃ kachu tumhahiṃ durāvaum̐
param rahasya manohar gāvaum̐

verses.sa:
सुनहु राम कर सहज सुभाऊ ।
जन अभिमान न राखहिं काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu rām kar sahaj subhāū
jan abhimān na rākhahiṃ kāū

verses.sa:
संसृत मूल सूलप्रद नाना ।
सकल सोक दायक अभिमाना ॥
verses.tr:
saṃsṛt mūl sūlaprad nānā
sakal sok dāyak abhimānā

verses.sa:
ताते करहिं कृपानिधि दूरी ।
सेवक पर ममता अति भूरी ॥
verses.tr:
tāte karahiṃ kṛpānidhi dūrī
sevak par mamatā ati bhūrī

verses.sa:
जिमि सिसु तन ब्रन होइ गोसाई ।
मातु चिराव कठिन की नाईं ॥
verses.tr:
jimi sisu tan bran hoi gosāī
mātu cirāv kaṭhin kī nāīṃ

verses.sa:
जदपि प्रथम दुख पावइ रोवइ बाल अधीर ।
ब्याधि नास हित जननी गनति न सो सिसु पीर ॥
verses.tr:
jadapi pratham dukh pāvai rovai bāl adhīr
byādhi nās hit jananī ganati na so sisu pīr
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
तिमि रघुपति निज दासकर हरहिं मान हित लागि ।
तुलसिदास ऐसे प्रभुहि कस न भजहु भ्रम त्यागि ॥
verses.tr:
timi raghupati nij dāsakar harahiṃ mān hit lāgi
tulasidās aise prabhuhi kas na bhajahu bhram tyāgi

trans: tion? the soul of a saint is bewildered on hearing of all. his actions, both natural and supernatural. |

Hearken, Garur, I will tell you to the best of my ability an agreeable story, in illustration of Rama’s power; declaring to you in full all the particulars of a delusion which befell myself. You, Sire, are a vessel of Rama's grace and cherish a special affection for Hari’s actions. and are moreover my greatest benefactor; I will therefore conceal nothing from you in this exposition of a great and excellent mystery. Hearken; Rama’s natural disposition is. such that he never tolerates pride in his servants. Pride has its root in worldliness and is the cause of many pains and every kind of vexation. Therefore the All-merciful does away with it, in the greatness of his affection for his ser. vants: in the same way, Sire, as when « child has a boil on its body, its mother with seeming cruelty cuts it open.

At first the poor child cries with the pain, but the mother pays no attention to it, her object being tooure the disease. [In like manner Raghupati cures his servants of pride, doing it all for their good. Ah, Tulsi Das, who would not forswear error and worship such a lord as this?

sections.label: Doha 75
sections.name: लरिकाईं जहँ जहँ फिरहिं तहँ तहँ संग उड़ाउँ

verses.sa:
राम कृपा आपनि जड़ताई ।
कहउँ खगेस सुनहु मन लाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām kṛpā āpani jar̤atāī
kahaum̐ khages sunahu man lāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जब जब राम मनुज तनु धरहीं ।
भक्त हेतु लीला बहु करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jab jab rām manuj tanu dharahīṃ
bhakt hetu līlā bahu karahīṃ

verses.sa:
तब तब अवधपुरी मैं ज़ाऊँ ।
बालचरित बिलोकि हरषाऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
tab tab avadhapurī maiṃ zāūm̐
bālacarit biloki haraṣāūm̐

verses.sa:
जन्म महोत्सव देखउँ जाई ।
बरष पाँच तहँ रहउँ लोभाई ॥
verses.tr:
janm mahotsav dekhaum̐ jāī
baraṣ pām̐c taham̐ rahaum̐ lobhāī

verses.sa:
इष्टदेव मम बालक रामा ।
सोभा बपुष कोटि सत कामा ॥
verses.tr:
iṣṭadev mam bālak rāmā
sobhā bapuṣ koṭi sat kāmā

verses.sa:
निज प्रभु बदन निहारि निहारी ।
लोचन सुफल करउँ उरगारी ॥
verses.tr:
nij prabhu badan nihāri nihārī
locan suphal karaum̐ uragārī

verses.sa:
लघु बायस बपु धरि हरि संगा ।
देखउँ बालचरित बहुरंगा ॥
verses.tr:
laghu bāyas bapu dhari hari saṃgā
dekhaum̐ bālacarit bahuraṃgā

verses.sa:
लरिकाईं जहँ जहँ फिरहिं तहँ तहँ संग उड़ाउँ ।
जूठनि परइ अजिर महँ सो उठाइ करि खाउँ ॥
verses.tr:
larikāīṃ jaham̐ jaham̐ phirahiṃ taham̐ taham̐ saṃg ur̤āum̐
jūṭhani parai ajir maham̐ so uṭhāi kari khāum̐
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
एक बार अतिसय सब चरित किए रघुबीर ।
सुमिरत प्रभु लीला सोइ पुलकित भयउ सरीर ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār atisaya sab carit kie raghubīr
sumirat prabhu līlā soi pulakit bhayau sarīr

trans: I will now tell you the story, Garur, of Rama’s grace and my own stupidity; listen attentively. Whenever Rama assumes human form and goes through his series of mimic actions in the behoof of his votaries, I always betake myself to Avadh and delight to watch his boyish doings. 1 go and attend the rejoicings at his birth and am glad to stay for five years. The child Rama is my patron divinity, beautiful in form asa myriad Loves. Ever gazing on the Face of my own lord, O Garur, I give my eyesa treat indeed, and being in the trivial shape of a crow I keep close to Hari and observe all his childlike sports..

Whenever he rambles in play, I flutter about close at hand, and for my food I pick up the crumbs in the courtyard that fall from his table. One day Raghubir played a very quaint frolic. At the remembrance of his lord's playfulness, every hair on his body stood erect with tapture.

sections.label: Doha 76
sections.name: रेखा त्रय सुन्दर उदर नाभी रुचिर गँभीर

verses.sa:
कहइ भसुंड सुनहु खगनायक ।
रामचरित सेवक सुखदायक ॥
verses.tr:
kahai bhasuṃḍ sunahu khaganāyak
rāmacarit sevak sukhadāyak
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नृपमंदिर सुंदर सब भाँती ।
खचित कनक मनि नाना जाती ॥
verses.tr:
nṛpamaṃdir suṃdar sab bhām̐tī
khacit kanak mani nānā jātī

verses.sa:
बरनि न जाइ रुचिर अँगनाई ।
जहँ खेलहिं नित चारिउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
barani na jāi rucir am̐ganāī
jaham̐ khelahiṃ nit cāriu bhāī

verses.sa:
बालबिनोद करत रघुराई ।
बिचरत अजिर जननि सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
bālabinod karat raghurāī
bicarat ajir janani sukhadāī

verses.sa:
मरकत मृदुल कलेवर स्यामा ।
अंग अंग प्रति छबि बहु कामा ॥
verses.tr:
marakat mṛdul kalevar syāmā
aṃg aṃg prati chabi bahu kāmā

verses.sa:
नव राजीव अरुन मृदु चरना ।
पदज रुचिर नख ससि दुति हरना ॥
verses.tr:
nav rājīv arun mṛdu caranā
padaj rucir nakh sasi duti haranā

verses.sa:
ललित अंक कुलिसादिक चारी ।
नूपुर चारू मधुर रवकारी ॥
verses.tr:
lalit aṃk kulisādik cārī
nūpur cārū madhur ravakārī

verses.sa:
चारु पुरट मनि रचित बनाई ।
कटि किंकिन कल मुखर सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
cāru puraṭ mani racit banāī
kaṭi kiṃkin kal mukhar suhāī

verses.sa:
रेखा त्रय सुन्दर उदर नाभी रुचिर गँभीर ।
उर आयत भ्राजत बिबिध बाल बिभूषन चीर ॥
verses.tr:
rekhā traya sundar udar nābhī rucir gam̐bhīr
ur āyat bhrājat bibidh bāl bibhūṣan cīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bhusundi continued; “Hearken, king of the birds, to my story of Rama's actions, which are ever the delight of his servants. The king's palace was exquisitely beautiful; of gold studded with precious stones of every kind. The pleasantness of the court-yard, where the four brothers were always playing, surpasses description. Here Rama roamed about, to the delight of his mother, diverting himself with childish amusements; his tender frame dark of hue as a sapphire, with the beauty of unnumbered Loves in every limb; his soft rosy feet like lotus buds, with lustrous nails that outshone the brightness of the moon, decorated with the four-fold stamp of the thunderbolt, the lotus the elephant-goad and the flag, and circled with pretty bangles that made sweet music. Melodious, too, the pretty belt about his waist fashioned of gold and bossed with jewels.
With a belly creased in the three lines of beauty, a navel shapely and deep, and a broad chest gleaming with all the ornaments that befit a child’s attire;

sections.label: Doha 77
sections.name: आवत निकट हँसहिं प्रभु भाजत रुदन कराहिं

verses.sa:
अरुन पानि नख करज मनोहर ।
बाहु बिसाल बिभूषन सुंदर ॥
verses.tr:
arun pāni nakh karaj manohar
bāhu bisāl bibhūṣan suṃdar
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कंध बाल केहरि दर ग्रीवा ।
चारु चिबुक आनन छबि सींवा ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃdh bāl kehari dar grīvā
cāru cibuk ānan chabi sīṃvā

verses.sa:
कलबल बचन अधर अरुनारे ।
दुइ दुइ दसन बिसद बर बारे ॥
verses.tr:
kalabal bacan adhar arunāre
dui dui dasan bisad bar bāre

verses.sa:
ललित कपोल मनोहर नासा ।
सकल सुखद ससि कर सम हासा ॥
verses.tr:
lalit kapol manohar nāsā
sakal sukhad sasi kar sam hāsā

verses.sa:
नील कंज लोचन भव मोचन ।
भ्राजत भाल तिलक गोरोचन ॥
verses.tr:
nīl kaṃj locan bhav mocan
bhrājat bhāl tilak gorocan

verses.sa:
बिकट भृकुटि सम श्रवन सुहाए ।
कुंचित कच मेचक छबि छाए ॥
verses.tr:
bikaṭ bhṛkuṭi sam śravan suhāe
kuṃcit kac mecak chabi chāe

verses.sa:
पीत झीनि झगुली तन सोही ।
किलकनि चितवनि भावति मोही ॥
verses.tr:
pīt jhīni jhagulī tan sohī
kilakani citavani bhāvati mohī

verses.sa:
रूप रासि नृप अजिर बिहारी ।
नाचहिं निज प्रतिबिंब निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
rūp rāsi nṛp ajir bihārī
nācahiṃ nij pratibiṃb nihārī

verses.sa:
मोहि सन करहीं बिबिध बिधि क्रीड़ा ।
बरनत मोहि होति अति ब्रीड़ा ॥
verses.tr:
mohi san karahīṃ bibidh bidhi krīr̤ā
baranat mohi hoti ati brīr̤ā

verses.sa:
किलकत मोहि धरन जब धावहिं ।
चलउँ भागि तब पूप देखावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
kilakat mohi dharan jab dhāvahiṃ
calaum̐ bhāgi tab pūp dekhāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
आवत निकट हँसहिं प्रभु भाजत रुदन कराहिं ।
जाउँ समीप गहन पद फिरि फिरि चितइ पराहिं ॥
verses.tr:
āvat nikaṭ ham̐sahiṃ prabhu bhājat rudan karāhiṃ
jāum̐ samīp gahan pad phiri phiri citai parāhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
प्राकृत सिसु इव लीला देखि भयउ मोहि मोह ।
कवन चरित्र करत प्रभु चिदानंद संदोह ॥
verses.tr:
prākṛt sisu iv līlā dekhi bhayau mohi moh
kavan caritr karat prabhu cidānaṃd saṃdoh

trans: With roseate hands and lovely nails; with long and richly braceleted arms and the shoulders of a young lion; with dimpled neck and rounded chin and face the perfection of beauty; with lisping speech and ruddy lips and two dear little pearly teeth above and below; with chubby cheeks and durling nose and a smile as winsome as that of the moon; with lotus eyes that loose earth’s ties and forehead gleaming with the mark of yellow pigment; with arched eye-brews and pretty ears; with curly hair black and beautiful; with a thin yellow jacket to set off his body, he fascinated me with his merry glance, as he sported in all his loveliness in the king’s courts, dancing at the sight of his own shadow, and having all sorts of antios with me, which I blush to tell, When he laaghing-
ly ran to catch me, I flew away; then he showed me e piece of cake.

T came near and the Lord laughed. 1 flew away again and he fell a-orying. I approached to lay hold of his feet, and he ran off, again and again turning round to look at me. Seeing him play like an ordinary child, I was overcome by bewilderment. Can these be the actions of the Lord who is the totality of intelligence und bliss?

sections.label: Doha 78
sections.name: रामचंद्र के भजन बिनु जो चह पद निर्बान

verses.sa:
एतना मन आनत खगराया ।
रघुपति प्रेरित ब्यापी माया ॥
verses.tr:
etanā man ānat khagarāyā
raghupati prerit byāpī māyā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सो माया न दुखद मोहि काहीं ।
आन जीव इव संसृत नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
so māyā na dukhad mohi kāhīṃ
ān jīv iv saṃsṛt nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
नाथ इहाँ कछु कारन आना ।
सुनहु सो सावधान हरिजाना ॥
verses.tr:
nāth ihām̐ kachu kāran ānā
sunahu so sāvadhān harijānā

verses.sa:
ग्यान अखंड एक सीताबर ।
माया बस्य जीव सचराचर ॥
verses.tr:
gyān akhaṃḍ ek sītābar
māyā basya jīv sacarācar

verses.sa:
जौं सब कें रह ग्यान एकरस ।
ईस्वर जीवहि भेद कहहु कस ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ sab keṃ rah gyān ekaras
īsvar jīvahi bhed kahahu kas

verses.sa:
माया बस्य जीव अभिमानी ।
ईस बस्य माया गुनखानी ॥
verses.tr:
māyā basya jīv abhimānī
īs basya māyā gunakhānī

verses.sa:
परबस जीव स्वबस भगवंता ।
जीव अनेक एक श्रीकंता ॥
verses.tr:
parabas jīv svabas bhagavaṃtā
jīv anek ek śrīkaṃtā

verses.sa:
मुधा भेद जद्यपि कृत माया ।
बिनु हरि जाइ न कोटि उपाया ॥
verses.tr:
mudhā bhed jadyapi kṛt māyā
binu hari jāi na koṭi upāyā

verses.sa:
रामचंद्र के भजन बिनु जो चह पद निर्बान ।
ग्यानवंत अपि सो नर पसु बिनु पूँछ बिषान ॥
verses.tr:
rāmacaṃdr ke bhajan binu jo cah pad nirbān
gyānavaṃt api so nar pasu binu pūm̐ch biṣān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: राकापति षोड़स उअहिं तारागन समुदाइ ॥
verses.tr: rākāpati ṣor̤as uahiṃ tārāgan samudāi

verses.sa: सकल गिरिन्ह दव लाइअ बिनु रबि राति न जाइ ॥
verses.tr: sakal girinh dav lāia binu rabi rāti na jāi

trans: This was what came into my mind, Garur, for Rama had sent forth his delusive power to entangle me. But this delusion was in no way hurmful to me. Iwas not so affected by it as other creatures. A special cause, my lord, was here at work, which a wish you, Garur, to observe attentively. Rama alone is absolute intelligence; every creature, animate, or inanimate, is subject to Maya. If all had the same perfect intelligence, tell me what would be the difference between God and his creature The creature in his pride is subjected to Maya. Maya with all its phenomena is subject to God. The creature is dependent on others, the Deity is self-dependent; the creature is manifold, Rama is one. Though the distinctions made by May are false, without Hari’s help they cannot be dispersed, whatever you may do.;

The wisest of men, who hopes for salvation without prayer to Rama, is like a beast without tail and borne. Though sixteen full moons were to rise and all the starry host and the forests on every mountain were set on fire night would not yield except to the sun.

sections.label: Doha 79
sections.name: ब्रह्मलोक लगि गयउँ मैं चितयउँ पाछ उड़ात

verses.sa:
ऐसेहिं हरि बिनु भजन खगेसा ।
मिटइ न जीवन्ह केर कलेसा ॥
verses.tr:
aisehiṃ hari binu bhajan khagesā
miṭai na jīvanh ker kalesā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हरि सेवकहि न ब्याप अबिद्या ।
प्रभु प्रेरित ब्यापइ तेहि बिद्या ॥
verses.tr:
hari sevakahi na byāp abidyā
prabhu prerit byāpai tehi bidyā

verses.sa:
ताते नास न होइ दास कर ।
भेद भगति भाढ़इ बिहंगबर ॥
verses.tr:
tāte nās na hoi dās kar
bhed bhagati bhār̤hai bihaṃgabar

verses.sa:
भ्रम ते चकित राम मोहि देखा ।
बिहँसे सो सुनु चरित बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
bhram te cakit rām mohi dekhā
biham̐se so sunu carit biseṣā

verses.sa:
तेहि कौतुक कर मरमु न काहूँ ।
जाना अनुज न मातु पिताहूँ ॥
verses.tr:
tehi kautuk kar maramu na kāhūm̐
jānā anuj na mātu pitāhūm̐

verses.sa:
जानु पानि धाए मोहि धरना ।
स्यामल गात अरुन कर चरना ॥
verses.tr:
jānu pāni dhāe mohi dharanā
syāmal gāt arun kar caranā

verses.sa:
तब मैं भागि चलेउँ उरगामी ।
राम गहन कहँ भुजा पसारी ॥
verses.tr:
tab maiṃ bhāgi caleum̐ uragāmī
rām gahan kaham̐ bhujā pasārī

verses.sa:
जिमि जिमि दूरि उड़ाउँ अकासा ।
तहँ भुज हरि देखउँ निज पासा ॥
verses.tr:
jimi jimi dūri ur̤āum̐ akāsā
taham̐ bhuj hari dekhaum̐ nij pāsā

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मलोक लगि गयउँ मैं चितयउँ पाछ उड़ात ।
जुग अंगुल कर बीच सब राम भुजहि मोहि तात ॥
verses.tr:
brahmalok lagi gayaum̐ maiṃ citayaum̐ pāch ur̤āt
jug aṃgul kar bīc sab rām bhujahi mohi tāt
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सप्ताबरन भेद करि जहाँ लगें गति मोरि ।
गयउँ तहाँ प्रभु भुज निरखि ब्याकुल भयउँ बहोरि ॥
verses.tr:
saptābaran bhed kari jahām̐ lageṃ gati mori
gayaum̐ tahām̐ prabhu bhuj nirakhi byākul bhayaum̐ bahori

trans: In like manner, Garur, without prayer to Hari, the troubles incident to existence cannot be dispersed. Ignorance has no power over a servant of Hari’s knowledge emanating from the Lord pervades his whole being. Therefore, O best of birds, there is no destruction for a believer: his faith as of a servant in his master isever growing. Retia smiled to see me reel in error, and hear what a strange course he adopted. The secret of his diversion neither his brother nor his father or mother ever knew. As he crawled oa his hands and knees in a hurry to catch me— with his body so dark of hue and his rosy hands and feet I took to flight, Garur, and he stretched out his arms to. lay hold of me. High as I flew into the air, I still saw his arms as close to me as ever.

I mounted even the Brahma’s sphere, but when I looked back in my flight, two fingers’ breadth, Sir, was all the distance between me and Rama’s arms. I cleft the seven folds of the universe and mounted to the utmost height that I could reach, still I saw the Lord’s arms; then was [ dumbfounded.

sections.label: Doha 80
sections.name: जो नहिं देखा नहिं सुना जो मनहूँ न समाइ

verses.sa:
मूदेउँ नयन त्रसित जब भयउँ ।
पुनि चितवत कोसलपुर गयऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
mūdeum̐ nayan trasit jab bhayaum̐
puni citavat kosalapur gayaūm̐
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मोहि बिलोकि राम मुसुकाहीं ।
बिहँसत तुरत गयउँ मुख माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
mohi biloki rām musukāhīṃ
biham̐sat turat gayaum̐ mukh māhīṃ

verses.sa:
उदर माझ सुनु अंडज राया ।
देखेउँ बहु ब्रह्मांड निकाया ॥
verses.tr:
udar mājh sunu aṃḍaj rāyā
dekheum̐ bahu brahmāṃḍ nikāyā

verses.sa:
अति बिचित्र तहँ लोक अनेका ।
रचना अधिक एक ते एका ॥
verses.tr:
ati bicitr taham̐ lok anekā
racanā adhik ek te ekā

verses.sa:
कोटिन्ह चतुरानन गौरीसा ।
अगनित उडगन रबि रजनीसा ॥
verses.tr:
koṭinh caturānan gaurīsā
aganit uḍagan rabi rajanīsā

verses.sa:
अगनित लोकपाल जम काला ।
अगनित भूधर भूमि बिसाला ॥
verses.tr:
aganit lokapāl jam kālā
aganit bhūdhar bhūmi bisālā

verses.sa:
सागर सरि सर बिपिन अपारा ।
नाना भाँति सृष्टि बिस्तारा ॥
verses.tr:
sāgar sari sar bipin apārā
nānā bhām̐ti sṛṣṭi bistārā

verses.sa:
सुर मुनि सिद्ध नाग नर किंनर ।
चारि प्रकार जीव सचराचर ॥
verses.tr:
sur muni siddh nāg nar kiṃnar
cāri prakār jīv sacarācar

verses.sa:
जो नहिं देखा नहिं सुना जो मनहूँ न समाइ ।
सो सब अद्भुत देखेउँ बरनि कवनि बिधि जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
jo nahiṃ dekhā nahiṃ sunā jo manahūm̐ na samāi
so sab adbhut dekheum̐ barani kavani bidhi jāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
एक एक ब्रह्मांड महुँ रहउँ बरष सत एक ।
एहि बिधि देखत फिरउँ मैं अंड कटाह अनेक ॥
verses.tr:
ek ek brahmāṃḍ mahum̐ rahaum̐ baraṣ sat ek
ehi bidhi dekhat phiraum̐ maiṃ aṃḍ kaṭāh anek

trans: In my terror I closed my eyes, and when I opened them again I found myself at Ayodhya. Rama looked at me with a smile, and as he laughed I jumped down his throat. Inhis belly (hearken, king of the birds) I saw multitudinous universes, with many strange worlds, each more wonderful than the other; with myriads of Brahmans and Sivas; stars and suns and moons innumerable; innumerable Lokpels and images of Death and Time; innumerable mountains and vast plains of earth; seas, lakes, rivers and forests without end, and all the complex machinery of creation; with gods, sages, saints, serpents and kinnars and the four classes of living things both moving and motionless,

Such as eye has not seen, nor ear heard, nor has entered into man’s mind to conceive, were all the marvels that I saw; how is it possible to describe them In each universe I stayed a hundred years and in this manner made the round of all the multitudinous globes. )

sections.label: Doha 81
sections.name: भिन्न भिन्न मै दीख सबु अति बिचित्र हरिजान

verses.sa:
लोक लोक प्रति भिन्न बिधाता ।
भिन्न बिष्नु सिव मनु दिसित्राता ॥
verses.tr:
lok lok prati bhinn bidhātā
bhinn biṣnu siv manu disitrātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नर गंधर्ब भूत बेताला ।
किंनर निसिचर पसु खग ब्याला ॥
verses.tr:
nar gaṃdharb bhūt betālā
kiṃnar nisicar pasu khag byālā

verses.sa:
देव दनुज गन नाना जाती ।
सकल जीव तहँ आनहि भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
dev danuj gan nānā jātī
sakal jīv taham̐ ānahi bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
महि सरि सागर सर गिरि नाना ।
सब प्रपंच तहँ आनइ आना ॥
verses.tr:
mahi sari sāgar sar giri nānā
sab prapaṃc taham̐ ānai ānā

verses.sa:
अंडकोस प्रति प्रति निज रुपा ।
देखेउँ जिनस अनेक अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
aṃḍakos prati prati nij rupā
dekheum̐ jinas anek anūpā

verses.sa:
अवधपुरी प्रति भुवन निनारी ।
सरजू भिन्न भिन्न नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
avadhapurī prati bhuvan ninārī
sarajū bhinn bhinn nar nārī

verses.sa:
दसरथ कौसल्या सुनु ताता ।
बिबिध रूप भरतादिक भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
dasarath kausalyā sunu tātā
bibidh rūp bharatādik bhrātā

verses.sa:
प्रति ब्रह्मांड राम अवतारा ।
देखउँ बालबिनोद अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
prati brahmāṃḍ rām avatārā
dekhaum̐ bālabinod apārā

verses.sa:
भिन्न भिन्न मै दीख सबु अति बिचित्र हरिजान ।
अगनित भुवन फिरेउँ प्रभु राम न देखेउँ आन ॥
verses.tr:
bhinn bhinn mai dīkh sabu ati bicitr harijān
aganit bhuvan phireum̐ prabhu rām na dekheum̐ ān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सोइ सिसुपन सोइ सोभा सोइ कृपाल रघुबीर ।
भुवन भुवन देखत फिरउँ प्रेरित मोह समीर ॥
verses.tr:
soi sisupan soi sobhā soi kṛpāl raghubīr
bhuvan bhuvan dekhat phiraum̐ prerit moh samīr

trans: _ Each world had its own separate Creator, its own Vishe nu, Siva and Manu and its own Regents of the spheres; with men, Gandharvas, imps and evils spirits, kinnars aaa demons, cattle, birds and serpents, all the tribes of gods and giants, and every living creature, but differing in form; with lands, rivers, seas, lakes, and mountains, and the whole mechanism of creation also quite distinct. Each mundane egg had its own peculiar aspect and in all its manifold de-il dite Ee. a a EE Biukamakge Mebloupesare, (nsther Ohba oe ie cee
precisely rendered ‘half-globe,’ kataha here standing for th i karaha, a large shallow iron vessel used for boiling wsertee remines ra

tails was wonderful to behold. Io each world was a separate city of Avadh with its own Sarju; its own men and women, with Dasarath and Kausalya and the other queens, and Bharat and his brothers, each in their proper form. Each sphere had its own incarnate Rama with all his child-like sports for me to see.

O Garur, I saw every part of the pageant separately repeated, but in my round of the innumerable worlds | saw no other Lord Rama. The same child-like ways, the same beauty, the same gracious Raghu-bir were what | saw in each successive world that I visited, driven on by the blast of delusion.

sections.label: Doha 82
sections.name: देखि कृपाल बिकल मोहि बिहँसे तब रघुबीर

verses.sa:
भ्रमत मोहि ब्रह्मांड अनेका ।
बीते मनहुँ कल्प सत एका ॥
verses.tr:
bhramat mohi brahmāṃḍ anekā
bīte manahum̐ kalp sat ekā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
फिरत फिरत निज आश्रम आयउँ ।
तहँ पुनि रहि कछु काल गवाँयउँ ॥
verses.tr:
phirat phirat nij āśram āyaum̐
taham̐ puni rahi kachu kāl gavām̐yaum̐

verses.sa:
निज प्रभु जन्म अवध सुनि पायउँ ।
निर्भर प्रेम हरषि उठि धायउँ ॥
verses.tr:
nij prabhu janm avadh suni pāyaum̐
nirbhar prem haraṣi uṭhi dhāyaum̐

verses.sa:
देखउँ जन्म महोत्सव जाई ।
जेहि बिधि प्रथम कहा मैं गाई ॥
verses.tr:
dekhaum̐ janm mahotsav jāī
jehi bidhi pratham kahā maiṃ gāī

verses.sa:
राम उदर देखेउँ जग नाना ।
देखत बनइ न जाइ बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
rām udar dekheum̐ jag nānā
dekhat banai na jāi bakhānā

verses.sa:
तहँ पुनि देखेउँ राम सुजाना ।
माया पति कृपाल भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ puni dekheum̐ rām sujānā
māyā pati kṛpāl bhagavānā

verses.sa:
करउँ बिचार बहोरि बहोरी ।
मोह कलिल ब्यापित मति मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
karaum̐ bicār bahori bahorī
moh kalil byāpit mati morī

verses.sa:
उभय घरी महँ मैं सब देखा ।
भयउँ भ्रमित मन मोह बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
ubhaya gharī maham̐ maiṃ sab dekhā
bhayaum̐ bhramit man moh biseṣā

verses.sa:
देखि कृपाल बिकल मोहि बिहँसे तब रघुबीर ।
बिहँसतहीं मुख बाहेर आयउँ सुनु मतिधीर ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi kṛpāl bikal mohi biham̐se tab raghubīr
biham̐satahīṃ mukh bāher āyaum̐ sunu matidhīr
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सोइ लरिकाई मो सन करन लगे पुनि राम ।
कोटि भाँति समुझावउँ मनु न लहइ बिश्राम ॥
verses.tr:
soi larikāī mo san karan lage puni rām
koṭi bhām̐ti samujhāvaum̐ manu na lahai biśrām

trans: Imagine a hundred cycles to have been spent in my wanderings through the different spheres. At last after all my travels [ came to my own hermitage and there | stayed some little time. When I heard of my lord’s birth at Avadh, I started up in an overwhelming ecstasy of devotion and went and witnessed the rejoicings at his nativity as 1 have already described to you. In Rama's belly I[ saw many worlds, but what I saw is past all telling. Then again I saw the all-wise Rama, the Lord of Maya, the merciful God, and much I questioned within myself, for my _ anderstanding was obscured by the mists of delusion. In two hours I saw everything; I was a-wedry and my soul was bewildered entirely. Dohe 82.

Seeing my distress, the all-merciful Ragbu-bir laughed, and as he laughed I issued from his mouth; hearken, O firm of faith. Rama again began his childish pranks with me. I reasoned with myself in every way I could; but my mind had no peace. bali Chaup4ai.

sections.label: Doha 83
sections.name: सुनि सप्रेम मम बानी देखि दीन निज दास

verses.sa:
देखि चरित यह सो प्रभुताई ।
समुझत देह दसा बिसराई ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi carit yah so prabhutāī
samujhat deh dasā bisarāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
धरनि परेउँ मुख आव न बाता ।
त्राहि त्राहि आरत जन त्राता ॥
verses.tr:
dharani pareum̐ mukh āv na bātā
trāhi trāhi ārat jan trātā

verses.sa:
प्रेमाकुल प्रभु मोहि बिलोकी ।
निज माया प्रभुता तब रोकी ॥
verses.tr:
premākul prabhu mohi bilokī
nij māyā prabhutā tab rokī

verses.sa:
कर सरोज प्रभु मम सिर धरेऊ ।
दीनदयाल सकल दुख हरेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kar saroj prabhu mam sir dhareū
dīnadayāl sakal dukh hareū

verses.sa:
कीन्ह राम मोहि बिगत बिमोहा ।
सेवक सुखद कृपा संदोहा ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh rām mohi bigat bimohā
sevak sukhad kṛpā saṃdohā

verses.sa:
प्रभुता प्रथम बिचारि बिचारी ।
मन महँ होइ हरष अति भारी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhutā pratham bicāri bicārī
man maham̐ hoi haraṣ ati bhārī

verses.sa:
भगत बछलता प्रभु कै देखी ।
उपजी मम उर प्रीति बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
bhagat bachalatā prabhu kai dekhī
upajī mam ur prīti biseṣī

verses.sa:
सजल नयन पुलकित कर जोरी ।
कीन्हिउँ बहु बिधि बिनय बहोरी ॥
verses.tr:
sajal nayan pulakit kar jorī
kīnhium̐ bahu bidhi binaya bahorī

verses.sa:
सुनि सप्रेम मम बानी देखि दीन निज दास ।
बचन सुखद गंभीर मृदु बोले रमानिवास ॥
verses.tr:
suni saprem mam bānī dekhi dīn nij dās
bacan sukhad gaṃbhīr mṛdu bole ramānivās
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
काकभसुंडि मागु बर अति प्रसन्न मोहि जानि ।
अनिमादिक सिधि अपर रिधि मोच्छ सकल सुख खानि ॥
verses.tr:
kākabhasuṃḍi māgu bar ati prasann mohi jāni
animādik sidhi apar ridhi mocch sakal sukh khāni

trans: Seeing this miracle and weighing its transcendency I lost my senses. I fell to the ground and no word came to my mouth, but ‘Save me, save me O saviour of all distrest believers. When the Lord saw my agony of devotion, he at once. checked the influence of his delusive power. The Lord placed his lotus hands upon my head and—ever merciful to the poor-—healed me of all my pain. Rama, the gracious benefactor of his servants, thus. dispelled my infatuation. As I reflected on his mighty power, there first arose in my heart a great transport of delight; and seeing his loving kindness to his worshippers my bosom heaved with an unutterable love. With streaming eyes and quivering frame and hands clasped in prayer, I again and again made humble petition. |

Hearing my loving words and seeing me to be his own devoted servant, he made me this gracious, profound and tender speech; ‘' Kek»-bhusundi, ask of me ¢ boon, for know that I am highly pleased with you; be it the supernatural powers of the saints, or fabulous wealth, or deliverance from further transmigration, the sum of all bliss;

sections.label: Doha 84
sections.name: अबिरल भगति बिसुध्द तव श्रुति पुरान जो गाव

verses.sa:
ग्यान बिबेक बिरति बिग्याना ।
मुनि दुर्लभ गुन जे जग नाना ॥
verses.tr:
gyān bibek birati bigyānā
muni durlabh gun je jag nānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आजु देउँ सब संसय नाहीं ।
मागु जो तोहि भाव मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
āju deum̐ sab saṃsaya nāhīṃ
māgu jo tohi bhāv man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु बचन अधिक अनुरागेउँ ।
मन अनुमान करन तब लागेऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
suni prabhu bacan adhik anurāgeum̐
man anumān karan tab lāgeūm̐

verses.sa:
प्रभु कह देन सकल सुख सही ।
भगति आपनी देन न कही ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu kah den sakal sukh sahī
bhagati āpanī den na kahī

verses.sa:
भगति हीन गुन सब सुख ऐसे ।
लवन बिना बहु बिंजन जैसे ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati hīn gun sab sukh aise
lavan binā bahu biṃjan jaise

verses.sa:
भजन हीन सुख कवने काजा ।
अस बिचारि बोलेउँ खगराजा ॥
verses.tr:
bhajan hīn sukh kavane kājā
as bicāri boleum̐ khagarājā

verses.sa:
जौं प्रभु होइ प्रसन्न बर देहू ।
मो पर करहु कृपा अरु नेहू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ prabhu hoi prasann bar dehū
mo par karahu kṛpā aru nehū

verses.sa:
मन भावत बर मागउँ स्वामी ।
तुम्ह उदार उर अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
man bhāvat bar māgaum̐ svāmī
tumh udār ur aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
अबिरल भगति बिसुध्द तव श्रुति पुरान जो गाव ।
जेहि खोजत जोगीस मुनि प्रभु प्रसाद कोउ पाव ॥
verses.tr:
abiral bhagati bisudhd tav śruti purān jo gāv
jehi khojat jogīs muni prabhu prasād kou pāv
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
भगत कल्पतरु प्रनत हित कृपा सिंधु सुख धाम ।
सोइ निज भगति मोहि प्रभु देहु दया करि राम ॥
verses.tr:
bhagat kalpataru pranat hit kṛpā siṃdhu sukh dhām
soi nij bhagati mohi prabhu dehu dayā kari rām

trans: Or knowledge and. wisdom, self-restraint and philosophy, qualities which as all the world knows scarce the gods can attain unto. To-day I will grant you anything; doubt not, but ask whatever your soul desires.” On hearing the Lord's words I was greatly moved and began to reason thus within myself; “The Lord, it is true, has promised to give me every blessing, but has not said he would give me faith. Without faith what are any virtues or blessings? like any quantity of condiments without salt. Of what avail is any good without prayer?’ Having thus considered,, O Garur, I made reply: If it be your good pleasure, my lord, to gruot mea boon and if you wish to do me a favour and kindness, | will ask the boon, Sire, which my soul desires; you are generous and know the secrets of‘ the hearts,

A steadfast and sincere faith, such as the Vedas and Puranas describe, such as the greatest ascetics and saints search after, but few only find and that by the Lord’s grace: O my lord Rama, tree of Paradise to the pious, friend of the suppliant, all-merciful, all-blessed, of your clemency grant me this faith.”

sections.label: Doha 85
sections.name: माया संभव भ्रम सब अब न ब्यापिहहिं तोहि

verses.sa:
एवमस्तु कहि रघुकुलनायक ।
बोले बचन परम सुखदायक ॥
verses.tr:
evamastu kahi raghukulanāyak
bole bacan param sukhadāyak
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनु बायस तैं सहज सयाना ।
काहे न मागसि अस बरदाना ॥
verses.tr:
sunu bāyas taiṃ sahaj sayānā
kāhe na māgasi as baradānā

verses.sa:
सब सुख खानि भगति तैं मागी ।
नहिं जग कोउ तोहि सम बड़भागी ॥
verses.tr:
sab sukh khāni bhagati taiṃ māgī
nahiṃ jag kou tohi sam bar̤abhāgī

verses.sa:
जो मुनि कोटि जतन नहिं लहहीं ।
जे जप जोग अनल तन दहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jo muni koṭi jatan nahiṃ lahahīṃ
je jap jog anal tan dahahīṃ

verses.sa:
रीझेउँ देखि तोरि चतुराई ।
मागेहु भगति मोहि अति भाई ॥
verses.tr:
rījheum̐ dekhi tori caturāī
māgehu bhagati mohi ati bhāī

verses.sa:
सुनु बिहंग प्रसाद अब मोरें ।
सब सुभ गुन बसिहहिं उर तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
sunu bihaṃg prasād ab moreṃ
sab subh gun basihahiṃ ur toreṃ

verses.sa:
भगति ग्यान बिग्यान बिरागा ।
जोग चरित्र रहस्य बिभागा ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati gyān bigyān birāgā
jog caritr rahasya bibhāgā

verses.sa:
जानब तैं सबही कर भेदा ।
मम प्रसाद नहिं साधन खेदा ॥
verses.tr:
jānab taiṃ sabahī kar bhedā
mam prasād nahiṃ sādhan khedā

verses.sa:
माया संभव भ्रम सब अब न ब्यापिहहिं तोहि ।
जानेसु ब्रह्म अनादि अज अगुन गुनाकर मोहि ॥
verses.tr:
māyā saṃbhav bhram sab ab na byāpihahiṃ tohi
jānesu brahm anādi aj agun gunākar mohi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
मोहि भगत प्रिय संतत अस बिचारि सुनु काग ।
कायँ बचन मन मम पद करेसु अचल अनुराग ॥
verses.tr:
mohi bhagat priya saṃtat as bicāri sunu kāg
kāyam̐ bacan man mam pad karesu acal anurāg

trans: ‘So be it,’ said the prince of the house of Raghu and then continued in these most gracious words: ‘Hearken, O crow; you are very sagacious, and therefore no wonder that you ask this boon. You crave faith, the source of
THE SEQUEL 6OL

every blessing; there is none in the world so highly; favour: ed as you; for the saints cannot grasp it after all their labours, though they consume their whole body in the fire of prayer and meditation. I am pleased to see your Sagacity; your prayer for faith is most agreeable to me. Hearken, now, O bird, to the favours I bestow upon you; every good quality shall dwell in your bosom; faith, knowledge, divine, wisdom, self-governance, the practice of mystic abstraction and all the secrets of esoteric love. You shall understand the mysteries of every science and with my favour shall need no other help.

None of the errors that arise from May shall henceforth uffect you; you know me to be the Supreme Spirit without birth or beginning, the im 'waterial root-of all matter, Remember, O crow, that every believer is dear to me; hearken to my words, and in thought, word and deed maintain an unalterable devotion to my feet.

sections.label: Doha 86
sections.name: सुचि सुसील सेवक सुमति प्रिय कहु काहि न लाग

verses.sa:
अब सुनु परम बिमल मम बानी ।
सत्य सुगम निगमादि बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
ab sunu param bimal mam bānī
satya sugam nigamādi bakhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
निज सिद्धांत सुनावउँ तोही ।
सुनु मन धरु सब तजि भजु मोही ॥
verses.tr:
nij siddhāṃt sunāvaum̐ tohī
sunu man dharu sab taji bhaju mohī

verses.sa:
मम माया संभव संसारा ।
जीव चराचर बिबिधि प्रकारा ॥
verses.tr:
mam māyā saṃbhav saṃsārā
jīv carācar bibidhi prakārā

verses.sa:
सब मम प्रिय सब मम उपजाए ।
सब ते अधिक मनुज मोहि भाए ॥
verses.tr:
sab mam priya sab mam upajāe
sab te adhik manuj mohi bhāe

verses.sa:
तिन्ह महँ द्विज द्विज महँ श्रुतिधारी ।
तिन्ह महुँ निगम धरम अनुसारी ॥
verses.tr:
tinh maham̐ dvij dvij maham̐ śrutidhārī
tinh mahum̐ nigam dharam anusārī

verses.sa:
तिन्ह महँ प्रिय बिरक्त पुनि ग्यानी ।
ग्यानिहु ते अति प्रिय बिग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
tinh maham̐ priya birakt puni gyānī
gyānihu te ati priya bigyānī

verses.sa:
तिन्ह ते पुनि मोहि प्रिय निज दासा ।
जेहि गति मोरि न दूसरि आसा ॥
verses.tr:
tinh te puni mohi priya nij dāsā
jehi gati mori na dūsari āsā

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि सत्य कहउँ तोहि पाहीं ।
मोहि सेवक सम प्रिय कोउ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni satya kahaum̐ tohi pāhīṃ
