mohi sevak sam priya kou nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
भगति हीन बिरंचि किन होई ।
सब जीवहु सम प्रिय मोहि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati hīn biraṃci kin hoī
sab jīvahu sam priya mohi soī

verses.sa:
भगतिवंत अति नीचउ प्रानी ।
मोहि प्रानप्रिय असि मम बानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhagativaṃt ati nīcau prānī
mohi prānapriya asi mam bānī

verses.sa:
सुचि सुसील सेवक सुमति प्रिय कहु काहि न लाग ।
श्रुति पुरान कह नीति असि सावधान सुनु काग ॥
verses.tr:
suci susīl sevak sumati priya kahu kāhi na lāg
śruti purān kah nīti asi sāvadhān sunu kāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Attend now to this most holy exposition of mine, which is both simple and true and is implied in the Vedas and other Scriptures. I will reveal to you my own peculiar doctrine: apply your mind to listen and worship me only, abjuring all others. The world is the product of my delusive power, with all its varieties of Life, both moving and motionless. [ love them all, for all are my creatures; but man is the creature that delights me most. Of men, Brahmans; of Brahmans, those who study the Vedas; of these, such as follow the precepts of the sacred texts; of these again celibates are my favourites, and yet more the wise; of the wise I love best the spiritually wise, and of these the best beloved of all are my own servants, who come to me and have no other hope. Again and again I tell you of a truth there are none so dear to me as my own disciples. If Brahma had no faith in me, he would be no dearer to me than any other creature; while the meanest creature that breathes, if possessed of faith, is as dear to me ag my own soul; this is my doctrine,

Tell me how is it possible that a pure, well-disposed and intelligent servant should not be held dear? Hear >n, O orqw, with attention to the principle laid down both in the Vedas and Puranas. Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 87
sections.name: पुरूष नपुंसक नारि वा जीव चराचर कोइ

verses.sa:
एक पिता के बिपुल कुमारा ।
होहिं पृथक गुन सील अचारा ॥
verses.tr:
ek pitā ke bipul kumārā
hohiṃ pṛthak gun sīl acārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कोउ पंडिंत कोउ तापस ग्याता ।
कोउ धनवंत सूर कोउ दाता ॥
verses.tr:
kou paṃḍiṃt kou tāpas gyātā
kou dhanavaṃt sūr kou dātā

verses.sa:
कोउ सर्बग्य धर्मरत कोई ।
सब पर पितहि प्रीति सम होई ॥
verses.tr:
kou sarbagya dharmarat koī
sab par pitahi prīti sam hoī

verses.sa:
कोउ पितु भगत बचन मन कर्मा ।
सपनेहुँ जान न दूसर धर्मा ॥
verses.tr:
kou pitu bhagat bacan man karmā
sapanehum̐ jān na dūsar dharmā

verses.sa:
सो सुत प्रिय पितु प्रान समाना ।
जद्यपि सो सब भाँति अयाना ॥
verses.tr:
so sut priya pitu prān samānā
jadyapi so sab bhām̐ti ayānā

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि जीव चराचर जेते ।
त्रिजग देव नर असुर समेते ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi jīv carācar jete
trijag dev nar asur samete

verses.sa:
अखिल बिस्व यह मोर उपाया ।
सब पर मोहि बराबरि दाया ॥
verses.tr:
akhil bisv yah mor upāyā
sab par mohi barābari dāyā

verses.sa:
तिन्ह महँ जो परिहरि मद माया ।
भजै मोहि मन बच अरू काया ॥
verses.tr:
tinh maham̐ jo parihari mad māyā
bhajai mohi man bac arū kāyā

verses.sa:
पुरूष नपुंसक नारि वा जीव चराचर कोइ ।
सर्ब भाव भज कपट तजि मोहि परम प्रिय सोइ ॥
verses.tr:
purūṣ napuṃsak nāri vā jīv carācar koi
sarb bhāv bhaj kapaṭ taji mohi param priya soi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सत्य कहउँ खग तोहि सुचि सेवक मम प्रानप्रिय ।
अस बिचारि भजु मोहि परिहरि आस भरोस सब ॥
verses.tr:
satya kahaum̐ khag tohi suci sevak mam prānapriya
as bicāri bhaju mohi parihari ās bharos sab

trans: Afather has a number of children, each different in character, temper and occupation. One is a student, another a philosophic ascetic, another an accumulator of wealth, an open- handed soldier, a clever man of the world, or a devotee; the father feels the same affection for them all. Another, again, isin thought, world and deed entirely devoted to his father, never even dreaming of any other duty; and this is the son whom the father loves as his own soul, though he be a perfect ignoramus. In like manner all animate and inanimate beings, including brute beasts, gods, men and demons, in short the entire universe that I have created, is viewed by me with equal compassion; but, amongst them all, if there be one who forswears vanity and delusion and worships me only in thought, word and deed,
Whether he be man, eunuch, or woman, whether animate or inanimate, if with all his soul he sincerely worships me, he is my best-beloved.
O crow, I tell] you of a truth that an honest servant is as dear to me as my own life.. Remember this and worship me only, abjuring every other hope and assurance.

sections.label: Doha 88
sections.name: जेहि सुख लागि पुरारि असुभ बेष कृत सिव सुखद

verses.sa:
कबहूँ काल न ब्यापिहि तोही ।
सुमिरेसु भजेसु निरंतर मोही ॥
verses.tr:
kabahūm̐ kāl na byāpihi tohī
sumiresu bhajesu niraṃtar mohī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रभु बचनामृत सुनि न अघाऊँ ।
तनु पुलकित मन अति हरषाऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu bacanāmṛt suni na aghāūm̐
tanu pulakit man ati haraṣāūm̐

verses.sa:
सो सुख जानइ मन अरु काना ।
नहिं रसना पहिं जाइ बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
so sukh jānai man aru kānā
nahiṃ rasanā pahiṃ jāi bakhānā

verses.sa:
प्रभु सोभा सुख जानहिं नयना ।
कहि किमि सकहिं तिन्हहि नहिं बयना ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu sobhā sukh jānahiṃ nayanā
kahi kimi sakahiṃ tinhahi nahiṃ bayanā

verses.sa:
बहु बिधि मोहि प्रबोधि सुख देई ।
लगे करन सिसु कौतुक तेई ॥
verses.tr:
bahu bidhi mohi prabodhi sukh deī
lage karan sisu kautuk teī

verses.sa:
सजल नयन कछु मुख करि रूखा ।
चितइ मातु लागी अति भूखा ॥
verses.tr:
sajal nayan kachu mukh kari rūkhā
citai mātu lāgī ati bhūkhā

verses.sa:
देखि मातु आतुर उठि धाई ।
कहि मृदु बचन लिए उर लाई ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi mātu ātur uṭhi dhāī
kahi mṛdu bacan lie ur lāī

verses.sa:
गोद राखि कराव पय पाना ।
रघुपति चरित ललित कर गाना ॥
verses.tr:
god rākhi karāv paya pānā
raghupati carit lalit kar gānā

verses.sa:
जेहि सुख लागि पुरारि असुभ बेष कृत सिव सुखद ।
अवधपुरी नर नारि तेहि सुख महुँ संतत मगन ॥
verses.tr:
jehi sukh lāgi purāri asubh beṣ kṛt siv sukhad
avadhapurī nar nāri tehi sukh mahum̐ saṃtat magan
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सोइ सुख लवलेस जिन्ह बारक सपनेहुँ लहेउ ।
ते नहिं गनहिं खगेस ब्रह्मसुखहि सज्जन सुमति ॥
verses.tr:
soi sukh lavales jinh bārak sapanehum̐ laheu
te nahiṃ ganahiṃ khages brahmasukhahi sajjan sumati

trans: » Time shall have no power over you, so long as you.remember to worship me without ceasing.” I should never have tired of listening’ to my lord’s ambrosial discourse; my body’ quivered all over.and my soul rejoiced exceedingly. My mindand my ears experienced u delight, which it ‘is beyond the power of tongue to tell. My eyes had the bliss oF beholding my lord’s beauty, but’ how can they declare it’ they have no voice. After he had gladdened me by his manifold exhortutions, he again began to sport like a child. With streaming eyes and mouth a little awry, he looked - at his mother as if he were very hungry. Seeing this she started up in haste and ran and spoke to him with caress-ing words and clasped him-to ber bosom; then holding him in-her lap she gave him to suck, singing the while of Rama's charming deeds..

The citizens of Avadh were ever flooded with that joy, to attain which the blessed Siva assumes his unsightly’ garb. They who have once realized even ina dream the least atom of that joy, think nothing, O Garur, if they are good and sensible, of the joys of heaven.

sections.label: Doha 89
sections.name: बिनु गुर होइ कि ग्यान ग्यान कि होइ बिराग बिनु

verses.sa:
मैं पुनि अवध रहेउँ कछु काला ।
देखेउँ बालबिनोद रसाला ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ puni avadh raheum̐ kachu kālā
dekheum̐ bālabinod rasālā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम प्रसाद भगति बर पायउँ ।
प्रभु पद बंदि निजाश्रम आयउँ ॥
verses.tr:
rām prasād bhagati bar pāyaum̐
prabhu pad baṃdi nijāśram āyaum̐

verses.sa:
तब ते मोहि न ब्यापी माया ।
जब ते रघुनायक अपनाया ॥
verses.tr:
tab te mohi na byāpī māyā
jab te raghunāyak apanāyā

verses.sa:
यह सब गुप्त चरित मैं गावा ।
हरि मायाँ जिमि मोहि नचावा ॥
verses.tr:
yah sab gupt carit maiṃ gāvā
hari māyām̐ jimi mohi nacāvā

verses.sa:
निज अनुभव अब कहउँ खगेसा ।
बिनु हरि भजन न जाहि कलेसा ॥
verses.tr:
nij anubhav ab kahaum̐ khagesā
binu hari bhajan na jāhi kalesā

verses.sa:
राम कृपा बिनु सुनु खगराई ।
जानि न जाइ राम प्रभुताई ॥
verses.tr:
rām kṛpā binu sunu khagarāī
jāni na jāi rām prabhutāī

verses.sa:
जानें बिनु न होइ परतीती ।
बिनु परतीति होइ नहिं प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
jāneṃ binu na hoi paratītī
binu paratīti hoi nahiṃ prītī

verses.sa:
प्रीति बिना नहिं भगति दिढ़ाई ।
जिमि खगपति जल कै चिकनाई ॥
verses.tr:
prīti binā nahiṃ bhagati dir̤hāī
jimi khagapati jal kai cikanāī

verses.sa:
बिनु गुर होइ कि ग्यान ग्यान कि होइ बिराग बिनु ।
गावहिं बेद पुरान सुख कि लहिअ हरि भगति बिनु ॥
verses.tr:
binu gur hoi ki gyān gyān ki hoi birāg binu
gāvahiṃ bed purān sukh ki lahia hari bhagati binu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
कोउ बिश्राम कि पाव तात सहज संतोष बिनु ।
चलै कि जल बिनु नाव कोटि जतन पचि पचि मरिअ ॥
verses.tr:
kou biśrām ki pāv tāt sahaj saṃtoṣ binu
calai ki jal binu nāv koṭi jatan paci paci maria

trans: After this I stayed some little time at Avadh, a spectator of his delightful boyish play. Then, by Rama’s blessing, having obtained the boon of faith, [ kissed my lord’s feet and returned to my hermitage. Since then no delusion has ever affected me, ‘after 1 had joined Rama. I[ have now told you the whole of this strange story of how I was bo-witched by Hari’s delusive power. From my own experience I warn you, Garur, that without prayer to Hari your troubles will not yield. Hearken, king of the birds; without Rama's grace, there is no understanding his power; without understanding there is no confidence; without confidence there is no affection; without affection there is no consistency in faith; it slips away, Garur, like oil on water.

How can there be knowledge without a teacher ¢ how can there be knowledge without self-control, or (as the Vedas and Puranas declare) how can man attain to happiness‘without devotion to Hari Without innate. content, Sire, none can find peace: a boat will not float without water, though you strain every nerve, enough to kill yourself.

sections.label: Doha 90
sections.name: बिनु बिस्वास भगति नहिं तेहि बिनु द्रवहिं न रामु

verses.sa:
बिनु संतोष न काम नसाहीं ।
काम अछत सुख सपनेहुँ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
binu saṃtoṣ na kām nasāhīṃ
kām achat sukh sapanehum̐ nāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम भजन बिनु मिटहिं कि कामा ।
थल बिहीन तरु कबहुँ कि जामा ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhajan binu miṭahiṃ ki kāmā
thal bihīn taru kabahum̐ ki jāmā

verses.sa:
बिनु बिग्यान कि समता आवइ ।
कोउ अवकास कि नभ बिनु पावइ ॥
verses.tr:
binu bigyān ki samatā āvai
kou avakās ki nabh binu pāvai

verses.sa:
श्रद्धा बिना धर्म नहिं होई ।
बिनु महि गंध कि पावइ कोई ॥
verses.tr:
śraddhā binā dharm nahiṃ hoī
binu mahi gaṃdh ki pāvai koī

verses.sa:
बिनु तप तेज कि कर बिस्तारा ।
जल बिनु रस कि होइ संसारा ॥
verses.tr:
binu tap tej ki kar bistārā
jal binu ras ki hoi saṃsārā

verses.sa:
सील कि मिल बिनु बुध सेवकाई ।
जिमि बिनु तेज न रूप गोसाई ॥
verses.tr:
sīl ki mil binu budh sevakāī
jimi binu tej na rūp gosāī

verses.sa:
निज सुख बिनु मन होइ कि थीरा ।
परस कि होइ बिहीन समीरा ॥
verses.tr:
nij sukh binu man hoi ki thīrā
paras ki hoi bihīn samīrā

verses.sa:
कवनिउ सिद्धि कि बिनु बिस्वासा ।
बिनु हरि भजन न भव भय नासा ॥
verses.tr:
kavaniu siddhi ki binu bisvāsā
binu hari bhajan na bhav bhaya nāsā

verses.sa:
बिनु बिस्वास भगति नहिं तेहि बिनु द्रवहिं न रामु ।
राम कृपा बिनु सपनेहुँ जीव न लह बिश्रामु ॥
verses.tr:
binu bisvās bhagati nahiṃ tehi binu dravahiṃ na rāmu
rām kṛpā binu sapanehum̐ jīv na lah biśrāmu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि मतिधीर तजि कुतर्क संसय सकल ।
भजहु राम रघुबीर करुनाकर सुंदर सुखद ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri matidhīr taji kutark saṃsaya sakal
bhajahu rām raghubīr karunākar suṃdar sukhad

trans: Without content there is no cessation of desire’;.so long as desire continues, it is vain to dream of ease. ‘Can. desire be subdued without prayer to Rama; cana tree ever take root without soil Can equanimity be attained without knowledge, or can you have space without the other? Without faith their is no religion, as there can be no scent without earth? Can fame spread without penance, any more than there can be moisture in the world without water? Can virtue be acquired without attendance on the wise, any more than vision can exist, Sir, without light? Can the mind be at rest when ill at ease, any more than the sense of touch is possible without air Without confidence there is no exercise of supernatural powers, and without prayer to Hari there is no conquest over the terrors of existenos.
Without confidence there is no devotion; without devo-

sections.label: Doha 91
sections.name: मरुत कोटि सत बिपुल बल रबि सत कोटि प्रकास

verses.sa:
निज मति सरिस नाथ मैं गाई ।
प्रभु प्रताप महिमा खगराई ॥
verses.tr:
nij mati saris nāth maiṃ gāī
prabhu pratāp mahimā khagarāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहेउँ न कछु करि जुगुति बिसेषी ।
यह सब मैं निज नयनन्हि देखी ॥
verses.tr:
kaheum̐ na kachu kari juguti biseṣī
yah sab maiṃ nij nayananhi dekhī

verses.sa:
महिमा नाम रूप गुन गाथा ।
सकल अमित अनंत रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
mahimā nām rūp gun gāthā
sakal amit anaṃt raghunāthā

verses.sa:
निज निज मति मुनि हरि गुन गावहिं ।
निगम सेष सिव पार न पावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
nij nij mati muni hari gun gāvahiṃ
nigam seṣ siv pār na pāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
तुम्हहि आदि खग मसक प्रजंता ।
नभ उड़ाहिं नहिं पावहिं अंता ॥
verses.tr:
tumhahi ādi khag masak prajaṃtā
nabh ur̤āhiṃ nahiṃ pāvahiṃ aṃtā

verses.sa:
तिमि रघुपति महिमा अवगाहा ।
तात कबहुँ कोउ पाव कि थाहा ॥
verses.tr:
timi raghupati mahimā avagāhā
tāt kabahum̐ kou pāv ki thāhā

verses.sa:
रामु काम सत कोटि सुभग तन ।
दुर्गा कोटि अमित अरि मर्दन ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu kām sat koṭi subhag tan
durgā koṭi amit ari mardan

verses.sa:
सक्र कोटि सत सरिस बिलासा ।
नभ सत कोटि अमित अवकासा ॥
verses.tr:
sakr koṭi sat saris bilāsā
nabh sat koṭi amit avakāsā

verses.sa:
मरुत कोटि सत बिपुल बल रबि सत कोटि प्रकास ।
ससि सत कोटि सुसीतल समन सकल भव त्रास ॥
verses.tr:
marut koṭi sat bipul bal rabi sat koṭi prakās
sasi sat koṭi susītal saman sakal bhav trās
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
काल कोटि सत सरिस अति दुस्तर दुर्ग दुरंत ।
धूमकेतु सत कोटि सम दुराधरष भगवंत ॥
verses.tr:
kāl koṭi sat saris ati dustar durg duraṃt
dhūmaketu sat koṭi sam durādharaṣ bhagavaṃt

trans: tion Rama is not moved; without the grace of Rama no creature can dream of peace.
Thus consider, O stout of heart,and abjuring scepticism
and every doubt, worship Hama, the heroic son of Raghu, fountain of mercy, the beautiful, the benficent.

Thus have I declared to you, king Garur, according to my ability, the greatness of the Lord’s power; nor have I anywhere had recourse to studied invention, for I have seen it all with ny own eyes. Rama’s greatness, his names, his glory, beauty and perfection, are all boundless and infinite. The saints sing his praises, according to their several ability, but not the Vedas, Sesh-ndey or Siva could declare them fully. There is no winged creature, from yourself down to a gnat, who can reach to the end of the heaven in his flight. In like manner, Sire, the greatness of Raghupati is unfathomable; none can sound the bottom of it. Rama is beautiful of body as a myriad Loves; irresistible in the destruction of his foes asa myriad Durgas; jocund as a myriad (ndras; immeasurable in expanse as a myriad firmaments.
As masterful in might as a myriad winds; as bright as @ myriad suns; as cooling asa myriad moons, soothing all the terror of existence; as impracticable. inaccessible and

sections.label: Doha 92
sections.name: रामु अमित गुन सागर थाह कि पावइ कोइ

verses.sa:
प्रभु अगाध सत कोटि पताला ।
समन कोटि सत सरिस कराला ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu agādh sat koṭi patālā
saman koṭi sat saris karālā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तीरथ अमित कोटि सम पावन ।
नाम अखिल अघ पूग नसावन ॥
verses.tr:
tīrath amit koṭi sam pāvan
nām akhil agh pūg nasāvan

verses.sa:
हिमगिरि कोटि अचल रघुबीरा ।
सिंधु कोटि सत सम गंभीरा ॥
verses.tr:
himagiri koṭi acal raghubīrā
siṃdhu koṭi sat sam gaṃbhīrā

verses.sa:
कामधेनु सत कोटि समाना ।
सकल काम दायक भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
kāmadhenu sat koṭi samānā
sakal kām dāyak bhagavānā

verses.sa:
सारद कोटि अमित चतुराई ।
बिधि सत कोटि सृष्टि निपुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
sārad koṭi amit caturāī
bidhi sat koṭi sṛṣṭi nipunāī

verses.sa:
बिष्नु कोटि सम पालन कर्ता ।
रुद्र कोटि सत सम संहर्ता ॥
verses.tr:
biṣnu koṭi sam pālan kartā
rudr koṭi sat sam saṃhartā

verses.sa:
धनद कोटि सत सम धनवाना ।
माया कोटि प्रपंच निधाना ॥
verses.tr:
dhanad koṭi sat sam dhanavānā
māyā koṭi prapaṃc nidhānā

verses.sa:
भार धरन सत कोटि अहीसा ।
निरवधि निरुपम प्रभु जगदीसा ॥
verses.tr:
bhār dharan sat koṭi ahīsā
niravadhi nirupam prabhu jagadīsā

verses.sa:
निरुपम न उपमा आन राम समान रामु निगम कहै ।
जिमि कोटि सत खद्योत सम रबि कहत अति लघुता लहै ॥
verses.tr:
nirupam na upamā ān rām samān rāmu nigam kahai
jimi koṭi sat khadyot sam rabi kahat ati laghutā lahai
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
एहि भाँति निज निज मति बिलास मुनिस हरिहि बखानहीं ।
प्रभु भाव गाहक अति कृपाल सप्रेम सुनि सुख मानहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bhām̐ti nij nij mati bilās munis harihi bakhānahīṃ
prabhu bhāv gāhak ati kṛpāl saprem suni sukh mānahīṃ

verses.sa:
रामु अमित गुन सागर थाह कि पावइ कोइ ।
संतन्ह सन जस किछु सुनेउँ तुम्हहि सुनायउँ सोइ ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu amit gun sāgar thāh ki pāvai koi
saṃtanh san jas kichu suneum̐ tumhahi sunāyaum̐ soi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
भाव बस्य भगवान सुख निधान करुना भवन ।
तजि ममता मद मान भजिअ सदा सीता रवन ॥
verses.tr:
bhāv basya bhagavān sukh nidhān karunā bhavan
taji mamatā mad mān bhajia sadā sītā ravan

trans: interminable as a myriad deaths; as irrepressible as a myriad fires, our very God.
The Lord is as unfathomable asa myriad Hells; as in

flexible as a myraid Yamas;as immeasurably holy as a myriad places of pilgrimage whose name obliterates any —__—_—_—_—_—_————___—_: rKr———— accumulation of sin. Raghu-bir is as immoveable as a myriad Himalayas; as profound as a myriad seas; as liberal in the fulfilment of every desire as a myriad cows of plenty, and is our very God. As illimitable in eloqaence asa myriad Seradds; as skilful in creation us a myriad Brahmans; as potent to save as a myriad Vishnu; as potent to destroy asa myriad Sivas; us abounding in wealth as 4 myriad Kuvers; as fertile in phenomena as a myriad Maya; a supporter of the world like a myriad Sesh-ndgs; the illimitable, incomparable Lord, the sovereign of the universe.

Incomparable indeed; for, as the Vedas declare, Hama alone is Rama's peer, none else can compare with him If one should compare the sun to a hundred myriads of fires flies, it would be utterly inadequate. In like manner the great sages have exercised their ingenuity in describing
Hari, and the Lord, appreciating their intention, has of his great clemency listened kindly and approved.
Rama is an unfathomable ocean of perfection, who can sound it to bottom? | can only tell you the little I have myself heard from the saints.
Abjure all selfishness, vanity and pride, and ever worship Sita’s spouse, the great God who is moved by sincere devotion, the all-blessed, the all-mercifal.”’

sections.label: Doha 93
sections.name: ताहि प्रसंसि बिबिध बिधि सीस नाइ कर जोरि

verses.sa:
सुनि भुसुंडि के बचन सुहाए ।
हरषित खगपति पंख फुलाए ॥
verses.tr:
suni bhusuṃḍi ke bacan suhāe
haraṣit khagapati paṃkh phulāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नयन नीर मन अति हरषाना ।
श्रीरघुपति प्रताप उर आना ॥
verses.tr:
nayan nīr man ati haraṣānā
śrīraghupati pratāp ur ānā

verses.sa:
पाछिल मोह समुझि पछिताना ।
ब्रह्म अनादि मनुज करि माना ॥
verses.tr:
pāchil moh samujhi pachitānā
brahm anādi manuj kari mānā

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि काग चरन सिरु नावा ।
जानि राम सम प्रेम बढ़ावा ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni kāg caran siru nāvā
jāni rām sam prem bar̤hāvā

verses.sa:
गुर बिनु भव निधि तरइ न कोई ।
जौं बिरंचि संकर सम होई ॥
verses.tr:
gur binu bhav nidhi tarai na koī
jauṃ biraṃci saṃkar sam hoī

verses.sa:
संसय सर्प ग्रसेउ मोहि ताता ।
दुखद लहरि कुतर्क बहु ब्राता ॥
verses.tr:
saṃsaya sarp graseu mohi tātā
dukhad lahari kutark bahu brātā

verses.sa:
तव सरूप गारुड़ि रघुनायक ।
मोहि जिआयउ जन सुखदायक ॥
verses.tr:
tav sarūp gārur̤i raghunāyak
mohi jiāyau jan sukhadāyak

verses.sa:
तव प्रसाद मम मोह नसाना ।
राम रहस्य अनूपम जाना ॥
verses.tr:
tav prasād mam moh nasānā
rām rahasya anūpam jānā

verses.sa:
ताहि प्रसंसि बिबिध बिधि सीस नाइ कर जोरि ।
बचन बिनीत सप्रेम मृदु बोलेउ गरुड़ बहोरि ॥
verses.tr:
tāhi prasaṃsi bibidh bidhi sīs nāi kar jori
bacan binīt saprem mṛdu boleu garur̤ bahori
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
प्रभु अपने अबिबेक ते बूझउँ स्वामी तोहि ।
कृपासिंधु सादर कहहु जानि दास निज मोहि ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu apane abibek te būjhaum̐ svāmī tohi
kṛpāsiṃdhu sādar kahahu jāni dās nij mohi

trans: On hearing Bhusundi’s delectable discourse, the king of the birds rejoiced and preened his wings. His eyes streamed and his soul was overcome with delight as he meditated on the might of the divine Rama. He was ashamed to think of his former delusion, when he had taken the everlasting and Supreme Spirit for a mere man. Again and again he bowed his head at the crow’s feet, whom in the greatness of his affection he regarded as a second Rama. “Without a spiritual guide none can traverse the ocean of existence, though he be the equal of Brahma or Siva. Doubt like a serpent had crushed me in the painful coils of wordy scepticism; but Rama appeared in your form as an antidote and restored me to life, beneficent as he is to all his votaries. By your favour I have overcome my delusion and have learnt the incomparable mystery of Rama.;

After eulogizing him in every possible way and bowing the head before him with clasped hands, Garur proceeded in these humble, affectionate and winning terms: “In my ignorance, O my lord and master, I would ask you # question. In your infinite compassion be pleased to instruct me, regarding me as your own peculiar servant.-

sections.label: Doha 94
sections.name: तुम्हहि न ब्यापत काल अति कराल कारन कवन

verses.sa:
तुम्ह सर्बग्य तन्य तम पारा ।
सुमति सुसील सरल आचारा ॥
verses.tr:
tumh sarbagya tanya tam pārā
sumati susīl saral ācārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ग्यान बिरति बिग्यान निवासा ।
रघुनायक के तुम्ह प्रिय दासा ॥
verses.tr:
gyān birati bigyān nivāsā
raghunāyak ke tumh priya dāsā

verses.sa:
कारन कवन देह यह पाई ।
तात सकल मोहि कहहु बुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
kāran kavan deh yah pāī
tāt sakal mohi kahahu bujhāī

verses.sa:
राम चरित सर सुंदर स्वामी ।
पायहु कहाँ कहहु नभगामी ॥
verses.tr:
rām carit sar suṃdar svāmī
pāyahu kahām̐ kahahu nabhagāmī

verses.sa:
नाथ सुना मैं अस सिव पाहीं ।
महा प्रलयहुँ नास तव नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nāth sunā maiṃ as siv pāhīṃ
mahā pralayahum̐ nās tav nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मुधा बचन नहिं ईस्वर कहई ।
सोउ मोरें मन संसय अहई ॥
verses.tr:
mudhā bacan nahiṃ īsvar kahaī
sou moreṃ man saṃsaya ahaī

verses.sa:
अग जग जीव नाग नर देवा ।
नाथ सकल जगु काल कलेवा ॥
verses.tr:
ag jag jīv nāg nar devā
nāth sakal jagu kāl kalevā

verses.sa:
अंड कटाह अमित लय कारी ।
कालु सदा दुरतिक्रम भारी ॥
verses.tr:
aṃḍ kaṭāh amit laya kārī
kālu sadā duratikram bhārī

verses.sa:
तुम्हहि न ब्यापत काल अति कराल कारन कवन ।
मोहि सो कहहु कृपाल ग्यान प्रभाव कि जोग बल ॥
verses.tr:
tumhahi na byāpat kāl ati karāl kāran kavan
mohi so kahahu kṛpāl gyān prabhāv ki jog bal
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
प्रभु तव आश्रम आएँ मोर मोह भ्रम भाग ।
कारन कवन सो नाथ सब कहहु सहित अनुराग ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu tav āśram āem̐ mor moh bhram bhāg
kāran kavan so nāth sab kahahu sahit anurāg

trans: You are all-wise; a perfect philosopher; intelligent, amiable and upright in your dealings: a store-house of knowledge, sobriety and spiritual intuition; and one of Rama's favourite servants: what, then, is the reason, -Sire, for your having received suchu form? Explain this to me in full. ‘Tell me also, venerable bird, where you learnt this excellent history of Rama’s deeds. Further, my. lord, I have heard from Siva that you do not perish at the time of the destruction of all things. The god never utters an idle word, and therefore my mind isin doubt. For the whole universe, my lord, with all creatures moving and motionless, serpents, men and gods, is but «a mouthful for Death. Death has swallowed up worlds without end and is ever irresistible and strony.
What is the reason that so terrible » monster as Death has no effect upon you? be pleased to inform me whether it be the power of your intellect or the virtue of your mystical devotion. <2
Father, my lord, be so kind as to explain to me how it was that my delusion vanished directly I approached your hermitage.”.

sections.label: Doha 95
sections.name: पन्नगारि असि नीति श्रुति संमत सज्जन कहहिं

verses.sa:
गरुड़ गिरा सुनि हरषेउ कागा ।
बोलेउ उमा परम अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
garur̤ girā suni haraṣeu kāgā
boleu umā param anurāgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
धन्य धन्य तव मति उरगारी ।
प्रस्न तुम्हारि मोहि अति प्यारी ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya dhanya tav mati uragārī
prasn tumhāri mohi ati pyārī

verses.sa:
सुनि तव प्रस्न सप्रेम सुहाई ।
बहुत जनम कै सुधि मोहि आई ॥
verses.tr:
suni tav prasn saprem suhāī
bahut janam kai sudhi mohi āī

verses.sa:
सब निज कथा कहउँ मैं गाई ।
तात सुनहु सादर मन लाई ॥
verses.tr:
sab nij kathā kahaum̐ maiṃ gāī
tāt sunahu sādar man lāī

verses.sa:
जप तप मख सम दम ब्रत दाना ।
बिरति बिबेक जोग बिग्याना ॥
verses.tr:
jap tap makh sam dam brat dānā
birati bibek jog bigyānā

verses.sa:
सब कर फल रघुपति पद प्रेमा ।
तेहि बिनु कोउ न पावइ छेमा ॥
verses.tr:
sab kar phal raghupati pad premā
tehi binu kou na pāvai chemā

verses.sa:
एहि तन राम भगति मैं पाई ।
ताते मोहि ममता अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
ehi tan rām bhagati maiṃ pāī
tāte mohi mamatā adhikāī

verses.sa:
जेहि तें कछु निज स्वारथ होई ।
तेहि पर ममता कर सब कोई ॥
verses.tr:
jehi teṃ kachu nij svārath hoī
tehi par mamatā kar sab koī

verses.sa:
पन्नगारि असि नीति श्रुति संमत सज्जन कहहिं ।
अति नीचहु सन प्रीति करिअ जानि निज परम हित ॥
verses.tr:
pannagāri asi nīti śruti saṃmat sajjan kahahiṃ
ati nīcahu san prīti karia jāni nij param hit
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
पाट कीट तें होइ तेहि तें पाटंबर रुचिर ।
कृमि पालइ सबु कोइ परम अपावन प्रान सम ॥
verses.tr:
pāṭ kīṭ teṃ hoi tehi teṃ pāṭaṃbar rucir
kṛmi pālai sabu koi param apāvan prān sam

trans: When he heard Garur’s question the crow was pleased and answered him, UmA, with the greatest possible kindness:

“A blessing on your wit. Garur; your questions are most agreeable to me. As I listen to your affectionate and becoming enquiries, the recollection of many previous births comes back to me. I will tell you the whole of my history; listen, Sire, with full and reverent attention. Prayer, penance, sacrifice, sobriety of mind, self-control, acts of devotion, charity, chastity, knowledge, mystical meditation and spiritual’ wisdom, all have their fruit in the love for Rama’s feet, without which none can attain to happiness. Ut was in this body that I learnt devotion to Rama, and therefore Ihave a special liking for it. Every one likes that by means of which he has gained his object. |

_ O.Garur, this isa maxim approved by the Vedas and declared by the pious that love should be shown to the meanest creature, if you know it to be your friend. Silk is the product of a» worm, but from it is made beautiful apparel; therefore, vile as the worm is, every one tends it with the most sedulous care.

sections.label: Doha 96
sections.name: प्रथम जन्म के चरित अब कहउँ सुनहु बिहगेस

verses.sa:
स्वारथ साँच जीव कहुँ एहा ।
मन क्रम बचन राम पद नेहा ॥
verses.tr:
svārath sām̐c jīv kahum̐ ehā
man kram bacan rām pad nehā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोइ पावन सोइ सुभग सरीरा ।
जो तनु पाइ भजिअ रघुबीरा ॥
verses.tr:
soi pāvan soi subhag sarīrā
jo tanu pāi bhajia raghubīrā

verses.sa:
राम बिमुख लहि बिधि सम देही ।
कबि कोबिद न प्रसंसहिं तेही ॥
verses.tr:
rām bimukh lahi bidhi sam dehī
kabi kobid na prasaṃsahiṃ tehī

verses.sa:
राम भगति एहिं तन उर जामी ।
ताते मोहि परम प्रिय स्वामी ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagati ehiṃ tan ur jāmī
tāte mohi param priya svāmī

verses.sa:
तजउँ न तन निज इच्छा मरना ।
तन बिनु बेद भजन नहिं बरना ॥
verses.tr:
tajaum̐ na tan nij icchā maranā
tan binu bed bhajan nahiṃ baranā

verses.sa:
प्रथम मोहँ मोहि बहुत बिगोवा ।
राम बिमुख सुख कबहुँ न सोवा ॥
verses.tr:
pratham moham̐ mohi bahut bigovā
rām bimukh sukh kabahum̐ na sovā

verses.sa:
नाना जनम कर्म पुनि नाना ।
किए जोग जप तप मख दाना ॥
verses.tr:
nānā janam karm puni nānā
kie jog jap tap makh dānā

verses.sa:
कवन जोनि जनमेउँ जहँ नाहीं ।
मैं खगेस भ्रमि भ्रमि जग माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kavan joni janameum̐ jaham̐ nāhīṃ
maiṃ khages bhrami bhrami jag māhīṃ

verses.sa:
देखेउँ करि सब करम गोसाई ।
सुखी न भयउँ अबहिं की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
dekheum̐ kari sab karam gosāī
sukhī na bhayaum̐ abahiṃ kī nāī

verses.sa:
सुधि मोहि नाथ जन्म बहु केरी ।
सिव प्रसाद मति मोहँ न घेरी ॥
verses.tr:
sudhi mohi nāth janm bahu kerī
siv prasād mati moham̐ na gherī

verses.sa:
प्रथम जन्म के चरित अब कहउँ सुनहु बिहगेस ।
सुनि प्रभु पद रति उपजइ जातें मिटहिं कलेस ॥
verses.tr:
pratham janm ke carit ab kahaum̐ sunahu bihages
suni prabhu pad rati upajai jāteṃ miṭahiṃ kales
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: पूरुब कल्प एक प्रभु जुग कलिजुग मल मूल ॥
verses.tr: pūrub kalp ek prabhu jug kalijug mal mūl

verses.sa: नर अरु नारि अधर्म रत सकल निगम प्रतिकूल ॥
verses.tr: nar aru nāri adharm rat sakal nigam pratikūl

trans: _ The highest object of every living creature is the love of Rama. The holiest and comeliest of bodies is the one in which he has been worshipped. An enemy of Rama’s, though in bodily appearance he rival Brahma, will never be extolled by any intelligent poet. It was in my present bodily form that my devotion to Rama first took root, and on that account, Sire, I have a great affection for it. Though I can die when a like, 1 donot give up my body, for without a body, as the Vedas declare, { could not pray. At first delusion led me greatly astray; having Rama against me, I was never happy even in my sleep. In different births I practised different courses of action, essaying mystical contemplation, prayer, fasting, sacrifice and almsgiving. Is there any womb in which I have not at some time taken birth, during my peregrinations of the universe? In all. my experience, Sire, | was never so happy as Iam at present; and yet, my lord, [ recollect many previous existences, in which, by the blessing of Siva, no delusion oppressed my understanding. - i Veen
«ie ees eh ale Dohe 93. ay

': Hearken, king of the birds; I will now tell you the story of a former birth. To hear it will increase your devotion to the Lord, which is the remedy for every ill.’ In a former Kalpa, my lord, there was an iron age of the utmost impurity; man and woman were devoted to impiety and all rebelled against the Veda.

sections.label: Doha 97
sections.name: कलिमल ग्रसे धर्म सब लुप्त भए सदग्रंथ

verses.sa:
तेहि कलिजुग कोसलपुर जाई ।
जन्मत भयउँ सूद्र तनु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
tehi kalijug kosalapur jāī
janmat bhayaum̐ sūdr tanu pāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सिव सेवक मन क्रम अरु बानी ।
आन देव निंदक अभिमानी ॥
verses.tr:
siv sevak man kram aru bānī
ān dev niṃdak abhimānī

verses.sa:
धन मद मत्त परम बाचाला ।
उग्रबुद्धि उर दंभ बिसाला ॥
verses.tr:
dhan mad matt param bācālā
ugrabuddhi ur daṃbh bisālā

verses.sa:
जदपि रहेउँ रघुपति रजधानी ।
तदपि न कछु महिमा तब जानी ॥
verses.tr:
jadapi raheum̐ raghupati rajadhānī
tadapi na kachu mahimā tab jānī

verses.sa:
अब जाना मैं अवध प्रभावा ।
निगमागम पुरान अस गावा ॥
verses.tr:
ab jānā maiṃ avadh prabhāvā
nigamāgam purān as gāvā

verses.sa:
कवनेहुँ जन्म अवध बस जोई ।
राम परायन सो परि होई ॥
verses.tr:
kavanehum̐ janm avadh bas joī
rām parāyan so pari hoī

verses.sa:
अवध प्रभाव जान तब प्रानी ।
जब उर बसहिं रामु धनुपानी ॥
verses.tr:
avadh prabhāv jān tab prānī
jab ur basahiṃ rāmu dhanupānī

verses.sa:
सो कलिकाल कठिन उरगारी ।
पाप परायन सब नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
so kalikāl kaṭhin uragārī
pāp parāyan sab nar nārī

verses.sa:
कलिमल ग्रसे धर्म सब लुप्त भए सदग्रंथ ।
दंभिन्ह निज मति कल्पि करि प्रगट किए बहु पंथ ॥
verses.tr:
kalimal grase dharm sab lupt bhae sadagraṃth
daṃbhinh nij mati kalpi kari pragaṭ kie bahu paṃth
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
भए लोग सब मोहबस लोभ ग्रसे सुभ कर्म ।
सुनु हरिजान ग्यान निधि कहउँ कछुक कलिधर्म ॥
verses.tr:
bhae log sab mohabas lobh grase subh karm
sunu harijān gyān nidhi kahaum̐ kachuk kalidharm

trans: In that iron age I went to the city of Kosala and was there born as a man of the servile class, a devoted worshipper of Siva, but a scornful reviler of all the other gods, intoxicated with the pride of wealth, outrageously boastful, savage of purpose and with « heartfal of arrogance. Although I lived in Rama's capital, I had at the time no knowledge of his greatness. Now I understand the virtue of Avadh, as it has been sung by the Vedas, Purdns and all the Scriptures, that every one who in any birth has lived at Avadh will eventually become a disciple of Rama’s. A man then knows the virtue of Avadh, when Rama with bow in hand takes up his abode in his heart. It was artage, Garur, of terrible wickedness; every man and woman was bent on crime.

The sinfulness of the age had stitled religion; the sacred books were all neglected and false teachers had published endless heresies, which they had invented out of their own imagination. The people were all over-mastered by delusion and greed had stifled all acts of piety. Hearken, most wise Garur, while I describe some of the religious practices of those evil times.

sections.label: Doha 98
sections.name: असुभ बेष भूषन धरें भच्छाभच्छ जे खाहिं

verses.sa:
बरन धर्म नहिं आश्रम चारी ।
श्रुति बिरोध रत सब नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
baran dharm nahiṃ āśram cārī
śruti birodh rat sab nar nārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
द्विज श्रुति बेचक भूप प्रजासन ।
कोउ नहिं मान निगम अनुसासन ॥
verses.tr:
dvij śruti becak bhūp prajāsan
kou nahiṃ mān nigam anusāsan

verses.sa:
मारग सोइ जा कहुँ जोइ भावा ।
पंडित सोइ जो गाल बजावा ॥
verses.tr:
mārag soi jā kahum̐ joi bhāvā
paṃḍit soi jo gāl bajāvā

verses.sa:
मिथ्यारंभ दंभ रत जोई ।
ता कहुँ संत कहइ सब कोई ॥
verses.tr:
mithyāraṃbh daṃbh rat joī
tā kahum̐ saṃt kahai sab koī

verses.sa:
सोइ सयान जो परधन हारी ।
जो कर दंभ सो बड़ आचारी ॥
verses.tr:
soi sayān jo paradhan hārī
jo kar daṃbh so bar̤ ācārī

verses.sa:
जौ कह झूँठ मसखरी जाना ।
कलिजुग सोइ गुनवंत बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
jau kah jhūm̐ṭh masakharī jānā
kalijug soi gunavaṃt bakhānā

verses.sa:
निराचार जो श्रुति पथ त्यागी ।
कलिजुग सोइ ग्यानी सो बिरागी ॥
verses.tr:
nirācār jo śruti path tyāgī
kalijug soi gyānī so birāgī

verses.sa:
जाकें नख अरु जटा बिसाला ।
सोइ तापस प्रसिद्ध कलिकाला ॥
verses.tr:
jākeṃ nakh aru jaṭā bisālā
soi tāpas prasiddh kalikālā

verses.sa:
असुभ बेष भूषन धरें भच्छाभच्छ जे खाहिं ।
तेइ जोगी तेइ सिद्ध नर पूज्य ते कलिजुग माहिं ॥
verses.tr:
asubh beṣ bhūṣan dhareṃ bhacchābhacch je khāhiṃ
tei jogī tei siddh nar pūjya te kalijug māhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
जे अपकारी चार तिन्ह कर गौरव मान्य तेइ ।
मन क्रम बचन लबार तेइ बकता कलिकाल महुँ ॥
verses.tr:
je apakārī cār tinh kar gaurav mānya tei
man kram bacan labār tei bakatā kalikāl mahum̐

trans: No regard was paid to caste or the four stages of life; every one was bent upon attucking the Scriptures. Brahmans sold the Veda; kings devoured their subjects; no one regarded the injunctions of revelation. The right road was any that most took the fancy; the greatest Pandit was the one who talked the loudest, Any who indulged in false pretences and hypocrisy was universally styled assaint. A wise man was he who plundered his neighbour; every boaster was thought a fine fellow, every liar a wit and was spoken of as a man of parts in those evil days. A reprobate
another begins ty run its courae, and so on te all eternity.
who denied the doctrines of revelation was an enlightened philosopher; and any one with unkempt hair and nails was celebrated in that debased age as a model of mortification.
To assume the loathsome rags and properties of a mendicant and feed indiscriminately on any kind of food was to be an ascetic, a saint, an object of veneration in that age of iniquity.

sections.label: Doha 99
sections.name: ब्रह्म ग्यान बिनु नारि नर कहहिं न दूसरि बात

verses.sa:
नारि बिबस नर सकल गोसाई ।
नाचहिं नट मर्कट की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
nāri bibas nar sakal gosāī
nācahiṃ naṭ markaṭ kī nāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सूद्र द्विजन्ह उपदेसहिं ग्याना ।
मेलि जनेऊ लेहिं कुदाना ॥
verses.tr:
sūdr dvijanh upadesahiṃ gyānā
meli janeū lehiṃ kudānā

verses.sa:
सब नर काम लोभ रत क्रोधी ।
देव बिप्र श्रुति संत बिरोधी ॥
verses.tr:
sab nar kām lobh rat krodhī
dev bipr śruti saṃt birodhī

verses.sa:
गुन मंदिर सुंदर पति त्यागी ।
भजहिं नारि पर पुरुष अभागी ॥
verses.tr:
gun maṃdir suṃdar pati tyāgī
bhajahiṃ nāri par puruṣ abhāgī

verses.sa:
सौभागिनीं बिभूषन हीना ।
बिधवन्ह के सिंगार नबीना ॥
verses.tr:
saubhāginīṃ bibhūṣan hīnā
bidhavanh ke siṃgār nabīnā

verses.sa:
गुर सिष बधिर अंध का लेखा ।
एक न सुनइ एक नहिं देखा ॥
verses.tr:
gur siṣ badhir aṃdh kā lekhā
ek na sunai ek nahiṃ dekhā

verses.sa:
हरइ सिष्य धन सोक न हरई ।
सो गुर घोर नरक महुँ परई ॥
verses.tr:
harai siṣya dhan sok na haraī
so gur ghor narak mahum̐ paraī

verses.sa:
मातु पिता बालकन्हि बोलाबहिं ।
उदर भरै सोइ धर्म सिखावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
mātu pitā bālakanhi bolābahiṃ
udar bharai soi dharm sikhāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म ग्यान बिनु नारि नर कहहिं न दूसरि बात ।
कौड़ी लागि लोभ बस करहिं बिप्र गुर घात ॥
verses.tr:
brahm gyān binu nāri nar kahahiṃ na dūsari bāt
kaur̤ī lāgi lobh bas karahiṃ bipr gur ghāt
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
बादहिं सूद्र द्विजन्ह सन हम तुम्ह ते कछु घाटि ।
जानइ ब्रह्म सो बिप्रबर आँखि देखावहिं डाटि ॥
verses.tr:
bādahiṃ sūdr dvijanh san ham tumh te kachu ghāṭi
jānai brahm so biprabar ām̐khi dekhāvahiṃ ḍāṭi

trans: All kinds of evil-doers were held in honour and respect, and the idlest babblers were accepted as preachers in those miserable days.

The man was everywhere subject to the woman and played the buffoon like a dancing monkey. Stidras instructed the twice-born in theology and assuming the Brehmanical cord took their infamous gains. Every one was addicted to sensuality, avarice and violence, and flouted the gods, the Brahmans, the Scriptures and the saints. Wives deserted their husbands, however handsome and accomplished, and adored instead any wretched stranger. Married women appeared without any ornaments, widows were bedecked with jewels. Teachers and pupils were of no more account than the deaf and blind; the one would not listen, the other had never read. A teacher who takes his pupil’s money but does not rid him of his doubts falls into an awful abyss of hell. Father and mother call up their children and teach them the duty of filling their belly.

People who are devoid of spiritual knowledge never say anything but this. In their greed they would kill a Brahman or their own guru to gain a cowrie. Stidras dispute with the twice-born, “Are you any better than we are any one who understands theology is as good as the best of Brahmans:” thus they insolently scoff.

sections.label: Doha 100
sections.name: भए बरन संकर कलि भिन्नसेतु सब लोग

verses.sa:
पर त्रिय लंपट कपट सयाने ।
मोह द्रोह ममता लपटाने ॥
verses.tr:
par triya laṃpaṭ kapaṭ sayāne
moh droh mamatā lapaṭāne
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेइ अभेदबादी ग्यानी नर ।
देखा में चरित्र कलिजुग कर ॥
verses.tr:
tei abhedabādī gyānī nar
dekhā meṃ caritr kalijug kar

verses.sa:
आपु गए अरु तिन्हहू घालहिं ।
जे कहुँ सत मारग प्रतिपालहिं ॥
verses.tr:
āpu gae aru tinhahū ghālahiṃ
je kahum̐ sat mārag pratipālahiṃ

verses.sa:
कल्प कल्प भरि एक एक नरका ।
परहिं जे दूषहिं श्रुति करि तरका ॥
verses.tr:
kalp kalp bhari ek ek narakā
parahiṃ je dūṣahiṃ śruti kari tarakā

verses.sa:
जे बरनाधम तेलि कुम्हारा ।
स्वपच किरात कोल कलवारा ॥
verses.tr:
je baranādham teli kumhārā
svapac kirāt kol kalavārā

verses.sa:
नारि मुई गृह संपति नासी ।
मूड़ मुड़ाइ होहिं सन्यासी ॥
verses.tr:
nāri muī gṛh saṃpati nāsī
mūr̤ mur̤āi hohiṃ sanyāsī

verses.sa:
ते बिप्रन्ह सन आपु पुजावहिं ।
उभय लोक निज हाथ नसावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
te bipranh san āpu pujāvahiṃ
ubhaya lok nij hāth nasāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
बिप्र निरच्छर लोलुप कामी ।
निराचार सठ बृषली स्वामी ॥
verses.tr:
bipr niracchar lolup kāmī
nirācār saṭh bṛṣalī svāmī

verses.sa:
सूद्र करहिं जप तप ब्रत नाना ।
बैठि बरासन कहहिं पुराना ॥
verses.tr:
sūdr karahiṃ jap tap brat nānā
baiṭhi barāsan kahahiṃ purānā

verses.sa:
सब नर कल्पित करहिं अचारा ।
जाइ न बरनि अनीति अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
sab nar kalpit karahiṃ acārā
jāi na barani anīti apārā

verses.sa:
भए बरन संकर कलि भिन्नसेतु सब लोग ।
करहिं पाप पावहिं दुख भय रुज सोक बियोग ॥
verses.tr:
bhae baran saṃkar kali bhinnasetu sab log
karahiṃ pāp pāvahiṃ dukh bhaya ruj sok biyog
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
श्रुति संमत हरि भक्ति पथ संजुत बिरति बिबेक ।
तेहि न चलहिं नर मोह बस कल्पहिं पंथ अनेक ॥
verses.tr:
śruti saṃmat hari bhakti path saṃjut birati bibek
tehi na calahiṃ nar moh bas kalpahiṃ paṃth anek

trans: Lecherous after their neighbour's wife, clever only in trickery, clasped about with ignorance, violence and selfishness, these are the men who are reckoned as theologians and philosophers. I have seen the practice of the Kali-yuga. Falling themselves and dragging down others who were keeping the path of virtue, they who trouble the world by their glosses on the Scriptures spend a whole Kalpa in each abyss of hell. People of low caste, such as oilmen, potters, dog-feeders, kirats, kols, and distillers of spirituous liquors, who on the death of their wife or loss of their household goods shave their heads and turn religious mendicants, and make Brahmans bow down at their feet; such men ty their deeds ruin themselves both for this world and also for the next. A Brahman is anlettered, greedy and sensual, dissolute, stupid and the husband of an outcast. A Sudra practises prayer, fasting and all the other duties of religion and taking the highest seat ex-pounds the Puranas. Every one practises the duties of some other state of life than his own, and the endless perversions of morality are beyond all description.

In the Iron Age different castes are confounded together and every one isa law to himself. Men practise sin and reap its reward in trouble, terror, sickness, sorrow, and bereavement. Overcome by delusion, they walk not in the path of Hari's service, such as is approved by the Scriptures and conjoined with sobriety and discernment, but invent diverse ways of their own.

sections.label: Doha 101
sections.name: सुनु खगेस कलि कपट हठ दंभ द्वेष पाषंड

verses.sa: बहु दाम सँवारहिं धाम जती। बिषया हरि लीन्हि न रहि बिरती ॥
verses.tr: bahu dām sam̐vārahiṃ dhām jatī biṣayā hari līnhi na rahi biratī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: तपसी धनवंत दरिद्र गृही। कलि कौतुक तात न जात कही ॥
verses.tr: tapasī dhanavaṃt daridr gṛhī kali kautuk tāt na jāt kahī

verses.sa: कुलवंति निकारहिं नारि सती। गृह आनिहिं चेरी निबेरि गती ॥
verses.tr: kulavaṃti nikārahiṃ nāri satī gṛh ānihiṃ cerī niberi gatī

verses.sa: सुत मानहिं मातु पिता तब लौं। अबलानन दीख नहीं जब लौं ॥
verses.tr: sut mānahiṃ mātu pitā tab lauṃ abalānan dīkh nahīṃ jab lauṃ

verses.sa: ससुरारि पिआरि लगी जब तें। रिपरूप कुटुंब भए तब तें ॥
verses.tr: sasurāri piāri lagī jab teṃ riparūp kuṭuṃb bhae tab teṃ

verses.sa: नृप पाप परायन धर्म नहीं। करि दंड बिडंब प्रजा नितहीं ॥
verses.tr: nṛp pāp parāyan dharm nahīṃ kari daṃḍ biḍaṃb prajā nitahīṃ

verses.sa: धनवंत कुलीन मलीन अपी। द्विज चिन्ह जनेउ उघार तपी ॥
verses.tr: dhanavaṃt kulīn malīn apī dvij cinh janeu ughār tapī

verses.sa: नहिं मान पुरान न बेदहि जो। हरि सेवक संत सही कलि सो ॥
verses.tr: nahiṃ mān purān na bedahi jo hari sevak saṃt sahī kali so

verses.sa: कबि बृंद उदार दुनी न सुनी। गुन दूषक ब्रात न कोपि गुनी ॥
verses.tr: kabi bṛṃd udār dunī na sunī gun dūṣak brāt na kopi gunī

verses.sa: कलि बारहिं बार दुकाल परै। बिनु अन्न दुखी सब लोग मरै ॥
verses.tr: kali bārahiṃ bār dukāl parai binu ann dukhī sab log marai

verses.sa:
सुनु खगेस कलि कपट हठ दंभ द्वेष पाषंड ।
मान मोह मारादि मद ब्यापि रहे ब्रह्मंड ॥
verses.tr:
sunu khages kali kapaṭ haṭh daṃbh dveṣ pāṣaṃḍ
mān moh mārādi mad byāpi rahe brahmaṃḍ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
तामस धर्म करहिं नर जप तप ब्रत मख दान ।
देव न बरषहिं धरनीं बए न जामहिं धान ॥
verses.tr:
tāmas dharm karahiṃ nar jap tap brat makh dān
dev na baraṣahiṃ dharanīṃ bae na jāmahiṃ dhān

trans: Devotees build themselves costly houses and are carried away by sensuality, forgetful of self-mortification. Ascetics amass wealth, mendicants become hoaseholders; the absurdities of the Iron Age, Sir, are beyond all description. They turn outa well-born and virtuous wife and bring home a servant-girl in violation of family usage. A son obeys his father and mother so long only as he sees not a woman’s face; as soon as he takes a fancy to his wife’s kinsfolk, be looks upon his own family as his enemies. King, devoted to criminal courses and with no regard for religion, oppress their subjects with un-righteous judgments. The meanest churl, if he is rich, is accounted noble; a Brahman is known only by his cord and any naked wretch is an ascetio., |

Any one in the lron-Age who rejects both Vedas and Purdnas is held » worshipper of Hari and a veritable saint The world neither rewards nor even listens to a poet;; guru is universally reviled and there is not a single wise man to be found. In the Iron Age famines are of frequent er and the people perish miserably for want of ood.

Hearken, Garur; in the Iron Age the whole universe is saturated with hypocrisy, violence, pride, enmity, heresy, arrogance, ignorance, sensuality and every other evil passion. Men worship the powers of darkness with prayers, fasting, sacrifice, vows and aims-giving: the gods rain not upon the earth and the rice is sown but does not germinate,

sections.label: Doha 102
sections.name: सुनु ब्यालारि काल कलि मल अवगुन आगार

verses.sa: अबला कच भूषन भूरि छुधा। धनहीन दुखी ममता बहुधा ॥
verses.tr: abalā kac bhūṣan bhūri chudhā dhanahīn dukhī mamatā bahudhā
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: सुख चाहहिं मूढ़ न धर्म रता। मति थोरि कठोरि न कोमलता ॥
verses.tr: sukh cāhahiṃ mūr̤h na dharm ratā mati thori kaṭhori na komalatā

verses.sa: नर पीड़ित रोग न भोग कहीं। अभिमान बिरोध अकारनहीं ॥
verses.tr: nar pīr̤it rog na bhog kahīṃ abhimān birodh akāranahīṃ

verses.sa: लघु जीवन संबतु पंच दसा। कलपांत न नास गुमानु असा ॥
verses.tr: laghu jīvan saṃbatu paṃc dasā kalapāṃt na nās gumānu asā

verses.sa:
कलिकाल बिहाल किए मनुजा। नहिं मानत क्वौ अनुजा तनुजा ।
नहिं तोष बिचार न सीतलता। सब जाति कुजाति भए मगता ॥
verses.tr:
kalikāl bihāl kie manujā nahiṃ mānat kvau anujā tanujā
nahiṃ toṣ bicār na sītalatā sab jāti kujāti bhae magatā

verses.sa: इरिषा परुषाच्छर लोलुपता। भरि पूरि रही समता बिगता ॥
verses.tr: iriṣā paruṣācchar lolupatā bhari pūri rahī samatā bigatā

verses.sa: सब लोग बियोग बिसोक हुए। बरनाश्रम धर्म अचार गए ॥
verses.tr: sab log biyog bisok hue baranāśram dharm acār gae

verses.sa: दम दान दया नहिं जानपनी। जड़ता परबंचनताति घनी ॥
verses.tr: dam dān dayā nahiṃ jānapanī jar̤atā parabaṃcanatāti ghanī

verses.sa: तनु पोषक नारि नरा सगरे। परनिंदक जे जग मो बगरे ॥
verses.tr: tanu poṣak nāri narā sagare paraniṃdak je jag mo bagare

verses.sa:
सुनु ब्यालारि काल कलि मल अवगुन आगार ।
गुनउँ बहुत कलिजुग कर बिनु प्रयास निस्तार ॥
verses.tr:
sunu byālāri kāl kali mal avagun āgār
gunaum̐ bahut kalijug kar binu prayās nistār
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
कृतजुग त्रेता द्वापर पूजा मख अरु जोग ।
जो गति होइ सो कलि हरि नाम ते पावहिं लोग ॥
verses.tr:
kṛtajug tretā dvāpar pūjā makh aru jog
jo gati hoi so kali hari nām te pāvahiṃ log

trans: A woman’s only ornament is her hair and she is sorely a-hungered; the poor are in distress, but are intensely selfish. Fools desire happiness, but have no regard for religion; their narrow mind is hardened and knows no compassion. Men burdened with disease find no rest anywhere, but only self-conceit and causeless wrangling. Life is short; man’s age is only fifteen years, yet in their pride they reckon on outliving creation. The Iron Age has no unsettled mankind, that no one shows any obedience, neither younger sister nor daughter. There is no contentment, nor consideration, nor repose; every caste is degraded to the condition of an importunate beggar; the world is full of envy, censoriousness and greed; placidity of temper is obsolete. Every one is smarting with sorrow and bereavement; all thought of the duties connected with caste and stage of life is abandoned. Men are so niggardly that they ignore all self-denial, charity and kind-heartedness; torpor and dishonesty are multiplied exceedingly. Men and women alike all pamper their body and slanderers are sown broadcast.

Hearken, Garur; the Iron Age is a mine of impurity and iniquity; but it has one enormous advantage, escape From it is easy. In the Ages of Gold, Silver, and Brass solemn worship, sacrifice and mystical meditation were the appointed means; in the Iron Age those who attain salvation do so only by Hari’s name.

sections.label: Doha 103
sections.name: कलिजुग सम जुग आन नहिं जौं नर कर बिस्वास

verses.sa:
कृतजुग सब जोगी बिग्यानी ।
करि हरि ध्यान तरहिं भव प्रानी ॥
verses.tr:
kṛtajug sab jogī bigyānī
kari hari dhyān tarahiṃ bhav prānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
त्रेताँ बिबिध जग्य नर करहीं ।
प्रभुहि समर्पि कर्म भव तरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tretām̐ bibidh jagya nar karahīṃ
prabhuhi samarpi karm bhav tarahīṃ

verses.sa:
द्वापर करि रघुपति पद पूजा ।
नर भव तरहिं उपाय न दूजा ॥
verses.tr:
dvāpar kari raghupati pad pūjā
nar bhav tarahiṃ upāya na dūjā

verses.sa:
कलिजुग केवल हरि गुन गाहा ।
गावत नर पावहिं भव थाहा ॥
verses.tr:
kalijug keval hari gun gāhā
gāvat nar pāvahiṃ bhav thāhā

verses.sa:
कलिजुग जोग न जग्य न ग्याना ।
एक अधार राम गुन गाना ॥
verses.tr:
kalijug jog na jagya na gyānā
ek adhār rām gun gānā

verses.sa:
सब भरोस तजि जो भज रामहि ।
प्रेम समेत गाव गुन ग्रामहि ॥
verses.tr:
sab bharos taji jo bhaj rāmahi
prem samet gāv gun grāmahi

verses.sa:
सोइ भव तर कछु संसय नाहीं ।
नाम प्रताप प्रगट कलि माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
soi bhav tar kachu saṃsaya nāhīṃ
nām pratāp pragaṭ kali māhīṃ

verses.sa:
कलि कर एक पुनीत प्रतापा ।
मानस पुन्य होहिं नहिं पापा ॥
verses.tr:
kali kar ek punīt pratāpā
mānas punya hohiṃ nahiṃ pāpā

verses.sa:
कलिजुग सम जुग आन नहिं जौं नर कर बिस्वास ।
गाइ राम गुन गन बिमलँ भव तर बिनहिं प्रयास ॥
verses.tr:
kalijug sam jug ān nahiṃ jauṃ nar kar bisvās
gāi rām gun gan bimalam̐ bhav tar binahiṃ prayās
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
प्रगट चारि पद धर्म के कलिल महुँ एक प्रधान ।
जेन केन बिधि दीन्हें दान करइ कल्यान ॥
verses.tr:
pragaṭ cāri pad dharm ke kalil mahum̐ ek pradhān
jen ken bidhi dīnheṃ dān karai kalyān

trans: In the Golden Age every one was spiritual and wise and crossed the ocean of existence by meditating on Hari.

In the Silver Age men performed many sacrifices and dedi-cating their actions to the Lord so accomplished their course. In the Age of Brass men had no other expedient save the worship of Rama's feet. In the Iron Age men sound the depths of existence simply by chanting Ramus praises. In the Iron Age neither spiritual abstraction, sacrifice, nor knowledge is of any avail; man’s only hope is in hymning Rama. Any one who abjures all reliance in every other and prays devoutly to Rama and sings his praises shall assuredly escape further mundane existence. The power of his name is the special revelation of the Iron Age. It is its one sanctifying influence by which the soul is purified and sin destroyed.

There is no age to compare with the Age of Iron: in it, if a man has only faith and devotes himself to singing Rama's holy praises, he escapes from existence without further trouble. Religion has been revealed with four Feet; in the Iron Age one is of the most importance; to whom-soever God has given, let him practise almsgiving and prosper.

sections.label: Doha 104
sections.name: हरि माया कृत दोष गुन बिनु हरि भजन न जाहिं

verses.sa:
नित जुग धर्म होहिं सब केरे ।
हृदयँ राम माया के प्रेरे ॥
verses.tr:
nit jug dharm hohiṃ sab kere
hṛdayam̐ rām māyā ke prere
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुद्ध सत्व समता बिग्याना ।
कृत प्रभाव प्रसन्न मन जाना ॥
verses.tr:
suddh satv samatā bigyānā
kṛt prabhāv prasann man jānā

verses.sa:
सत्व बहुत रज कछु रति कर्मा ।
सब बिधि सुख त्रेता कर धर्मा ॥
verses.tr:
satv bahut raj kachu rati karmā
sab bidhi sukh tretā kar dharmā

verses.sa:
बहु रज स्वल्प सत्व कछु तामस ।
द्वापर धर्म हरष भय मानस ॥
verses.tr:
bahu raj svalp satv kachu tāmas
dvāpar dharm haraṣ bhaya mānas

verses.sa:
तामस बहुत रजोगुन थोरा ।
कलि प्रभाव बिरोध चहुँ ओरा ॥
verses.tr:
tāmas bahut rajogun thorā
kali prabhāv birodh cahum̐ orā

verses.sa:
बुध जुग धर्म जानि मन माहीं ।
तजि अधर्म रति धर्म कराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
budh jug dharm jāni man māhīṃ
taji adharm rati dharm karāhīṃ

verses.sa:
काल धर्म नहिं ब्यापहिं ताही ।
रघुपति चरन प्रीति अति जाही ॥
verses.tr:
kāl dharm nahiṃ byāpahiṃ tāhī
raghupati caran prīti ati jāhī

verses.sa:
नट कृत बिकट कपट खगराया ।
नट सेवकहि न ब्यापइ माया ॥
verses.tr:
naṭ kṛt bikaṭ kapaṭ khagarāyā
naṭ sevakahi na byāpai māyā

verses.sa:
हरि माया कृत दोष गुन बिनु हरि भजन न जाहिं ।
भजिअ राम तजि काम सब अस बिचारि मन माहिं ॥
verses.tr:
hari māyā kṛt doṣ gun binu hari bhajan na jāhiṃ
bhajia rām taji kām sab as bicāri man māhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
तेहि कलिकाल बरष बहु बसेउँ अवध बिहगेस ।
परेउ दुकाल बिपति बस तब मैं गयउँ बिदेस ॥
verses.tr:
tehi kalikāl baraṣ bahu baseum̐ avadh bihages
pareu dukāl bipati bas tab maiṃ gayaum̐ bides

trans: Every Age has its special characteristic, infused into the soul by Rama’s delusive power. Purity, truth, equanimity and wisdom, combined with joy of soul, are recognized as the outcome of the Golden Age. A great devotion to trnth—though with some admixture of passion—and general happiness are the note of the Silver Age. Much passion, little truth and some ignorance, with mingled joy and terror of soul, are the note of the Brazen Age. Great ignorance, less passion and universal antagonism are the outcome of the [Iron Age. The wise understand the proper virtue of each age and forswearing iniquity devote themselves to religion. The influence of the Iron Age has no effect on him who cherishes a love for Rama's feet. A juggler, Garur, may practise the most wonderful decep-tions, but they do not impose upon his own servants.

The good and evil, which are the creation of Hari’s de lusive power, can only be dispersed by prayer to Hari know this and worship Hari, forswearing all sensuality In that particular Iron Age I lived, Garur for many year at Avadh, till a famine occurred which compelled me to go to another country. Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 105
sections.name: मैं खल मल संकुल मति नीच जाति बस मोह

verses.sa:
गयउँ उजेनी सुनु उरगारी ।
दीन मलीन दरिद्र दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
gayaum̐ ujenī sunu uragārī
dīn malīn daridr dukhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गएँ काल कछु संपति पाई ।
तहँ पुनि करउँ संभु सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
gaem̐ kāl kachu saṃpati pāī
taham̐ puni karaum̐ saṃbhu sevakāī

verses.sa:
बिप्र एक बैदिक सिव पूजा ।
करइ सदा तेहि काजु न दूजा ॥
verses.tr:
bipr ek baidik siv pūjā
karai sadā tehi kāju na dūjā

verses.sa:
परम साधु परमारथ बिंदक ।
संभु उपासक नहिं हरि निंदक ॥
verses.tr:
param sādhu paramārath biṃdak
saṃbhu upāsak nahiṃ hari niṃdak

verses.sa:
तेहि सेवउँ मैं कपट समेता ।
द्विज दयाल अति नीति निकेता ॥
verses.tr:
tehi sevaum̐ maiṃ kapaṭ sametā
dvij dayāl ati nīti niketā

verses.sa:
बाहिज नम्र देखि मोहि साईं ।
बिप्र पढ़ाव पुत्र की नाईं ॥
verses.tr:
bāhij namr dekhi mohi sāīṃ
bipr par̤hāv putr kī nāīṃ

verses.sa:
संभु मंत्र मोहि द्विजबर दीन्हा ।
सुभ उपदेस बिबिध बिधि कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃbhu maṃtr mohi dvijabar dīnhā
subh upades bibidh bidhi kīnhā

verses.sa:
जपउँ मंत्र सिव मंदिर जाई ।
हृदयँ दंभ अहमिति अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
japaum̐ maṃtr siv maṃdir jāī
hṛdayam̐ daṃbh ahamiti adhikāī

verses.sa:
मैं खल मल संकुल मति नीच जाति बस मोह ।
हरि जन द्विज देखें जरउँ करउँ बिष्नु कर द्रोह ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ khal mal saṃkul mati nīc jāti bas moh
hari jan dvij dekheṃ jaraum̐ karaum̐ biṣnu kar droh
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
गुर नित मोहि प्रबोध दुखित देखि आचरन मम ।
मोहि उपजइ अति क्रोध दंभिहि नीति कि भावई ॥
verses.tr:
gur nit mohi prabodh dukhit dekhi ācaran mam
mohi upajai ati krodh daṃbhihi nīti ki bhāvaī

trans: I went to Ujain—mark me, Garur—a miserable outcast, poor and wretched. After some time I acquired wealth and as before practised devotion to Sambhu. ‘There was there a Vedic Brahman, who constantly worshipped Siva and had no other occupation; a very saintly man learned in divine truth, who served Sambhu, but at the same time showed no disrespect to Hari I hypocritically attended upon this benignant philosopher, and he, Sir, seeing me outwardly so submissive, instructed me as his own son, teaching me the Siva incantations and giving me every kind of good advice. I went to a temple of Siva and repeated the spells with a heart full of pride and selfconceit.;
Wretch that I was, with a soul full of impurity,!lowborn and enthralled by delusion, I flew into a passion if I
saw any BrAhman a worshipper of Hari and I persecuted Vishnu.
My teacher was distressed to see my manner of life and was always admonishing me; but I] became exceedingly angry. Is pride ever pleased by sober counsel?

sections.label: Doha 106
sections.name: एक बार हर मंदिर जपत रहेउँ सिव नाम

verses.sa:
एक बार गुर लीन्ह बोलाई ।
मोहि नीति बहु भाँति सिखाई ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār gur līnh bolāī
mohi nīti bahu bhām̐ti sikhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सिव सेवा कर फल सुत सोई ।
अबिरल भगति राम पद होई ॥
verses.tr:
siv sevā kar phal sut soī
abiral bhagati rām pad hoī

verses.sa:
रामहि भजहिं तात सिव धाता ।
नर पावँर कै केतिक बाता ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi bhajahiṃ tāt siv dhātā
nar pāvam̐r kai ketik bātā

verses.sa:
जासु चरन अज सिव अनुरागी ।
तातु द्रोहँ सुख चहसि अभागी ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu caran aj siv anurāgī
tātu droham̐ sukh cahasi abhāgī

verses.sa:
हर कहुँ हरि सेवक गुर कहेऊ ।
सुनि खगनाथ हृदय मम दहेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
har kahum̐ hari sevak gur kaheū
suni khaganāth hṛdaya mam daheū

verses.sa:
अधम जाति मैं बिद्या पाएँ ।
भयउँ जथा अहि दूध पिआएँ ॥
verses.tr:
adham jāti maiṃ bidyā pāem̐
bhayaum̐ jathā ahi dūdh piāem̐

verses.sa:
मानी कुटिल कुभाग्य कुजाती ।
गुर कर द्रोह करउँ दिनु राती ॥
verses.tr:
mānī kuṭil kubhāgya kujātī
gur kar droh karaum̐ dinu rātī

verses.sa:
अति दयाल गुर स्वल्प न क्रोधा ।
पुनि पुनि मोहि सिखाव सुबोधा ॥
verses.tr:
ati dayāl gur svalp na krodhā
puni puni mohi sikhāv subodhā

verses.sa:
जेहि ते नीच बड़ाई पावा ।
सो प्रथमहिं हति ताहि नसावा ॥
verses.tr:
jehi te nīc bar̤āī pāvā
so prathamahiṃ hati tāhi nasāvā

verses.sa:
धूम अनल संभव सुनु भाई ।
तेहि बुझाव घन पदवी पाई ॥
verses.tr:
dhūm anal saṃbhav sunu bhāī
tehi bujhāv ghan padavī pāī

verses.sa:
रज मग परी निरादर रहई ।
सब कर पद प्रहार नित सहई ॥
verses.tr:
raj mag parī nirādar rahaī
sab kar pad prahār nit sahaī

verses.sa:
मरुत उड़ाव प्रथम तेहि भरई ।
पुनि नृप नयन किरीटन्हि परई ॥
verses.tr:
marut ur̤āv pratham tehi bharaī
puni nṛp nayan kirīṭanhi paraī

verses.sa:
सुनु खगपति अस समुझि प्रसंगा ।
बुध नहिं करहिं अधम कर संगा ॥
verses.tr:
sunu khagapati as samujhi prasaṃgā
budh nahiṃ karahiṃ adham kar saṃgā

verses.sa:
कबि कोबिद गावहिं असि नीती ।
खल सन कलह न भल नहिं प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
kabi kobid gāvahiṃ asi nītī
khal san kalah na bhal nahiṃ prītī

verses.sa:
उदासीन नित रहिअ गोसाईं ।
खल परिहरिअ स्वान की नाईं ॥
verses.tr:
udāsīn nit rahia gosāīṃ
khal pariharia svān kī nāīṃ

verses.sa:
मैं खल हृदयँ कपट कुटिलाई ।
गुर हित कहइ न मोहि सोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ khal hṛdayam̐ kapaṭ kuṭilāī
gur hit kahai na mohi sohāī

verses.sa:
एक बार हर मंदिर जपत रहेउँ सिव नाम ।
गुर आयउ अभिमान तें उठि नहिं कीन्ह प्रनाम ॥
verses.tr:
ek bār har maṃdir japat raheum̐ siv nām
gur āyau abhimān teṃ uṭhi nahiṃ kīnh pranām
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सो दयाल नहिं कहेउ कछु उर न रोष लवलेस ।
अति अघ गुर अपमानता सहि नहिं सके महेस ॥
verses.tr:
so dayāl nahiṃ kaheu kachu ur na roṣ lavales
ati agh gur apamānatā sahi nahiṃ sake mahes

trans: One day the Guru called me and instructed me at length in the principles of morality: “The reward, my son, for serving Siva is a steadfast faith in Rama. Siva and Brahma both worship Rama; why speak then of miserable an? Do you hope to secure happiness, you luckless wight, by persecuting him whose feet even Siva and Brahma adore?” When I heard the Guru speak of Siva asa worshipper of Hari, my heart, Garur, was all on fire. Being such a low-born churl, after receiving education I became like a snake that has been fed on milk. Arrogant, perverse, ill-starred and ill-bred, I worried my Guru day and night. But he was too tender-hearted to be angry and still] continued his wise admonitions. The very person from whom a char obtains promotion is the first for him to destroy. Hearken, friend; smoke is produced by fire, and

yet when promoted to cloudship it puts the fire out.. Dust while it lies on the road is held in contempt and submits to be trodden under foot of every one. If the wind carries it aloft, it first darkens that and then gets into king's eyes or svllies his crown. Hearken, Garur, and thus understand my parable; sensible people have no dealings with the mean. The wisest of the poets have declared this maxim, it is good neither to quarrel with achurl nor to be friends with him; never have anything todo with him at all, Sire; let him alone, like a dog. Churl as 1 was, witha heart full of falsehood and perversity, I paid no heed to the Guru’s friendly admonition.;

One day I was in « temple of Siva saying his rosary when the Gara came in, and in my conceit I did not rise to salute him. He was too gentle to say anything, neither did he feel the slightest atom of resentment, but the grievous sin of slighting a spiritual teacher was more than Siva could tolerate.

sections.label: Doha 107
sections.name: हाहाकार कीन्ह गुर दारुन सुनि सिव साप

verses.sa:
मंदिर माझ भई नभ बानी ।
रे हतभाग्य अग्य अभिमानी ॥
verses.tr:
maṃdir mājh bhaī nabh bānī
re hatabhāgya agya abhimānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जद्यपि तव गुर कें नहिं क्रोधा ।
अति कृपाल चित सम्यक बोधा ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi tav gur keṃ nahiṃ krodhā
ati kṛpāl cit samyak bodhā

verses.sa:
तदपि साप सठ दैहउँ तोही ।
नीति बिरोध सोहाइ न मोही ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi sāp saṭh daihaum̐ tohī
nīti birodh sohāi na mohī

verses.sa:
जौं नहिं दंड करौं खल तोरा ।
भ्रष्ट होइ श्रुतिमारग मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ nahiṃ daṃḍ karauṃ khal torā
bhraṣṭ hoi śrutimārag morā

verses.sa:
जे सठ गुर सन इरिषा करहीं ।
रौरव नरक कोटि जुग परहीं ॥
verses.tr:
je saṭh gur san iriṣā karahīṃ
raurav narak koṭi jug parahīṃ

verses.sa:
त्रिजग जोनि पुनि धरहिं सरीरा ।
अयुत जन्म भरि पावहिं पीरा ॥
verses.tr:
trijag joni puni dharahiṃ sarīrā
ayut janm bhari pāvahiṃ pīrā

verses.sa:
बैठ रहेसि अजगर इव पापी ।
सर्प होहि खल मल मति ब्यापी ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭh rahesi ajagar iv pāpī
sarp hohi khal mal mati byāpī

verses.sa:
महा बिटप कोटर महुँ जाई ।
रहु अधमाधम अधगति पाई ॥
verses.tr:
mahā biṭap koṭar mahum̐ jāī
rahu adhamādham adhagati pāī

verses.sa: हाहाकार कीन्ह गुर दारुन सुनि सिव साप ॥
verses.tr: hāhākār kīnh gur dārun suni siv sāp
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: कंपित मोहि बिलोकि अति उर उपजा परिताप ॥
verses.tr: kaṃpit mohi biloki ati ur upajā paritāp

verses.sa:
करि दंडवत सप्रेम द्विज सिव सन्मुख कर जोरि ।
बिनय करत गदगद स्वर समुझि घोर गति मोरि ॥
verses.tr:
kari daṃḍavat saprem dvij siv sanmukh kar jori
binaya karat gadagad svar samujhi ghor gati mori

trans: A heavenly voice proceeded from the shrine: “You miserable, conceited churl, though your Guru shows no resentment, being so tender-hearted and of such sublime intelligence, yet I must pronounce a curse upon you, you wretch: I cannot endure sucha breach of morality. If I were not to punish you for your wickedness, my scriptural ordinance would be violated. Villains who bear malice against their Guru are cast for a million ages into the most awful abyss of hell; then they take birth in the brute creation and suffer affliction in a myriad successive exis« tences. As for you, you guilty wretch, whose soul reeks with impurity, since you kept your seat, as it were some unwieldy boa-constrictor, you shall become a snake; enter into the hollow of some huge forest tree and there
like motion,’ each line consists of four Baccbics, or Hindi prosody, four yzganas. ee remain, vilest of the vile, in the form of the vilest of creatures,” r) Dohd 104.

Alas! alas cried the Guru, as he heard Siva’s terrible curse; and seeing me all in a tremble, a profound compassion moved his soul. Devoutly prostrating himself in Siva’s presence, with his hands clasped and his voice choked with emotion as he reflected on my awful fate, he uttered this prayer:

sections.label: Doha 108
sections.name: सुनि बिनती सर्बग्य सिव देखि ब्रिप्र अनुरागु

verses.sa:
नमामीशमीशान निर्वाणरूपं। विंभुं ब्यापकं ब्रह्म वेदस्वरूपं ।
निजं निर्गुणं निर्विकल्पं निरींह। चिदाकाशमाकाशवासं भजेऽहं ॥
verses.tr:
namāmīśamīśān nirvāṇarūpaṃ viṃbhuṃ byāpakaṃ brahm vedasvarūpaṃ
nijaṃ nirguṇaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirīṃh cidākāśamākāśavāsaṃ bhaje'haṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa: निराकारमोंकारमूलं तुरीयं। गिरा ग्यान गोतीतमीशं गिरीशं ॥
verses.tr: nirākāramoṃkāramūlaṃ turīyaṃ girā gyān gotītamīśaṃ girīśaṃ

verses.sa: करालं महाकाल कालं कृपालं। गुणागार संसारपारं नतोऽहं ॥
verses.tr: karālaṃ mahākāl kālaṃ kṛpālaṃ guṇāgār saṃsārapāraṃ nato'haṃ

verses.sa: तुषाराद्रि संकाश गौरं गभीरं। मनोभूत कोटि प्रभा श्री शरीरं ॥
verses.tr: tuṣārādri saṃkāś gauraṃ gabhīraṃ manobhūt koṭi prabhā śrī śarīraṃ

verses.sa: स्फुरन्मौलि कल्लोलिनी चारु गंगा। लसद्भालबालेन्दु कंठे भुजंगा ॥
verses.tr: sphuranmauli kallolinī cāru gaṃgā lasadbhālabālendu kaṃṭhe bhujaṃgā

verses.sa: चलत्कुंडलं भ्रू सुनेत्रं विशालं। प्रसन्नाननं नीलकंठं दयालं ॥
verses.tr: calatkuṃḍalaṃ bhrū sunetraṃ viśālaṃ prasannānanaṃ nīlakaṃṭhaṃ dayālaṃ

verses.sa: मृगाधीशचर्माम्बरं मुण्डमालं। प्रियं शंकरं सर्वनाथं भजामि ॥
verses.tr: mṛgādhīśacarmāmbaraṃ muṇḍamālaṃ priyaṃ śaṃkaraṃ sarvanāthaṃ bhajāmi

verses.sa: प्रचंडं प्रकृष्टं प्रगल्भं परेशं। अखंडं अजं भानुकोटिप्रकाशं ॥
verses.tr: pracaṃḍaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ pragalbhaṃ pareśaṃ akhaṃḍaṃ ajaṃ bhānukoṭiprakāśaṃ

verses.sa: त्रयःशूल निर्मूलनं शूलपाणिं। भजेऽहं भवानीपतिं भावगम्यं ॥
verses.tr: trayaḥśūl nirmūlanaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ bhaje'haṃ bhavānīpatiṃ bhāvagamyaṃ

verses.sa: कलातीत कल्याण कल्पान्तकारी। सदा सज्जनान्ददाता पुरारी ॥
verses.tr: kalātīt kalyāṇ kalpāntakārī sadā sajjanāndadātā purārī

verses.sa: चिदानंदसंदोह मोहापहारी। प्रसीद प्रसीद प्रभो मन्मथारी ॥
verses.tr: cidānaṃdasaṃdoh mohāpahārī prasīd prasīd prabho manmathārī

verses.sa: न यावद् उमानाथ पादारविन्दं। भजंतीह लोके परे वा नराणां ॥
verses.tr: na yāvad umānāth pādāravindaṃ bhajaṃtīh loke pare vā narāṇāṃ

verses.sa: न तावत्सुखं शान्ति सन्तापनाशं। प्रसीद प्रभो सर्वभूताधिवासं ॥
verses.tr: na tāvatsukhaṃ śānti santāpanāśaṃ prasīd prabho sarvabhūtādhivāsaṃ

verses.sa: न जानामि योगं जपं नैव पूजां। नतोऽहं सदा सर्वदा शंभु तुभ्यं ॥
verses.tr: na jānāmi yogaṃ japaṃ naiv pūjāṃ nato'haṃ sadā sarvadā śaṃbhu tubhyaṃ

verses.sa: जरा जन्म दुःखौघ तातप्यमानं। प्रभो पाहि आपन्नमामीश शंभो ॥
verses.tr: jarā janm duḥkhaugh tātapyamānaṃ prabho pāhi āpannamāmīś śaṃbho

verses.sa:
रुद्राष्टकमिदं प्रोक्तं विप्रेण हरतोषये ।
ये पठन्ति नरा भक्त्या तेषां शम्भुः प्रसीदति ॥
verses.tr:
rudrāṣṭakamidaṃ proktaṃ vipreṇa haratoṣaye
ye paṭhanti narā bhaktyā teṣāṃ śambhuḥ prasīdati
verses.head: श्लोक

verses.sa:
सुनि बिनती सर्बग्य सिव देखि ब्रिप्र अनुरागु ।
पुनि मंदिर नभबानी भइ द्विजबर बर मागु ॥
verses.tr:
suni binatī sarbagya siv dekhi bripr anurāgu
puni maṃdir nabhabānī bhai dvijabar bar māgu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
जौं प्रसन्न प्रभु मो पर नाथ दीन पर नेहु ।
निज पद भगति देइ प्रभु पुनि दूसर बर देहु ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ prasann prabhu mo par nāth dīn par nehu
nij pad bhagati dei prabhu puni dūsar bar dehu

verses.sa:
तव माया बस जीव जड़ संतत फिरइ भुलान ।
तेहि पर क्रोध न करिअ प्रभु कृपा सिंधु भगवान ॥
verses.tr:
tav māyā bas jīv jar̤ saṃtat phirai bhulān
tehi par krodh na karia prabhu kṛpā siṃdhu bhagavān

verses.sa:
संकर दीनदयाल अब एहि पर होहु कृपाल ।
साप अनुग्रह होइ जेहिं नाथ थोरेहीं काल ॥
verses.tr:
saṃkar dīnadayāl ab ehi par hohu kṛpāl
sāp anugrah hoi jehiṃ nāth thorehīṃ kāl

trans: ‘I adore the Lord of lords; the embodiment of salvation; the omnipresent and all-pervading Supreme Spirit; the image of the Veda. I worship the absolute; the an-qualified; the unconditioned the unwiseful; who dwelleth in the heavens and who has heaven for his soul. I bow before the formless germ of the themystic incantation Om; the transcendental; the lord that is beyond all speech, understanding, or faculty of the senses; the Himalayan king, terrible and the death of tyrant Death; and yet the allmerciful; the grace-aboundiog refuge of the world. Rugged and stern as the Snowy Mountains, yet radiant with the beauty of a myriad Loves; with the bright waters of the Ganges springing from thy head, with the crescent moon gleaming on the brow and snakes on thy neck, with tremulous ear-rings and large eyes and shaggy brows, with benignant face and deep-stained throat, O all-merciful. robed in a tiger's skin, with a necklet of skulls, I worship thee, the universal Lord, even Sankara, whom | love, [ adore thee, the vehement, the exalted the intrepid, the supreme lord; the indivisible, the unbegotten, whose glory is that of a myriad suns; tearing up by the root every kind of trouble with the trident in thy hand; Bhavani’s lord, accessible only by meditation. Unchangeable and ever-blessed Pureri, consummator of earth's cycles, constant bestower of Blessings on the pious, sum of all knowledge and felicity, dispeller of delusion, conqueror of Love have mercy, O my lord, have mercy, So long as they worship not the Lotus feet of Uma’s lord, neither in this world nor io the next is there any happiness for men, nor peace, nor cessation of misery; O my lord, clothed about with all the elements, have mercy. I know nothing of meditation, or prayer, or ritual, but’ at-all times and in all places I bow before thee, O Sambhu. Have mercy, O my lord, on a wretch so sorely afflicted by old age and life's flood of troubles;! for thee only I worship, O my lord Sambhu,”’ Slok@ 4.
Any one who devoutly repeats this hymn to Siva, as uttered by the Brahman io his propitiation, upon him will
Siva show favour. Dohe 105.

When the omniscient Siva heard the Brahman’s prayer and saw his devotion, and heavenly voice again sounded in the temple: ‘“ Best of Brahmans, ask a boon.” ‘If my lord is well pleased with me and will show favour to his servant, grant me first devotion to thy feet and then yet another boon. Overcome, by thy delusive power, ignorant creatures ever wander astray: be not then wroth with him, O merciful Lord God. Gracious Sankara, be merciful to him. After a little time may thy curse bea kindness.

sections.label: Doha 109
sections.name: सुनि सिव बचन हरषि गुर एवमस्तु इति भाषि

verses.sa:
एहि कर होइ परम कल्याना ।
सोइ करहु अब कृपानिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
ehi kar hoi param kalyānā
soi karahu ab kṛpānidhānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिप्रगिरा सुनि परहित सानी ।
एवमस्तु इति भइ नभबानी ॥
verses.tr:
bipragirā suni parahit sānī
evamastu iti bhai nabhabānī

verses.sa:
जदपि कीन्ह एहिं दारुन पापा ।
मैं पुनि दीन्ह कोप करि सापा ॥
verses.tr:
jadapi kīnh ehiṃ dārun pāpā
maiṃ puni dīnh kop kari sāpā

verses.sa:
तदपि तुम्हार साधुता देखी ।
करिहउँ एहि पर कृपा बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi tumhār sādhutā dekhī
karihaum̐ ehi par kṛpā biseṣī

verses.sa:
छमासील जे पर उपकारी ।
ते द्विज मोहि प्रिय जथा खरारी ॥
verses.tr:
chamāsīl je par upakārī
te dvij mohi priya jathā kharārī

verses.sa:
मोर श्राप द्विज ब्यर्थ न जाइहि ।
जन्म सहस अवस्य यह पाइहि ॥
verses.tr:
mor śrāp dvij byarth na jāihi
janm sahas avasya yah pāihi

verses.sa:
जनमत मरत दुसह दुख होई ।
अहि स्वल्पउ नहिं ब्यापिहि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
janamat marat dusah dukh hoī
ahi svalpau nahiṃ byāpihi soī

verses.sa:
कवनेउँ जन्म मिटिहि नहिं ग्याना ।
सुनहि सूद्र मम बचन प्रवाना ॥
verses.tr:
kavaneum̐ janm miṭihi nahiṃ gyānā
sunahi sūdr mam bacan pravānā

verses.sa:
रघुपति पुरीं जन्म तब भयऊ ।
पुनि तैं मम सेवाँ मन दयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati purīṃ janm tab bhayaū
puni taiṃ mam sevām̐ man dayaū

verses.sa:
पुरी प्रभाव अनुग्रह मोरें ।
राम भगति उपजिहि उर तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
purī prabhāv anugrah moreṃ
rām bhagati upajihi ur toreṃ

verses.sa:
सुनु मम बचन सत्य अब भाई ।
हरितोषन ब्रत द्विज सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
sunu mam bacan satya ab bhāī
haritoṣan brat dvij sevakāī

verses.sa:
अब जनि करहि बिप्र अपमाना ।
जानेहु संत अनंत समाना ॥
verses.tr:
ab jani karahi bipr apamānā
jānehu saṃt anaṃt samānā

verses.sa:
इंद्र कुलिस मम सूल बिसाला ।
कालदंड हरि चक्र कराला ॥
verses.tr:
iṃdr kulis mam sūl bisālā
kāladaṃḍ hari cakr karālā

verses.sa:
जो इन्ह कर मारा नहिं मरई ।
बिप्रद्रोह पावक सो जरई ॥
verses.tr:
jo inh kar mārā nahiṃ maraī
bipradroh pāvak so jaraī

verses.sa:
अस बिबेक राखेहु मन माहीं ।
तुम्ह कहँ जग दुर्लभ कछु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
as bibek rākhehu man māhīṃ
tumh kaham̐ jag durlabh kachu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
औरउ एक आसिषा मोरी ।
अप्रतिहत गति होइहि तोरी ॥
verses.tr:
aurau ek āsiṣā morī
apratihat gati hoihi torī

verses.sa:
सुनि सिव बचन हरषि गुर एवमस्तु इति भाषि ।
मोहि प्रबोधि गयउ गृह संभु चरन उर राखि ॥
verses.tr:
suni siv bacan haraṣi gur evamastu iti bhāṣi
mohi prabodhi gayau gṛh saṃbhu caran ur rākhi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
प्रेरित काल बिधि गिरि जाइ भयउँ मैं ब्याल ।
पुनि प्रयास बिनु सो तनु जजेउँ गएँ कछु काल ॥
verses.tr:
prerit kāl bidhi giri jāi bhayaum̐ maiṃ byāl
puni prayās binu so tanu jajeum̐ gaem̐ kachu kāl

verses.sa:
जोइ तनु धरउँ तजउँ पुनि अनायास हरिजान ।
जिमि नूतन पट पहिरइ नर परिहरइ पुरान ॥
verses.tr:
joi tanu dharaum̐ tajaum̐ puni anāyās harijān
jimi nūtan paṭ pahirai nar pariharai purān

verses.sa:
सिवँ राखी श्रुति नीति अरु मैं नहिं पावा क्लेस ।
एहि बिधि धरेउँ बिबिध तनु ग्यान न गयउ खगेस ॥
verses.tr:
sivam̐ rākhī śruti nīti aru maiṃ nahiṃ pāvā kles
ehi bidhi dhareum̐ bibidh tanu gyān na gayau khages

trans: And the highest blessings attend him; bring it thus to pass, © fountain of mercy.” On hearing the Brahman’s speech so pregnant with charity, the heavenly voice replied. ‘So be it. Although he has committed a grievous sin, and I] in my wrath have cursed him, yet seeing your goodness I will visit him with a special favour. Brahmans who are of a forgiviog disposition and charitable to their neighbours are as dear to me as Khardri himself. Yet my curse, father, cannot be in vain; he shall of a certainty have a thousand lives. But the insapportable misery of birth and death shall not have the slightest effect upon him. In no birth shall his knowledge fail. Hearken, Sudra, to my judgment. You have been born in Rama's capital and, further, you have done me service. By the blessing of the city and by my favour a devotion to Rama shall spring up in your bosom. Now hearken, friend, to my solemn declaration: the way to please Hari is by fasting and ministering to the Br^hmans Never again insult » Brebman; regard the saints in the light of the Everlasting. Indra’s thunderbolt, my mighty trident, the road of, Death and Vishnu’s terrible discus, by all these a man may be smitten yet not die; but a Brahman's wrath is a fire which shall burn him to ashes. Cherish this counsel at heart and there is nothing in the world too difficult for you to obtain. One other blessing I have still to bestow; your goings shall never be impeded.”

On hearing Siva’s promise, the Guru rejoiced and cried Amen, Then after admonishing me, he returned home, with the image of Sambhu’s feet impressed upon his heart. Driven by my fate, I went to the Vindhya mountains and then became a snake, and again after some time quietly dropped that form. Whatever body I assume, Garur, I readily drop again, like a man who puts off his old clothes and takes to him new. Siva observed the ordinances of the Veda, while I suffered no pain; thus I assumed many different forms, but my understanding, Garur, never left me.

sections.label: Doha 110
sections.name: गुर के बचन सुरति करि राम चरन मनु लाग

verses.sa:
त्रिजग देव नर जोइ तनु धरउँ ।
तहँ तहँ राम भजन अनुसरऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
trijag dev nar joi tanu dharaum̐
taham̐ taham̐ rām bhajan anusaraūm̐
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एक सूल मोहि बिसर न काऊ ।
गुर कर कोमल सील सुभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ek sūl mohi bisar na kāū
gur kar komal sīl subhāū

verses.sa:
चरम देह द्विज कै मैं पाई ।
सुर दुर्लभ पुरान श्रुति गाई ॥
verses.tr:
caram deh dvij kai maiṃ pāī
sur durlabh purān śruti gāī

verses.sa:
खेलउँ तहूँ बालकन्ह मीला ।
करउँ सकल रघुनायक लीला ॥
verses.tr:
khelaum̐ tahūm̐ bālakanh mīlā
karaum̐ sakal raghunāyak līlā

verses.sa:
प्रौढ़ भएँ मोहि पिता पढ़ावा ।
समझउँ सुनउँ गुनउँ नहिं भावा ॥
verses.tr:
praur̤h bhaem̐ mohi pitā par̤hāvā
samajhaum̐ sunaum̐ gunaum̐ nahiṃ bhāvā

verses.sa:
मन ते सकल बासना भागी ।
केवल राम चरन लय लागी ॥
verses.tr:
man te sakal bāsanā bhāgī
keval rām caran laya lāgī

verses.sa:
कहु खगेस अस कवन अभागी ।
खरी सेव सुरधेनुहि त्यागी ॥
verses.tr:
kahu khages as kavan abhāgī
kharī sev suradhenuhi tyāgī

verses.sa:
प्रेम मगन मोहि कछु न सोहाई ।
हारेउ पिता पढ़ाइ पढ़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
prem magan mohi kachu na sohāī
hāreu pitā par̤hāi par̤hāī

verses.sa:
भए कालबस जब पितु माता ।
मैं बन गयउँ भजन जनत्राता ॥
verses.tr:
bhae kālabas jab pitu mātā
maiṃ ban gayaum̐ bhajan janatrātā

verses.sa:
जहँ जहँ बिपिन मुनीस्वर पावउँ ।
आश्रम जाइ जाइ सिरु नावउँ ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ jaham̐ bipin munīsvar pāvaum̐
āśram jāi jāi siru nāvaum̐

verses.sa:
बूझत तिन्हहि राम गुन गाहा ।
कहहिं सुनउँ हरषित खगनाहा ॥
verses.tr:
būjhat tinhahi rām gun gāhā
kahahiṃ sunaum̐ haraṣit khaganāhā

verses.sa:
सुनत फिरउँ हरि गुन अनुबादा ।
अब्याहत गति संभु प्रसादा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat phiraum̐ hari gun anubādā
abyāhat gati saṃbhu prasādā

verses.sa:
छूटी त्रिबिध ईषना गाढ़ी ।
एक लालसा उर अति बाढ़ी ॥
verses.tr:
chūṭī tribidh īṣanā gār̤hī
ek lālasā ur ati bār̤hī

verses.sa:
राम चरन बारिज जब देखौं ।
तब निज जन्म सफल करि लेखौं ॥
verses.tr:
rām caran bārij jab dekhauṃ
tab nij janm saphal kari lekhauṃ

verses.sa:
जेहि पूँछउँ सोइ मुनि अस कहई ।
ईस्वर सर्ब भूतमय अहई ॥
verses.tr:
jehi pūm̐chaum̐ soi muni as kahaī
īsvar sarb bhūtamaya ahaī

verses.sa:
निर्गुन मत नहिं मोहि सोहाई ।
सगुन ब्रह्म रति उर अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
nirgun mat nahiṃ mohi sohāī
sagun brahm rati ur adhikāī

verses.sa:
गुर के बचन सुरति करि राम चरन मनु लाग ।
रघुपति जस गावत फिरउँ छन छन नव अनुराग ॥
verses.tr:
gur ke bacan surati kari rām caran manu lāg
raghupati jas gāvat phiraum̐ chan chan nav anurāg
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
मेरु सिखर बट छायाँ मुनि लोमस आसीन ।
देखि चरन सिरु नायउँ बचन कहेउँ अति दीन ॥
verses.tr:
meru sikhar baṭ chāyām̐ muni lomas āsīn
dekhi caran siru nāyaum̐ bacan kaheum̐ ati dīn

verses.sa:
सुनि मम बचन बिनीत मृदु मुनि कृपाल खगराज ।
मोहि सादर पूँछत भए द्विज आयहु केहि काज ॥
verses.tr:
suni mam bacan binīt mṛdu muni kṛpāl khagarāj
mohi sādar pūm̐chat bhae dvij āyahu kehi kāj

verses.sa:
तब मैं कहा कृपानिधि तुम्ह सर्बग्य सुजान ।
सगुन ब्रह्म अवराधन मोहि कहहु भगवान ॥
verses.tr:
tab maiṃ kahā kṛpānidhi tumh sarbagya sujān
sagun brahm avarādhan mohi kahahu bhagavān

trans: Whatever body 1! assumed, whether of beast, god or man, I invariably retained the practice of prayer to Rama. The one regret that never left me was in the remembrance of the Guru’s mildness of temper and disposition. At last I took birth in the holy form of a Brahman, a rank to which —as the Vedas and Puranas declare—it is difficult even for a good to attain. So joining in play with other children, I enacted all] Rama's boyish sports. When I grew bigger, my father gave me lessons; but I neither understood nor attended, nor gave my mind to anything; every other inclination clean deserted me and I was wholly absorbed in my devotion to Rama’s feet. Tell me, king of the birds, is there any one so foolish as to abandon the cow of plenty to tend a she-ass? I was so overwhelmed with Love that naught else pleased me and my father was quite tired of trying to teach me. After my parents had succambed to fate, I went into the forest, there to adore the Saviour of his people. Wherever I discovered any great saints living in the woods, I frequently visited their hermitage and bowed before them, asking them all about Rama’s excellences and listening. Garur, with delight to what they told me. I went about everywhere hearing the tale _of Hari’s goodness, for by the blessing of Sambhu there was no chcek to my movements. The three kinds of evil concern had left me and I had only one great longing at heart: ‘When I shall] behold Rama’s lotus feet, then a shall account my life to have been worth living.’ Every sage, whom I questioned, told me thus: ‘The Lord is present in all his creatures.” This religion of the impersonal did not satisfy me; I felt an overpowering devotion towards the incarnation of the Supreme.

Rememberiog the Guru’s words and with my mind fixed on Rama's feet, | wandered about. hymning his praises, and my love every moment grew yet more and more. On one of the peaks of Mount Meru, under the shade of a bar tree, sat the Seer Lomas. On seeing him I bowed my head at his feet and addressed him in most humble strain.
