No sooner, Garur, had the beneficent sage heard my meek and submissive «address than he graciously enquired: “Say, O Brahman, with what purpose you have come.” Thereupon I replied: “Fountain of mercy, you are omniscient and allwise; teach my, Sire, how to worship the incarnate God.”

sections.label: Doha 111
sections.name: -बारंबार सकोप मुनि करइ निरुपन ग्यान

verses.sa:
तब मुनिष रघुपति गुन गाथा ।
कहे कछुक सादर खगनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
tab muniṣ raghupati gun gāthā
kahe kachuk sādar khaganāthā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मग्यान रत मुनि बिग्यानि ।
मोहि परम अधिकारी जानी ॥
verses.tr:
brahmagyān rat muni bigyāni
mohi param adhikārī jānī

verses.sa:
लागे करन ब्रह्म उपदेसा ।
अज अद्वेत अगुन हृदयेसा ॥
verses.tr:
lāge karan brahm upadesā
aj advet agun hṛdayesā

verses.sa:
अकल अनीह अनाम अरुपा ।
अनुभव गम्य अखंड अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
akal anīh anām arupā
anubhav gamya akhaṃḍ anūpā

verses.sa:
मन गोतीत अमल अबिनासी ।
निर्बिकार निरवधि सुख रासी ॥
verses.tr:
man gotīt amal abināsī
nirbikār niravadhi sukh rāsī

verses.sa:
सो तैं ताहि तोहि नहिं भेदा ।
बारि बीचि इव गावहि बेदा ॥
verses.tr:
so taiṃ tāhi tohi nahiṃ bhedā
bāri bīci iv gāvahi bedā

verses.sa:
बिबिध भाँति मोहि मुनि समुझावा ।
निर्गुन मत मम हृदयँ न आवा ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh bhām̐ti mohi muni samujhāvā
nirgun mat mam hṛdayam̐ na āvā

verses.sa:
पुनि मैं कहेउँ नाइ पद सीसा ।
सगुन उपासन कहहु मुनीसा ॥
verses.tr:
puni maiṃ kaheum̐ nāi pad sīsā
sagun upāsan kahahu munīsā

verses.sa:
राम भगति जल मम मन मीना ।
किमि बिलगाइ मुनीस प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagati jal mam man mīnā
kimi bilagāi munīs prabīnā

verses.sa:
सोइ उपदेस कहहु करि दाया ।
निज नयनन्हि देखौं रघुराया ॥
verses.tr:
soi upades kahahu kari dāyā
nij nayananhi dekhauṃ raghurāyā

verses.sa:
भरि लोचन बिलोकि अवधेसा ।
तब सुनिहउँ निर्गुन उपदेसा ॥
verses.tr:
bhari locan biloki avadhesā
tab sunihaum̐ nirgun upadesā

verses.sa:
मुनि पुनि कहि हरिकथा अनूपा ।
खंडि सगुन मत अगुन निरूपा ॥
verses.tr:
muni puni kahi harikathā anūpā
khaṃḍi sagun mat agun nirūpā

verses.sa:
तब मैं निर्गुन मत कर दूरी ।
सगुन निरूपउँ करि हठ भूरी ॥
verses.tr:
tab maiṃ nirgun mat kar dūrī
sagun nirūpaum̐ kari haṭh bhūrī

verses.sa:
उत्तर प्रतिउत्तर मैं कीन्हा ।
मुनि तन भए क्रोध के चीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
uttar pratiuttar maiṃ kīnhā
muni tan bhae krodh ke cīnhā

verses.sa:
सुनु प्रभु बहुत अवग्या किएँ ।
उपज क्रोध ग्यानिन्ह के हिएँ ॥
verses.tr:
sunu prabhu bahut avagyā kiem̐
upaj krodh gyāninh ke hiem̐

verses.sa:
अति संघरषन जौं कर कोई ।
अनल प्रगट चंदन ते होई ॥
verses.tr:
ati saṃgharaṣan jauṃ kar koī
anal pragaṭ caṃdan te hoī

verses.sa:
-बारंबार सकोप मुनि करइ निरुपन ग्यान ।
मैं अपनें मन बैठ तब करउँ बिबिध अनुमान ॥
verses.tr:
-bāraṃbār sakop muni karai nirupan gyān
maiṃ apaneṃ man baiṭh tab karaum̐ bibidh anumān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
क्रोध कि द्वेतबुद्धि बिनु द्वैत कि बिनु अग्यान ।
मायाबस परिछिन्न जड़ जीव कि ईस समान ॥
verses.tr:
krodh ki dvetabuddhi binu dvait ki binu agyān
māyābas parichinn jar̤ jīv ki īs samān

trans: Thereupon, Garar, the great saint spoke, briefly though reverently, of Rama’s virtues; then, being himself a philosopher devoted to the mystery of the transcendental and thinking that I had fully mastered the subject, he began a sermon on Brahma, the unbegotten, the indivisible, the immaterial, the sovereign of the heart; unchangeable, unwishful, nameless, formless; approachable only by analogy, indestructible, incomparable; beyond the reach of thought or sense, spotless, immortal, emotionless, illimitable, blessed for ever; identical with yourself, yonand he being as absolutely oneas a wave and its water: so the Vedas declare. The saint gave me the fullest possible instruction but the worship of the impersonal Laid no hold of my oeee Again I cried, bowing my head at his feet: “Tell me holy father, how to worship the Incarnate. Devotion to Rama, O wisest of sages, is like the element of water and my soul—which is as it were a fish—how can it exist without it? Of your mercy so instruct me that I may see RAma with my own eyes. When I have seen my fill of the lord of Avadh, then I will listen to your sermon on_ the Unembodied.” Again the saint discoursed of the incon parable Hari and demolishing the dogma of the incarnation expounded him as altogether passionless. But I rejected the theory of the abstract and with much obstinacy insisted on his concrete manifestation. For every answer I had a rejoinder ready, The saint at last showed signs of anger. Mark me, Sir; I was so disrespectful that resentment was aroused even in the breast of a philosopher. An excessive amount of friction will strike fire even out of sandul-wood.

Again and again the saint angrily expounded his theory, while I sat still and argued the matter from every point of view in my own mind: “Can there be anger without duality, or duality without ignorance Can a soul, dull circumscribed and subject to delusion be identified with divinity?

sections.label: Doha 112
sections.name: तुरत भयउँ मैं काग तब पुनि मुनि पद सिरु नाइ

verses.sa:
कबहुँ कि दुख सब कर हित ताकें ।
तेहि कि दरिद्र परस मनि जाकें ॥
verses.tr:
kabahum̐ ki dukh sab kar hit tākeṃ
tehi ki daridr paras mani jākeṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
परद्रोही की होहिं निसंका ।
कामी पुनि कि रहहिं अकलंका ॥
verses.tr:
paradrohī kī hohiṃ nisaṃkā
kāmī puni ki rahahiṃ akalaṃkā

verses.sa:
बंस कि रह द्विज अनहित कीन्हें ।
कर्म कि होहिं स्वरूपहि चीन्हें ॥
verses.tr:
baṃs ki rah dvij anahit kīnheṃ
karm ki hohiṃ svarūpahi cīnheṃ

verses.sa:
काहू सुमति कि खल सँग जामी ।
सुभ गति पाव कि परत्रिय गामी ॥
verses.tr:
kāhū sumati ki khal sam̐g jāmī
subh gati pāv ki paratriya gāmī

verses.sa:
भव कि परहिं परमात्मा बिंदक ।
सुखी कि होहिं कबहुँ हरिनिंदक ॥
verses.tr:
bhav ki parahiṃ paramātmā biṃdak
sukhī ki hohiṃ kabahum̐ hariniṃdak

verses.sa:
राजु कि रहइ नीति बिनु जानें ।
अघ कि रहहिं हरिचरित बखानें ॥
verses.tr:
rāju ki rahai nīti binu jāneṃ
agh ki rahahiṃ haricarit bakhāneṃ

verses.sa:
पावन जस कि पुन्य बिनु होई ।
बिनु अघ अजस कि पावइ कोई ॥
verses.tr:
pāvan jas ki punya binu hoī
binu agh ajas ki pāvai koī

verses.sa:
लाभु कि किछु हरि भगति समाना ।
जेहि गावहिं श्रुति संत पुराना ॥
verses.tr:
lābhu ki kichu hari bhagati samānā
jehi gāvahiṃ śruti saṃt purānā

verses.sa:
हानि कि जग एहि सम किछु भाई ।
भजिअ न रामहि नर तनु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
hāni ki jag ehi sam kichu bhāī
bhajia na rāmahi nar tanu pāī

verses.sa:
अघ कि पिसुनता सम कछु आना ।
धर्म कि दया सरिस हरिजाना ॥
verses.tr:
agh ki pisunatā sam kachu ānā
dharm ki dayā saris harijānā

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि अमिति जुगुति मन गुनऊँ ।
मुनि उपदेस न सादर सुनऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi amiti juguti man gunaūm̐
muni upades na sādar sunaūm̐

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि सगुन पच्छ मैं रोपा ।
तब मुनि बोलेउ बचन सकोपा ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni sagun pacch maiṃ ropā
tab muni boleu bacan sakopā

verses.sa:
मूढ़ परम सिख देउँ न मानसि ।
उत्तर प्रतिउत्तर बहु आनसि ॥
verses.tr:
mūr̤h param sikh deum̐ na mānasi
uttar pratiuttar bahu ānasi

verses.sa:
सत्य बचन बिस्वास न करही ।
बायस इव सबही ते डरही ॥
verses.tr:
satya bacan bisvās na karahī
bāyas iv sabahī te ḍarahī

verses.sa:
सठ स्वपच्छ तब हृदयँ बिसाला ।
सपदि होहि पच्छी चंडाला ॥
verses.tr:
saṭh svapacch tab hṛdayam̐ bisālā
sapadi hohi pacchī caṃḍālā

verses.sa:
लीन्ह श्राप मैं सीस चढ़ाई ।
नहिं कछु भय न दीनता आई ॥
verses.tr:
līnh śrāp maiṃ sīs car̤hāī
nahiṃ kachu bhaya na dīnatā āī

verses.sa:
तुरत भयउँ मैं काग तब पुनि मुनि पद सिरु नाइ ।
सुमिरि राम रघुबंस मनि हरषित चलेउँ उड़ाइ ॥
verses.tr:
turat bhayaum̐ maiṃ kāg tab puni muni pad siru nāi
sumiri rām raghubaṃs mani haraṣit caleum̐ ur̤āi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: उमा जे राम चरन रत बिगत काम मद क्रोध ॥
verses.tr: umā je rām caran rat bigat kām mad krodh

verses.sa: निज प्रभुमय देखहिं जगत केहि सन करहिं बिरोध ॥
verses.tr: nij prabhumaya dekhahiṃ jagat kehi san karahiṃ birodh

trans: Can pain under any circumstances be the same as pleasure Can the possessor of the philosopher's stone suffer poverty? Can an oppressor be free from anxiety or a sensualist remain without reproach? Can a man’s family prosper if he persecute Brahmans Can religious observances be practised by a man careful only for bodily comfort? Can sound doctrine be acquired by intercourse with the wicked? Can an adulterer attain to the felicity of the Blessed? Can asearcher after the Supreme Spirit escape from transmigration? (an a reviler of Hari be ever happy? Cana kingdom stand without a knowledge of statecraft? Quan sin coexist with a recital of Hari’s virtues? Can spotless renown be acquired without religious merit? Can any one be disgraced except by sin. Ts there any gain like devotion to Hari, as hymned by the Vedas, the saints and the Purdnas Is there any loss, Sire, in the whole world like that of being born as a man and yet not worshipping Hari Is there any other sin so bad as detraction, or any virtue, Garur, so great as charity?” Thus I reasoned to myself with much ingenuity and could not listen with patience to the saint’s instruction. Againand again I maintained the doctrine of the Incarnation, till at last the saint uttered these angry words: *: Fool, I have given you the most advanced teaching, but still you are not covinced and persist in your replies and rejoinders. You have no confidence in my voracious dise course bnt like a crow suspect everything. Wretch, as your soul is so exceedingly self-opinionated, you shall at once be changed into an anvileun bird I took the curse on my head, but was neither alarmed nor humbled.

Immediately I was turned into a crow. Then again I bowed my head at the saints feet and mindful of Rama, the jewel of the line of Raghu, I joyfully flew away. O Uma, they who devote themselves to Rama’s feet and abjure lust, pride and choler, they see their lord present in everything: with what then can they quarrel?

sections.label: Doha 113
sections.name: -सदा राम प्रिय होहु तुम्ह सुभ गुन भवन अमान

verses.sa:
सुनु खगेस नहिं कछु रिषि दूषन ।
उर प्रेरक रघुबंस बिभूषन ॥
verses.tr:
sunu khages nahiṃ kachu riṣi dūṣan
ur prerak raghubaṃs bibhūṣan
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कृपासिंधु मुनि मति करि भोरी ।
लीन्हि प्रेम परिच्छा मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
kṛpāsiṃdhu muni mati kari bhorī
līnhi prem paricchā morī

verses.sa:
मन बच क्रम मोहि निज जन जाना ।
मुनि मति पुनि फेरी भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
man bac kram mohi nij jan jānā
muni mati puni pherī bhagavānā

verses.sa:
रिषि मम महत सीलता देखी ।
राम चरन बिस्वास बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
riṣi mam mahat sīlatā dekhī
rām caran bisvās biseṣī

verses.sa:
अति बिसमय पुनि पुनि पछिताई ।
सादर मुनि मोहि लीन्ह बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
ati bisamaya puni puni pachitāī
sādar muni mohi līnh bolāī

verses.sa:
मम परितोष बिबिध बिधि कीन्हा ।
हरषित राममंत्र तब दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
mam paritoṣ bibidh bidhi kīnhā
haraṣit rāmamaṃtr tab dīnhā

verses.sa:
बालकरूप राम कर ध्याना ।
कहेउ मोहि मुनि कृपानिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
bālakarūp rām kar dhyānā
kaheu mohi muni kṛpānidhānā

verses.sa:
सुंदर सुखद मिहि अति भावा ।
सो प्रथमहिं मैं तुम्हहि सुनावा ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar sukhad mihi ati bhāvā
so prathamahiṃ maiṃ tumhahi sunāvā

verses.sa:
मुनि मोहि कछुक काल तहँ राखा ।
रामचरितमानस तब भाषा ॥
verses.tr:
muni mohi kachuk kāl taham̐ rākhā
rāmacaritamānas tab bhāṣā

verses.sa:
सादर मोहि यह कथा सुनाई ।
पुनि बोले मुनि गिरा सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
sādar mohi yah kathā sunāī
puni bole muni girā suhāī

verses.sa:
रामचरित सर गुप्त सुहावा ।
संभु प्रसाद तात मैं पावा ॥
verses.tr:
rāmacarit sar gupt suhāvā
saṃbhu prasād tāt maiṃ pāvā

verses.sa:
तोहि निज भगत राम कर जानी ।
ताते मैं सब कहेउँ बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
tohi nij bhagat rām kar jānī
tāte maiṃ sab kaheum̐ bakhānī

verses.sa:
राम भगति जिन्ह कें उर नाहीं ।
कबहुँ न तात कहिअ तिन्ह पाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagati jinh keṃ ur nāhīṃ
kabahum̐ na tāt kahia tinh pāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मुनि मोहि बिबिध भाँति समुझावा ।
मैं सप्रेम मुनि पद सिरु नावा ॥
verses.tr:
muni mohi bibidh bhām̐ti samujhāvā
maiṃ saprem muni pad siru nāvā

verses.sa:
निज कर कमल परसि मम सीसा ।
हरषित आसिष दीन्ह मुनीसा ॥
verses.tr:
nij kar kamal parasi mam sīsā
haraṣit āsiṣ dīnh munīsā

verses.sa:
राम भगति अबिरल उर तोरें ।
बसिहि सदा प्रसाद अब मोरें ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagati abiral ur toreṃ
basihi sadā prasād ab moreṃ

verses.sa:
-सदा राम प्रिय होहु तुम्ह सुभ गुन भवन अमान ।
कामरूप इच्धामरन ग्यान बिराग निधान ॥
verses.tr:
-sadā rām priya hohu tumh subh gun bhavan amān
kāmarūp icdhāmaran gyān birāg nidhān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
जेंहिं आश्रम तुम्ह बसब पुनि सुमिरत श्रीभगवंत ।
ब्यापिहि तहँ न अबिद्या जोजन एक प्रजंत ॥
verses.tr:
jeṃhiṃ āśram tumh basab puni sumirat śrībhagavaṃt
byāpihi taham̐ na abidyā jojan ek prajaṃt

trans: Hearken, king of the birds; the saint was no way in fault; it was Rama who had stirred his soul. The Allmerciful had confounded his intellect and thus made trial of my love. When the Lord God had proved the thorough-nes: of my devotion, he restored the saint his senses. On beholding my great amiability and pre-eminent confidence in Rama, the holy man was much astonished and sorely repented him and courteously called me near. After consoling me in every possible way, he gladly taught me the spell by which Rama is invoked, and in his infinite compassion told me how to meditate on the blessed child, The Beauty and sweetness of this cult pleased me well. I told you all about it at the beginning. The saint kept me there some little time and recited the whole of the poem, entitled ‘the Lake of Rama’s deeds. When he had reverently completed the narrative, he finally adressed me in these gracious words: ‘By the blessing of Sambhu, my son, I discovered this secret and delectable fountain of song; I know you to be one of Rama’s most devoted servants and therefore I have told it all to you. Never repeat it, my son, in the presence of any whose heart is void of Rama’s love.” The saint reiterated his instructions again and again. and I lovingly bowed my head at his feet. He touched my head with his lotus hands and gladly gave me his blessing:
“Henceforth by my favour an unalterable devotion to Rama shall dwell for ever in your heart.

sections.label: Doha 114
sections.name: ताते यह तन मोहि प्रिय भयउ राम पद नेह

verses.sa:
काल कर्म गुन दोष सुभाऊ ।
कछु दुख तुम्हहि न ब्यापिहि काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kāl karm gun doṣ subhāū
kachu dukh tumhahi na byāpihi kāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम रहस्य ललित बिधि नाना ।
गुप्त प्रगट इतिहास पुराना ॥
verses.tr:
rām rahasya lalit bidhi nānā
gupt pragaṭ itihās purānā

verses.sa:
बिनु श्रम तुम्ह जानब सब सोऊ ।
नित नव नेह राम पद होऊ ॥
verses.tr:
binu śram tumh jānab sab soū
nit nav neh rām pad hoū

verses.sa:
जो इच्छा करिहहु मन माहीं ।
हरि प्रसाद कछु दुर्लभ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jo icchā karihahu man māhīṃ
hari prasād kachu durlabh nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि आसिष सुनु मतिधीरा ।
ब्रह्मगिरा भइ गगन गँभीरा ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni āsiṣ sunu matidhīrā
brahmagirā bhai gagan gam̐bhīrā

verses.sa:
एवमस्तु तव बच मुनि ग्यानी ।
यह मम भगत कर्म मन बानी ॥
verses.tr:
evamastu tav bac muni gyānī
yah mam bhagat karm man bānī

verses.sa:
सुनि नभगिरा हरष मोहि भयऊ ।
प्रेम मगन सब संसय गयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
suni nabhagirā haraṣ mohi bhayaū
prem magan sab saṃsaya gayaū

verses.sa:
करि बिनती मुनि आयसु पाई ।
पद सरोज पुनि पुनि सिरु नाई ॥
verses.tr:
kari binatī muni āyasu pāī
pad saroj puni puni siru nāī

verses.sa:
हरष सहित एहिं आश्रम आयउँ ।
प्रभु प्रसाद दुर्लभ बर पायउँ ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣ sahit ehiṃ āśram āyaum̐
prabhu prasād durlabh bar pāyaum̐

verses.sa:
इहाँ बसत मोहि सुनु खग ईसा ।
बीते कलप सात अरु बीसा ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ basat mohi sunu khag īsā
bīte kalap sāt aru bīsā

verses.sa:
करउँ सदा रघुपति गुन गाना ।
सादर सुनहिं बिहंग सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
karaum̐ sadā raghupati gun gānā
sādar sunahiṃ bihaṃg sujānā

verses.sa:
जब जब अवधपुरीं रघुबीरा ।
धरहिं भगत हित मनुज सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
jab jab avadhapurīṃ raghubīrā
dharahiṃ bhagat hit manuj sarīrā

verses.sa:
तब तब जाइ राम पुर रहऊँ ।
सिसुलीला बिलोकि सुख लहऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
tab tab jāi rām pur rahaūm̐
sisulīlā biloki sukh lahaūm̐

verses.sa:
पुनि उर राखि राम सिसुरूपा ।
निज आश्रम आवउँ खगभूपा ॥
verses.tr:
puni ur rākhi rām sisurūpā
nij āśram āvaum̐ khagabhūpā

verses.sa:
कथा सकल मैं तुम्हहि सुनाई ।
काग देह जेहिं कारन पाई ॥
verses.tr:
kathā sakal maiṃ tumhahi sunāī
kāg deh jehiṃ kāran pāī

verses.sa:
कहिउँ तात सब प्रस्न तुम्हारी ।
राम भगति महिमा अति भारी ॥
verses.tr:
kahium̐ tāt sab prasn tumhārī
rām bhagati mahimā ati bhārī

verses.sa:
ताते यह तन मोहि प्रिय भयउ राम पद नेह ।
निज प्रभु दरसन पायउँ गए सकल संदेह ॥
verses.tr:
tāte yah tan mohi priya bhayau rām pad neh
nij prabhu darasan pāyaum̐ gae sakal saṃdeh
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
भगति पच्छ हठ करि रहेउँ दीन्हि महारिषि साप ।
मुनि दुर्लभ बर पायउँ देखहु भजन प्रताप ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati pacch haṭh kari raheum̐ dīnhi mahāriṣi sāp
muni durlabh bar pāyaum̐ dekhahu bhajan pratāp

trans: Be for ever Rama’s favourite; an illimitable; store-house of all good qualities; changing your form at will and choos- Ee ing your own time for death; a treasury of knowledge and asceticism. May every hermitage, where you hereafter abide and make your prayer to the blessed God, be unapproachable by the spirit of ignorance for the space of a league all round. Chaupdi. May neither time nor fate, merit, demerit nor circumstance ever cause you any vexation. May the unspeakably delightful mysteries of Rama, the esoteric as well as the exoteric doctrines of the Chronicles and Puranas, be all comprehended by you without any difficulty, and may your affection for Rama’s feet increase day by day. May every desire you form in your mind by the blessing of Hari be ever easy of attainment.” On hearing the saint’s benediction—mark me, O firm of faith—this solemo response of Brahma’s came from heaven: “May your words come to pass, O wisest of sages: he is my votary in thought, word and deed.’ When I heard the heavenly voice I rejoiced and was so drowned in love that all my doubts vanished. ‘After making humble petition I received the saint’s commands, and bowing again and again at his lotus feet I took my leave and arrived with joy at this hermitage, having obtained by my lord’s favour an inestimable boon. During my stay here mark me, king of the birds, seven and twenty cycles have elapsed. I incessantly repeat Rama’s praises, and the birds in their wisdom reverently listen. Whenever ‘Ragha-bir in behoof of his votaries takes upon him the form of a man at the city of Avadh, I go and stay at his capital and delight myself with the spectacle of the childish sports. - Again, cherishing in my heart the image of the child Rama, I return Garur, to my own cell. Ihave now told you the whole history of the reason for which I was changed into a crow and have replied, Sir, to all your questions. The efficacy of faith in Rama is truly marvellous.

Therefore I love this form, in which my devotion to Rama’s feet has been exhibited, in which I have been favoured with the sight of my lord and all my doubts have been removed. For my obstinacy in upholding the doctrine of faith I was cursed by the seer, but eventually I obtained a boon which even the saints find difficult: see the efficacy

sections.label: Doha 115
sections.name: -पुरुष त्यागि सक नारिहि जो बिरक्त मति धीर

verses.sa:
जे असि भगति जानि परिहरहीं ।
केवल ग्यान हेतु श्रम करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
je asi bhagati jāni pariharahīṃ
keval gyān hetu śram karahīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ते जड़ कामधेनु गृहँ त्यागी ।
खोजत आकु फिरहिं पय लागी ॥
verses.tr:
te jar̤ kāmadhenu gṛham̐ tyāgī
khojat āku phirahiṃ paya lāgī

verses.sa:
सुनु खगेस हरि भगति बिहाई ।
जे सुख चाहहिं आन उपाई ॥
verses.tr:
sunu khages hari bhagati bihāī
je sukh cāhahiṃ ān upāī

verses.sa:
ते सठ महासिंधु बिनु तरनी ।
पैरि पार चाहहिं जड़ करनी ॥
verses.tr:
te saṭh mahāsiṃdhu binu taranī
pairi pār cāhahiṃ jar̤ karanī

verses.sa:
सुनि भसुंडि के बचन भवानी ।
बोलेउ गरुड़ हरषि मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni bhasuṃḍi ke bacan bhavānī
boleu garur̤ haraṣi mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
तव प्रसाद प्रभु मम उर माहीं ।
संसय सोक मोह भ्रम नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tav prasād prabhu mam ur māhīṃ
saṃsaya sok moh bhram nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनेउँ पुनीत राम गुन ग्रामा ।
तुम्हरी कृपाँ लहेउँ बिश्रामा ॥
verses.tr:
suneum̐ punīt rām gun grāmā
tumharī kṛpām̐ laheum̐ biśrāmā

verses.sa:
एक बात प्रभु पूँछउँ तोही ।
कहहु बुझाइ कृपानिधि मोही ॥
verses.tr:
ek bāt prabhu pūm̐chaum̐ tohī
kahahu bujhāi kṛpānidhi mohī

verses.sa:
कहहिं संत मुनि बेद पुराना ।
नहिं कछु दुर्लभ ग्यान समाना ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ saṃt muni bed purānā
nahiṃ kachu durlabh gyān samānā

verses.sa:
सोइ मुनि तुम्ह सन कहेउ गोसाईं ।
नहिं आदरेहु भगति की नाईं ॥
verses.tr:
soi muni tumh san kaheu gosāīṃ
nahiṃ ādarehu bhagati kī nāīṃ

verses.sa:
ग्यानहि भगतिहि अंतर केता ।
सकल कहहु प्रभु कृपा निकेता ॥
verses.tr:
gyānahi bhagatihi aṃtar ketā
sakal kahahu prabhu kṛpā niketā

verses.sa:
सुनि उरगारि बचन सुख माना ।
सादर बोलेउ काग सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
suni uragāri bacan sukh mānā
sādar boleu kāg sujānā

verses.sa:
भगतिहि ग्यानहि नहिं कछु भेदा ।
उभय हरहिं भव संभव खेदा ॥
verses.tr:
bhagatihi gyānahi nahiṃ kachu bhedā
ubhaya harahiṃ bhav saṃbhav khedā

verses.sa:
नाथ मुनीस कहहिं कछु अंतर ।
सावधान सोउ सुनु बिहंगबर ॥
verses.tr:
nāth munīs kahahiṃ kachu aṃtar
sāvadhān sou sunu bihaṃgabar

verses.sa:
ग्यान बिराग जोग बिग्याना ।
ए सब पुरुष सुनहु हरिजाना ॥
verses.tr:
gyān birāg jog bigyānā
e sab puruṣ sunahu harijānā

verses.sa:
पुरुष प्रताप प्रबल सब भाँती ।
अबला अबल सहज जड़ जाती ॥
verses.tr:
puruṣ pratāp prabal sab bhām̐tī
abalā abal sahaj jar̤ jātī

verses.sa: -पुरुष त्यागि सक नारिहि जो बिरक्त मति धीर ॥
verses.tr: -puruṣ tyāgi sak nārihi jo birakt mati dhīr
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: न तु कामी बिषयाबस बिमुख जो पद रघुबीर ॥
verses.tr: na tu kāmī biṣayābas bimukh jo pad raghubīr

verses.sa:
सोउ मुनि ग्याननिधान मृगनयनी बिधु मुख निरखि ।
बिबस होइ हरिजान नारि बिष्नु माया प्रगट ॥
verses.tr:
sou muni gyānanidhān mṛganayanī bidhu mukh nirakhi
bibas hoi harijān nāri biṣnu māyā pragaṭ

trans: They who knowingly reject such devotion and labour merely for wisdom are fools, who would leave at home the cow of plenty and go out to look for dk plants to give them milk. Hearken, Garur: all who abandon the worship of Hari and seek to prosper by any other means are wretched blunderers who would try to swim across the ocean without a boat. On hearing Bhusundi’s speech, Bhavani, Garur was glad and said in gentle accents;: “By your favour, my lord, every doubt, anxiety, error and delusion has been removed from my breast. Though your clemency I have heard the holy tale of Rama's achievements and have gained peace. There is still one matter, Sir, about which I would ask; in your infinite compassion be pleased to enlighten me. The saints and sages, the Vedas and Pur^nas, all say there is nothing so difficult of attainment as wisdom. But the saint told you, father, that there is nothing so estimable as faith. Explain to me, most gracious lord, all the difference between faith and wisdom.” The sagacious crow was pleased to hear Garur’s question and courteously replied: There is no difference between faith and wisdom; both put an end to the troubles incident; to existence. There is no discrepancy, Sir, in the saint’s doctrine; give me your attention, O noblest of birds, while I explain the matter. Wisdom, asceticism, abstraction and science—mark me, Garur—are all mascaline. Now the masculine character is altogether strong, while the feminine is weak and naturally inferior.
The man who can forswear woman must be self-restrained and resolute; not a sensual voluptuary without any regard for Hari’s feet.
Even such a saint and philosopher, Garur, is distracted at the sight of a woman, with her fawn-like eyes and moon-bright face. Now creation’s bride is manifested as Maya,

sections.label: Doha 116
sections.name: यह रहस्य रघुनाथ कर बेगि न जानइ कोइ

verses.sa:
इहाँ न पच्छपात कछु राखउँ ।
बेद पुरान संत मत भाषउँ ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ na pacchapāt kachu rākhaum̐
bed purān saṃt mat bhāṣaum̐
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मोह न नारि नारि कें रूपा ।
पन्नगारि यह रीति अनूपा ॥
verses.tr:
moh na nāri nāri keṃ rūpā
pannagāri yah rīti anūpā

verses.sa:
माया भगति सुनहु तुम्ह दोऊ ।
नारि बर्ग जानइ सब कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
māyā bhagati sunahu tumh doū
nāri barg jānai sab koū

verses.sa:
पुनि रघुबीरहि भगति पिआरी ।
माया खलु नर्तकी बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
puni raghubīrahi bhagati piārī
māyā khalu nartakī bicārī

verses.sa:
भगतिहि सानुकूल रघुराया ।
ताते तेहि डरपति अति माया ॥
verses.tr:
bhagatihi sānukūl raghurāyā
tāte tehi ḍarapati ati māyā

verses.sa:
राम भगति निरुपम निरुपाधी ।
बसइ जासु उर सदा अबाधी ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagati nirupam nirupādhī
basai jāsu ur sadā abādhī

verses.sa:
तेहि बिलोकि माया सकुचाई ।
करि न सकइ कछु निज प्रभुताई ॥
verses.tr:
tehi biloki māyā sakucāī
kari na sakai kachu nij prabhutāī

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि जे मुनि बिग्यानी ।
जाचहीं भगति सकल सुख खानी ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri je muni bigyānī
jācahīṃ bhagati sakal sukh khānī

verses.sa:
यह रहस्य रघुनाथ कर बेगि न जानइ कोइ ।
जो जानइ रघुपति कृपाँ सपनेहुँ मोह न होइ ॥
verses.tr:
yah rahasya raghunāth kar begi na jānai koi
jo jānai raghupati kṛpām̐ sapanehum̐ moh na hoi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
औरउ ग्यान भगति कर भेद सुनहु सुप्रबीन ।
जो सुनि होइ राम पद प्रीति सदा अबिछीन ॥
verses.tr:
aurau gyān bhagati kar bhed sunahu suprabīn
jo suni hoi rām pad prīti sadā abichīn

trans: Here I maintain no private theory of my own. I only declare the doctrine of the Vedas, Purdnas and the saints. Delusion is not feminine, though of feminine appearance; this, Garur, is a strange proceeding. But observe; Maya and Faith are both of the feminine gender, as every one knows. Again, Faith is beloved of Rama, while he regards Maya as a mere dancing-girl. Rama being thus amiable to Faith, Maya is greatly afraid of her. Rama’s Faith is incomparable and illimitable, and he in whose heart she abides is ever blessed. Maya atthe sight of her is confounded and can do nothing of her own power. Knowing this, the most enlightened sages attest Faith to be the source of every blessing.

This mystery of Raghunath’s no one can grasp all at once; whoever, by his favour, does comprehend it is never even in sleep subject to any delusion. Further now, hearken with your best intelligence to the distinction between Wisdom and Faith, by the hearing of which is induced an imperishable devotion to Rama's feet.

sections.label: Doha 117
sections.name: जोग अगिनि करि प्रगट तब कर्म सुभासुभ लाइ

verses.sa:
सुनहु तात यह अकथ कहानी ।
समुझत बनइ न जाइ बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu tāt yah akath kahānī
samujhat banai na jāi bakhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ईस्वर अंस जीव अबिनासी ।
चेतन अमल सहज सुख रासी ॥
verses.tr:
īsvar aṃs jīv abināsī
cetan amal sahaj sukh rāsī

verses.sa:
सो मायाबस भयउ गोसाईं ।
बँध्यो कीर मरकट की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
so māyābas bhayau gosāīṃ
bam̐dhyo kīr marakaṭ kī nāī

verses.sa:
जड़ चेतनहि ग्रंथि परि गई ।
जदपि मृषा छूटत कठिनई ॥
verses.tr:
jar̤ cetanahi graṃthi pari gaī
jadapi mṛṣā chūṭat kaṭhinaī

verses.sa:
तब ते जीव भयउ संसारी ।
छूट न ग्रंथि न होइ सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
tab te jīv bhayau saṃsārī
chūṭ na graṃthi na hoi sukhārī

verses.sa:
श्रुति पुरान बहु कहेउ उपाई ।
छूट न अधिक अधिक अरुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
śruti purān bahu kaheu upāī
chūṭ na adhik adhik arujhāī

verses.sa:
जीव हृदयँ तम मोह बिसेषी ।
ग्रंथि छूट किमि परइ न देखी ॥
verses.tr:
jīv hṛdayam̐ tam moh biseṣī
graṃthi chūṭ kimi parai na dekhī

verses.sa:
अस संजोग ईस जब करई ।
तबहुँ कदाचित सो निरुअरई ॥
verses.tr:
as saṃjog īs jab karaī
tabahum̐ kadācit so niruaraī

verses.sa:
सात्त्विक श्रद्धा धेनु सुहाई ।
जौं हरि कृपाँ हृदयँ बस आई ॥
verses.tr:
sāttvik śraddhā dhenu suhāī
jauṃ hari kṛpām̐ hṛdayam̐ bas āī

verses.sa:
जप तप ब्रत जम नियम अपारा ।
जे श्रुति कह सुभ धर्म अचारा ॥
verses.tr:
jap tap brat jam niyam apārā
je śruti kah subh dharm acārā

verses.sa:
तेइ तृन हरित चरै जब गाई ।
भाव बच्छ सिसु पाइ पेन्हाई ॥
verses.tr:
tei tṛn harit carai jab gāī
bhāv bacch sisu pāi penhāī

verses.sa:
नोइ निबृत्ति पात्र बिस्वासा ।
निर्मल मन अहीर निज दासा ॥
verses.tr:
noi nibṛtti pātr bisvāsā
nirmal man ahīr nij dāsā

verses.sa:
परम धर्ममय पय दुहि भाई ।
अवटै अनल अकाम बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
param dharmamaya paya duhi bhāī
avaṭai anal akām banāī

verses.sa:
तोष मरुत तब छमाँ जुड़ावै ।
धृति सम जावनु देइ जमावै ॥
verses.tr:
toṣ marut tab chamām̐ jur̤āvai
dhṛti sam jāvanu dei jamāvai

verses.sa:
मुदिताँ मथैं बिचार मथानी ।
दम अधार रजु सत्य सुबानी ॥
verses.tr:
muditām̐ mathaiṃ bicār mathānī
dam adhār raju satya subānī

verses.sa:
तब मथि काढ़ि लेइ नवनीता ।
बिमल बिराग सुभग सुपुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
tab mathi kār̤hi lei navanītā
bimal birāg subhag supunītā

verses.sa:
जोग अगिनि करि प्रगट तब कर्म सुभासुभ लाइ ।
बुद्धि सिरावैं ग्यान घृत ममता मल जरि जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
jog agini kari pragaṭ tab karm subhāsubh lāi
buddhi sirāvaiṃ gyān ghṛt mamatā mal jari jāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
तब बिग्यानरूपिनि बुद्धि बिसद घृत पाइ ।
चित्त दिआ भरि धरै दृढ़ समता दिअटि बनाइ ॥
verses.tr:
tab bigyānarūpini buddhi bisad ghṛt pāi
citt diā bhari dharai dṛr̤h samatā diaṭi banāi

verses.sa:
तीनि अवस्था तीनि गुन तेहि कपास तें काढ़ि ।
तूल तुरीय सँवारि पुनि बाती करै सुगाढ़ि ॥
verses.tr:
tīni avasthā tīni gun tehi kapās teṃ kār̤hi
tūl turīya sam̐vāri puni bātī karai sugār̤hi

verses.sa: एहि बिधि लेसै दीप तेज रासि बिग्यानमय ॥
verses.tr: ehi bidhi lesai dīp tej rāsi bigyānamaya

verses.sa: जातहिं जासु समीप जरहिं मदादिक सलभ सब ॥
verses.tr: jātahiṃ jāsu samīp jarahiṃ madādik salabh sab

trans: Attend, my son, to this unutterable utterance, which is in truth incapable of expression though it may be mentally conceived. ‘the soul is a particle of the divinity, immortal, intelligent, pure and naturally, blissful. But, Sir, being overcome by May it is caught, as it were a parrot or monkey. The enfeebled intellect is bound with a knot, which though imaginary is difficult to untie. Thus the soul becomes worldly; there is no loosing the knot and it knows no happiness. The Vedas and Puranas have declared many remedies; but thereis no getting free, the entanyle-ment is rather increased. The interior of the soul is full of the darkness of delusion and it cannot see how the knot can be untied. When God brings about such a come-plication, escape is problematical. If by Hari’s favour a spirit of sincere piety like a beautiful cow comes and dwells in the heart, the prayers, penance and fasts and all the religious observances and acts of devotion which the Vedas have inculcated as meritorious practices are, as it were, a green pasture for thecow to graze in. The calf which fills her teats with milk is love; the heel-rope with which she is bound is the spirit of quietism, the milk bowl faith, and the herdsman who tends her a spotless soul. After drawing off the milk of sound religion, it is set to boil on the fire of continence. Forbearance then cools it with the breath of patience; and perseverance is the rennet that coagulates it into curds. Contentment is the maid who churaos it in the bow] of discretion, with self-restraint for the stick, and truth and good words for the cord. By suchchurning is produced the butter of pure, excellent and holy asceticism.

After kindling the flame of meditation and applying actions both good and bad, Intelligence allows the ghi of wisdom to cool, but burns all the scum of selfishness in the fire. Then Intelligence, master of highest wisdom, takes absolutely pure ght, and filling with itthe lamp of the soul sets it on the stand of equanimity. Then extract-ing from the cotton the soul's three conditions and the three properties, it works up the clean fibre of the fourth state and fashions it into an excellent candle.
In this manner is kindled a splendid torch of science and the gnat-like swarms of vanity and other vices on approaching it are consumed by it.;

sections.label: Doha 118
sections.name: तब फिरि जीव बिबिध बिधि पावइ संसृति क्लेस

verses.sa:
सोहमस्मि इति बृत्ति अखंडा ।
दीप सिखा सोइ परम प्रचंडा ॥
verses.tr:
sohamasmi iti bṛtti akhaṃḍā
dīp sikhā soi param pracaṃḍā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आतम अनुभव सुख सुप्रकासा ।
तब भव मूल भेद भ्रम नासा ॥
verses.tr:
ātam anubhav sukh suprakāsā
tab bhav mūl bhed bhram nāsā

verses.sa:
प्रबल अबिद्या कर परिवारा ।
मोह आदि तम मिटइ अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
prabal abidyā kar parivārā
moh ādi tam miṭai apārā

verses.sa:
तब सोइ बुद्धि पाइ उँजिआरा ।
उर गृहँ बैठि ग्रंथि निरुआरा ॥
verses.tr:
tab soi buddhi pāi um̐jiārā
ur gṛham̐ baiṭhi graṃthi niruārā

verses.sa:
छोरन ग्रंथि पाव जौं सोई ।
तब यह जीव कृतारथ होई ॥
verses.tr:
choran graṃthi pāv jauṃ soī
tab yah jīv kṛtārath hoī

verses.sa:
छोरत ग्रंथि जानि खगराया ।
बिघ्न अनेक करइ तब माया ॥
verses.tr:
chorat graṃthi jāni khagarāyā
bighn anek karai tab māyā

verses.sa:
रिद्धि सिद्धि प्रेरइ बहु भाई ।
बुद्धहि लोभ दिखावहिं आई ॥
verses.tr:
riddhi siddhi prerai bahu bhāī
buddhahi lobh dikhāvahiṃ āī

verses.sa:
कल बल छल करि जाहिं समीपा ।
अंचल बात बुझावहिं दीपा ॥
verses.tr:
kal bal chal kari jāhiṃ samīpā
aṃcal bāt bujhāvahiṃ dīpā

verses.sa:
होइ बुद्धि जौं परम सयानी ।
तिन्ह तन चितव न अनहित जानी ॥
verses.tr:
hoi buddhi jauṃ param sayānī
tinh tan citav na anahit jānī

verses.sa:
जौं तेहि बिघ्न बुद्धि नहिं बाधी ।
तौ बहोरि सुर करहिं उपाधी ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ tehi bighn buddhi nahiṃ bādhī
tau bahori sur karahiṃ upādhī

verses.sa:
इंद्रीं द्वार झरोखा नाना ।
तहँ तहँ सुर बैठे करि थाना ॥
verses.tr:
iṃdrīṃ dvār jharokhā nānā
taham̐ taham̐ sur baiṭhe kari thānā

verses.sa:
आवत देखहिं बिषय बयारी ।
ते हठि देही कपाट उघारी ॥
verses.tr:
āvat dekhahiṃ biṣaya bayārī
te haṭhi dehī kapāṭ ughārī

verses.sa:
जब सो प्रभंजन उर गृहँ जाई ।
तबहिं दीप बिग्यान बुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
jab so prabhaṃjan ur gṛham̐ jāī
tabahiṃ dīp bigyān bujhāī

verses.sa:
ग्रंथि न छूटि मिटा सो प्रकासा ।
बुद्धि बिकल भइ बिषय बतासा ॥
verses.tr:
graṃthi na chūṭi miṭā so prakāsā
buddhi bikal bhai biṣaya batāsā

verses.sa:
इंद्रिन्ह सुरन्ह न ग्यान सोहाई ।
बिषय भोग पर प्रीति सदाई ॥
verses.tr:
iṃdrinh suranh na gyān sohāī
biṣaya bhog par prīti sadāī

verses.sa:
बिषय समीर बुद्धि कृत भोरी ।
तेहि बिधि दीप को बार बहोरी ॥
verses.tr:
biṣaya samīr buddhi kṛt bhorī
tehi bidhi dīp ko bār bahorī

verses.sa:
तब फिरि जीव बिबिध बिधि पावइ संसृति क्लेस ।
हरि माया अति दुस्तर तरि न जाइ बिहगेस ॥
verses.tr:
tab phiri jīv bibidh bidhi pāvai saṃsṛti kles
hari māyā ati dustar tari na jāi bihages
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
कहत कठिन समुझत कठिन साधन कठिन बिबेक ।
होइ घुनाच्छर न्याय जौं पुनि प्रत्यूह अनेक ॥
verses.tr:
kahat kaṭhin samujhat kaṭhin sādhan kaṭhin bibek
hoi ghunācchar nyāya jauṃ puni pratyūh anek

trans: The unalterable persuasion of the identification of the soul with God is its pre-eminently brilliant flame, and ‘the happiness that results from this knowledge of self is the light it diffuses, by which it destroys the erroneous distinctions which are born of the world. Delusion and all the other forms of darkness that attend upon tyrant Ignorance are utterly dispersed. Thus (Intelligence having procured a light sits in the chamber of the heart and tries to loosen the knot; should he succeed in untying it, the soul obtains its object. But when Maya, O Garor, sees him loosening the knot, she creates many difficulties and sends forth. Sir, innumerable elves and fairies to excite his concupiscence. In some way or other, by force or by fraud, they get near and try to put out the lamp by a side puff. If Intelligence is altogether wise, he perceives their hostile intent and will not look at them. Should he escape free from this danger, the gods then proceed to attack him. The faculties of sense are so many portals, at each of which a god sits on guard. When they see any sensual air atir-ring, they at once throw the doors wide open. If the blast penetrates the chamber of the soul, it forthwith extinguishes the lamp of knowledge. When its light is put out, there is no untying the knot, for Intelligence is undone by this blast of sensuality. Neither the senses nor the gods approve of wisdom; they are always inclined to sensual enjoyment. When Intelligence has been thus fooled by the breath of sensuality, who can light the lamp again us before?

Then the soul is again subjected to all the manifold miseries of transmigration. O Garur, Hari’s delusive power is a trackless ocean that none can traverse. Wisdom is difficult to describe, difficult to understand, difficult to master, and if by any lucky chance a right judgment be formed, still many impediments block the way.

sections.label: Doha 119
sections.name: सेवक सेब्य भाव बिनु भव न तरिअ उरगारि

verses.sa:
ग्यान पंथ कृपान कै धारा ।
परत खगेस होइ नहिं बारा ॥
verses.tr:
gyān paṃth kṛpān kai dhārā
parat khages hoi nahiṃ bārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जो निर्बिघ्न पंथ निर्बहई ।
सो कैवल्य परम पद लहई ॥
verses.tr:
jo nirbighn paṃth nirbahaī
so kaivalya param pad lahaī

verses.sa:
अति दुर्लभ कैवल्य परम पद ।
संत पुरान निगम आगम बद ॥
verses.tr:
ati durlabh kaivalya param pad
saṃt purān nigam āgam bad

verses.sa:
राम भजत सोइ मुकुति गोसाई ।
अनइच्छित आवइ बरिआई ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhajat soi mukuti gosāī
anaicchit āvai bariāī

verses.sa:
जिमि थल बिनु जल रहि न सकाई ।
कोटि भाँति कोउ करै उपाई ॥
verses.tr:
jimi thal binu jal rahi na sakāī
koṭi bhām̐ti kou karai upāī

verses.sa:
तथा मोच्छ सुख सुनु खगराई ।
रहि न सकइ हरि भगति बिहाई ॥
verses.tr:
tathā mocch sukh sunu khagarāī
rahi na sakai hari bhagati bihāī

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि हरि भगत सयाने ।
मुक्ति निरादर भगति लुभाने ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri hari bhagat sayāne
mukti nirādar bhagati lubhāne

verses.sa:
भगति करत बिनु जतन प्रयासा ।
संसृति मूल अबिद्या नासा ॥
verses.tr:
bhagati karat binu jatan prayāsā
saṃsṛti mūl abidyā nāsā

verses.sa:
भोजन करिअ तृपिति हित लागी ।
जिमि सो असन पचवै जठरागी ॥
verses.tr:
bhojan karia tṛpiti hit lāgī
jimi so asan pacavai jaṭharāgī

verses.sa:
असि हरिभगति सुगम सुखदाई ।
को अस मूढ़ न जाहि सोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
asi haribhagati sugam sukhadāī
ko as mūr̤h na jāhi sohāī

verses.sa: सेवक सेब्य भाव बिनु भव न तरिअ उरगारि ॥
verses.tr: sevak sebya bhāv binu bhav na taria uragāri
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: भजहु राम पद पंकज अस सिद्धांत बिचारि ॥
verses.tr: bhajahu rām pad paṃkaj as siddhāṃt bicāri

verses.sa:
जो चेतन कहँ ज़ड़ करइ ज़ड़हि करइ चैतन्य ।
अस समर्थ रघुनायकहिं भजहिं जीव ते धन्य ॥
verses.tr:
jo cetan kaham̐ zar̤ karai zar̤ahi karai caitanya
as samarth raghunāyakahiṃ bhajahiṃ jīv te dhanya

trans: The pith of wisdom is like the edge of a scimitar; for those who full on it, Garur, there is no escape. It any tras verse the path in spite of its difficulty, they attain to the supreme sphere of beatitude. But this exalted felicity is immensely hard of attainment, as is declared by the saints, the Puranas, the Vedas and all the Scriptures. By the worship of Rama, Sir, salvation comes freely of its own accord. As water cannot stay without some eupport, however much you may try to make it; in like manner, mark me, Garur, the joy of final salvation cannot be secured without the worship of Hari. The wisest of Hari’s worshippers know this, and thinking lightly of the soul's deliverance from the body crave rather for faith. By faith, without any trouble or difficulty, the ignorance that arises from mundane existence is utterly abolished. Eating is for the sake of satiety, but it is the heat of the belly that digests what is eaten; in like manner.the worship of Hari gives immediate relief. A man must be a fool indeed who does not delight in it. Dohd 116.

Except by the good favour of the worshipped, it is not possible, Garur, for any worshipper to escape from existence; worship then the lotus feet of Rama, knowing this to be the end of all theology. With Raghunath is the power to make the!living dead and the dead alive; blessed are the souls that worship him.

sections.label: Doha 120
sections.name: ब्रह्म पयोनिधि मंदर ग्यान संत सुर आहिं

verses.sa:
कहेउँ ग्यान सिद्धांत बुझाई ।
सुनहु भगति मनि कै प्रभुताई ॥
verses.tr:
kaheum̐ gyān siddhāṃt bujhāī
sunahu bhagati mani kai prabhutāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम भगति चिंतामनि सुंदर ।
बसइ गरुड़ जाके उर अंतर ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagati ciṃtāmani suṃdar
basai garur̤ jāke ur aṃtar

verses.sa:
परम प्रकास रूप दिन राती ।
नहिं कछु चहिअ दिआ घृत बाती ॥
verses.tr:
param prakās rūp din rātī
nahiṃ kachu cahia diā ghṛt bātī

verses.sa:
मोह दरिद्र निकट नहिं आवा ।
लोभ बात नहिं ताहि बुझावा ॥
verses.tr:
moh daridr nikaṭ nahiṃ āvā
lobh bāt nahiṃ tāhi bujhāvā

verses.sa:
प्रबल अबिद्या तम मिटि जाई ।
हारहिं सकल सलभ समुदाई ॥
verses.tr:
prabal abidyā tam miṭi jāī
hārahiṃ sakal salabh samudāī

verses.sa:
खल कामादि निकट नहिं जाहीं ।
बसइ भगति जाके उर माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
khal kāmādi nikaṭ nahiṃ jāhīṃ
basai bhagati jāke ur māhīṃ

verses.sa:
गरल सुधासम अरि हित होई ।
तेहि मनि बिनु सुख पाव न कोई ॥
verses.tr:
garal sudhāsam ari hit hoī
tehi mani binu sukh pāv na koī

verses.sa:
ब्यापहिं मानस रोग न भारी ।
जिन्ह के बस सब जीव दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
byāpahiṃ mānas rog na bhārī
jinh ke bas sab jīv dukhārī

verses.sa:
राम भगति मनि उर बस जाकें ।
दुख लवलेस न सपनेहुँ ताकें ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagati mani ur bas jākeṃ
dukh lavales na sapanehum̐ tākeṃ

verses.sa:
चतुर सिरोमनि तेइ जग माहीं ।
जे मनि लागि सुजतन कराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
catur siromani tei jag māhīṃ
je mani lāgi sujatan karāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सो मनि जदपि प्रगट जग अहई ।
राम कृपा बिनु नहिं कोउ लहई ॥
verses.tr:
so mani jadapi pragaṭ jag ahaī
rām kṛpā binu nahiṃ kou lahaī

verses.sa:
सुगम उपाय पाइबे केरे ।
नर हतभाग्य देहिं भटमेरे ॥
verses.tr:
sugam upāya pāibe kere
nar hatabhāgya dehiṃ bhaṭamere

verses.sa:
पावन पर्बत बेद पुराना ।
राम कथा रुचिराकर नाना ॥
verses.tr:
pāvan parbat bed purānā
rām kathā rucirākar nānā

verses.sa:
मर्मी सज्जन सुमति कुदारी ।
ग्यान बिराग नयन उरगारी ॥
verses.tr:
marmī sajjan sumati kudārī
gyān birāg nayan uragārī

verses.sa:
भाव सहित खोजइ जो प्रानी ।
पाव भगति मनि सब सुख खानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhāv sahit khojai jo prānī
pāv bhagati mani sab sukh khānī

verses.sa:
मोरें मन प्रभु अस बिस्वासा ।
राम ते अधिक राम कर दासा ॥
verses.tr:
moreṃ man prabhu as bisvāsā
rām te adhik rām kar dāsā

verses.sa:
राम सिंधु घन सज्जन धीरा ।
चंदन तरु हरि संत समीरा ॥
verses.tr:
rām siṃdhu ghan sajjan dhīrā
caṃdan taru hari saṃt samīrā

verses.sa:
सब कर फल हरि भगति सुहाई ।
सो बिनु संत न काहूँ पाई ॥
verses.tr:
sab kar phal hari bhagati suhāī
so binu saṃt na kāhūm̐ pāī

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि जोइ कर सतसंगा ।
राम भगति तेहि सुलभ बिहंगा ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri joi kar satasaṃgā
rām bhagati tehi sulabh bihaṃgā

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म पयोनिधि मंदर ग्यान संत सुर आहिं ।
कथा सुधा मथि काढ़हिं भगति मधुरता जाहिं ॥
verses.tr:
brahm payonidhi maṃdar gyān saṃt sur āhiṃ
kathā sudhā mathi kār̤hahiṃ bhagati madhuratā jāhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
बिरति चर्म असि ग्यान मद लोभ मोह रिपु मारि ।
जय पाइअ सो हरि भगति देखु खगेस बिचारि ॥
verses.tr:
birati carm asi gyān mad lobh moh ripu māri
jaya pāia so hari bhagati dekhu khages bicāri

trans: I have thus stated and expounded the theory of Science; hear now the virtue of the jewel Faith. Faithino Rama is a glorious philosopher’s stone; in whose-ever heart it dwells, Garur, there night and day is an infinite splendour, a lamp that never requires to be fed with oil. Delusion and poverty come not near; no blast of covetousness ever extinguishes it. The gloom of overpowering ignorance is dispersed; the swarms of gnats are all destroyed. Neither vile lust nor any other vice approaches the soul in which faith abides. It changes poison to ambrosia, enemies to friends, and without this Jewel no one can attain to happiness. Those grievous mental diseases, by the influence of which all living creatures are rendered miserable, have no effect upon him’ in whose heart is the jewel of Faith; not even in a dream can he feel the slightest atom of pain. They are truly paragons of wisdom in the world who labour persistently to secure this jewel. Though it be revealed on earth, without Rama’s grace none can find it. There is an easy device for finding it, but luckless wights go on wrangling. The Vedas and Puranas are the holy mountain, the legends of Rama its many glorious mines: the pious are the discoverers, and good counsel is their pick-axe, while wisdom and asceticism Garur, are their eyes, Any creature who searches with: will can find the jewel, faith;in itself a mine of every blessing. Ihave in my mind persuasion of this, Sir, that one of Rama's servants is greater than Rama himself. Rama is the sea, the good and pious are the rain-clouds. Hari is the sandal-tree and the saints are the winds that diffuse its perfume. Faith in Hari is a delight and the crown of all desire, but it cannot be had without the saints. ‘Any one, Garur, who understands this and communes with the saints will find faith in Rama easy of attainment.

The Supreme Spirit is the ocean, wisdom is mount Mandara and the saints are the gods, while the sacred legends are the nectar which they churn out having faith for its sweetness. Again, self-control is the shield, and wisdom the sword, with which faith in Hari slays his enemies, Pride, Greed and Delusion, and wins the victory; take thought, O king of the birds, and see if it be not-so,””

sections.label: Doha 121
sections.name: एक ब्याधि बस नर मरहिं ए असाधि बहु ब्याधि

verses.sa:
पुनि सप्रेम बोलेउ खगराऊ ।
जौं कृपाल मोहि ऊपर भाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
puni saprem boleu khagarāū
jauṃ kṛpāl mohi ūpar bhāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाथ मोहि निज सेवक जानी ।
सप्त प्रस्न कहहु बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
nāth mohi nij sevak jānī
sapt prasn kahahu bakhānī

verses.sa:
प्रथमहिं कहहु नाथ मतिधीरा ।
सब ते दुर्लभ कवन सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
prathamahiṃ kahahu nāth matidhīrā
sab te durlabh kavan sarīrā

verses.sa:
बड़ दुख कवन कवन सुख भारी ।
सोउ संछेपहिं कहहु बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
bar̤ dukh kavan kavan sukh bhārī
sou saṃchepahiṃ kahahu bicārī

verses.sa:
संत असंत मरम तुम्ह जानहु ।
तिन्ह कर सहज सुभाव बखानहु ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt asaṃt maram tumh jānahu
tinh kar sahaj subhāv bakhānahu

verses.sa:
कवन पुन्य श्रुति बिदित बिसाला ।
कहहु कवन अघ परम कराला ॥
verses.tr:
kavan punya śruti bidit bisālā
kahahu kavan agh param karālā

verses.sa:
मानस रोग कहहु समुझाई ।
तुम्ह सर्बग्य कृपा अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
mānas rog kahahu samujhāī
tumh sarbagya kṛpā adhikāī

verses.sa:
तात सुनहु सादर अति प्रीती ।
मैं संछेप कहउँ यह नीती ॥
verses.tr:
tāt sunahu sādar ati prītī
maiṃ saṃchep kahaum̐ yah nītī

verses.sa:
नर तन सम नहिं कवनिउ देही ।
जीव चराचर जाचत तेही ॥
verses.tr:
nar tan sam nahiṃ kavaniu dehī
jīv carācar jācat tehī

verses.sa:
नरग स्वर्ग अपबर्ग निसेनी ।
ग्यान बिराग भगति सुभ देनी ॥
verses.tr:
narag svarg apabarg nisenī
gyān birāg bhagati subh denī

verses.sa:
सो तनु धरि हरि भजहिं न जे नर ।
होहिं बिषय रत मंद मंद तर ॥
verses.tr:
so tanu dhari hari bhajahiṃ na je nar
hohiṃ biṣaya rat maṃd maṃd tar

verses.sa:
काँच किरिच बदलें ते लेही ।
कर ते डारि परस मनि देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kām̐c kiric badaleṃ te lehī
kar te ḍāri paras mani dehīṃ

verses.sa:
नहिं दरिद्र सम दुख जग माहीं ।
संत मिलन सम सुख जग नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ daridr sam dukh jag māhīṃ
saṃt milan sam sukh jag nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
पर उपकार बचन मन काया ।
संत सहज सुभाउ खगराया ॥
verses.tr:
par upakār bacan man kāyā
saṃt sahaj subhāu khagarāyā

verses.sa:
संत सहहिं दुख परहित लागी ।
परदुख हेतु असंत अभागी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt sahahiṃ dukh parahit lāgī
paradukh hetu asaṃt abhāgī

verses.sa:
भूर्ज तरू सम संत कृपाला ।
परहित निति सह बिपति बिसाला ॥
verses.tr:
bhūrj tarū sam saṃt kṛpālā
parahit niti sah bipati bisālā

verses.sa:
सन इव खल पर बंधन करई ।
खाल कढ़ाइ बिपति सहि मरई ॥
verses.tr:
san iv khal par baṃdhan karaī
khāl kar̤hāi bipati sahi maraī

verses.sa:
खल बिनु स्वारथ पर अपकारी ।
अहि मूषक इव सुनु उरगारी ॥
verses.tr:
khal binu svārath par apakārī
ahi mūṣak iv sunu uragārī

verses.sa:
पर संपदा बिनासि नसाहीं ।
जिमि ससि हति हिम उपल बिलाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
par saṃpadā bināsi nasāhīṃ
jimi sasi hati him upal bilāhīṃ

verses.sa:
दुष्ट उदय जग आरति हेतू ।
जथा प्रसिद्ध अधम ग्रह केतू ॥
verses.tr:
duṣṭ udaya jag ārati hetū
jathā prasiddh adham grah ketū

verses.sa:
संत उदय संतत सुखकारी ।
बिस्व सुखद जिमि इंदु तमारी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt udaya saṃtat sukhakārī
bisv sukhad jimi iṃdu tamārī

verses.sa:
परम धर्म श्रुति बिदित अहिंसा ।
पर निंदा सम अघ न गरीसा ॥
verses.tr:
param dharm śruti bidit ahiṃsā
par niṃdā sam agh na garīsā

verses.sa:
हर गुर निंदक दादुर होई ।
जन्म सहस्त्र पाव तन सोई ॥
verses.tr:
har gur niṃdak dādur hoī
janm sahastr pāv tan soī

verses.sa:
द्विज निंदक बहु नरक भोग करि ।
जग जनमइ बायस सरीर धरि ॥
verses.tr:
dvij niṃdak bahu narak bhog kari
jag janamai bāyas sarīr dhari

verses.sa:
सुर श्रुति निंदक जे अभिमानी ।
रौरव नरक परहिं ते प्रानी ॥
verses.tr:
sur śruti niṃdak je abhimānī
raurav narak parahiṃ te prānī

verses.sa:
होहिं उलूक संत निंदा रत ।
मोह निसा प्रिय ग्यान भानु गत ॥
verses.tr:
hohiṃ ulūk saṃt niṃdā rat
moh nisā priya gyān bhānu gat

verses.sa:
सब के निंदा जे जड़ करहीं ।
ते चमगादुर होइ अवतरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sab ke niṃdā je jar̤ karahīṃ
te camagādur hoi avatarahīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनहु तात अब मानस रोगा ।
जिन्ह ते दुख पावहिं सब लोगा ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu tāt ab mānas rogā
jinh te dukh pāvahiṃ sab logā

verses.sa:
मोह सकल ब्याधिन्ह कर मूला ।
तिन्ह ते पुनि उपजहिं बहु सूला ॥
verses.tr:
moh sakal byādhinh kar mūlā
tinh te puni upajahiṃ bahu sūlā

verses.sa:
काम बात कफ लोभ अपारा ।
क्रोध पित्त नित छाती जारा ॥
verses.tr:
kām bāt kaph lobh apārā
krodh pitt nit chātī jārā

verses.sa:
प्रीति करहिं जौं तीनिउ भाई ।
उपजइ सन्यपात दुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
prīti karahiṃ jauṃ tīniu bhāī
upajai sanyapāt dukhadāī

verses.sa:
बिषय मनोरथ दुर्गम नाना ।
ते सब सूल नाम को जाना ॥
verses.tr:
biṣaya manorath durgam nānā
te sab sūl nām ko jānā

verses.sa:
ममता दादु कंडु इरषाई ।
हरष बिषाद गरह बहुताई ॥
verses.tr:
mamatā dādu kaṃḍu iraṣāī
haraṣ biṣād garah bahutāī

verses.sa:
पर सुख देखि जरनि सोइ छई ।
कुष्ट दुष्टता मन कुटिलई ॥
verses.tr:
par sukh dekhi jarani soi chaī
kuṣṭ duṣṭatā man kuṭilaī

verses.sa:
अहंकार अति दुखद डमरुआ ।
दंभ कपट मद मान नेहरुआ ॥
verses.tr:
ahaṃkār ati dukhad ḍamaruā
daṃbh kapaṭ mad mān neharuā

verses.sa:
तृस्ना उदरबृद्धि अति भारी ।
त्रिबिध ईषना तरुन तिजारी ॥
verses.tr:
tṛsnā udarabṛddhi ati bhārī
tribidh īṣanā tarun tijārī

verses.sa:
जुग बिधि ज्वर मत्सर अबिबेका ।
कहँ लागि कहौं कुरोग अनेका ॥
verses.tr:
jug bidhi jvar matsar abibekā
kaham̐ lāgi kahauṃ kurog anekā

verses.sa:
एक ब्याधि बस नर मरहिं ए असाधि बहु ब्याधि ।
पीड़हिं संतत जीव कहुँ सो किमि लहै समाधि ॥
verses.tr:
ek byādhi bas nar marahiṃ e asādhi bahu byādhi
pīr̤ahiṃ saṃtat jīv kahum̐ so kimi lahai samādhi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
नेम धर्म आचार तप ग्यान जग्य जप दान ।
भेषज पुनि कोटिन्ह नहिं रोग जाहिं हरिजान ॥
verses.tr:
nem dharm ācār tap gyān jagya jap dān
bheṣaj puni koṭinh nahiṃ rog jāhiṃ harijān

trans: Garur asked further in loving tones: “Since, my lord, you are pleased to be gracious to me, acknowledge me as your disciple and resolve me these seven questions. ‘Tell me first, O staunchest of the faithful, what form is the most difficult of all to obtain. Next consider and explain briefly what is the greatest pain and the highest pleasure. Tell me also the essential characteristics both of the good and of the evil, for this is a secret you understand. Tell me further what is the highest religious merit as made known in the Scriptures, and what the most awful sin. In your infinite wisdom and supreme compassion explain to me also the diseases of the soul.” ‘Listen, my son, with the greatest reverence and devotion, while I briefly expound this scheme of doctrine. The human form is the most excellent of all, and the desire of every living creature, whether moving or motionless. It is the ladder that connects hell and heaven and final emancipation and is the bestower of the blessings of wisdom, continence and faith. Men who have attained to this form and yet do not worship Hari show themselves, in their infatuation for the world, greater fools than any fool living, clutching at bits of glass while they throw away the philosopher's stone which they had in their hands. There is no pain in the world so great as poverty and no pleasure like that which results from communion with the saints. It is an essential characteristic of the good,

Garur, to be charitable to others, in thought, word and in deed. The good take pains lo help their neighbours, but wicked wretches to trouble them. The good in their compassionateness resemble the birch tree and constantly submit to the greatest distress in order to benefit others. The wicked, like the hemp, have their skin flayed off and perish in agony, merely to supply cords to bind people. Observe, Garor; the wicked do mischief, even when they have no object of their own to gain. like a serpent or a rat. They would kill themselves to rain another’s prosperity, like the hail which dissolves after destroying the crops. The rising of the wicked is as much a cause of calamity to the world as that of the famous planet Ketu ix known to be. The rise of the good is ever prodnetive of happiness, as when the moon rejoices the world by scattering the darkness, The highest religious merit as declared in the Scriptures is to do no harm toany creature; and there is no sin so heinous as the abuse of another. He who abuses Hari or his Guru becomes a frog and is born a thousand times in that form. He who abusesa Brahman, after suffering in many Hells, will be born into the world in the form of a crow. They who have the presumption to abuse the gods or the Scriptures will fall into the hell called Ksurava. They who delight to abuse the saints will be changed into owls, as loving the night of error and hating the sun of knowledge. The fools who abuse every one will be born again as bats, Hearken now, my son, to the diseases of the soul from which all people suffer pain. De- Jusion of the root of all ailments and from these again spring many pains. The flatulence of lust, the phlegm of insatiable greed, and the bile of passion constantly inflame the breast, and when these three combine, Sir, there results a miserable paralysis of the whole system. Who can tell the names of ul] the disease represented by the various obstinate sensual cravings Sach are the leprosy of selfish ness, the itch of envy, the rheumatic throbs of joy and sorrow, the consumption that barns at the sight of another’s prosperity, the horrible open sore of a malignant spirit, the excraciating gout of egoism, the sciatica of heresy, hypocrisy, vanity and pride, the terrible leprosy of greed, the violent tertian agne of the three kinds of
AT 1 Vhe bark of which is employed as paper and for other useful purposes and after being torn cf the tree ia again renewed, i
covetousness, the two fevers of jealousy and indisorimina-tion; but why continue the interminable list of diseases?

A man dies even of one disease; but these incurable diseases which constantly harass the soul are many in number, how then can it find rest? Pious and religious observances penance, meditation, sacrifice, prayer and almsgiving are so many different remedies;2 but the disease, Garur, does not abate.

sections.label: Doha 122
sections.name: उबारि मथें घृत होइ बरु सिकता ते बरु तेल

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सकल जीव जग रोगी ।
सोक हरष भय प्रीति बियोगी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sakal jīv jag rogī
sok haraṣ bhaya prīti biyogī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मानक रोग कछुक मैं गाए ।
हहिं सब कें लखि बिरलेन्ह पाए ॥
verses.tr:
mānak rog kachuk maiṃ gāe
hahiṃ sab keṃ lakhi biralenh pāe

verses.sa:
जाने ते छीजहिं कछु पापी ।
नास न पावहिं जन परितापी ॥
verses.tr:
jāne te chījahiṃ kachu pāpī
nās na pāvahiṃ jan paritāpī

verses.sa:
बिषय कुपथ्य पाइ अंकुरे ।
मुनिहु हृदयँ का नर बापुरे ॥
verses.tr:
biṣaya kupathya pāi aṃkure
munihu hṛdayam̐ kā nar bāpure

verses.sa:
राम कृपाँ नासहि सब रोगा ।
जौं एहि भाँति बनै संयोगा ॥
verses.tr:
rām kṛpām̐ nāsahi sab rogā
jauṃ ehi bhām̐ti banai saṃyogā

verses.sa:
सदगुर बैद बचन बिस्वासा ।
संजम यह न बिषय कै आसा ॥
verses.tr:
sadagur baid bacan bisvāsā
saṃjam yah na biṣaya kai āsā

verses.sa:
रघुपति भगति सजीवन मूरी ।
अनूपान श्रद्धा मति पूरी ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati bhagati sajīvan mūrī
anūpān śraddhā mati pūrī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि भलेहिं सो रोग नसाहीं ।
नाहिं त जतन कोटि नहिं जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi bhalehiṃ so rog nasāhīṃ
nāhiṃ ta jatan koṭi nahiṃ jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
जानिअ तब मन बिरुज गोसाँई ।
जब उर बल बिराग अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
jānia tab man biruj gosām̐ī
jab ur bal birāg adhikāī

verses.sa:
सुमति छुधा बाढ़इ नित नई ।
बिषय आस दुर्बलता गई ॥
verses.tr:
sumati chudhā bār̤hai nit naī
biṣaya ās durbalatā gaī

verses.sa:
बिमल ग्यान जल जब सो नहाई ।
तब रह राम भगति उर छाई ॥
verses.tr:
bimal gyān jal jab so nahāī
tab rah rām bhagati ur chāī

verses.sa:
सिव अज सुक सनकादिक नारद ।
जे मुनि ब्रह्म बिचार बिसारद ॥
verses.tr:
siv aj suk sanakādik nārad
je muni brahm bicār bisārad

verses.sa:
सब कर मत खगनायक एहा ।
करिअ राम पद पंकज नेहा ॥
verses.tr:
sab kar mat khaganāyak ehā
karia rām pad paṃkaj nehā

verses.sa:
श्रुति पुरान सब ग्रंथ कहाहीं ।
रघुपति भगति बिना सुख नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
śruti purān sab graṃth kahāhīṃ
raghupati bhagati binā sukh nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
कमठ पीठ जामहिं बरु बारा ।
बंध्या सुत बरु काहुहि मारा ॥
verses.tr:
kamaṭh pīṭh jāmahiṃ baru bārā
baṃdhyā sut baru kāhuhi mārā

verses.sa:
फूलहिं नभ बरु बहुबिधि फूला ।
जीव न लह सुख हरि प्रतिकूला ॥
verses.tr:
phūlahiṃ nabh baru bahubidhi phūlā
jīv na lah sukh hari pratikūlā

verses.sa:
तृषा जाइ बरु मृगजल पाना ।
बरु जामहिं सस सीस बिषाना ॥
verses.tr:
tṛṣā jāi baru mṛgajal pānā
baru jāmahiṃ sas sīs biṣānā

verses.sa:
अंधकारु बरु रबिहि नसावै ।
राम बिमुख न जीव सुख पावै ॥
verses.tr:
aṃdhakāru baru rabihi nasāvai
rām bimukh na jīv sukh pāvai

verses.sa:
हिम ते अनल प्रगट बरु होई ।
बिमुख राम सुख पाव न कोई ॥
verses.tr:
him te anal pragaṭ baru hoī
bimukh rām sukh pāv na koī

verses.sa:
उबारि मथें घृत होइ बरु सिकता ते बरु तेल ।
बिनु हरि भजन न भव तरिअ यह सिद्धांत अपेल ॥
verses.tr:
ubāri matheṃ ghṛt hoi baru sikatā te baru tel
binu hari bhajan na bhav taria yah siddhāṃt apel
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
मसकहि करइ बिंरंचि प्रभु अजहि मसक ते हीन ।
अस बिचारि तजि संसय रामहि भजहिं प्रबीन ॥
verses.tr:
masakahi karai biṃraṃci prabhu ajahi masak te hīn
as bicāri taji saṃsaya rāmahi bhajahiṃ prabīn

trans: Thus every creature in the world is diseased, destracted alternately by sorrow and joy, by fear and love. I have mentioned only some of the diseases of the soul; they touch every one, but few only detect them. On detection the wretches diminish somewhat, but these tormentors of the faithful are not completely destroyed. They spring up even in the soul of a saint, if fed on the unwholesome diet of materialism; how much more in that of an ordinary man? By the grace of Rama every disease is extirpated, if the treatment is conducted in the following manner, with a holy teacher for physician, faith for a prescription, contempt of the world for regimen, devotion to Hari for life giving drug and a soul toll of faith for the vehicle in which it is administered. By this treatment the disease is easily subdued: otherwise all your efforts go for nothing. You may know, Sir. that the mind is free from disease assoon as it gains strength in self-control, with a daily increasing appetite for good resolations and disappearance of the weakness of material hopes. After bathing in the pure stream of divine knowledge, the whole soul is suffused with faith in Rama. This, O king of the birds, is the doctrine of Siva, Brahma, Sukadeva, Sanat-Kumdra, Narad and all the sages, who have been eminent in theological xpeculation; ‘Practise devotion to Rama's lotus feet.’ The Vedas and Puranas and all the Scriptures declare that without faith in Rama there is no happiness. It would be easier for water to stay on the back of a tortoise, or for the son of a childless woman to be slain, or for flowers of every description to bloom in the uir,than for any creature to be happy in opposition to Hari. Sooner shall thirst be satisfied by drinking of a mirage, or horns sprout on the head of a hare, or darkness extinguish the sun, than any creature finds happiness if he has Rama against him. Sooner shall fire appear out of ice than any one oppose Rama and yet find happiness.

Sooner shall butter be produced by churning water, or oi come out of sand, than the ocean of existence be traversed without prayer to Hari: this is an indisputable conclusion. The Lord can change a gnat into Brahma, or make Brahma himself even less than a gnat. A wise man will consider this and discard 4]! doubt and worship Rama.

sections.label: Doha 123
sections.name: आजु धन्य मैं धन्य अति जद्यपि सब बिधि हीन

verses.sa:
विनिच्श्रितं वदामि ते न अन्यथा वचांसि मे ।
हरिं नरा भजन्ति येऽतिदुस्तरं तरन्ति ते ॥
verses.tr:
vinicśritaṃ vadāmi te na anyathā vacāṃsi me
hariṃ narā bhajanti ye'tidustaraṃ taranti te
verses.head: श्लोक

verses.sa:
कहेउँ नाथ हरि चरित अनूपा ।
ब्यास समास स्वमति अनुरुपा ॥
verses.tr:
kaheum̐ nāth hari carit anūpā
byās samās svamati anurupā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
श्रुति सिद्धांत इहइ उरगारी ।
राम भजिअ सब काज बिसारी ॥
verses.tr:
śruti siddhāṃt ihai uragārī
rām bhajia sab kāj bisārī

verses.sa:
प्रभु रघुपति तजि सेइअ काही ।
मोहि से सठ पर ममता जाही ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu raghupati taji seia kāhī
mohi se saṭh par mamatā jāhī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह बिग्यानरूप नहिं मोहा ।
नाथ कीन्हि मो पर अति छोहा ॥
verses.tr:
tumh bigyānarūp nahiṃ mohā
nāth kīnhi mo par ati chohā

verses.sa:
पूछिहुँ राम कथा अति पावनि ।
सुक सनकादि संभु मन भावनि ॥
verses.tr:
pūchihum̐ rām kathā ati pāvani
suk sanakādi saṃbhu man bhāvani

verses.sa:
सत संगति दुर्लभ संसारा ।
निमिष दंड भरि एकउ बारा ॥
verses.tr:
sat saṃgati durlabh saṃsārā
nimiṣ daṃḍ bhari ekau bārā

verses.sa:
देखु गरुड़ निज हृदयँ बिचारी ।
मैं रघुबीर भजन अधिकारी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhu garur̤ nij hṛdayam̐ bicārī
maiṃ raghubīr bhajan adhikārī

verses.sa:
सकुनाधम सब भाँति अपावन ।
प्रभु मोहि कीन्ह बिदित जग पावन ॥
verses.tr:
sakunādham sab bhām̐ti apāvan
prabhu mohi kīnh bidit jag pāvan

verses.sa:
आजु धन्य मैं धन्य अति जद्यपि सब बिधि हीन ।
निज जन जानि राम मोहि संत समागम दीन ॥
verses.tr:
āju dhanya maiṃ dhanya ati jadyapi sab bidhi hīn
nij jan jāni rām mohi saṃt samāgam dīn
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
नाथ जथामति भाषेउँ राखेउँ नहिं कछु गोइ ।
चरित सिंधु रघुनायक थाह कि पावइ कोइ ॥
verses.tr:
nāth jathāmati bhāṣeum̐ rākheum̐ nahiṃ kachu goi
carit siṃdhu raghunāyak thāh ki pāvai koi

trans: I declare to you as an established truth, and I have nothing to say asagainst it, that they who worship Hari can alone traverse the impassable. Chaupdi.:

I have told you, my lord, Hari’s unparalleled achievements, in full or io brief as my ability served me, and this Garur, is the crowning dogma of the Scriptures to abandon sensuality and worship Rama Whom else can you serve if you forsake the Lord Raghupati, who was compas: sionute even to such a wretch as myself.. You are wisdom itself and superior to delusion, but you showed me, my. lord, a great kindness in that you asked me for Rama’s history, which is so holy that it delights the soul even of Sukadeva and Sanat-Kumdra and Sambhu. The company of the good is hard to get in the world, even for once only
THE SEQUEL 63h

and for a single moment. See, Garur, and consider for yourself; I am now a master in the worship of Raghu-bir; though I was the vilest of birds and in every way abominable, the Lord has made me famous as a purifier of the world.

Blessed, blessed indeed am [ to-day notwithstandiny my meanness; for Rama _ has acknowledged me as one of his own servants and has admitted me to the communion of the saints. I have spoken, my lord, according to my ability and have concealed ‘nothing; but Rama's doings are a very ocean; who can find the bottom of them?”

sections.label: Doha 124
sections.name: जासु नाम भव भेषज हरन घोर त्रय सूल

verses.sa:
सुमिरि राम के गुन गन नाना ।
पुनि पुनि हरष भुसुंडि सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
sumiri rām ke gun gan nānā
puni puni haraṣ bhusuṃḍi sujānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
महिमा निगम नेति करि गाई ।
अतुलित बल प्रताप प्रभुताई ॥
verses.tr:
mahimā nigam neti kari gāī
atulit bal pratāp prabhutāī

verses.sa:
सिव अज पूज्य चरन रघुराई ।
मो पर कृपा परम मृदुलाई ॥
verses.tr:
siv aj pūjya caran raghurāī
mo par kṛpā param mṛdulāī

verses.sa:
अस सुभाउ कहुँ सुनउँ न देखउँ ।
केहि खगेस रघुपति सम लेखउँ ॥
verses.tr:
as subhāu kahum̐ sunaum̐ na dekhaum̐
kehi khages raghupati sam lekhaum̐

verses.sa:
साधक सिद्ध बिमुक्त उदासी ।
कबि कोबिद कृतग्य संन्यासी ॥
verses.tr:
sādhak siddh bimukt udāsī
kabi kobid kṛtagya saṃnyāsī

verses.sa:
जोगी सूर सुतापस ग्यानी ।
धर्म निरत पंडित बिग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
jogī sūr sutāpas gyānī
dharm nirat paṃḍit bigyānī

verses.sa:
तरहिं न बिनु सेएँ मम स्वामी ।
राम नमामि नमामि नमामी ॥
verses.tr:
tarahiṃ na binu seem̐ mam svāmī
rām namāmi namāmi namāmī

verses.sa:
सरन गएँ मो से अघ रासी ।
होहिं सुद्ध नमामि अबिनासी ॥
verses.tr:
saran gaem̐ mo se agh rāsī
hohiṃ suddh namāmi abināsī

verses.sa:
जासु नाम भव भेषज हरन घोर त्रय सूल ।
सो कृपालु मोहि तो पर सदा रहउ अनुकूल ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu nām bhav bheṣaj haran ghor traya sūl
so kṛpālu mohi to par sadā rahau anukūl
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
सुनि भुसुंडि के बचन सुभ देखि राम पद नेह ।
बोलेउ प्रेम सहित गिरा गरुड़ बिगत संदेह ॥
verses.tr:
suni bhusuṃḍi ke bacan subh dekhi rām pad neh
boleu prem sahit girā garur̤ bigat saṃdeh

trans: As he pondered on Rama’s manifold perfections, the all-wise Bhusundi was yet more and more enraptored. “He, whose greatness the Scriptures have declared to be unutterable, whose might and majesty and dominion are unbounded, whose feet are adored by Siva, and Brahma, even he Raghu-rai, has in his infinite compassion shown favour to me. Never have I seen or heard of such benignity; to whom, O Garur, can I compare Rama? Miracle-working saints, deified anchorites, inspired bards and rigid ascetics, spiritaalists, doctors, self-mortified divines and the wisest and most religious of philosophers, can none of them escape but by serving my lord; again and again and yet again I bow myself betore Rama. I worship the Immortal, with whom all who take refuge are sanctified, though even guiltier than I.

He whose name isan elixir of life, the healer of every kind of trouble, may he in his mercy remain ever gracious both to me and to thee.” Hearing Bhusundi’s words and perceiving his admirable devotion to Rama’s feet, Garur replied in loving tones and with every doubt at an end:

sections.label: Doha 125
sections.name: तासु चरन सिरु नाइ करि प्रेम सहित मतिधीर

verses.sa:
मै कृत्कृत्य भयउँ तव बानी ।
सुनि रघुबीर भगति रस सानी ॥
verses.tr:
mai kṛtkṛtya bhayaum̐ tav bānī
suni raghubīr bhagati ras sānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम चरन नूतन रति भई ।
माया जनित बिपति सब गई ॥
verses.tr:
rām caran nūtan rati bhaī
māyā janit bipati sab gaī

verses.sa:
मोह जलधि बोहित तुम्ह भए ।
मो कहँ नाथ बिबिध सुख दए ॥
verses.tr:
moh jaladhi bohit tumh bhae
mo kaham̐ nāth bibidh sukh dae

verses.sa:
मो पहिं होइ न प्रति उपकारा ।
बंदउँ तव पद बारहिं बारा ॥
verses.tr:
mo pahiṃ hoi na prati upakārā
baṃdaum̐ tav pad bārahiṃ bārā

verses.sa:
पूरन काम राम अनुरागी ।
तुम्ह सम तात न कोउ बड़भागी ॥
verses.tr:
pūran kām rām anurāgī
tumh sam tāt na kou bar̤abhāgī

verses.sa:
संत बिटप सरिता गिरि धरनी ।
पर हित हेतु सबन्ह कै करनी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt biṭap saritā giri dharanī
par hit hetu sabanh kai karanī

verses.sa:
संत हृदय नवनीत समाना ।
कहा कबिन्ह परि कहै न जाना ॥
verses.tr:
saṃt hṛdaya navanīt samānā
kahā kabinh pari kahai na jānā

verses.sa:
निज परिताप द्रवइ नवनीता ।
पर दुख द्रवहिं संत सुपुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
nij paritāp dravai navanītā
par dukh dravahiṃ saṃt supunītā

verses.sa:
जीवन जन्म सुफल मम भयऊ ।
तव प्रसाद संसय सब गयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jīvan janm suphal mam bhayaū
tav prasād saṃsaya sab gayaū

verses.sa:
जानेहु सदा मोहि निज किंकर ।
पुनि पुनि उमा कहइ बिहंगबर ॥
verses.tr:
jānehu sadā mohi nij kiṃkar
puni puni umā kahai bihaṃgabar

verses.sa:
तासु चरन सिरु नाइ करि प्रेम सहित मतिधीर ।
गयउ गरुड़ बैकुंठ तब हृदयँ राखि रघुबीर ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu caran siru nāi kari prem sahit matidhīr
gayau garur̤ baikuṃṭh tab hṛdayam̐ rākhi raghubīr
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
गिरिजा संत समागम सम न लाभ कछु आन ।
बिनु हरि कृपा न होइ सो गावहिं बेद पुरान ॥
verses.tr:
girijā saṃt samāgam sam na lābh kachu ān
binu hari kṛpā na hoi so gāvahiṃ bed purān

trans: « By your discourse I have attained my end, now that I have Learnt the delectable doctrine of faith in Rama. My love to his feet increases ever more and more, and the trouble created by May is clean gone. You have been my raft in the sea of delusion and have bestowed on me, my lord, the most exquisite delight. I can in no way requite you; but again and again I prostrate myself at your feet. Full to overflowing with love for Rama you are so blessed, Sire,

that none can equal you. Saints, trees, rivers, mountains and the earth, all operate for the good of others. The heart of the saints is like butter; so the poets say, but they say not well; for butter melts when itself is tried by the fire, but the saints are so good that they melt at others’ trials..Now has my life become worth living, for by your favour my doubts have disappeared Regard me ever a8 your servant.” Again and again, O Uma, thus spake the noblest of birds.

After affectionately bowing his head at his feet, Garur proceeded to Vaikanth, with K&ms’s image impressed upon his heart. O Girije, there isno blessing like that of communion with the saints: it is attainable only by Hari's grace; so the Vedas and Puranas declare.

sections.label: Doha 126
sections.name: मुनि दुर्लभ हरि भगति नर पावहिं बिनहिं प्रयास

verses.sa:
कहेउँ परम पुनीत इतिहासा ।
सुनत श्रवन छूटहिं भव पासा ॥
verses.tr:
kaheum̐ param punīt itihāsā
sunat śravan chūṭahiṃ bhav pāsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रनत कल्पतरु करुना पुंजा ।
उपजइ प्रीति राम पद कंजा ॥
verses.tr:
pranat kalpataru karunā puṃjā
upajai prīti rām pad kaṃjā

verses.sa:
मन क्रम बचन जनित अघ जाई ।
सुनहिं जे कथा श्रवन मन लाई ॥
verses.tr:
man kram bacan janit agh jāī
sunahiṃ je kathā śravan man lāī

verses.sa:
तीर्थाटन साधन समुदाई ।
जोग बिराग ग्यान निपुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
tīrthāṭan sādhan samudāī
jog birāg gyān nipunāī

verses.sa:
नाना कर्म धर्म ब्रत दाना ।
संजम दम जप तप मख नाना ॥
verses.tr:
nānā karm dharm brat dānā
saṃjam dam jap tap makh nānā

verses.sa:
भूत दया द्विज गुर सेवकाई ।
बिद्या बिनय बिबेक बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhūt dayā dvij gur sevakāī
bidyā binaya bibek bar̤āī

verses.sa:
जहँ लगि साधन बेद बखानी ।
सब कर फल हरि भगति भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ lagi sādhan bed bakhānī
sab kar phal hari bhagati bhavānī

verses.sa:
सो रघुनाथ भगति श्रुति गाई ।
राम कृपाँ काहूँ एक पाई ॥
verses.tr:
so raghunāth bhagati śruti gāī
rām kṛpām̐ kāhūm̐ ek pāī

verses.sa:
मुनि दुर्लभ हरि भगति नर पावहिं बिनहिं प्रयास ।
जे यह कथा निरंतर सुनहिं मानि बिस्वास ॥
verses.tr:
muni durlabh hari bhagati nar pāvahiṃ binahiṃ prayās
je yah kathā niraṃtar sunahiṃ māni bisvās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I have now finished the all-holy history, by the hearing of which the bonds of existence are loosened, a very tree of Paradise abounding in mercies for all who approach it and stimulating a devotion to RAma's lotus feet. Sins engen-dered of thought, word and deed are all] absolved in those who listen attentively to this legend. Pilgrimages to shrines, recourse to all the means of grace, meditation, self-control, perfection in wisdom, works of religious merit, devotional practices, fasting and almsgiving, continence, temperanes, prayer, penance and manifold sacrifices, tender-heartedness to all living creatures, ministering to Brahmans and Gurus, learning, morality and exalted intelligence, in short all the forms of discipline, which the Vedas have recommended. have but one aim, Bhavani, viz., devotion to Rama. Te such devotion—as the Scriptures describe it—soarce any has attained and then only by Rama's favour.
But though the patriarchs found it scarce attainable

sections.label: Doha 127
sections.name: सो कुल धन्य उमा सुनु जगत पूज्य सुपुनीत

verses.sa:
सोइ सर्बग्य गुनी सोइ ग्याता ।
सोइ महि मंडित पंडित दाता ॥
verses.tr:
soi sarbagya gunī soi gyātā
soi mahi maṃḍit paṃḍit dātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
धर्म परायन सोइ कुल त्राता ।
राम चरन जा कर मन राता ॥
verses.tr:
dharm parāyan soi kul trātā
rām caran jā kar man rātā

verses.sa:
नीति निपुन सोइ परम सयाना ।
श्रुति सिद्धांत नीक तेहिं जाना ॥
verses.tr:
nīti nipun soi param sayānā
śruti siddhāṃt nīk tehiṃ jānā

verses.sa:
सोइ कबि कोबिद सोइ रनधीरा ।
जो छल छाड़ि भजइ रघुबीरा ॥
verses.tr:
soi kabi kobid soi ranadhīrā
jo chal chār̤i bhajai raghubīrā

verses.sa:
धन्य देस सो जहँ सुरसरी ।
धन्य नारि पतिब्रत अनुसरी ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya des so jaham̐ surasarī
dhanya nāri patibrat anusarī

verses.sa:
धन्य सो भूपु नीति जो करई ।
धन्य सो द्विज निज धर्म न टरई ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya so bhūpu nīti jo karaī
dhanya so dvij nij dharm na ṭaraī

verses.sa:
सो धन धन्य प्रथम गति जाकी ।
धन्य पुन्य रत मति सोइ पाकी ॥
verses.tr:
so dhan dhanya pratham gati jākī
dhanya punya rat mati soi pākī

verses.sa:
धन्य घरी सोइ जब सतसंगा ।
धन्य जन्म द्विज भगति अभंगा ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya gharī soi jab satasaṃgā
dhanya janm dvij bhagati abhaṃgā

verses.sa:
सो कुल धन्य उमा सुनु जगत पूज्य सुपुनीत ।
श्रीरघुबीर परायन जेहिं नर उपज बिनीत ॥
verses.tr:
so kul dhanya umā sunu jagat pūjya supunīt
śrīraghubīr parāyan jehiṃ nar upaj binīt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: any one cap now easily acquire it, by the repeated hearing, of this history, if only he believes,

He is all-wise, he is un accomplished soholar, he is re nowned throughout the world for learning and beneficence he is truly pious and his Kinsfolk’s saviour, whose soul i enamoured of Rama's feet. He is perfect in morality and supremely intelligent; he has a thorough understanding of scriptural doctrine; he isan inspired bard and a man of fixed purpose, who without hypocrisy worships Raghubir. Blessed is the land where the Ganges flows; blessed is the wife who is faithful to her husband; blessed is the king who governs justly; blessed is the Brahman who swerves not from his duty; blessed is the wealth which is used to the best advantage; blessed is the creed which most conduces to works of piety; blessed is the hour which brings communion with the saints; blessed is the life which is staunch in devotion to the twice-born.
Blessed is the family, yea—mark me, Uma—worthy of veneration throughout the world and truly holy, in which is born a humble worshipper of the divine Raghubir.

sections.label: Doha 128
sections.name: राम चरन रति जो चह अथवा पद निर्बान

verses.sa:
मति अनुरूप कथा मैं भाषी ।
जद्यपि प्रथम गुप्त करि राखी ॥
verses.tr:
mati anurūp kathā maiṃ bhāṣī
jadyapi pratham gupt kari rākhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तव मन प्रीति देखि अधिकाई ।
तब मैं रघुपति कथा सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
tav man prīti dekhi adhikāī
tab maiṃ raghupati kathā sunāī

verses.sa:
यह न कहिअ सठही हठसीलहि ।
जो मन लाइ न सुन हरि लीलहि ॥
verses.tr:
yah na kahia saṭhahī haṭhasīlahi
jo man lāi na sun hari līlahi

verses.sa:
कहिअ न लोभिहि क्रोधहि कामिहि ।
जो न भजइ सचराचर स्वामिहि ॥
verses.tr:
kahia na lobhihi krodhahi kāmihi
jo na bhajai sacarācar svāmihi

verses.sa:
द्विज द्रोहिहि न सुनाइअ कबहूँ ।
सुरपति सरिस होइ नृप जबहूँ ॥
verses.tr:
dvij drohihi na sunāia kabahūm̐
surapati saris hoi nṛp jabahūm̐

verses.sa:
राम कथा के तेइ अधिकारी ।
जिन्ह कें सतसंगति अति प्यारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām kathā ke tei adhikārī
jinh keṃ satasaṃgati ati pyārī

verses.sa:
गुर पद प्रीति नीति रत जेई ।
द्विज सेवक अधिकारी तेई ॥
verses.tr:
gur pad prīti nīti rat jeī
dvij sevak adhikārī teī

verses.sa:
ता कहँ यह बिसेष सुखदाई ।
जाहि प्रानप्रिय श्रीरघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
tā kaham̐ yah biseṣ sukhadāī
jāhi prānapriya śrīraghurāī

verses.sa:
राम चरन रति जो चह अथवा पद निर्बान ।
भाव सहित सो यह कथा करउ श्रवन पुट पान ॥
verses.tr:
rām caran rati jo cah athavā pad nirbān
bhāv sahit so yah kathā karau śravan puṭ pān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Though at first I kept it secret, I have now to the best of my ability told you the whole story. I saw the extreme devotion of your soul, and it is for this reason that I have declared to you Rama’s history. It is not to be repeated to any perverse wretch, who will not give his mind to understand the tale of Hari’s sportive manifestations, nor to any covetous, choleric or sensual person, who worships not the lord of all animate and inanimate creation. Neither must it ever be told to a persecator of the Brahmans, even should he be as great a king as Indra. They are fit for instruction in Rama’s history, who dearly love the communion of the saints, who have a great affection for the feet of their Guru and the precepts of morality and are submissive to the Brahmans: these are fit recipients. But he will derive a special delight from it who loves Rama as he loves his own life.
Whoever wishes to love Rama's feet or to attain to final deliverance should devoutly fill the pitchers of his ears with the water of this legend.

sections.label: Doha 129
sections.name: मैं कृतकृत्य भइउँ अब तव प्रसाद बिस्वेस

verses.sa:
राम कथा गिरिजा मैं बरनी ।
कलि मल समनि मनोमल हरनी ॥
verses.tr:
rām kathā girijā maiṃ baranī
kali mal samani manomal haranī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
संसृति रोग सजीवन मूरी ।
राम कथा गावहिं श्रुति सूरी ॥
verses.tr:
saṃsṛti rog sajīvan mūrī
rām kathā gāvahiṃ śruti sūrī

verses.sa:
एहि महँ रुचिर सप्त सोपाना ।
रघुपति भगति केर पंथाना ॥
verses.tr:
ehi maham̐ rucir sapt sopānā
raghupati bhagati ker paṃthānā

verses.sa:
अति हरि कृपा जाहि पर होई ।
पाउँ देइ एहिं मारग सोई ॥
verses.tr:
ati hari kṛpā jāhi par hoī
pāum̐ dei ehiṃ mārag soī

verses.sa:
मन कामना सिद्धि नर पावा ।
जे यह कथा कपट तजि गावा ॥
verses.tr:
man kāmanā siddhi nar pāvā
je yah kathā kapaṭ taji gāvā

verses.sa:
कहहिं सुनहिं अनुमोदन करहीं ।
ते गोपद इव भवनिधि तरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ sunahiṃ anumodan karahīṃ
te gopad iv bhavanidhi tarahīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि सब कथा हृदयँ अति भाई ।
गिरिजा बोली गिरा सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
suni sab kathā hṛdayam̐ ati bhāī
girijā bolī girā suhāī

verses.sa:
नाथ कृपाँ मम गत संदेहा ।
राम चरन उपजेउ नव नेहा ॥
verses.tr:
nāth kṛpām̐ mam gat saṃdehā
rām caran upajeu nav nehā

verses.sa:
मैं कृतकृत्य भइउँ अब तव प्रसाद बिस्वेस ।
उपजी राम भगति दृढ़ बीते सकल कलेस ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ kṛtakṛtya bhaium̐ ab tav prasād bisves
upajī rām bhagati dṛr̤h bīte sakal kales
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The story of Rama, asI have now told it you, O Uma, has power to subdue the impurity of this evil age and to remove all the impurities of the soul. It is a healing remedy for every disease of life, as is declared by those learned in the Veda. It has seven beautiful ghats, being so many steps towards faith in him. Only he to whom Hari shows special favour can set his feet on this road. They who guilelessly recite this history obtain success in everything their soul desires. They who hear, or repeat and gladly assent to it, traverse the depths of existence as they would a mere puddle.” Uma was greatly pleased to have heard the whole history and cried in joyous tones: ** By my lord’s favour my doubts have been dispelled, and my love for RAma's feet has sprang up anew.
Through your grace, O lord of the universe, I have now attained my desire; a firm faith in Rama has resulted and all my troubles are at an end.”

sections.label: Doha 130
sections.name: मो सम दीन न दीन हित तुम्ह समान रघुबीर

verses.sa:
यह सुभ संभु उमा संबादा ।
सुख संपादन समन बिषादा ॥
verses.tr:
yah subh saṃbhu umā saṃbādā
sukh saṃpādan saman biṣādā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भव भंजन गंजन संदेहा ।
जन रंजन सज्जन प्रिय एहा ॥
verses.tr:
bhav bhaṃjan gaṃjan saṃdehā
jan raṃjan sajjan priya ehā

verses.sa:
राम उपासक जे जग माहीं ।
एहि सम प्रिय तिन्ह कें कछु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām upāsak je jag māhīṃ
ehi sam priya tinh keṃ kachu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
रघुपति कृपाँ जथामति गावा ।
मैं यह पावन चरित सुहावा ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati kṛpām̐ jathāmati gāvā
maiṃ yah pāvan carit suhāvā

verses.sa:
एहिं कलिकाल न साधन दूजा ।
जोग जग्य जप तप ब्रत पूजा ॥
verses.tr:
ehiṃ kalikāl na sādhan dūjā
jog jagya jap tap brat pūjā

verses.sa:
रामहि सुमिरिअ गाइअ रामहि ।
संतत सुनिअ राम गुन ग्रामहि ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi sumiria gāia rāmahi
saṃtat sunia rām gun grāmahi

verses.sa:
जासु पतित पावन बड़ बाना ।
गावहिं कबि श्रुति संत पुराना ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu patit pāvan bar̤ bānā
gāvahiṃ kabi śruti saṃt purānā

verses.sa:
ताहि भजहि मन तजि कुटिलाई ।
राम भजें गति केहिं नहिं पाई ॥
verses.tr:
tāhi bhajahi man taji kuṭilāī
rām bhajeṃ gati kehiṃ nahiṃ pāī

verses.sa:
पाई न केहिं गति पतित पावन राम भजि सुनु सठ मना ।
गनिका अजामिल ब्याध गीध गजादि खल तारे घना ॥
verses.tr:
pāī na kehiṃ gati patit pāvan rām bhaji sunu saṭh manā
ganikā ajāmil byādh gīdh gajādi khal tāre ghanā
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
आभीर जमन किरात खस स्वपचादि अति अघरूप जे ।
कहि नाम बारक तेपि पावन होहिं राम नमामि ते ॥
verses.tr:
ābhīr jaman kirāt khas svapacādi ati agharūp je
kahi nām bārak tepi pāvan hohiṃ rām namāmi te

verses.sa:
रघुबंस भूषन चरित यह नर कहहिं सुनहिं जे गावहीं ।
कलि मल मनोमल धोइ बिनु श्रम राम धाम सिधावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
raghubaṃs bhūṣan carit yah nar kahahiṃ sunahiṃ je gāvahīṃ
kali mal manomal dhoi binu śram rām dhām sidhāvahīṃ

verses.sa:
सत पंच चौपाई मनोहर जानि जो नर उर धरै ।
दारुन अबिद्या पंच जनित बिकार श्री रघुबर हरै ॥
verses.tr:
sat paṃc caupāī manohar jāni jo nar ur dharai
