dārun abidyā paṃc janit bikār śrī raghubar harai

verses.sa:
सुंदर सुजान कृपा निधान अनाथ पर कर प्रीति जो ।
सो एक राम अकाम हित निर्बानप्रद सम आन को ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar sujān kṛpā nidhān anāth par kar prīti jo
so ek rām akām hit nirbānaprad sam ān ko

verses.sa:
जाकी कृपा लवलेस ते मतिमंद तुलसीदासहूँ ।
पायो परम बिश्रामु राम समान प्रभु नाहीं कहूँ ॥
verses.tr:
jākī kṛpā lavales te matimaṃd tulasīdāsahūm̐
pāyo param biśrāmu rām samān prabhu nāhīṃ kahūm̐

verses.sa:
मो सम दीन न दीन हित तुम्ह समान रघुबीर ।
अस बिचारि रघुबंस मनि हरहु बिषम भव भीर ॥
verses.tr:
mo sam dīn na dīn hit tumh samān raghubīr
as bicāri raghubaṃs mani harahu biṣam bhav bhīr
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa:
कामिहि नारि पिआरि जिमि लोभिहि प्रिय जिमि दाम ।
तिमि रघुनाथ निरंतर प्रिय लागहु मोहि राम ॥
verses.tr:
kāmihi nāri piāri jimi lobhihi priya jimi dām
timi raghunāth niraṃtar priya lāgahu mohi rām

trans: This glorious dialogue between Sambhu and Uma is fruitfal in blessings and destructive of sorrow; it breaks the bonds of existence, refutes scepticism; delights the believer and is dear to all good men; there is nothing in the world equally dear to a worshipper of Rama. By Raghupati's favour I have sung to the best of my ability his holy and gracious deeds. In this the last age of the world there is no other means of salvation, neither abstraction, sacrifice, prayer, penance, the paying of vows, nor religious ceremonial. Think only of Rama, sing only of Rama, give ear only to Rama’s infinite perfections. Let the soul give over its perversity and worship him whose special characteristic it is to sanctify the fallen, asis declared by saints and seers, by Veda and Puranas: is there any one who has worshipped Rama and not found salvation?

Hearken, O dull of soul; is there any creature who has worshipped Rama, the purifier of the fallen, and not found salvation The wretches whom he has redeemed are countless, such as the harlots Pingale and Ajamil, the huntsman Valmiki, the vulture Jateyu and the elephant. An Abhir, a foreigner, a Kirat, a Khasia, are an outcast, embodiments of pollution as they are purified if they but once repeat his name; O Rama, I adore thee. Any one who reads, or hears, or recites this history of the glorious son of Raghu washes out the stains of the world and the stains of his own soul and without any trouble goes straight to Rama’s sphere in heaven. Any one who, appreciating their beauty, learns by heart five or six stanzas is delivered by the blessed Raghubir from all the disturbances created by the five over whose councils the monster Ignorance presides. Rama, alone is all-beautiful, all-wise, full of compassion and of loving-kindness for the destitute, disinterested in his benevolence and the bestower of final deliverance; whom else can I desire There is no other lord like Rama, by whose favour, however, slight, even I, the dull-witted Tulsi Das, have found perfect peace.

There is no one so poor as a am and no one g0 gracious to the poor as you, O Raghu-bir: remember this, O glory of the race of Raghu, and rid me of the grievous burden of existence. Asa lovor loves his mistress and asa miser loves his money, so for ever and ever may Rama be beloved by me.

sections.label: Closing verses
sections.name: पुण्यं पापहरं सदा शिवकरं विज्ञानभक्तिप्रदं

verses.sa:
यत्पूर्वं प्रभुणा कृतं सुकविना श्रीशम्भुना दुर्गमं ।
श्रीमद्रामपदाब्जभक्तिमनिशं प्राप्त्यै तु रामायणम् ।
मत्वा तद्रघुनाथनामनिरतं स्वान्तस्तमःशान्तये ।
भाषाबद्धमिदं चकार तुलसीदासस्तथा मानसम् ॥
verses.tr:
yatpūrvaṃ prabhuṇā kṛtaṃ sukavinā śrīśambhunā durgamaṃ
śrīmadrāmapadābjabhaktimaniśaṃ prāptyai tu rāmāyaṇam
matvā tadraghunāthanāmanirataṃ svāntastamaḥśāntaye
bhāṣābaddhamidaṃ cakāra tulasīdāsastathā mānasam
verses.head: श्लोक

verses.sa:
पुण्यं पापहरं सदा शिवकरं विज्ञानभक्तिप्रदं ।
मायामोहमलापहं सुविमलं प्रेमाम्बुपूरं शुभम् ।
श्रीमद्रामचरित्रमानसमिदं भक्त्यावगाहन्ति ये ।
ते संसारपतङ्गघोरकिरणैर्दह्यन्ति नो मानवाः ॥
verses.tr:
puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ sadā śivakaraṃ vijñānabhaktipradaṃ
māyāmohamalāpahaṃ suvimalaṃ premāmbupūraṃ śubham
śrīmadrāmacaritramānasamidaṃ bhaktyāvagāhanti ye
te saṃsārapataṅgaghorakiraṇairdahyanti no mānavāḥ
verses.head: श्लोक
